entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 1] You’re A Hero, Too!
entry.content:
Chiaki has come up with the ultimate outfit design. However, the design elements are difficult to reproduce as an idol outfit. In order to think over once more what a hero is, he heads over to the amusement park. This story is connected to the card [Ray of Hope] Chiaki Morisawa. Story Release Date: July 25, 2021
Characters
Writer
Yuumasu
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
ryuseipuka
Chapter 1
Season: ES 1st Year, Autumn
Location: StarPro Office
Bam! Thank you for waiting, Anzu! Morisawa Chiaki is here in all his glory…☆ “I’m sorry to make you come all the way here”? Don’t sweat it! Aren’t we on good terms? Anyhow, let’s get to the main topic. We’re here to talk about my personalized outfit, right? Fuhahaha! I’m finally next! I’ve been eagerly waiting for the day when you’d call for my turn!
…You bet that I’d want an outfit in a hero-like style? Heh-heh-heh… I see that you’re interested to know what design I’ve thought up. This right here! — is the ultimate vision of my personalized outfit! ☆
…Mm? Why do you look so troubled?
I drew the design to make it visually understandable, but… It seems as though it had the opposite effect, huh? The head piece is a helmet which covers the whole face. I took visibility into account, so I made the face shield bigger. The part dangling from the neck is a scarf. It’s two meters long. Imagining it flowing in the wind fires up my heart…♪
…Mm? You don’t think it’s possible to implement this design? Why do you say that, Anzu!? Nobody will be able to see my face with the helmet on, and the scarf might get tangled up while dancing…? Now that you mention it, I suppose that’s true…
Then what about the gears attached to both arms!? They glow in seven different colors to the beat of the song! ☆ …It likely won’t be possible with the budget we have? Mm~…
(Well, this puts me in a bind… I didn’t think my design would get rejected, so I’m not sure where to go from here…) (But I’m just an idol — and I know she, as a producer, knows what she’s talking about.) (I suppose I’d best follow along here…)
…Yeah, you’re exactly right, Anzu. I was only focused on making my ideals a reality, without considering much of anything else.
Alright, let’s scrap this design entirely! Fuhaha, there’s no need to feel sorry. I won’t lose heart to something like this! I’ll show you that I can come up with an even better design…☆ Mm? I think someone’s here… Ooh, Hero-kun! Hello there! (waves)
Hello there, you two. Anzu-san, I’m happy to see you here. A part of this outfit got loose, so I brought it over in hopes of asking someone to fix it. …You can fix it right away? Mhm, then I’ll wait right here. Hm, were the two of you in the middle of discussing outfit designs? Is this one for Ryuseitai?
Ah, no. This is meant to be my personalized outfit.
Ooh, your individuality really shines through. It truly feels like a special outfit of its own. I’m excited to see the final version.
Thank you, but this is a rejected design. I was hoping for a hero-style outfit, but I found out it isn’t suitable for an idol… It’s not easy to come up with outfit designs. I have to applaud Anzu for having made so many outfits thus far.
“Hero”… Chiaki-senpai, you seem to be very fixated over this “hero”. But what is a hero? I asked Aira about it once, but he didn’t provide me with a clear answer.
“What is a hero,” huh? That almost sounds like a subtitle for a movie. I’ll gladly teach you! “A hero is a cool being who helps the vulnerable”…☆
Hm… Martial artists also help those who are vulnerable. Are martial artists also heroes?
Hmm… You could call that a hero, but what I’m thinking of is a little different from that. But hrm, how do I convey that to you… It’s something you have to feel, rather than think about… Oh, I know! Hero-kun, why don’t you and I go to an amusement park? Seeing is believing, after all! It’ll be easier to understand if you were to see it with your own two eyes.
Do heroes live in that “amusement park” place? Mhm, please do take me there. I’ll finally be able to know what a hero is. I’m so happy…♪
Location: Amusement Park
A few days later…
So this is the amusement park… There are building structures I would never find in my hometown. How intriguing.
Ahh… This is your very first time coming to an amusement park, Hero-kun?
Mhm. I asked Aira to teach me all about it before visiting, though. Apparently, there are various kinds of games here. I’m interested in the one where you ride a horse. It’s been a while since I last went horseback riding. I thought that people in the city don’t ride horses, but it seems like I was wrong!
Ah, do you mean the merry-go-round? Can that really be called horseback riding…? Mmm~…
…Anzu, why’re you tugging on my clothes? “We should head over to the show”? You’re right. The hero show’s starting soon. Hero-kun, over here!
Mhm. I’m following you!
Anzu, thank you for accompanying us today. …“Is it alright for me to be here”? Fuhaha, of course it is. Everyone needs a break, be it a hero, idol, or producer! I’d like you to give yourself a break today. Your job may be important, but you still have the right to rest all the same…♪
During the final act of the hero show…
—Ah! Chiaki-senpai, the hero’s transformation has worn off. And the villain is only getting stronger… He’ll lose at this rate!
Don’t panic. The most important thing is to hold an unyielding heart that never stops believing. Those who believe in the hero make him stronger! Hang in there! Don’t lose now, Hero! C’mon, you two! Let’s cheer with the kids!
…Mhm. Hang in there, Hero! Stand back up!
Fuhahahaha! ☆ Keep at it! Defeat never suits a hero! (Oooh, the hero suit looks even cooler than it did earlier! That’s impressive… The suit could still evolve even further…!)
(No matter the predicament they fall in, a hero will always be able to stand up for what they believe in. They can get stronger and stronger…) (Ahh, right… That’s why I—…)
Chapter 2
After the hero show…
That was really interesting! So that’s what it means to be a hero! A person who never loses heart no matter the hardship — Who only grows stronger for someone else’s sake… I see what you mean now about heroes and martial artists; they may have a few differences.
Fuhaha! It makes me so happy to see you learn the charm of heroes, Hero-kun! However, that was only the tip of the iceberg. The more you learn about heroes, the more you’ll grow fond of them. Their history runs deep, y’know! I’ll hold a tokusatsu marathon party in Seisoukan Dorm sometime! I’d love to show you my tokusatsu DVD collection…☆
Mhm! I’m looking forward to it. By the way, what are we going to do now? The hero show is over…
We’re in an amusement park, so let’s enjoy some attractions! Hero-kun, is there anything that piques your interest? Did you still want to try the merry-go-round?
That would be nice, but I’m also curious about the screams I’ve been hearing. What is that spiral-shaped object over there?
That’s a roller coaster. It’s a thrill ride that travels over the rails at high speed, and makes people enjoy the sensation of fear.
Sensation of fear…? Why would people want to experience something fearsome? I’d love to find out the reason. Anzu-san, Chiaki-senpai, let’s ride this so-called “roller coaster”!
A while later…
(I didn’t think we’d go spinning in a teacup right after the roller coaster ride…) (Both Anzu and Hero-kun seem fine, so I have to act composed. Hang in there, my semicircular canals…!)1
Fufu, both of those attractions were so interesting! It’s as Aira said; this is the land of dreams. Chiaki-senpai, I’d like to experience that one next.
A-Ah, sure—
(—Wait, a haunted house…!?)
So there are not only heroes here, but ghosts too? I’m excited to see what sort of ghosts I’ll meet. ♪
…………
What’s wrong, Chiaki-senpai?
Ah— No… Haha. Sorry, I’m just a little tired. I think I’ll go rest on that bench over there, so how about the two of you go to the haunted house?
I’ll accompany you if you’d like to take a break first. I want to enjoy the attractions with all three of us.
I appreciate the thought, but it’s alright. There are many other attractions here, after all. Go ahead and try this one out with Anzu.
Hm… Alright then. Let’s go, Anzu-san.
…They’re gone. Whew… (I wasn’t lying about not feeling well, but it’s still so pathetic of me to stay behind…)
(…Mm?) Anzu… Why are you here…? Where’s Hero-kun? You told him to go to the haunted house alone? …You came back because you couldn’t leave me on my own when I seemed unwell? You even bought me cold water… Thank you.
…Haha, I’m so pathetic. I’m making you take care of me even now… When this whole time, I was hoping to give you a chance to rest and forget about work for a while…
…This has nothing to do with work? You came back because you were worried for me? No matter who the person may be, you’d make sure to help them if they’re in trouble… and that includes me? Even when I’m everyone’s hero?
I see now. If I were in your position, I’m sure I would have done the exact same. …Anzu, you’re a hero of your own, aren’t you? You help the vulnerable and support them. You’re someone indispensable to me.
…Sigh. It’s already time to leave. I suppose I have to wake up from my dream at one point. I’ll miss everyone. What a shame that I have to leave as soon as I became friends with all the ghosts in the haunted house…
You became friends with ghosts…!? How is that even possible…!? Actually, I’d rather not know…
Today may be coming to an end, but dreams can be seen over and over again. You can just come back with a friend next time!
Mhm, I’ll do just that! …Ah, they’re selling souvenir gifts over there.
Oh no…! I almost forgot that Aira asked me to buy some sort of limited merchandise for him. I’ll quickly go and buy it!
Mhm, take care of yourself. Anzu and I will wait for you here. …Hey, Anzu. I know I said to forget about work today, but… Could you lend me an ear for a moment? While watching the hero show, my personalized outfit came to mind. A hero suit may be essential for a hero, but… It’s only an outfit, not the actual essence of a hero.
What matters is the beliefs that heroes are born for. The true essence of a hero is the very flesh and bones where those beliefs reside. While the personalized outfit is made for the idol, it’s also to make the fans happy. So for the sake of everyone who cheers for me as well, I’d like an outfit design full of my charm as both an idol and a hero. That’s why— Anzu. Could you and I think up a new outfit design from scratch? I’m knowledgeable about heroes, and you’ve always watched over idols. If we were to team up, we should be able to create an incredible outfit.
…Thank you. I just knew you’d say that. With the two of us, I’m sure it will turn out perfect. Let’s work hard together, partner…♪

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] Changing The Flavor Up A Bit
entry.content:
Niki’s Solo Live is coming up, but he’s in no rush, saying it’s fine if the styles are in the same flavor as the times before. However, he starts to reconsider if that’s really alright.
Characters
Story Release Date
March 25, 2026
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
Chapter 1 This story is set after the Mega Sphere arc began (July), where idols start live-streaming through Mega Stream.
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer
(Uu, what am I going to do… I’m really stumped…)
Takamine, will it be fine if I pour the scrambled eggs in?
Y-Yes. It’s fine. Add them in vee~ry slowly, and then lightly mix them together.
Leave it to me, then. I’ve watched my grandmother cook this plenty of times before, so I should be able to do that just fine.
Yeah, I’m sure. I’ll prepare the rice then, so please call for me if anything happens.
Sure, alright.
(Whew, looks like it’ll go okay at this rate…) (I was a little anxious at first when Hidaka-senpai told me he isn’t good at cooking. He even asked me for advice after saying that, so…)
(But anyway, the harder part is how awkward it feels to be all alone with Hidaka-senpai… I don’t really have anything to talk to him about, and I feel so awkward every time there’s silence between us…)
Alright, I’ll be done as soon as I add the seasoning. Takamine, how’s it going on your side?
I’m done here. I’ll take them to the table.
Got it. Although, maybe it isn’t so interesting to only have soup and rice as a meal.
Mm~ Yeah, but I feel like if you added more to the soup, you’ll end up with too much of it.
I suppose you have a point. Plus, I doubt I have it in me to make something intricate right now.
We managed to make something that can fill up an empty stomach, so I feel like it’s good enough.
Sniff, sniff… This smells like consommé and ginger.
Mm?
And mixed with it is a faint aroma of sesame oil…
I got it! You made egg soup, didn’tcha!
Shiina-senpai? That’s impressive, you managed to figure out the meal just through its scent.1
Nahaha. I caught sight of you stirring eggs in it earlier, Hidaka-kun~♪
Huh? I could’ve sworn I heard from Anzu-san that she has a briefing with Crazy:B today…
Ahh, I left before ‘em.
Ah! I have Miss Anzu’s permission, though. I’m not skipping out or anything~
I see. That’s good to hear.
Aaanyways, enough ‘bout me. More importantly, that’s a huge load’a soup you made~ Were you that hungry?
You’re right that I’m hungry, but to put it simply, I just accidentally made too much, that’s all. I put too much seasoning at first because the taste was bland, but that made it too spicy. So I tried diluting it with water, but it went back to tasting bland… I wasn’t able to get it to taste the way I had hoped. If Takamine hadn’t come to the kitchen by chance, I might have ended up with two pots of soup.
I underestimated how hard it’d be to make soup, thinking I could just flavor it based on my own measurements… but now I’ve learnt my lesson; I should’ve looked at a recipe book or searched up a recipe online.
Ah~ That’s a common mistake by beginners, yeah. I get it now. So that’s when you had Takamine-kun help ya, huh? I was wondering where the unusual combination came from~♪
Yeah, I’m really grateful to Takamine.
No, no need for that, I’m not an expert at cooking like Shiina-senpai is! Plus, it’s mostly that we got the taste to a barely passing mark through some seasoning, that’s all.
Hmm… That sounds like a li’l bit of a waste…
Ermm, Shiina-senpai…?
Mind if I taste-test this?
Feel free. There’s this much of it, anyway. I wouldn’t mind you having two or three scoops of it.
Ooh, this is a luxurious feast, then! Aight, I’mma gladly have a big bite~♪ Munchmunch, munchmunch…
(Gulps down) Mm! I see, so if we just add a bit’a butter and white sesame seeds… Munchmunch. I think it’ll taste a lot better. Since the vegetables are already nice and soft, and the eggs are pretty dang fluffy~♪
Butter, huh… I never once considered that as an option.
You were able to tell what it was lacking in a single moment’s notice… Hm, as you’d expect, someone who’s used to making meals on a daily basis is on a different level.
Nahaha~♪ It’s my one and only field of expertise, after all~ So whaddya say, mind if I join you guys in the cookin’? I’ll also make that rice even tastier while I’m at it~☆
He already started cooking!? He’s pouring the soup and rice into the frypan… Wait, are you making fried rice?
You betcha! I’mma add in another soup and some foods, so you two should go ahead and prepare the plates~♪
Several minutes later…
…Wow, you didn’t just make fried rice, but omelette too…
Fufun~♪ And now all’s left is for the chawanmushi to finish steaming, and we’re good to go.2
(I regretted this a little at first, but now that I’ll get to eat Shiina-senpai’s cooking, maybe it was a good idea to not eat out today after all…♪)
Wait a minute, huh? Oh yeah, this reminds me. When I spoke to Anzu-san, I remember she mentioned that Shiina-senpai’s going to perform a solo live show…
Yeah, I also saw it through the announcement.
Ohh, so everyone knows ‘bout it now, huh~
You make it sound like it’s something completely unrelated to you… But are you sure it was fine to help us out with cooking?
…? It’s fine, I made my own portion to eat too, after all.
That’s not what I meant. There’s a lot of things the idol has to think over for the solo live, like the outfit and song, right?
Yeah, since one of the selling points is that the idol can self-produce it.
I know this is silly to ask after we had you help us, but aren’t you busy with preparing for the solo live?
Not at all, actually. At most, I’ve been talkin’ to Miss Anzu a li’l more lately.
Does that mean you’ve already decided on the concept and direction?
Ah~ Yeah, more or less…
I see, that explains why you aren’t in a rush over it. Hm. It sounds like the solo live preparations are proceeding smoothly for you, so… I don’t mind if it’s only within the limitations of what you can discuss, but — For future purposes, I’d like to know what you’re going to do for your live show.
Oh yeah, good point. I might be able to avoid panicking over my turn if I get to hear about it beforehand… Um, is it alright if I also hear you out?
‘Course it’s fine!
I plan to go with an outfit that’s related to cooking. Same with the stage; I’m plannin’ to ask for it to be somethin’ that matches the outfit.
Ohh… So you’re going with something that’s exactly the image you give off, or like, the classics for yourself, huh?
But didn’t your previous outfits have to do with cooking, too?3
Huh, you remember that?
I did check out the design references that Miss Anzu recommended me, but… None of ‘em really clicked, like, I just can’t help but think of cookin’ when it comes to me. That’s how I knew that it’ll be impossible to separate cooking from myself, so I figured I may as well go with the same vibe as last time.
Hm, I can’t say the concept isn’t fitting for you, but…
Plus, I actually worked pretty dang hard in my own way, y’know? Why, one of the last times it was my turn, I was so caught up in thinkin’ up a recipe that I had completely forgotten ‘bout the outfit…!4
Uh, I don’t think that’s something you should say so proudly.
Ermm, Shiina-senpai’s idea is realistically doable, and if that’s what you want to show to all your fans, then I feel like it’s good enough, isn’t it? In terms of all the people who’ve performed their solo live so far, they also jam packed it with what they personally want to do, so…
The people who’ve performed their solo live so far, huh…
Chapter 2 …That reminds me, there was something that came to my mind when I was watching Kohaku-chan’s solo live on stream.5 I was thinkin’ about what makes this Kohaku-chan different from when he’s performin’ with Crazy:B.
Ermm, what do you mean?
Mm~ How do I put it… It’s not like he was wearin’ something different from what we’d wear as Crazy:B…
But it felt exciting to me, like when I think up a new recipe, y’know? ♪
You felt something novel from it, is what you mean?
Ah~ That might be it!
I also watched Oukawa’s live stream, and it looked childi—… No, that’s not it. It gave off an innocent impression, and it was rightfully appropriate for his age in its own way. Well, between you and I, you’ve spent more time with him than I ever have, so we might have had different ways of seeing it.
…………
Anyway, I got the impression it was a big hit among his fans, with many of them asking him to appear in a stream again… as well as build up higher expectations for the idols who are next in line for a solo live.
It’s good to hear that Oukawa-kun’s solo live was a big hit, but I’d honestly hate to have people expect things from me as well… The pressure feels heavy.
Really? I feel like the higher the fans’ expectations, the more motivating it feels, though…
(…Yeah, I also think it’s fitting for me to have an outfit and stage that’s related to cooking.) (But will I be able to make everyone happy with something novel and fresh like Kohaku-chan did for his fans?)
(Mm~ I’m not so sure anymore…)
Mm?
Sorry. I’m afraid there’s been smoke coming from the stove the moment we took our eyes off of it.
Whoa, we can’t have that happenin’! I’mma rescue the chawanmushi right away…!
Another several minutes later…
Thank you for the food. Wow, I’m surprised to see all that soup be gone and done with just like that.
More than half of it vanished into Shiina-senpai’s stomach, though.
Nahaha, I’m so thankful to you two for makin’ such a huge portion of soup~♪
No, that’s what we should say. I didn’t expect the food we made to turn into such a luxurious meal.
Yeah, we should be the ones to thank you.
But honestly, that’s really incredible. Just a few fixes turned it into an entirely different meal…
Huh? Takamine-kun, your phone’s lighting up…?
Ah, you’re right. I’m sorry, I’ll have to check this.
Ermm, it’s a message from Shinobu-kun. This is pretty sudden, I wonder what’s wrong… Let’s see… “All five of us in Ryuseitai will be live-streaming soon. I’m sorry to ask this, but I’d like you to come to the Mega Sphere Tower too, Takamine.” Wait a second—
This is clearly a message Morisawa-senpai thought up!
Man, I didn’t think that guy would contact me through Shinobu-kun’s phone now that I have his messages blocked.6
If Morisawa-senpai’s the one calling for you, I think you’d best hurry over there. I’ll clear up the dishes, so feel free to go and meet up with everyone.
Yup, don’t worry ‘bout it, you’re feel to head on over there.
Thank you so much~♪ Alright then, I’m sorry about this, but I’ll leave the rest to you two.
Hmm… Since it seems like Takamine will also live-stream, I should think up what to do for a stream back in my room once I’m done doing the dishes.
Wow, everyone’s incredible for being so serious about idol work~
Where did that come from? Aren’t you an idol too, Shiina-senpai?
Well, you saw how Takamine-kun headed off to his unit even if reluctantly? And now you mentioned that you wanna think up an idea for a stream, Hidaka-kun.
…My top priority is always food, and that’s never changin’. So I felt like I was a li’l different from you two.
Is that so…? In the past, you were only ever thinking about cooking, and completely forgot about the personalized outfit for your solo live, right?
How about now, though? You mentioned that you’ll make it an outfit related to food like last time, but you clearly seem to remember the outfit part itself this time.
Huh, I guess you’re right?
Isn’t that pretty incredible coming from you? All you’ve ever thought about is cooking up until now, but you’ve made space in your mind to think about something else, even if only a little bit… Now there’s leeway to think about idol work. I’d say that’s you growing as an idol, so I think that makes you the same as Takamine and I.
Nahaha… You tellin’ it to me straight makes me blush a li’l. I might not be able to say that idol work is my top priority, but… If there’s even just one fan out there who hopes to see me as an idol… Then I wanna respond to their feelings as much as possible; that’s how I think now. So that’s why I’m gonna think over the idea for my solo live again, and properly this time. Just like how the egg soup became fried rice and omelette… I might be able to fix up the plan a li’l to be somethin’ everyone will enjoy.
Yeah, I think that sounds like a great idea. You truly are an incredible idol of your own, Shiina-senpai.
Nahaha. Well, I haven’t really thought up anything specific, though!
That’s exactly where Anzu comes into play. They say that if you want rice cakes, then go to a rice cake shop, so I think you should try consulting her.7 I’m sure she’d gladly listen to what you have to say.
Ah~ The image popped into my head perfectly!
…Mm? What was that sound just now?
Nahaha. Looks like I felt so relieved that my stomach started growling.
Aaalright, this means I gotta go all out and make a full course meal…♪
Spicy Smoothie
This story is associated with Niki’s 2nd Solo: Spicy Smoothie. It is recommended to listen to the song and read the lyrics!
format_size
Translation Notes ↑ Niki’s nose is so sensitive that he can even tell people’s scents apart. Among some of the examples is Yuuta’s FS1, where he could tell it was Yuuta through smell.↑ Chawanmushi is a savory steamed egg custard. More information here.↑ Referring to Niki’s first and second feature scouts. Translations can be found here: First Feature Scout, Second Feature Scout.↑ Referring to his first feature scout.↑ Kohaku had his 3rd FS before Niki. Translation here.↑ Midori blocks Chiaki’s phone often. The last time he mentioned doing this was in VS★GOURMET, Flood of Customers 4, after Chiaki pulled a stunt that inadvertently involved Midori.↑ Idiom to mean that “One should go to the specialist for the best results”. I kept it as it was in Japanese since the idiom is food-related.

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] Good at Streaming?
entry.content:
[Professional Stitch-up] Shu Itsuki
Center Skill
Dexterous Artist
Live Skill
Unconcealed Face
Support Skill
Unexpected Frayed Spot
Shu was about to head to the bakery when he noticed Tetora live-streaming, and…
Characters
Story Release Date
January 25, 2026
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
This story is set after the Mega Sphere arc began (July), where idols start live-streaming through Mega Stream.
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer
(Sigh, I’m exhausted… I wonder if the bakery below is still selling croissants at this hour…)1 (Focused or not, working endlessly without eating breakfast or lunch would undoubtedly wear anyone out, including myself.) (Perhaps I shouldn’t have held back from asking Kagehira to fetch me some lunch after all.)
(Oh? The person over there…)
MEGA LIVE on @Nagumo_Ryusei
“Aight, it’s time I end the live stream. Thanks for joinin’, everyone~”
(Ah, Nagumo. It appears he was live-streaming here. Good grief, he truly works diligently, doesn’t he.) (…The camera may catch sight of me from the corners if I stand here. I’ll head off promptly.)
(Oh? Nagumo’s jacket…)
Whew, that’s that for the live stream. I feel thirsty after talkin’ so much.
Nagumo, a word with you, if you may? The thread of your jacket’s hem has come undone.
Eh!? Woah, you’re right!? Don’t tell me it was also like this while I was streaming!?
Uwah~ That’s kinda embarrassin’. I guess nobody pointed it out for my sake…
No, it isn’t possible to tell at a simple glance, so I assume they hadn’t noticed at all.
Itsuki-senpai, thank ya for lettin’ me know. You helped me out!
But that all bein’ said… I was plannin’ on wearin’ these training clothes for other stuff too, so this is bad… Well, I guess I can fix this much on my own… Maybe? I’ll try at least.
…You’ve left me no choice.
Eh?
I mean to say that I will mend it for you. Stand over there, quickly.
Eh!? Are you sure it’s okay?
I always carry with me a basic sewing kit, so I can mend a simple loosened hem. Right, do not move an inch. You could risk getting pricked by the needle otherwise.
Several minutes later…
Ooh~! So quick! So clean! You stitched it up like a pro!
Non! How insolent of you! I am already working as a professional artist!
Ah, sorry! But I just meant that it moved me that much! I knew from Taishou that you’re good at sewin’, but like, Itsuki-senpai’s level of amazingness is even more than I imagined!
That all being said and done, what on earth have you been doing for your clothes to get this tattered? I found plenty of other threads that were undone, you know.
Uu~myu… Oh yeah, I think my clothes got caught in some ornament when I was practicin’ outside yesterday.
Good grief… Well, what’s done is done, I suppose.
I was on my way to the bakery, so I shall take my leave here.
Ossu! Thank you very much!
Ah—!
You’re truly noisy. What is it this time?
‘Scuse me, Itsuki-senpai, I’m sorry ‘bout this! I thought I’d turned off the live stream’s camera, but it looks like it didn’t actually turn off… So everythin’ we were talkin’ about got streamed to the whole world…!
What…!?
Woah, woah, there’s so many comments comin’ in! “Wow, amazing!” “I’m so jealous of how skilled he is!” “Itsuki-kun is so kind”… My fans are goin’ crazy! There’s even comments askin’, “What will you buy at the bakery?”
What does it matter what I’ll buy!?
(How could this happen…! I knew that there were cameras in this room as well, but I never expected it would cause this much of a ruckus…)
Sound of footsteps
Itsuki! Thank you for taking care of our Nagumo!
Eh!? Morisawa-senpai, why’re you here!?
I was watching over Nagumo’s stream in our room and then caught sight of his conversation with Itsuki!2 Your conversation moved me so much that I just had to rush over here! Thank you, Itsuki! Your sewing skills are truly reassuring to have!
My hand hurts! Your handshakes are far too strong!
Uwah!? The comments are goin’ even crazier now! “It’s Chiaki-kun!” “Itsuki-kun’s amazing”… There’s so many comments pourin’ in that I can barely keep up!
Itsuki-senpai! Next time around, I’d love you to teach me and everyone else how to sew!
Good grief…
It’s because these sorts of incidents can occur that I cannot grow fond of streaming, truly.
format_size
Translation Notes ↑ Shu is in the Shared Space, on the 3rd floor of the Star House (where the idols live). Down on the 1st floor is the Passage Arcade, where all the shops and restaurants are.↑ In Mega Sphere, each unit lives in a room together in the Star House.

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] crossing past the [vast ocean]
entry.content:
[journey full of freedom] Kanata Shinkai
Outfit name: “Ulysses”. An outfit that Kanata also had a hand in. Designed to envision a fairytale-like butterfly ready to take off.
Center Skill
the time to wake up
Live Skill
the place we return to
Support Skill
the blue butterfly
The special program, “Behind the Scenes ☆ Shinkai Kanata’s Puka Puka Day”, is currently being live-streamed. Through the interview that looks back on his daily life, Kanata searches for clues that can help with his Solo Live.
Characters
Story Release Date
January 10, 2026
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
Chapter 1 This story is set after the Mega Sphere arc began (July), where idols start live-streaming through Mega Stream.
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer
Haah… The sky is so pretty. Having lunch on a bench while taking my mind off things is probably the happiest I can be right now.
Ever since we got here, every day has been hectic…1 Even though just a while back, all I had to do was decide between going to school or doing work… I miss the land… When I can finally get back down again, I want to go see all the yuru-chara across the country…2
Not that I have the energy to travel to that many places… But right now, I want to enjoy daydreaming about that.
…That cloud over there looks like the “Kerokero-rin” yuru-chara.3
Fufu. And that one looks exactly like “Pen-tagon”…♪4 I wonder how “Sumo Cabbage-kun” is doing. I hope “Alien Tomato” is doing okay with the produce stores.5
I want to go see them all now… I want to touch their unique textures to feel healed and relaxed… …If only Mega Sphere had its own original yuru-chara, at least…
Would Anzu-san make one for me? I feel like she’d agree if I asked her… But she seems super busy… She’s also the type who wouldn’t say no if you ask her for a favor, so it actually makes it harder to ask anything from her. And I’ll seriously feel bad if her physical health gets ruined all because of me…
…Nah, let’s drop that idea. The most peaceful option is that I satisfy myself by looking at the clouds and daydreaming.
Sigh… I wish a yuru-chara could just appear from thin air right now. I feel like I’d be a little more motivated if I had one…
—Hee~y, Midori-kun!
Eh…? That voice…
No way, a yuru-chara…!? Was my wish heard…!? What if it’s somehow Mega Sphere’s official mascot or something…!? I have to get its autograph…!
MEGA STREAM: Behind the Scenes ☆ Shinkai Kanata’s Puka Puka Day
“I finally found ya, Midori-kun!”
“Your autograph, please!”
“…Eh?”
“Autograph? Mine? Why’s that?”
“No, um… That’s not wh—… Eh, are you live-streaming?”
“Ossu, I sure am! I’m currently walkin’ around and asking people an ‘important question’.”
“Midori-kun, what do you think of Shinkai-senpai?”
“What do I think of him…?” (Anzu-san’s behind Tetora-kun. Which means this isn’t a personal live stream or something…) (Then I have to give a proper answer here, right? Ermm…)
“Mm~… He’s generally a senior I can respect… maybe?”
“Ahaha, that’s not what we’re hopin’ for here~”
“Ehhh…? I can’t tell what you’re aiming for at all, though.” “Why’re you asking me that…? Actually… What is this live stream even for?”
“Ah, I didn’t explain it yet, did I! Sorry ‘bout that.”
“This program’s called ‘Behind the Scenes ☆ Shinkai Kanata’s Puka Puka Day’! As the title goes, it’s a documentary that takes you through a day in the mysterious, laidback life of Shinkai-senpai.” “It’s a special live stream for Shinkai-senpai’s Solo Live, and I’m actin’ as the host for it.”
“For Shinkai-senpai’s…”
“Hold on, he isn’t even here, though…? Is this a horror show with that sort of gimmick?”
“No, no, not at all! He just isn’t here for a li’l while, is all.” “Shinkai-senpai’s puka puka-ing in a cold bath in the big bathhouse. And obviously, we can’t be showin’ that, so~”6 “I’ve been interviewing people all over ‘til he’s back.” “That bein’ said… Apparently, Senpai has already done everythin’ he wanted to do back in the Feature Live.”7 “So for the Solo Live that’s gonna be live-streamed, it hasn’t struck him just yet how he wants to go ‘bout it.” “That’s why he wants to look back on his daily life through a ‘behind the scenes interview,’ while usin’ everyone’s impression of him as clues on what to do.”
“I get it now… So that’s why you asked me what I thought of Shinkai-senpai.”
“My impression of him, huh… I feel like nobody could ever come close to the clear-cut impression Shinkai-senpai gives off.” “He’s someone with a relaxing way of speaking, brimming with knowledge about the sea, and always has the urge to go into the water whenever he sees it…”
“That’s more or less how he is, right? I feel like it’s not something you even need to ask.”
“Yeah. Everyone else said ‘bout the same thing.”
“By the way, Morisawa-senpai said, ‘Like water, he’s someone you can’t live without, and my partner! ☆’—” “Kanzaki-senpai said, ‘A respectable and reliable senior, who wraps around you like the great ocean’—” “And Hakaze-senpai said, ‘He’s the epitome of the sea,’ and also, ‘Gentle, but he packs a punch with his strength~’.”
“Fufu, they all answered in a similar way, mentioning the sea and water, huh.” “Well, I’d also answer about the same way if I was asked what sort of person he is.”
“Yeah, right~ Same here, when I was first asked, I said, ‘A man who suits water more than anyone out there’.”
“If I close my eyes right now, I can still see it so vividly~ The image of Senpai when he was water-bathing so boldly in the fountain in Yumenosaki Academy…!”
“Mhm… Everyone basically accepted it, like, ‘there he is again~’.”
“But if you think about it, it was a pretty surreal sight to see. His behavior was way too eccentric.”
“…Wait, is it alright that I’m talking about him like this while he isn’t around?” “If this is a live stream to show stuff behind the scenes, then most of the viewers must be fans of Shinkai-senpai, right? Are the comments going crazy right now…?”
“Mm~… Looks good to me. Lots of comments are saying, ‘This is fine, I feel like we’re getting inside stories’.”
“As expected of Shinkai-senpai’s fans! They’ve all got broad-minded hearts like the sea! ☆”
“Whew… I really appreciate it when there are fans who watch over us so thoughtfully.” “I’m sure that Shinkai-senpai has also been able to expand on his idol activities thanks to fans like that.”
“Ossu! I want his Solo Live to be an absolute success for the sake of his fans, as well.”
“That’s why I’m hopin’ this live stream helps give him the clues he needs, even if only a li’l…” “But we still need a li’l more of somethin’ else. Somethin’ that can bring out what makes him ‘Shinkai-senpai’ outside of the sea and water…”
“Uu~myu, this is so hard…!”
Chapter 2
“heeey~, tetora~♪” (waves)
“oh? midori is [with you], too~”
“midori, hello~ [everyone] watching, hello as well~♪”
“How’d water-bathin’ go, Shinkai-senpai?”
“it went great~ the [cold water] was lovely…♪”
“Huh, usually people would say ‘the hot bath was lovely’ here.”
“i am not good with hot things, after all~ [hot water] is not suitable for survival, you see.” “i am a little more [accustomed] to it than i used to be, but i do not want to go inside the [big bathhouse]’s hot bathtub.” “if only the [water temperature] was around the same degree as [heated swimming pools], though~”
“It was designed with a cold bath area in mind, so the hot bathtub is pretty hot, yeah~”6
“I love that level of hot temperature, though! When I go in there with Taishou, I can’t help but have an endurance contest with him~♪”
“Ahh… Yeah, people really like doing that for some reason. Even though it sucks to feel faint…”
“fufu, that reminds me, chiaki [joined along] with that the other day~”
“it does not seem like midori [uses] the [big bathhouse] much, does he?”
“Ahh, yeah. I almost always get it over and done with in our room’s shower.”
“It’s a pain to leave my room just to take a bath, anyway. And I’d rather not go to places like that in the first place…”
“is it because you have to be [naked] there? midori is very [shy], huh?”
“Ehh? No, not that… I just don’t feel relaxed being in a bathhouse with people I don’t know.”
“I’d be fine with it if I was alone, though. Relaxing in a huge bathtub does sound like it’d feel nice.” “But you don’t know who’s in the bathhouse unless you go there first, right?”
“Doesn’t the thought of opening the door to a bathhouse full of party animals sound scary…?”
“fufu. it is just like midori to [think] that way~”
“you just need to choose the [right time] then. shinobu mentioned that the [big bathhouse] gets crowded only at certain times.”
“Shinobu-kun said that?”
“yes~ it seems that he practices his [water-escape jutsu] during the time when nobody is in there, like the morning.”8
“Ahh, yeah… Since people might think he’s acting suspicious if he did it in front of them.”
“By the way… Are you sure it’s alright that we’re just having a cozy chat?” “This live stream is meant to show stuff behind the scenes, right? But we aren’t even talking about your Solo Live, so I feel like this live stream is inching into a disaster—…”
“it is alright~ that is [how] the stream has been from the [start]~♪” “i have tetora here to act as the [host] for me, while i do what i want to do. that is the sort of relaxing [program] we have here~”
“tetora~ did anything happen while i was [puka puka]-ing?”
“Ossu! While waitin’ for ya, I went ‘round and interviewed people ‘bout Shinkai-senpai. Morisawa-senpai said—”
A few minutes later…
“…i see~ as i thought, people think of the [sea] when it comes to me.” “that is not bad either, but… there is no area to change things up, so it is quite boring, isn’t it?”
“You want to give yourself a makeover that badly? In that case—”
“How about wearing a Kanatee-looking costume…♪”9
“Midori-kun, Midori-kun, your personal desires are leakin’ out!”
“ufufu. that might also be nice~ it would be unusual and amusing.”
“…ohh? a [butterfly] is fluttering toward us.”
“Ohhh, it stopped on Shinkai-senpai’s finger. You can find butterflies even high up in the sky, huh~”
“that would not be [unusual] for them, actually. since you can find them above the [sea], as well.”
“Above the sea…? You mean butterflies?”
“yes~ the [butterfly] you would find there is called ‘asagimadara butterfly’.” “its name [matches] with that [rogue], doesn’t it?”10 “for [fishies] and [dolphins] as well, there are some [species] that have [spots] on them, so…”11
“if we were to look around, we could probably find all sorts of [creatures] that [match] with the [rogue]~ ehe, hehehe…♪”
“anyway… the [asagimadara butterfly] flies over the [sea] for several thousands of kilometers, just like [migratory birds].”12 “perhaps it is to cross over the [sea] in search of comfortable land to be in—”
“or perhaps crossing over the [sea] in itself is the [way of life] for the [asagimadara butterfly]? i am not sure.” “i wonder what the first [asagimadara butterfly] to go beyond the [sea] was thinking when it decided to take off?”
“it does not even know what is out there beyond the [sea]…” “and yet… one [speck] of courage is all it took—”
“maybe that is how the [asagimadara butterfly] became a [species] that crosses over the [sea].” “it [naturally] stretches its [wings] to take flight across the [vast ocean], as if it was always the norm for it.” “incredible, isn’t it? it crosses past the [sea] without much rest in between.”
“it managed to pull off such a [miraculous] act with its tiny [body]…♪”
“…i have made up my mind. i will go with the [butterfly].”13
“Eh? Erm, do you mean… for your Solo Live?”
“yes~ who i am [right now] is sort of like the [butterfly], after all.”
“i do not know where we are heading towards — nor do i know what lies ahead of us.”
“but even then, i will continue to fly. i will cross over [today], and into [tomorrow] — into the [future].” “as long as i have the [wind] that is everyone with me, taking me along with them—”
“as long as i am with everyone, i feel as though i [can fly] no matter where, until the very end…♪”
“fufufu, it looks like i have found the [answer]~ all my lovely [fans], please look forward to the [solo live]~♪” (waves)
“No no, please wait! It’s still too early to end the program!” “There’s still the latter half of today left for the program’s time slot. If we end it here, we seriously will have that live stream disaster!” “And there are so many people who were looking forward to your behind the scenes live stream, Shinkai-senpai!”
“i see~ that is true, we have already decided on the [time] for the [live stream], so we should not end it early, right?”
“okay then, how about i turn this into a program where i [follow] how everyone is like [behind the scenes]?”
“Eh…? Who do you mean by everyone?”
“i have not decided on anyone in particular. it could be midori, or maybe tetora~?”
“if i act as the [host] instead, it will not turn into a [live stream disaster], yes?”
“Uu~myu… Well, based on the comments, it doesn’t seem like there’d be any problems with that.”
“Shinkai-senpai’s fans really are used to Senpai’s free whims, huh? They’re seriously amazin’! ☆”
“Umm… You can do whatever you want with Tetora-kun, so let’s drop the idea of showing behind the scenes for me—…”
“you will not escape from this, midori. please let me closely follow your [behind the scenes], okay~?”
“I guess I can’t get away with it after all… Uuu, please be gentle with me…”
Tabisuru Ulysses
This story is associated with Kanata’s 3rd Solo: Tabisuru Ulysses – Traveling Ulysses Butterfly. It is recommended to listen to the song and read the lyrics! Ryuseitai 5* Feature Scout Stories
Dear ‘Me’, Before I Became a Ninja
You’re A Hero, Too!
Some Day, On The Path To My Ideal
True To Myself, Staying The Way I Am
me, the sea, and everyone with me
me research
A Raininja Day to Convey
As I Am
Dream Days and the Hero
True To Myself, Taking A Step Forward
Turn Crisis Into Opportunity
crossing past the [vast ocean]
format_size
Story: crossing past the [vast ocean] Solo Song: Tabisuru Ulysses
Translation Notes ↑ Around the start of July, the ES idols go to the Mega Sphere only to find out they will be live-streaming on the blimp, and can’t leave to go back down until the end of the month. This is shown in Sailing Ceremony, with Midori initially feeling very anxious by the turn of events.↑ Yuru-chara; yuru meaning “loose,” “laid-back,” + the word “character”. yuru-chara are a type of mascot character, and their defining feature is their peculiar designs, ranging from bizarre-cute to adorkable. They’re well-known for being used all across Japan for PR purposes for companies, prefectures, etc… For more information read here.↑ In Japanese, kero is the sound a frog makes, so the yuru-chara’s name is based on that. Midori’s mentioned this yuru-chara before, one story being Buddy.↑ The Pen-tagon yuru-chara is a pentagon-shaped penguin, mentioned by Midori in Soleil.↑ Sumo Cabbage-kun was the yuru-chara star of the story, Whimsical City Rider, and Alien Tomato was first mentioned in Midori’s FS1.↑ In Japanese, large bathhouse is daiyokujou. There’s a cold bathtub area, usually used to cool off after a sauna or hot bath. In this case, the large bathhouse has a hot bathtub area and a cold bathtub area.↑ Referring to the 2nd round of Feature Scout, where idols had to perform a Feature Live. You can read Kanata’s FS2 here.↑ Known as suiton in Japanese, it’s one of the ninja arts of escape. In the case of the water-escape jutsu, the ninja dives into a body of water to infiltrate or hide, and then uses a bamboo as a snorkel. Shinobu has done this before in Air Ride; his CG showcases it!↑ Kanatee (Kanata + Manatee pun) is Aoumi Aquarium’s mascot, and you can see how it looks in this CG and in Kanata’s birthday cake.↑ “Rogue” refers to Madara. Kanata used to often call him by this name back in his Yumenosaki days.↑ Madara’s name (斑) means “spots”; used to describe spotted things as well. Also, as a fun note, his name is homophonous with the word for “pacific cod fish” (真鱈).↑ Known as “chestnut tiger butterfly” in English. Kanata gives a main rundown of its well-known feature (being a migratory butterfly), but if you’d like to read up more, I recommend searching its name in romaji (asagimadara), or katakana (アサギマダラ).↑ Kanata’s solo song is called “Traveling Ulysses”, as in the Ulysses butterfly.

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] Interlude Drum Roll
entry.content:
[ride on the beat] Kanata Shinkai
Center Skill
enjoying the crash cymbals
Live Skill
the five together in peace
Support Skill
sound coming out by nature
Ryuseitai end up in the Music Studio to practice, and Kanata finds the drums fun…
Characters
Story Release Date
July 10, 2026
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (August)
2nd year of ES’s establishment, in August. In the Music Studio within Mega Sphere Tower…
♪~♪~♪ (Hitting the drums)
…Was this really the only room available, Morisawa-senpai?
Yep. It’s because our activity was restricted during the Mega Stream period.1 Now that we’ve been freed from that restriction, it seems that it’s caused units all over to pour everything into practice lessons. Thanks to that, all the lesson rooms are fully booked… Getting us this Music Studio was the best I could do.
In fact, by the looks of it, we wouldn’t have been able to reserve this room if we were just a few minutes late. We’re really fortunate!
Mm~… If we can’t use a lesson room, couldn’t we have taken the day off?
C’mon now, Midori-kun! It’s always said in the sports world that “taking a day off will make you take another three days to get back on your feet”, right? Taking the right amount of breaks is important too of course, but our senses as part of our unit have dulled after being restricted for so long. So I don’t think skipping out with an excuse at a time like this would be a good thing!
Guh… He’s telling me off with sportsman-like reasoning, it hurts to hear…
Are you that against having a lesson today, Midori-kun?
No, it’s not that. It’s just that there’s a lot of equipment here that looks pretty expensive, like instruments and stuff, right? The thought of bumping into one in the moment, or my hand accidentally hitting one and breaking it makes it hard for me to relax and move around here—
drum, drum, drum~♪ (Hitting the drums in his own pace)
I mean, just look…! While I’m freaking out by the thought, Shinkai-senpai’s just innocently playing around with one…!
You look like you’re havin’ fun here, Shinkai-senpai. Have you taken a likin’ to the drums that much?
yes~♪ it makes a [sound] when i hit it, so it is fun.
Yeah! That’s the correct response! The word for music, ongaku, is written as “enjoying the sound”, after all.2
Well, I’ve learned that’s not the actual etymology of the word, but I personally like that theory. After all, music brings smiles to people~♪
Back when I was a student, a certain question came to my mind. “Why do we use the word ‘study’ in ‘Chemistry’ and ‘Math’, while ‘Music’ is the only one that uses the word for ‘enjoyment’?” — That’s how it started.3
I couldn’t get the thought out of my head, so after class, I searched for answers in the library. That’s how I learned about the origins of the word, but… I still didn’t know why the name of the school subject is ongaku. It’s taught in school, so I feel like it’s more natural to call it ongaku-gaku, for “music studies”…4
But I’m glad that the name remained as ongaku. If we had it as ongaku-gaku, it’d have sounded a bit more complicated. It’s because it’s ongaku, “enjoying the sound”, that we can sing and perform laxly without restraint— That may be how we’ve been able to “enjoy” our time with smiles~♪
ufufu. it is as chiaki says~ [music] puts [smiles] on people’s faces. singing [songs] and performing with [musical instruments] are also a lot of fun.
well, all i can really do is [hit] the drums with all my might, though~ pashh~ shh~…♪ (Happily hits the crash cymbals)
…ah, wait! i just came up with a [great idea]~♪ how about we perform as a [band] in the next [live] together?
Eh? A band!?
yes~ i will play the [drums], and chiaki will play the [tambourine]. tetora plays the [marimba], midori plays the [triangle], and shinobu plays the [maraca]~♪
Why’s it just percussion instrument​s and nothing else… Actually, why’d you suddenly get the urge to play a band? Something like that should be left to a unit brimming with youth and sparkles, right… I don’t feel like it’s a genre of music we can casually dip our fingers into as a group of quirky individuals.
What’re you saying, Takamine!? Our potential as Ryuseitai is always infinite! We’ll take on any challenge for the sake of bringing smiles to everyone! Whether it’s playing as a band, or being enveloped in light and transforming into giants to fight the huge kaijuu attacking the city! ☆5
I could say the same to you, what’re you even on about? Please don’t start saying stuff that could derail the conversation. It’ll only complicate things…
Mm~ A band refers to any group that “performs with musical instruments”, so it wouldn’t be incorrect to be a group of percussion instruments only… But when you think of bands, the typical instruments outside of the drums are the guitar, bass, and keyboard, you know?
that sounds nice too~ but i thought it might be hard to [learn] those. since [percussion instruments] only need you to hit or shake the instrument, anyone can make [sounds] with them. i am sure we could quickly learn how to [perform] with them without it taking too much [time].
Hahaha. Things that look easy at first glance tend to be pretty difficult to master, y’know? Since we’ll be performing for our fans, I wouldn’t want to make do with a hasty performance. However, the idea itself is wonderful!
Even if it’d be hard to perform this for the next live, how about we all start by getting a feel of the instruments for fun?
I like that idea! Hey, how ‘bout we even stream ourselves practicin’ and makin’ sense of the instruments? The sight of a buncha inexperienced people slowly improving in somethin’ feels like a documentary show in a way, so it’d totally fire anyone up! ☆
Mm~… I feel like that sort of thing just pushes viewers to be emotionally moved by what they’re seeing, so I don’t really know about that… Well, then again, it’s better than suddenly performing in a live show, I guess. If our fans got to see our abilities before the performance, it’d lower their expectations, too.
fufufu, our [dreams] just keep on expanding, don’t they~ and just [talking] about it with everyone is fun.
—okay then. we will stop our [break] here, so how about we start [practicing] now? first things first, let’s bring [smiles] to everyone with our [songs]…♪
format_size
Translation Notes ↑ This is referring to the Mega Stream main story arc. In July, all the ES idols were locked up in the Mega Sphere for a month to do a world-wide stream 24/7. As of August, idols can freely do as they like, including going between ES and Mega Sphere whenever.↑ 音楽 (music) is made up of the kanjis “sound” and “enjoyment/pleasure”.↑ In Japanese, Chemistry is kagaku (化学, lit. transformation studies), and Math is suugaku (数学, lit. number studies). More commonly said as “study of (something)” in English.↑ This is 音楽学, “music” (ongaku) and “study” (gaku). Typically known as Musicology (the study of music).↑ Referring to Ultraman. Chiaki’s a huge tokusatsu fan and enjoys referencing various series.

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] Sometimes From a Different Perspective
entry.content:
[Similar Positions] Makoto Yuuki
Center Skill
Vigor is Important
Live Skill
Experienced Handling
Support Skill
Cyber Ninja
Makoto invites Shinobu to join his live stream, but a problem occurs midway…
Characters
Story Release Date
September 10, 2025
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
Tori
This story is set after the Mega Sphere arc began (July), where idols start live-streaming through Mega Stream.
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer
MEGA LIVE on @TS_Makoto1
“Hello~! I’m Yuuki Makoto, from Trickstar!” (waves)
“Sorry for announcing the stream just thirty minutes earlier…! I was hoping to live stream at some point today, but I couldn’t figure out the right timing.” “I thought it’d be at night, but then my work ended early. And I even managed to find a guest, so I just started it as soon as I got everything set.”
“Right, who do you think the guest will be? …You want a hint?”
“Mmm~ Okay! Then… It starts with ‘se’, and ends with ‘bu’!” “Ahaha, maybe that was too easy~♪”
“Huh!? The comments are filled with Izumi-san’s name! His name doesn’t end with ‘bu’, though!?”
“‘Sena Izumi-bu’? Ahaha, you’re pushing it~ Now it just sounds like a club!2 ♪”
“…Ah, I found someone who got the right answer~♪ That’s right! Today’s guest is—”
“He leaps out on the call of his name with a shutatatata!3 Sengoku Shinobu, reporting for duty…☆” “To the one who said my name, you have my undying gratitude!”
“If nobody had called for me, the embarrassment would have had me disguising myself as ‘just someone who so happened to pass by’.” “That, or I would’ve had no choice but to quickly manufacture a mask of Sena-dono and masquerade myself for my appearance…!”
“No, no. You don’t have to do anything like that! The commenters just gave answers the moment they heard ‘se’, like a push-button quiz.” “You’re fine the way you are, Shinobu-kun. Look, they’re welcoming you! ♪” “Alright, let me introduce him to all of you again. This is Sengoku Shinobu-kun, from Ryuseitai!” “We had a job together earlier, so I asked him if he wanted to join my stream as a guest. Thanks for agreeing even though it was on such short notice, Shinobu-kun.”
“It is I who is thankful! I’m so happy you invited me, Yuuki-dono~”
“The two of us may seem different, but the truth is, we have a few shared points between us.”
“Indeed. Though our school years are different, we were once fellow members of the Broadcasting Committee back in school.” “Yuuki-dono is one of the few people who was friendly with me in my first few days in Yumenosaki, and I’m truly grateful for it.”
“I’m the same too, y’know? I was really bad at starting conversations back then.” “So I’m really glad I had a junior like you, who was always so honest and easy to talk to.”
“Nihihi~♪ Broadcasting Committee isn’t our only shared point; now I’ve discovered we both share the trait of being shy with strangers!”
“True. I haven’t fully overcome that part of myself yet, but I feel like the way we’re slowly getting better at talking to people is similar.” “And for another trait, we’re both working under StarPro, and…” “Our positions in our respective units are pretty similar too, I think. We’re usually the ones who take the role of supporting everyone in the unit rather than being the one who stands out on stage.” “We’re both the type who does the heavy lifting in the background, right?”
“Precisely! It is a ninja’s duty to support others in secret, without ever standing out…☆” “Information transmission and behind-the-scenes work are also respectable duties of a ninja. That, too, is quite similar to Yuuki-dono, as you excel in intel gathering.”
“Ahaha, now that you mention it, the things I do is kinda ninjacore, huh?” “I know ninjutsu techniques are only possible in games, but I’m pretty good at stuff like collecting information and analyzing it.”
“Heh, truly just like a cyber ninja, no? ♪”
“Hey, I like that! Maybe I should go with that sort of job title from now on?” “You can count on me for intel gathering! I’m Yuuki Makoto, Trickstar’s Cyber Ninja! Heheh, just kidding~♪”
“…Woah!? The comments are filled with people saying ‘Cyber Ninja’!”
“Calm down, everyone~ It’s just a silly joke, okay?” “Calling myself that just because we’ve got a few similarities would be rude to Shinobu-kun, who’s an actual ninja.”
“I am not bothered in the slightest! I would be more than happy to have more ninja allies by my side!” “But I’m very grateful for your consideration and kindness!”
(What am I gonna do… I only meant it as a joke, but the comments calling me ‘Cyber Ninja’ just keep coming.) (I really messed up my timing with the joke. I feel really bad on behalf of Shinobu-kun…)
(I need to change the topic somehow… Alright! I’ll bring up something else, even if it means cutting off the flow of the stream!)
(…Wait, huh?)
“Mm? Yuuki-dono, aren’t the comments in a loop…?”
“You’re right. The recording seems choppy, too. Let me check on my phone.”
Screen fades out for a moment
…Woah! The stream’s a mess… It’s pixelated everywhere! The sound seems fine, though… Sorry for the unclear screen, guys!
There’s no notice appearing about technical issues, so I think the camera’s the problem. The fastest way to fix it is to stop the stream for a moment, but I’d feel bad for all the people who came to watch me…
…Ah, I know! We can use Shinobu-kun’s phone— Everyone, can you still hear me? The screen’s looking all funky, so I’ll stop this stream for a moment. We’ll continue the stream from Shinobu-kun’s personal channel, like a “different perspective”. We’ll get right back to the stream once I’m done preparing, so please head onto his stream until then, okay? Shinobu-kun, could I ask you to do the filming? I’ll fix the camera in the meantime.
Roger, nin-nin! You truly are amazing, Yuuki-dono, always adapting to the situation! So reliable~
You’re praising me too early~ I’m still not sure if the camera can be fixed.
MEGA LIVE on @Sengoku_Ryusei4
“Hello everyone! I’ll be streaming for the moment from a different channel!” “What you see before you is Yuuki-dono fixing the camera! It’s so cool how he knows all the tech~"
 
“Hm, hm? It needs to be rebooted after resetting the settings? Will that fix it?” “Ohhh…! I’m entirely clueless what he means, but in any case, it appears that he can restore the camera with that trick!” “Erm, as for the comments… ‘I want to see other parts, too’?” “You’d like to see me, as well? I do not really excel at selfies, but…”
“Uhyaa!? How embarrassing — The screen is filled with my face~!”
“I-I will do my best to master the ninja arts of, er, selfie…? until the next time I stream—”
“But for now, it appears that the stream is ready to start, so I shall end it here! …Click ♪”
MEGA LIVE on @TS_Makoto
“Sorry for all that waiting, and for the mess too. My stream’s back up and running!” “Shinobu-kun, thanks for keeping the flow going. It helped me stay calm and finish the job~♪”
“No, no, all I did was simply talk!” “Look over the comments! They’re all praising you for that moment, saying their hearts were beating fast by the sight of you, so serious and focused.”
“You’re being praised a whole lot too, y’know? There’s comments saying you looked cute when you were flustered.” “Ahaha, we’re similar even in the way we pass the focus to one another, huh?”
“Right, now that we’ve solved the equipment issue, it’s time we head over to the main topic. …Well, I say that, but it’s just going to be us chatting.” “You never know what’ll happen in a live stream, but I hope you enjoy yourselves with ours, including those unexpected moments.”
“Even unexpected problems can turn out to be a nice memory if it means we’re all smiling by the end, right? ♪”
If you enjoyed Makoto & Shinobu’s dynamic, try…
Backstage RADIO
…or considering checking the Translation Masterlist! (Filter to Makoto & Shinobu)

Ryuseitai share a similar username pattern, "(Last name)_Ryusei"; ryusei meaning “meteor/shooting star”.

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] Terror! Sound of Footsteps Creeping Closer
entry.content:
[Star Shining on the Surface] Shinobu Sengoku
Center Skill
Lively Departure
Live Skill
Kind Emotional Moment
Support Skill
The Moment to Wish
Shinobu wants to do a nighttime live stream to see the stars and Chiaki helps him out, except…
Characters
Story Release Date
January 10, 2026
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
This story is set after the Mega Sphere arc began (July), where idols start live-streaming through Mega Stream.
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer
MEGA LIVE on @Sengoku_Ryusei
“Good evening, everyone~! I am Ryuseitai’s Sengoku Shinobu!”
“And for tonight! Our guest will be—”
“Bam—! Ryuseitai’s Morisawa Chiaki is here in all his glory! ☆” “Thank you for inviting me to your live stream, Sengoku! I’m so glad I get to greet all your fans!”
“Good evening, everyone! Thanks for always taking great care of our Sengoku…☆”
“Ahaha, you speak almost like a father~” “It is I who is grateful here. I wanted to attempt doing a nighttime live stream, but I felt anxious doing it all alone…” “I was searching for someone who could live-stream with me all this time.”
“Mm. There may be lights around, but the outdoors at night are much darker here than when we’re on the ground.” “Holding the camera while talking and reading comments will only put you at risk of tripping on yourself. I’m honored to accompany you as your escort, Sengoku.”
“I just so happen to have something I want to try out tonight, too.”
“There’s something you’d like to try? What could it be?”
“That’s for us to enjoy once it’s time. Come on now, let’s head outside first!”
“Mmh! Right then, everyone, it is time we depart for our first nighttime live stream~♪”
A few minutes later…
“—Let’s see here. I’ll change this to night-view mode…” “How’s the screen, everyone? Can you still see us just fine?”
“Ooh, it’s a lot brighter now. I’m glad to know the lighting was easily fixed!”
“…But, as I thought, the starry sky doesn’t appear to be showing clearly through the camera.” “It looks so pretty right now, so it is a little frustrating that I cannot show it to everyone~”
“Were you hoping to do a nighttime live stream to show the starry sky, Sengoku?”
“Indeed, I was. Since there aren’t any city lights around, the stars are much clearer and prettier here than on the ground.” “I was extremely moved the first time I saw it. Just gazing at the stars made me forget all about all the turmoil in Mega Sphere.” “That is why I wanted to share that emotional moment with everyone, as well.”
“I get it now. You’re very kind, Sengoku.”
“The stars aren’t properly showing on camera, but… Look, the moon is showing clearly.” “Can you all see it? The big moon looks absolutely beautiful.”
“Morisawa-dono…”
“Hm, that wasn’t right of me. It upset me to know I cannot show the stars, but…” “That’s fine, I simply have to convey my feelings through my own words, as well as the atmosphere of the scenery!”
“The beauty of live streams is chatting and exchanging banter with the viewers! I shall switch my ninja gears and pull myself together.”
“Mm? I believe I saw a comment about the stars — ‘What star constellations can you see’?”
“While I’d love to answer that, I’m not all too sure~ I am only aware of the well-known ones, such as the North Star and the Summer Triangle.”
“Hmm… Right now is the period when the spring and summer star constellations mingle.” “West is over on that side, so… Those over there are the constellations of Bootes and Virgo. Shining in the north is the Ursa Major.” “The Summer Triangle you mentioned should show itself soon from the east side.”
“Oohh—! Why are you so knowledgeable about this!? Are you the Star Constellation Master!?”1
“Fuhaha! I don’t know enough to be called ‘Master’. These are just the fruits of my studying in my childhood…☆” “As long as the skies are clear, you can see star constellations no matter where you are on Earth, right? That thought made me feel like I’m connected to people all across the world.” “Back in those days, I found that fun, and became engrossed with it enough to memorize a few.”
“So that’s what it was. I don’t do quite well with the feeling of cramming knowledge in my head, and would always escape from reality instead.” “I would come up with my own made-up constellations, such as ‘Shuriken constellation’, or ‘Ninja Scroll constellation’…”2
“——Ah! A shooting star!” “I wish for, erm, um…”
“Uwaah! It disappeared before I could make up my mind~!”
“Ahh, that’s such a shame, Sengoku. But with skies like these, we should be able to spot one again. Let’s be patient and wait.”
“We should prepare for that moment by thinking up a wish from now. All you viewers out there, please tell us your wishes in the comments, if possible! ☆”
“…I’ve decided! My wish will be: ‘I wish for this to be a fun live stream’.” “Also, ‘I wish to see many shooting stars.’ I feel as though that’s how we could get at least one of them to appear on the live stream! ♪”
“What shall you wish for, Morisawa-dono?”
“Me? Hmm, let’s see, I’ll wish for everyone to be in good health—”
“Oh? The commenters are pretty chatty right now…?”
“‘I hear a weird sound’, ‘Is it just the wind?’… Mm? Sound?” “‘It sounds like footsteps’…? No, there isn’t anyone near us, though~”
“You hear it even though there’s nobody… here…?” “No, no, it can’t be…”
“The comments are saying, ‘Maybe it’s a ghost?’. Ahaha, there’s nothing like that here, you know~ Right, Morisawa-dono?”
“E-Exactly! Maybe on land there could’ve been, but there wouldn’t be a ghost in a place this high—…”
“—Ah! This is the perfect time for this…!” “Transformation belt! Locked in!”
“Eh!? That was sudden… Wait, are you telling me the item you wanted to try is—”
“You got it! I happened to come across this when I was looking around the Passage Arcade. It’s apparently merchandise of an American sentai hero show.”3 “If I click on this switch — Look, it shines out lights in five colors!”
“Ooh~! It plays out an electronic sound, how exciting! ♪”
“Fuhaha! I thought the lights would look a lot better outside at night, so I kept it for this very day!” “With the light and sound of justice, we’ll eradicate any and all mysterious phenomena!”
“—What’s that ‘mysterious phenomena’ about?”
“Nnhii—!?”
“I-IT’S ACTUALLY HEREEEEE!?”
“Ooh~… Moririn distanced himself real fast while blaring out lively sounds and lights.”
“You surprised me~ So the mysterious footsteps came from you all along, Sakuma-dono.”
“Guess so…? I was chatting on live stream while looking at the stars, when I heard two people talking from where I was~” “It’s pretty rare to come across someone at this hour, so I got curious and came over to see what’s going on.”
“…Oh, woops, you’re live-streaming right now too, huh.” “Everyone watching NinNin-kun’s live stream, good evenin’~ I’m Sakuma Ritsu~♪”
“Ahaha, thank you for greeting them. Everyone’s raving at the sight of a surprise guest!”
“…Mfun. Just as the comments say, as we were waiting for the stars, the moon came instead~”
“Moon… Ahh, you mean me, huh~♪ ‘Cause my name has the ‘moon’ kanji in it, yeah?”4
“…By the way, NinNin-kun. You sure it’s fine to not recover back ‘that’?”
“What do you mean by ‘that’?”
“Look over there. Moririn’s cowering on the side while the lights and noise keep blaring out.”
“Khh… I can’t stand, my legs are frozen from terror…!”5
“Ha—!? I’m coming to save you now, Morisawa-dono~!”6
“Ooh~ He zipped through like a shooting star.” “Fufu. We got to see something really interesting, didn’t we~ Live streams at night are pretty neat.”
“Right, everyone, let’s get back to chatting. Don’t forget to ‘Nice!’ and subscribe to the channel…♪”
Fun Note: The story title, Terror! Footsteps Creeping Closer, uses shinobi yoru for “creeping closer”. Another way to put it is “drawing near without noticing”, as shinobi refers to concealing oneself. The word shares the same kanji as Shinobu’s name!
