entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] Raika – Idol Story 3
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
Mika Enstars
This story happens shortly after the events of Final Ceremony. You can see Raika’s profile on the Wiki.
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (June)
Location: Outfit Room
2nd year since ES’s establishment. Inside the ES building, the outfit room…
Hmhmhmm~♪ Hmhmmhmm~♪ (Humming)
…………
Hyaaah! There’s soooo many outfits here! There’s mature-lookin’ ones, kiddy-lookin’ ones! Uniforms for all occasions, even ones that I dunno what they’d be for! Heaps and loads and piles of outfits!
This means we should be able to find somethin’ formal for us to wear! But I don’t really know fashion all too well, so I’d like to leave the decision-making to Yume-san!
Ehihi. Yume-san’s always dressed in such stylish outfits, so I’m certain you have that so-called “eye for beauty”! Please choose outfits that would suit us at your own discretion~♪ I heard there’s going to be a party to celebrate the formation of Esupuri soon… And there’s apparently a press conference too, so it seems to be a pretty dignified occasion. So we had a talk that there might end up bein’ a problem if we just walked in with our usual casual clothes… ‘Specially for me, ‘cause I look so shabby and dirty! That’s why we have to be quick and change into clothes fitting for the occasion—
…………
Raika-chan.
Aye? What is it, Yume-san?
You nuisance.
That’s so cruel!? Please say otherwise…! I admit that I’m hardly useful when it comes to choosing outfits, but…! Even so, for the sake of Yume-san whom I love and cherish, I have been doin’ my utmost best…!
Sorry. Let Yume rephrase that, Raika-chan. You eyesore.
It became even more cruel!?
Listen. It seems as though Yume is going to work under the same unit as you from now on, and so Yume would rather avoid causing discord in the unit… But considering it doesn’t seem to have gotten through to you that Yume is giving off “don’t talk to me” vibes, Yume will tell it to you plain and clear.1 Even if you and Yume are in the same unit, Yume has no will nor communication skills to be involved with anyone outside of Esu. So Yume would much prefer you don’t get involved as much as possible.
If you take your distance from your side, then there will be no interference from this side either. That way, both sides can continue on in peace. Got it?
Ehh~… But, but, we’re going to work together from now on, so having no conversation whatsoever and not being able to get along is just lonely…
You and Yume are just coworkers, okay? There’s no need to get along.
But~… I’ve been such a big fan of Ohana-san since a long time back.
Such an annoyance. Since you know the stage name “Ohana”, you must be a pretty old fan…2 That’s why maybe Yume should treasure this more, but. Communicating with Yume’s fans is something Yume really, really, really—can’t stand.
It’s bothersome, uncomfortable, and unbearable. In the past, Yume could avoid it a lot more often compared to when being an idol, but every time Yume was greeted by a fan before or after a photo shoot, Yume felt sick inside. If you want to take photos, then go ahead. Take as many photos of adorable Yume to your heart’s content. But. Having other people’s hands traced upon parts of Yume other than that adorable “surface”, or dipped further past it, is truly uncomfortable.
Since Yume will now work as an idol, those sorts of moments will likely increase, and Yume already feels so fed up with it. But, well, in those moments, Yume will just retreat back to the far end while making Esu bear the brunt.
O-Of course, I’ll also protect you as best as I can if that ever happens, Yume-san! We’re goin’ to be companions of the same unit, after all! If there’s anythin’ that makes Yume-san uncomfortable, I’ll do my utmost best to make sure it doesn’t ever get near you!
Oh, really? Then how about you vanish from sight for starters, hm?
Uu~… If that’s what Yume-san wishes, then—then I, I…
…And besides, Yume doesn’t even get it. Yume has zero interest in the fans, so Yume doesn’t ever remember faces, but— Someone like you who’s distinctive—or more like, a weird kid, would at least be stuck somewhere in the corners of Yume’s memory. And yet, Yume doesn’t recognize you. …Are you really a fan of Yume?
Of course! I love you ever so much!
…………
But, well, it’s only natural you have no memory of me. It was all one-sided; I became a fan of Ohana-san during the time I was at the ‘facility’.3 That’s all there is to it; we had never directly met.
Photos of you were in a magazine a long while back, right? Somethin’ like a collection of cosplays. The moment I saw it—how do I put this… It was like love at first sight.
After that, I went through all the events you participated in, and grew to love you more and more, Ohana-san. Say, doesn’t the world look so sparkly bright when there’s somethin’ you love?
There were many painful things at the ‘facility’, but—whenever I would keep up with what Ohana-san’s been doing, I could just forget ‘bout everything, even the unpleasant stuff. I’m grateful to you, so, so very much.
…This may just be somethin’ you feel indifferent about, bein’ thought of in such a one-sided way— But. I dearly love you, and there’s no hidden side to those feelings of mine— At the very least, that is the one thing that I would love you to know.
………… …Eh, sorry. What? Yume wasn’t listening.
At this point, being treated this cruelly feels refreshing! Ehihihi, it’s starting to feel pleasant somehow~♪
Weird kid.
Not that it really matters, but. Since there’s not much time left, Yume chose whatever seems fitting for the occasion, so hurry and change. In the meantime, Yume will call over the other two—Esu and the uh, glasses kid.
Ah, understood! Since the other two were stalling for time…? I think? ‘Til we finally got ourselves prepared, right!
Mhm. It’s a must to quickly call the other two so that everyone wears a fitting costume for the ball—Ah, no, the party. Here, this is the formal outfit for Raika-chan.
Ooh, you chose somethin’ for me, too!? That’s only to be expected, but ‘cause you were so curt with me, or well, rubbin’ salt to the wound all the time, it makes me so happy!
Don’t be so pleased over something so trivial… From here on out, you and Yume are going to be seen as part of the same group, no? In other words. If you expose a disgraceful sight, Yume’s reputation will fall along with you. Yume just doesn’t want that to happen, that’s all.
But it still made me so happy~! Thank ya so much, thank ya so much!
Ehihi. I’ll change into these clothes right away! Yume-san chose this, so I’m sure there’s no problems at all! ♪ We’re talkin’ about you, after all, Yume-san. You’re particular when it comes to formal clothing, so you make all the outfits that you wear. Somethin’ like that was written in a magazine article from long ago, right?
You sure remember that well. You really are a fan of Yume, huh?
I would never lie about somethin’ like that, ya know~?
Yume thought it was nothing but lip service. That maybe you’re just trying to brighten the mood by saying flattering words, so that we’re on good terms for the future. The people of this business world are basically all like that.
But—Guess you don’t have that sort of shrewdness in you, do you.
Aye! I’m simply sayin’ what’s on my mind!
And Yume as well. The same, huh? Not that it really matters either way.
But if we have shared topics to talk about, then we could go on for days about it! While it may be rude of me to say this, that is exactly where I’d love to start from. Because, even if I’m a kid who’s a nuisance and an eyesore right now, I want to be a kid who’s loved by you one day. That’s why… I hope to make your acquaintance from here on out too—Yume-san. ♪
Just go and change already. And hurry it up. You can prattle your gibberish after you’ve finished your duties.
Ehihi, such profound words! I expect nothing less from ya, Senpai~♪
Annoying. An irritance to both ears and eyes. Weird kid that’s just a nuisance to the very core.
But. ……It made Yume happy to hear “love” towards Yume. Since Yume’s life was one without much love from others.
Huh? Did ya say somethin’, Yume-san?
This kid is sooo annoying. Yume was just wondering if you could die somehow.
Ehhh…?
format_size
Translation Notes Comparisons between Raika Idol Story 3 and Fuyume Idol Story 2 (feat. Midori): The two idol stories have interesting similarities and differences. This is purely my personal interpretation, but I found it interesting enough to share! Similarities:
Both stories mention ‘“don’t talk to me” vibes’.
Both discuss Yume’s photo shoots and cosplaying skills.
Both have a moment when one of them realizes they’re “the same”. In Fuyume Idol Story 2, Midori thought that about Yume, and in this idol story, Yume thought that about Raika.
Both mention how one of them knows the other, and that it was through a magazine. Yume first saw Midori in a magazine and thought he looked like a prince, Raika first saw Yume in a magazine and grew infatuated.
Both end with the same dialogue and same expression from Raika and Midori (“Ehhh…?” and a worried expression).
Differences:
In Fuyume Idol Story 2, Midori and Yume were accidentally giving off ‘“don’t talk to me” vibes’ to each other and making each other feel nervous from having a conversation. In this idol story, Yume deliberately tries to ward off Raika with those vibes, but it didn’t work on him.
Yume wanted to get along with Midori, but was awkward about it because he didn’t know how to go about it, while Midori was confused about everything Yume’s doing. Yume is also the first to approach speaking to Midori. In this idol story, Raika wanted to get along with Yume, but Yume found him a nuisance from the get-go, and sees him as a weird kid.
During their photo shoot work together, Midori found out that Yume only “has confidence and nothing else”, and doesn’t seem to have professional experience in modeling. But Raika sees him as very capable in his skills (outfit styling and cosplay photo shoots) and someone to learn from.
Midori is confused by Yume’s “world”, while Raika is extremely entranced by it.
…And I could probably go on, but these are the most striking points! This isn’t necessarily important to the stories, I just found the similarities and differences striking enough to write up a personal interpretation about it. If nothing else, I hope it was interesting! ↑ Interesting point to note: Yume mentions “don’t talk to me vibes” in his idol story with Midori, but in that story, he wanted to get along with Midori from the start. Please check the translation notes for more interesting points to note!↑ Ohana (お花), lit. “flower”. It was mentioned in Final Ceremony that this was Yume’s stage name during his cosplay days. Yume’s last name, Hanamura (花群), shares the same kanji.↑ Raika briefly talks about how he got to the facility and his time there in VS★GOURMET, Praise of Delicious Flavors Chapter 12.

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] Mega Stream Arc – Athletic Atmos (Ryuseitai Scene ONLY!)
entry.content:
Translation of Ryuseitai’s scene from the Mega Stream main story Athletic Atmos. Chapter: Scurrying 1
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Season
ES 2nd Year, Summer (2nd Week of July)
Note: This is a partial translation of the main story Athletic Atmos.
Scurrying 1
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (2nd Week of July)
The next day…
everyone in ryuseitai~ great job at coming on [time]~♪ thank you for coming to my [declaration of conviction] today~♪
Ah, sure. We gathered at the stadium like you asked, but… What’s goin’ on? We live in the same room, so we could’ve just got together there, right?
tsk, tsk, tsk…♪ a [declaration of conviction] must be said in front of a [camera], you know? if i just say it [in secret] in my [room], nobody will be able to know.
Hm. Shinkai-dono typically takes it easy, so if you’re taking action on your own accord, it must be serious.
Yeah. It’s like, how do I put it… He has a different expression in his eyes… I can feel his determination.
Tell us, Kanata. What sort of declaration of conviction do you intend to speak out?
yes, i will say the [conclusion].
i intend to become one of the [six of song]. mm, no. i will become one.
Shinkai-dono, becoming one of the Six of Song…? Those eyes look absolutely legit.
Kanata, your determination was heard loud and clear. …However, why did you decide to declare it all of a sudden? If you were aiming to be one of the Six of Song, there were plenty of other timings you could’ve mentioned it.
there comes a [time] when a man must fight. i thought that by declaring my conviction here, it shows that i am cutting off all [retreats].
Ooh, that’s so manly of ya, Shinkai-senpai! You really are that determined… Your determination to be one of the Six of Song is totally getting through to everyone in this worldwide stream! This isn’t somethin’ anyone can do, y’know!
fufufu. tetora is also cool, being a man of [action before words].
but i will only cause [misunderstandings] if i do not explain myself, so i will at least mention my reason. i want to save my [friend].
Friend…?
yes. shu is [pushing] himself too much.
he is being caught in the flow of the [situation], just like in the past… i cannot stand to watch.
so i plan to become one of the [six of song], and create a [stir] in what is happening.
I see. So it’s about Itsuki… I assume this means you still have some regrets from the time when you were one of the Five Eccentrics.
I’ll support you then, Kanata. Actually, it isn’t only Kanata. I’m supporting everyone in Ryuseitai. I was chosen as one of the Six of Song in Sailing Ceremony, so I was hoping everyone else would get chosen, too!
And here you are, Kanata, letting us know your feelings. So I’ll be sure to back you up with all I’ve got!
Mhn, I share the same feelings~♪ I’m happy no matter who gets chosen from Ryuseitai. If there’s something I can assist with, do let me know!
Everyone’s so proactive… Well, it’s rare to see Shinkai-senpai this motivated, and if that’s how determined he is, then I’ll help out a little, too.
You’ll fight for the sake of your friend… That’s Shinkai-senpai’s manly courage showing!
But if we had to compete with each other in the end, make sure not to hold back, ‘kay? If we just hand over the win to Shinkai-senpai, it wouldn’t be a fair and square match.
yes, of course. let’s not [hold back] if that moment comes.
Fufu, you’ve got a good look in your eyes, Kanata.
The only thing that worries me is that Kanata doesn’t really excel at all in races.
I don’t believe you can compete with the usual way you go about things, so do you have any sort of plan?
no. i plan to pour my [all] even if i cannot win. because i will be [competing] over the amount of [nice!]’s—
well then, it is time i go…♪
Uoooh, such a cool-lookin’ back…! I can totally feel Shinkai-senpai’s spirit!
But it was still a really sluggish way to walk… Will he really be alright?
Mfun! Shinkai-dono accomplishes his duty when it’s time! I’m certain he will take his declaration into heart, and show us all how cool he is…♪

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 1] Main Story: Chapter 123–124
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
Akira
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
honeyspades
The ES!! Main story is fully voiced in-game.
Chapter 123: Injured (Rinne is currently live on stage, preparing himself to diss Ryuseitai on the Idol Royale.)
(Midori and Chiaki, in another area)
…Wha? Huh? Isn’t this like, really bad…?
What’s up, Takamine! Does your stomach hurt!? Exercise is the perfect medicine for the stomach! Let’s do hindu squats together! ☆
Shut up. ……Please look at this for a moment, Morisawa-senpai.
Did you just casually tell me to shut up!? And with a low voice, too! Are you in your rebellious phase, Takamine~!? Is my love not reaching you!?
I was always acting “rebellious” towards you, though… Never mind that — Here. Look at this please; doesn’t this look really bad?
Hm… This is—horrible. It’ll be a fatal wound on us in the worst case. We’ll have to contact the rest of Ryuseitai and group up, then we’ll need to quickly go to the Idol Royale hall.
Huh? Uhh… But is that okay for you? You’re seeing me off for some reason, but don’t you have loads of work to do for the rest of the day?
Yeah, but I’ve built a trustworthy relationship with the people I work with, and they aren’t the type who can’t understand personal circumstances. I could ask them a favor to keep the photoshoot for tomorrow, so let’s hurry and head to the hall straight away.
Ah, no… You really should do your job like you’re meant to. I’ll go meet up with Tetora-kun and the others, and deal with the matter. You’re still new into your career, aren’t you? You can’t just be reckless like that. If you do the wrong move, all that effort you put into having those trustworthy relationships may go back to square one — Don’t act rash, please. And anyway, don’t get too ahead of yourself please; nothing’ll change whether you were there or not. Quit poking yourself into every single thing. Please have faith in us, and let us handle it.
Yeah… You’re right. You’ve grown so splendidly, Takamine. I’m so proud of you~
Do not pat my head. …Alright, I gotta hurry, so I’ll be leaving now. I’ll keep you updated.
Got it. Be careful, Takamine — I have a bad feeling about this. It’s been peaceful for a while, so honestly, I let my guard down… But it seems like something as ill-intentional as the revolution from two years ago has surged… But it might be even more serious than that.
Chapter 124: Emergency
Location: Training Room
Tetora-kuun~! No wait— I mean Nagumo Tetora-taichou! I, Ryusei Yellow — Sengoku Shinobu, have belatedly arrived at our lesson! Here are some refreshments~ Please do accept them~♪
Ahaha, you don’t have to call me by “Taichou”, Shinobu-kun. It actually makes me feel more queasy — Like, I dunno, I kinda feel somethin’ weird ‘bout it to this day. ‘Cuz like, Ryuseitai never had an actual inheritance event like Knights did with the Crowning Ceremony in Florence.
Uu~myu… I think we should be doing that, though. Our seniors have been busy all over the place and can barely fit time in their schedule ever since their graduation neared, and now here we are…
Ooh, you copied my thing!
Ah, so you were saying “uu~myu” on purpose, Tetora-kun?
Well, more like it became a topic among our fans, so I felt like I had to keep sayin’ it… I get some extreme responses whenever I say “uu~myu”, and that makes me happy, so…
That’s how I feel about the role of Taichou, too — I think I’ll be able to get used to being the leader once I become a great man who can match up to that title. For now, I gotta work hard, then work harder, then even harder and harder! Ossu!
(Mm… But… I really feel like Tetora-kun has not been doing well lately. It’s like he’s trying his best to seem energetic.) (He is the type to act like a tough guy, so he usually holds things in no matter how painful or rough it gets.) (At the very least, Midori-kun and I need to pay close attention to that, as we are the ones closest to him.) (Mhm, and Morisawa-dono and Shinkai-dono should have finally, at last, reached a breathing point in their lives.) (We should plan out an event to hold a ceremony for the inheritance of Ryusei Red—as a surprise.) (Ryuseitai does not have that sort of tradition or anything, so that might be why Morisawa-dono and the others forgot to do such a thing…) (However, it is why there are all sorts of things said about us compared to Knights, so I think it is best that we do this for the sake of Ryuseitai’s future, too.) (We are waiting for MDM at the moment, and it will cost a bit of our expenses, but…) (We have decided not to participate in the so-called “Idol Royale”, so we should have enough funds for the live show.)
Hm? What’s wrong, Shinobu-kun? You’ve been in deep thought for a while now… You’ve been having those moments a lot lately, y’know? Is somethin’ bothering you?
Hehe, I was sinking in the fact that we both became second years, and cannot continue to be children who blindly follow their seniors’ orders. Plus, I am quite the busy person—I have joined the Student Council under Isara-dono’s invitation, and have much thinking to do about many matters. Though frankly, I would like to also gather more new members so that I may advance the Ninja Association into a club…
Ah, then how about we do something ninja-related like Scroll of the Elements1 again? Both me and Midori-kun’ll help out as much as we can, since we’re always in your debt — It’ll be our repayment to you~♪
Ahaha, our trail of thoughts are different, but we are still thinking about the same thing. No matter how much our roles or members have changed, we will always be Ryuseitai.
Ossu! All for one, one for all! That’s the true image of Ryuseitai, the Super Sentai Idols of Justice!
Bad news! We’ve got an emergency, everyone!
Eep!? W-W-What is happening, Midori-kun!? What’s made you rush in here like we’re in a historical drama…!?
Huh? Midori-kun, didn’t you have some fancy commercial shooting to do at the TV station? You were happy about possibly meeting Morisawa-senpai, since he’s doin’ a drama shoot in the same place, weren’t you?
I was not! We were just talking on HoldHands when that idiot was all giddy like, “then I’ll come see you, Takamine! ☆”, and then had to go and find a way to come over and greet me!
Ahh, so you did get to see him. Good, good, was he doing well?
Ahaha. Rather, I could never imagine him not doing well.
Yeah, yeah, he was! I wasn’t worried about that, really, there’s more pressing matters right now…!
Alright, alright, calm down. You’re always so low in energy, so this isn’t like you — What happened? Did something bad happen during your shooting?
No, it’s not that… Ahh, jeez! Just look at this video! Crazy:B’s starting to say some crazy stuff on that Idol Royale thing!
Idol Royale… If I remember correctly, Morisawa-dono was asked to have Ryuseitai appear on that stage. However, as always, Morisawa-dono and Shinkai-dono are far too busy to have their schedules match up, and you also had your commercial shooting to do today… I also personally had Student Council duties to deal with first. Not to mention, as students, we have not yet been able to do proper unit activities within Ryuseitai-N, as most of our members are newcomers… So we chose to decline the offer, did we not?
Ossu, we did. Crazy:B’s got a lotta bad rumors going ‘round, after all. Morisawa-senpai also mentioned that it felt awkward to decline, since we were personally requested to appear on stage, but that it felt wiser to refuse the offer.
Mhm. The current Ryuseitai leader is Tetora-kun, so Morisawa-dono felt like it was wrong to decline it on his own and contacted you about the matter. Morisawa-dono was only the middleman, but he still went ahead and properly explained why we chose to decline the offer to the client. So, yes, Ryuseitai no longer has any relation with the Idol Royale—
Yeah… That was how it was meant to be. See, I was kinda curious about Crazy:B, because Akehoshi-senpai’d sometimes mention them during club activities in school. ‘Cause like, he’d always look upset talking about them, which is unusual for him… So I thought hey, if he hates it, then maybe I’ll like it—
Ahaha, he’s a grand idol who won the SS, you know? You should make sure to get along with him, Midori-kun. You will be able to gain quite a lot from doing so; you should learn from Isara-dono and I, as I have pledged a vow to be a servant to my lord~♪
No way… I can’t physically deal with that guy… Trickstar must be having a lot of free time lately or something, because he keeps pestering me… Just when I thought I’d have a peaceful time at school now that Morisawa-senpai’s graduated… No, wait— Forget about Akehoshi-senpai, we need to talk about Crazy:B— Right now, at the Idol Royale… They’re literally bashing Ryuseitai, calling us frauds and hypocrites.
Chapter end. Next chapter, Rinne starts bashing on Ryuseitai, and fabricating screenshots of things they’ve “said”. The summary of it is to make Ryuseitai sound like fake heroes who only do things for profit.

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] Mega Stream Arc – Dynamic Diamond (Partial Translation)
entry.content:
Translation of a Mayoi, Midori, and Raika scene from the Mega Stream main story Dynamic Diamond. Chapter: Hardness of Bonds 3
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
Note: This is a partial translation of the main story Dynamic Diamond.
Hardness of Bonds 3
Warning: Suicidal ideation in this chapter.
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (4th Week of July)
Around an hour later…
(Sobbing)
(Uu… How could I let this happen…) (I shouldn’t have spoken about HiMERU-san after all.)
(Oogami-san said it isn’t my fault, but the one who ruined Neo-Six of Song’s atmosphere once again is undeniably no one but myself…!) (How am I to take responsibility for this…? What am I supposed to do here…? I don’t know anymore…!) (I truly shouldn’t have been chosen to represent Japan’s idols after aaallll…!)
(If I hope to stop causing any more trouble to everyone… then my only choice now is to atone with my life—)
♪~♪~♪ (Humming)
(Hm? That was Ayase-senpai just now, right…?) (Mm~mm? Are my eyes just playing tricks on me? Why’s he walking aimlessly over there…)
(If I recall correctly, Ayase-senpai was chosen to represent Japan’s idols in order to fight against MELLOW DEAR US… I thought he’d be practicing day and night for that.) (But since he’s walking around, I guess that wasn’t the case…?)
(…Well, I’m not a representative or anything, so it doesn’t really have anything to do with me. More importantly is this right now…♪) (Fufu, never in my wildest dreams did I ever imagine this happening… Collaboration products with yuru-chara are being sold even in Mega Sphere…♪) (Surprisingly, the convenience stores and cafes here aren’t that different from the ones on land. The product lineup goes through changes, and even limited stuff is put out for sale.)
(…I feel like it’s been a while since I got to have some time like this for myself. I’ve been so preoccupied with so many things ever since I got to Mega Sphere.) (When I just got here, I was constantly live-streaming with everyone while still having no idea what was going on…)1
(The moment I thought things settled, they announced an athletic meet up with all the idols right after… And just last week, we were told to do a musical out of nowhere.)2 (Such a harsh schedule… It was really rough without any time to rest.)
(I wasn’t chosen to represent Japan, so I’m kind of happy that I get to have some time to relax and take it easy.)
(…But, well, based on what I’ve heard from Morisawa-senpai, the people representing Japan are having a hard time to this day.) (I’d absolutely hate to fight against the world’s best idol unit. I’d never be able to handle having all of that live-streamed to the whole world…!) (This goes for Ayase-senpai too, but the people working hard as representatives sure are incredible, huh…)
I’m so sorry…! Midori-oniisan!
Woah!? You’re… Raika-kun, was it?
And Anzu-san’s with you, too. What’s wrong?
If I may ask, did you see Neo-Six of Song anywhere here?
Eh? Well, I saw Ayase-senpai a moment ago — He was walking toward the tower over there.
Really!? Did you hear that, Anzu-oneesan!?
…Erm, did something happen? Huh… You went to the lesson room thinking they’d all be there practicing, only to find out nobody’s there… So you got worried that something might’ve happened?
Aye. I came across Anzu-oneesan, so I’m helpin’ her out.
Now that you mention it, Ayase-senpai looked really tired, I think… I thought he just felt exhausted from all the practice as Japan’s representative, though.
Uu… I’m now even more worried… We can’t just stay here! Let’s catch up to Mayomayo Onii-san quickly!3
Sound of running footsteps
They’re gone… This isn’t something I need to follow after, right?
A few minutes later. On the roof of the Mega Sphere Tower…
—Ahh, it truly is so high up here. Unlike that day, the sky is bright enough to see the scenery clearly… Oogami-san isn’t here, and neither is Yuuki-san, who had accompanied me that day. Yet I don’t really feel scared… I wonder why?
Perhaps it’s because I have accepted my punishment. With this, I won’t be causing trouble to anyone anymo—
Uhyaaaa!? Please wait, Mayomayo Onii-san!
…Raika-san!? Why are you here…? Wait, you cannot cling to my back like that, it’s dangerous!
You can’t die~! I’m never ever letting go of ya!
N-No! Not that, it’s that you’re pushing me over further and further, and— O-Oh no—…!?
Hold on, Raika-kun!? You can’t be moving like that in a place this high up, it’s dangerous!
I-I’m losing my balance—!
…!! Ayase-senpai—!
UHYAAAA!?
…Wait, huh? We’re not fallin’?
That was an insanely close call…
…Huff, huff… Anzu-san and Midori-san pulled us back over…
Y-You saved us. Thank ya ever so kindly…♪
I’m so glad you two are safe… If you fell before my eyes, I would’ve been traumatized for life…
I-I’m so sorry. I caused you much trou— Eeek!?
Anzu-oneesan has such a scary look on her face…!
I’m so sorry, everything is all my fault! I’m a worthless being that can only ever cause trouble to otheeerss!
…Pardon? “What happened’?
Uu… The truth is, this and that happened… Causing Neo-Six of Song to break apart, all because I said something unnecessary.
That’s why… I was going to erase myself from this world, so that I no longer cause any trouble to people…
Eeeep!? Anzu-san’s face looks even scarier now…!?
That’s because she was extremely worried about you.
We were so worried you’d disappear forever, Mayomayo Onii-san! I’m never lettin’ ya go, squeeze squeeze~…☆
Hah-hii…! I’ll never do something like this again!
In any case, I truly do not know what to do anymore… How am I to take responsibility for turning Neo-Six of Song into a mess…? How am I supposed to face everyone again…?
You take responsibility for this too, as the producer? I shouldn’t feel responsible for this alone…?
Anzu-san saw herself as spineless because of everything that’s happened?
That’s not true at all! You’re workin’ hard every day for our sake!
Yeah. I don’t think you should be tormenting yourself over this too much. From my perspective, both Ayase-senpai and Anzu-san are doing incredible work, for working hard as Japan’s representative, and for producing every one of those idols.
…Eh? You’d like me to assist you one more time?
Yes, of course I will! If there’s anything I can do for you, please make use of me as you please…! For us to bring back Neo-Six of Song together again, perhaps we should go speak to HiMERU-san first? If we don’t find out the true reason he was practicing with MELLOW DEAR US, the rest of the members, especially Izumi-san, won’t be able to accept it…
Yes, understood. Then let’s split up and look for HiMERU-san…♪
…? There’s another thing you’d like to ask from me…?

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] Mega Stream Arc – Inferno Influence (Partial Translation)
entry.content:
Translation of a Raika, Aira, Chiaki, Mayoi, and Mitsuru scene from the Mega Stream main story Inferno Influence. Chapters: Intermission 6 & 7
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
Note: This is a partial translation of the main story Inferno Influence.
Intermission 6
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (3rd Week of July)
A few minutes later…
…………
Ah, there you are, Raika-kun! Wait up! You vanished from the lesson room before I knew it, y’know~ It surprised me.
Here, I bought some drinks. Is there anything you’d like to drink, Raika-kun? I got us a cake as refreshments for today, so if you’re hungry, I’ll give some to you, too.
Eating something sweet after a practice lesson’s the best, after all! It feels like the sugar goes through your whole worn-out body, almost like — no matter what bad thing happened, one bite of that sweetness can make you forget those heart-wrenching feelings.
…Aira-oniisan.
Here, it’s yummy. How about you try it?
I…
No. I don’t want any. It’s so strange… I don’t feel like I could eat anything right now. Even though bein’ blessed with food should make me super happy… Really weird, right?
Raika-kun…
(He really is feeling super down about what happened…) (From his perspective, even though he was trying his best for Yume-kun’s sake with a fresh start, he only ended up making a mistake all over again.) (Yume-kun was super harsh with his words, too. If it were me, I would’ve felt too devastated to do anything…)
(I was hoping to help Raika-kun get back his confidence, though…) (Confidence is only built through successful experiences, so with situations like this, Raika-kun needs to build more confidence in himself.)
(It’s so much easier said than done, though… I don’t know what I’m supposed to do to help him at all!) (I’m so sorry I’m such a pathetic senior, Raika-kun…)
Fuhahahaha! You seem to be bearing some heavy worries, boys!
Eh…? Morisawa-senpai!?
Mm! The red flame is the mark of justice! The sun of life, burning bright red! Ryusei Red, Morisawa Chiaki…! I came here as soon as I heard about Raika-kun’s crisis…☆
It’s not just Chia-chan-senpai! I also came rushing as soon as I heard Raika-chan’s in crisis! And what’s more… Look, Mayo-chan-senpai’s here, too!
I-I’m so sorry. But I don’t think that a miserable person like myself could ever hope to cheer Raika-kun up…
What’re you saying, Ayase!? Aren’t you the first person to mention wanting to cheer up Raika-kun?
Mayomayo Onii-san… said that about me?
Erm, um… Yes. I happened to see what was happening in Raika-san’s team through the 24-hour live stream…
However, I was not sure how to go about speaking to you, so I called for Chiaki-san and Mitsuru-sannn…
The four of us here reminds me of when we encouraged each other back in Gourmet District.1 Back then, Raika-kun’s innocent singing voice brought me lots of energy!
To this very day, I remember when Raika-kun and Ayase danced to the “Vegetable Dance” together, all for the sake of cheering me up!2
Ah—! I learned about that after I went back on the 4piece program way after!
It’s not fair that I wasn’t part of it! It feels so lonely being left out!
We weren’t trying to leave you out, Tenma-kun. But, well, I can’t deny the fact that in the end, that’s technically what happened.
In that case, let’s sing a song to cheer Raika-kun up together this time! Come on now, let’s do this! Shiratori, Ayase, you join us too!
Hurray~! Hurray~! Raika-kun~♪
You can do this, you can do this, Raika-chan! You’ve still got it in you, Raika-chan~♪
Eh? Eh!? This is too sudden for me…!
I don’t know anything either, y’know!?
It’s alright, you just need to share the words you want to tell Raika-kun, you two! I understand not being sure what to say, but you won’t be able to convey your feelings without trying to say something at least.
Intermission 7
Ehihi. Chiaki-oniisan, everyone, you really are all such kind people. I’m very happy about all of this, but… I also feel bad, as well. I’m makin’ all of you use up your time for someone like me…
P-Please don’t feel bad about this, Raika-san!
Hmm… It really is too tough on him to feel better just by being told that.
Raika-chan. You should just let out every bit of your feelings out when you feel this way!
It’s okay, no matter what you say, we’ll always be by your side, Raika-chan!
…Mitsuru-oniisan. Chiaki-oniisan. Mayomayo Onii-san…
Sniff… Uu… I, just feel so frustrated with myself… Why is it so hard for me to do anything? Why am I this stupid? I just want to be of help to Yume-san… So why does my bird brain forget such simple lines so easily?3 How am I… How am I supposed to atone for all the bad things I’ve done? Sniff… I can’t think of any way to do that, not with this empty head of mine…
Raika-kun…
And all I’ve ever done is cause trouble to my team… I really am better off not being here after all…
That’s not true, Raika-chan! It’s all thanks to Raika-chan that I could have loads of fun with 4piece!
And it’s ‘cuz you were there that I was able to do all sortsa things!4 I’m super sure that even in Mega Sphere, there’s something only you can do, Raika-chan!
Yeah, exactly what Tenma-kun says. There’s nothing out there that would be better off without you, not for even a second.
But… All I’m able to do is get in everyone’s way, and I can’t do anythin’ right.
And what’s worse, I made everythin’ that Yume-san wanted to do go to waste. After all these things I’ve done, is there really somethin’ out there that I could do…?
There definitely is. And I believe that what you should do right now is look for that very thing. Most of all, if you run away now, I’m sure you would just regret it, Raika-kun.
……Long ago, I was also made painfully aware of my utter powerlessness to do anything. I tried to look away from it as hard as I could, telling myself that it’s a problem beyond my power. I made excuses that I can’t do it… I made use of any means to protect myself from it… I even shut down my very own dream that I believed in for so many years…5
But averting our eyes will never help clear our hearts in the end. That’s why, Raika-kun. I don’t want you to look away from what your heart wants to do.
So come on, go ahead and say it. Raika-kun, what is it that you want to do?
Sobs… Sniffs… I want to do what I can for Yume-san’s sake… I don’t want this to end with me accomplishin’ nothing but trouble for my team…!
You did a great job saying it outloud, Raika-kun. You were able to express it, so it’ll be alright now. Now that you’ve said all the words in your heart, all that’s left is to pour in all your efforts to achieve that!
As long as you don’t give up, you’ll surely find something you can do. Hang in there, Raika-kun!
Aye…! I don’t know what I can do, but… Even then… I will try to do my best so that I can do somethin’…!
(Whew, I’m so glad. Thanks to Mayo-san and everyone, Raika-kun got back on his feet a little.)
(That being said… All my seniors rushing in to cheer Raika-kun up was sooo ra~vely…☆) (Just listening to them from the sides moved me to tears.)
(My seniors really are amazing… Meanwhile, I didn’t know what I was supposed to tell Raika-kun here…)
(No. I can’t let myself be down in the dumps right now. Raika-kun’s finally feeling a bit better.)
(I gotta do the same, too. It’s ‘cause the team is in such a mess right now that I gotta think about what I can do here!)

Translation Notes ↑ Referring to the 4piece audition main story, VS★GOURMET. Chiaki, Mayoi, Raika, and Mitsuru would typically group up in the audition and help each other get through each task.↑ Chiaki’s referring to the song performed in VS★GOURMET; Flood of Customers, Chapter 3, when Raika and Mayoi wanted to help Chiaki overcome his hatred of eggplants in order to complete his assistance work in the vegetable field (which was the only way to get back to the main audition).↑ In Japanese, bird brain means “forgetful memory”.↑ Raika helped Mitsuru in various ways in the 4piece audition, VS★GOURMET. One of the biggest ways he helped him is by singing and attracting customers to Mitsuru’s shop.↑ This is referring to Meteor Impact, Unqualified Hero 16-19. In these chapters, Chiaki kept doubting himself and overthought everything happening around him, until he emotionally spiralled saying he was never a hero, and then eventually broke down crying. He picks himself back up eventually after Madara phonecalls him, which gave him a second chance to achieve his dream of becoming a hero.

entry.title: SS Finals – Ryuseitai’s Scene (1 Chapter Only!)
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
Akira
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
None
The ES!! Main story is fully voiced in-game.
——Ryuseitai!
Don’t set out to battle just yet!
Hm? Hidaka? Akehoshi? What’s up, what’s wrong? I thought you guys at Trickstar became much more quiet this year. Are you actually planning to cause a stir on this final stage…?
Spare us from any unnecessary disruptions, ‘kay?
We wouldn’t do that! How rude! Hrmph, hrmph!
It’s as Akehoshi says. We’re extremely grateful to Morisawa-senpai — No, to Ryuseitai as a whole, for what you’ve all done for us during the first DDD. We will never forget what you did for us. We assure you that we won’t do anything to repay that kindness with spite instead.
So you say, but all you did in Tanabata last year was put pressure on us… My depression got worse for a while after that, y’know…
Ahaha, but thanks to everything that had happened then, we were able to finally peel off our newbie labels. All’s well that ends well!
Well, I’m sure it was nice for you since you were just flirting with Isara-senpai, Shinobu-kun… but it was a traumatic experience for me, personally…
Huh? Why? Did we do something to you, Takamin?
You see what I mean…? Could you guys please understand your position for once…?
We’re told that often. Especially lately.
erm. did you have something to [tell] us, trickstar?
Fuhaha! You came to cheer for us as fellow members of the Red Team, right? I’m sure that’s why! Thank you! We’ll turn your cheers into strength, and march forth!
Chi~chan-senpai… (I really can’t say it after all… He won’t listen even if I tried… After all, I got that from him in the end.) No, never mind. Mhm, I just came to cheer for you guys. Do your best out there!
Um, we don’t need you to tell us that, ‘kay? We’re gonna do our best no matter what. Does everyone seriously just see us as weaklings or something?
Ohhh, Midori-kun suddenly became so energetic!
He’s got a stronger fighting spirit than you’d first expect, after all~! ♪
…Yeah. If Ryuseitai wins here, we’ll have won four battles in a row, and it would let us Red Team win in the end. Knowing the victor half-way into the event would ruin the fun for everything, but— At least it would mean that once we’re up next, we can perform as we like, without worrying about victories and losses.
Mhm! We prefer it that way, anyway, so make sure you win, Ryuseitai! ♪ We’re all pretty tired of all this fighting and crushing each other, anyway!
Ahaha, that’s so not like you guys.
What do you mean?
Wh— Why do you look so surprised…? Maybe you aren’t like that this year, but you guys were basically picking a fight with anyone last year, like you were some biker gang…
Biker gang… I suppose that is a perfectly fitting phrase for us.
Ohh, incredible Takamin! You’re so precise! So smart! There, there, there~♪
Don’t get near me! I don’t want your pestering! Can you just go already if you’re done talking…!?
But Takamin, you love being pat like this, right? ♪
I’d never be happy being pat if it’s from you!
fufu, exactly~ i will not say that your help is [unnecessary], but… there is no [need] to worry about us. we will not lose anymore. we will win this [battle], and ensure [victory] for the [red team], all so that we may [relieve] those who will [perform] after us. don’t you think that is very ryuseitai of us?
Exactly what Kanata said! Believe in us and watch over us, Trickstar! We won’t lose to anyone any further!
I see. Then we’ll believe in you all. That’s good enough, right, Akehoshi?
Mhm. If anything, I’m sorry we ruined your focus just before your performance.
You really did… What an absolute nuisance.
Now, now… They aren’t the type to act on ill intent, so let’s laugh it off and forgive ‘em.
laugh and forgive! that is also very ryuseitai-like~♪
Ahaha~ True, that’s what I love about you guys. You always give me energy and courage. …Good luck out there, I mean it! ♪~♪~♪
Right, we’ll excuse ourselves now. Sorry for the trouble. We wish you the best of luck from the bottom of our hearts.

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] World Tour Arc – Prologue
entry.content:
Translation of the World Tour Arc: Prologue Chapters, featuring all ES units, as well as the tournament matches.
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori & citrinesea
Note: This chapter kickstarts the World Tour Arc and introduces the tournament match-ups.
Click HERE to watch & read along the translation!
Season: ES 2nd Year, Autumn
My friends! I’d like to announce a brand new grand event to you all, held jointly by Thunderbolt Entertainment and Ensemble Square! This event shall be a world tour to determine who shall be the “Icon of the New Idol Century”, known as “Megasphere Match”!
“Megasphere Match” — “MM” for short — is an event set up similarly to “SS”, with the objective of determining who makes up the idol industry’s cream of the crop. Four units from each ES agency have been selected to take part in a tournament-style live showdown, held across several countries around the world. Each showdown shares this one rule: the units will conduct a joint-performance with a song arranged by the management team.
The winners of each match shall be decided by the total number of votes from both online viewers and those in the live venue.1 In other words, our voter base will be the over 8-billion people across the whole world!
The proud winner of the tournament will obtain the title of “World’s Best Idols”, both in name and actuality! Right now, the whole world has their eyes on idols after the success of Mega Stream. If you can grab all that attention to yourself, there would be no greater honor to your name!
Which unit will be chosen as the “World’s Best Idols”? I expect absolutely Nice battles all around~♪
(Yoshihide-kun’s blabberin’ on and on about nonsense, but — In short, this is just a power struggle between agencies, isn’t it?) (As for us, the big-shots picked us out, and all we did was get forcibly dispatched to this lottery. There was no asking us to do it, we just had to.)
(But, well, it doesn’t sound like there’s a penalty if you lose, so I’ll just take this nice and easy~♪)
Right then, let’s begin the lottery event to decide the matches. Could the leaders of each unit step forward, please! Inside this box are strips of papers with the numbers 1 to 16 written on them.
Could you enter the name of your unit on the tournament bracket, starting from whoever drew the lowest number? There are eight match-ups in total. Those who write their name first will also earn the right to decide where the venue will be held, so this lottery is of utmost importance.
Hmph. Where it will be held doesn’t matter. Cease this silly charade already.
Now, now, Oshi-san…
Alright, go ahead and draw the lottery…☆
…Fufu.
Now then, which team drew the lowest number?
That would be us, fine. Right, for the bracket… I suppose I’ll choose position number “4”, the unlucky number. ♪2 Although it may be a bad omen, let’s say that this is a declaration of our intent — that we will demonstrate our capability and confidence to ward it all off.
This man truly utters nothing but meaningless statements, as per usual.
If you’re done here, withdraw yourself already. We, Valkyrie, are next in line.
Hm… We shall take number 16.
Number 16? D’ya got some kinda reason behind that?
I simply chose the farthest bracket away from this demonic man.
Oh my, have you gotten the jitters just from coming into contact with us?
I won’t fall for such cheap provocations. I simply deemed this the most optimal strategy.
Well then, let’s begin selecting where each showdown will be held as well. Could you state the country you’d like to hold it in?
We’ll go with “Japan”. I’d like to preserve our stamina by minimizing all travel.
Then we shall hold ours in “France”. The reason why — Well, that’s quite clear without me saying it, isn’t it?
Such Nice choices! Next in line is—
It is UNDEAD’s turn. While those two were bickering, we had already decided on the bracket and location. We shall go with number 9. As for the location…
It will be Adonis-kun’s homeland, “Boemika”.
We aren’t goin’ with my beloved UK!?
This was Adonis-kun’s one and only request, you see. ♪
Alright thEN, we Switch will choose number 14. (I’d like to reduce the chances that we end up against a powerful uNIT. AlthouGH, we may end up fighting against Shu-niisan if we wIN.) RigHT, for the locatiON…
Shisho~, Sora wants to go to “Egypt”! The movie Sora watched the other day was super duper interesting~♪
Ahh, you’re talking about “The Mummy”, aren’t yoU?
My turn nooow! ☆ Leeet’s see here, this is a pretty massive event and all, sooo…
Number 3! I’m gonna straight up challenge Eichi-san to a battle!
Fufu, the moment to bring you down has finally come. This will be quite the delight…♪
Up next is us!
Aight then… Number 1! ‘Cuz we’re number one! ☆
Dumbass, ya hafta give this more proper thought.
Nah, for somethin’ like this, you’ll only strike gold if ya don’t think about it! ♪
—We choose “the U.S.” as our location. We’re quite acquainted with that country, so it should come to our advantage.
Hm, “the U.S.”, is it? Perfect, we’ll choose number 2 then. Crazy:B. We’ll redeem ourselves for the loss we suffered in the Idol Royale, once and for all.
We were hoping to have a showdown with fine, the victors of the last SS, but since that’s not an option… Another bracket we could take is…
Hokuto-senpai. This is meant to be a showdown between agencies as well, so it’s best that you avoid any brackets with a unit from the same agency!
Then we’ll go with number 5.
As for the location… We choose “Italy”. We went through plenty of struggles in the jungle back at SS, after all. I’d like to fight in an urban area this time.
(Uu, which country should we go to…? No, first off, which bracket should I even choose…!?) (I can’t believe I’m the leader at such a crucial time like this… This is so depressing…)
Oh? Who’s next in line?
Ah—Um, yes! It’s me! Our number will be, um…
Ah, screw it. I’ll pick with my eyes closed. Let’s go with number 10…!
We’ll have to fight against UNDEAD in our very first match if you choose that one, you know!?
Eh!? Ah—! Then number 15…?
We’re going up against Valkyrie!?
I take that back too! We’ll go with number 11, and the location will be “Australia”. I want to see the koalas…
Then Knights will choose number 6. Please do go easy on us, Hidaka-senpai.
Our first opponent is Knights, huh. This should be a satisfactory battle for the both of us.
Erm, Ra*bits’ bracket will be…
The powerhouse units Eden and MELLOW DEAR US haven’t decided on their brackets yet…
Uu… We won’t know who we’re up against, but I’ll choose number 8. Can I let you guys decide the venue location?
I don’t know a thing about overseas, so I’d have no clue what to choose, you know~!? Um, ummm…
Then let’s go with “Hawaii”! ☆
You just said a tourist area you know of, didn’t you!?
Okay nooow~! Next up is 2wink~☆ We’ll take number 12! We’ll pick up the gauntlet against Ryuseitai!
If we want to blast through the first match, then we should target Ryuseitai — right, Aniki~? ♪
Mh—! We refuse to lose to you!
It’s finally our turn, huh. Right then, let’s see what brackets are left…
(Whatever you do, don’t choose number 7…!)
—We’ll choose number 15. We’re in your care, Valkyrie. ♪
(T-That was close~!)
…Hmph.
We choose number 7. Dear seniors in Ra*bits, we are in your care!!!!
This is gonna be a cute showdown! Yaaay~! ☆
What are you on about? “Cute” obviously means Spri will be the winner.
Couldja not pick fights before the match has even begun!?
…So what’s left for us is either UNDEAD or Switch’s match.
…Fufu. How about our two units fight — UNDEAD?
Oh? We’ll be fighting against Eden? This is going to be quite the intriguing battle~♪
That means ALKALOID will have a match against Switch! We’re in your care!
Fufu, and now, we have our showdown brackets settled with!
1st Match: Crazy:B VS Akatsuki!
2nd Match: MaM VS fine!
3rd Match: Trickstar VS Knights!
4th Match: Special for Princess! VS Ra*bits!
5th Match: UNDEAD VS Eden!
6th Match: Ryuseitai VS 2wink!
7th Match: ALKALOID VS Switch!
8th Match: MELLOW DEAR US VS Valkyrie!
These will be all our unit matches for the first round! What sort of dramatic events will take place in these battles? Which unit will manage to climb up to the top? We hope that you look forward to seeing the brilliance of all these idols!
Now then, it is time we open the curtains to the World Tour “MM”!

entry.title: Mainstream Megasphere – Possibility of Scattering (Chapter 1–5)
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Ch 4 - Ch 5 - Translation Notes Chapter 1
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer
Next day. Passage Arcade…1
—Oi, oi, it’s practically a deserted town here. Usually there’s at least one or two idols live-streamin’ around this area, so what gives? This is just wastin’ away Rinne-kun’s grand plan to have a change of pace by bargin’ in and making a mess of someone’s stream… …………
Sigh, this is so borin’…
Man… Was it that shockin’ to lose against MELLOW DEAR US? We were up against world-class idols. If anythin’, Merumeru and his unit did a pretty damn good job holdin’ up against them, yeah?2 Sure, the loss was by a huge margin and all, but those guys put up a good fight all the same.
…Well, I guess this just means there’s only a few people like me who can make do with the results bein’ that way. In reality, you could actually just as much say that that showdown made the gap between us and them even more obvious. Merumeru and his unit poured in a good amount of effort, but the world’s barrier isn’t lax enough to get through with just that alone. I guess you can’t really deny that the producer Anzu-chan’s prospects were way too naive in the end.
Either way… That defeat is why all the ES idols are dead silent like they’re in mournin’. And thanks to that, stayin’ in my room just means bein’ surrounded by that depressin’ air, and I couldn’t take it anymore. My ever-so-precious luck is also gonna run off somewhere at this rate, man…?
Well, then again, I haven’t been able to do any gamblin’ ever since I came to Mega Sphere, so I guess it doesn’t really matter. Ah~h, I wanna go to a pachinko parlor after so long and get a kick outta a big one…!
Eughh, it’s miserable here too. I can practically hear the crickets…
I was seriously hopin’ to banter with whoever came here for tea, though. What a letdown… Wait, hm?
…Hello there, Amagi Rinne-kun. If it’s banter you want, you’re completely welcome to do so here. ♪
Well, if it isn’t Nagi. It was pretty quiet here, so I thought there wasn’t anyone at first.
…I had nobody to speak to, that’s all. And as for you, I see you’ve been talking to yourself quite a bit. …It’s said that talking to yourself a lot indicates stress or lack of conversation; is that the case for you, Amagi Rinne-kun?
Yep yep, bingo! I managed to get outta some real depressin’ air that was tirin’ me out, but it’s a bore no matter where I go!
So with that said, how about you and I talk a li’l, Nagi~♪
…Of course. Is there anything you’d like to drink?
Got anythin’ you recommend? Gimme your reccs, as the senior who came here first.
…Then I recommend the coffee. It goes well with the sandwich as a light meal.
Guess I’ll order me some coffee and sandwich as an early lunch, then.
So. Why’re ya all alone here, drinkin’ coffee? You aren’t with Hiyori-chan today?
…Hiyori-kun is in our room.3 I simply dropped by here while I was taking my daily stroll. …There was something I wanted to think about on my own, you see.
Somethin’ ya wanted to think about, huh…? Bet it’s the next showdown against MELLOW DEAR US, yeah?
…Yes. We, ES idols, suffered a thorough defeat in Dynamic Diamond. …Not even Anzu-san’s producing skills nor Neo-Six of Song’s fierce battle was a match against MELLOW DEAR US.2 …I was pondering how I’m meant to come to terms with that fact.
How to come to terms with it, huh…? So, what’s on your mind regardin’ that? The ES idols miserably lost in the prelude live show, “Dynamic Diamond” — Do ya think those idols have a chance to win in the next performance, “Mainstream Megasphere”?
…I don’t know.
Oi, oi, what’s with the inoffensive answer, Nagi? How about ya say how ya honestly feel? This ain’t the time to word it in a hopeful way like “I don’t know”, is it?
…I see that you don’t think we have a chance to win against them, Rinne-kun.
As of this moment, we already lost by a huge margin, didn’t we? It’s pretty damn clear there’s no chance we can win by doin’ it normally. One of the most important rules of Mega Stream is who can get the most “Nice!”s, and the amount of fans directly influences your victory. And since MELLOW DEAR US already has fans all over the world, us ES idols can never have enough fans to compare, even if we formed a group. The very showdown that made that fact wide and clear is none other than the pre-live the other day — Dynamic Diamond.
Yoshihide-kun’s pretty nasty, too. First he makes us painfully aware of the gap between us and our opponent, and now he’s tryin’ to put an end to us one last time. It’s like kickin’ down a dead body at this point, ain’t it?
…We haven’t died. So that wording doesn’t quite work here.
Huh, you sure? The ES idols are like corpses right now, though. They’ve lost all strength to keep goin’ after seein’ the overwhelmin’ gap between ‘em and MELLOW DEAR US. Are ya sayin’ there’s still a chance for us to win even then, Nagi?
…………
As they say, speech is silver, silence is golden. The fact you can’t respond back basically gives the answer.
…Right. As you’d expect, it will likely be a very harsh battle. …The gap between us and MELLOW DEAR US is evidently clear. What sort of move can ES take here to overturn that gap… That, I wouldn’t know. …We’ll need a plan. An extraordinary plan that can flip the script over and revive us all from the brink of death.
…That, or if it were her… Perhaps if it were Anzu-san, who had overturned adversities multiple times up until this point — She could be coming up with a strategy to win against MELLOW DEAR US.
I wonder…? Seems to me that even Anzu-chan, who’s always poured her efforts into her work as the ES idols’ goddess, feels beaten down by this showdown. Is this really a situation where the Goddess of Victory could smile upon us…?
Chapter 2
(Mhh…) (No matter how many times I think back on our conversation, I can’t fully grasp where exactly the problem was. I don’t believe I said anything strange…) (…But Anzu ran off in tears, so I must have messed up somewhere.)
(What on earth did I say to make her so sad…?) (I was trying to comfort her to the maximum capability — “You don’t have to feel burdened by our defeat,” “Even if we’ve lost this time, it’ll be fine as long as we win next time”…) (That was me trying to encourage her, nestle close and sympathize with her…)
Hey, Hidaka-kun? You seem pretty down since yesterday, did something happen?
Yeah, yeah! Hokke~ is acting so weird. It feels like something’s on his mind rather than he’s feeling down, though.
Ahh, no. I was just absorbed in my thoughts. I was thinking back on my conversation with Anzu, wondering if I might have blurted out something insensitive to her.
Ah—! So that’s what it was!? As soon as you got back, you suddenly asked me, “Am I actually just as insensitive as you?”— But even when I asked you where the heck that came from, you just went quiet with a sad look on your face! Just so you know, at that moment, you were the only one who was being insensitive, ‘kay!?
…And anyway, Hokuto, you sometimes call me insensitive or whatever, but let me just say — You’re way more insensitive, in my opinion.
Ahaha, Hokke~ and Sally~ are the insensitive duo! ☆
Subaru~! What’s with that grin, like you’re not a part of this! I’m not letting you get away with it, ‘kay? We’re the insensitive trio!
Ehhh~!? Nu-uh, count me out! I don’t want that position~ You and Hokke~ should take the seat by yourselves!
It’s hard to draw the line between whether Hidaka-kun is insensitive or just a natural airhead, honestly.
Alright, this isn’t even important right now, anyway.
So what even happened yesterday? It seems like something you said to Anzu is weighing your mind. If you can’t make sense of it on your own, then you could talk to us about it, yeah?
…You’re right. I’ve thought it over since last night, but I don’t think I’ll be able to reach a clear answer on my own. I’d like to hear your thoughts. The truth is—
Time passes…
Hokuto (Hokke~), you’re in the wrong.
Why…!?
‘Cause it’s clear as day that you basically cornered Anzu by saying all that.
Cornered her…? That’s not what I was trying to do. My intention was to do what’s best at that moment, and encourage her with positive words as much as I could.
Uh, I’m sure that is what you wanted to do, but that doesn’t mean that a logical argument is what would’ve been correct for her, y’know?
…? What do you mean?
Well, I get how Hokke~ feels, as well. After all, if encouraging someone to do their best when they feel down is the wrong answer, then what would be the right one, yeah?
But the thing is, Anzu was doing her best the whole time. She tried, and tried, and tried, and even then couldn’t win. And then she gets told to just “do her best some more”… if I was in her shoes, I’d feel a little fed up.
…………
Anzu-chan… I didn’t know she was feeling responsible for our defeat all this time… Even though it’s all our fault that we lost…2 I don’t want her to feel so much responsibility. I don’t want her to be sad, and yet…
…But I think that sense of responsibility she feels is ‘cause Anzu is firmly dedicated to her producer job. It’s ‘cause she takes her work seriously that she must feel so frustrated for failing to achieve good results for all the idols that trusted and followed her. While it’s true that we, the idols, are the ones who go up on stage and participate in the performances and battles… In that same sense, Anzu must feel as though she’s been putting up just as much of a fight, as a producer. So Makoto, saying you don’t want her to feel so much responsibility is basically just looking down on her in the end, isn’t it?
I see… That makes sense. It’s because she dedicated herself to us that she feels that way, right…
Fufu. You were the Student Council President, so you really get how it feels to be the one in charge of many people, huh?
Yeah, more or less.
But I’m still worried… If Anzu was like that yesterday, then she must still be feeling down in the dumps today, too.
…Ah, I know! Let’s go cheer up Anzu together!
Eh? But it didn’t go well when I encouraged her yesterday, y’know? Would anything change if we did it today instead?
Jeez, that’s just ‘cause the way you encouraged her was all wrong, Hokke~!
We don’t have to tell her to do her best or anything, and I don’t plan on saying it either. Let’s just eat tasty food together!
Ahh, yeah, that sounds great! ♪
Yeah, if she’s feeling hungry, she won’t have the energy to feel better in the first place.
I see. It’s like the saying, “You can’t fight on an empty stomach”, right? My grandmother would always make me lots of food whenever I was feeling down, too.
Yup, yup! Alrighty then, let’s head off to where she is! Off we gooo~! ☆
Sound of running footsteps
Woah— Hold it, Akehoshi! Don’t drag me over like that…!
Sound of door bell ringing
…………
…Mm?
Sound of door bell ringing again
There’s no response even when I push the door bell~ Actually, I don’t think I sense anyone inside the room.
Maybe she went out somewhere. We just missed her, then… Bad timing on our part~
But where could she have gone? Did she go somewhere for a change of pac—
Sound of door opening
Huh!?
What’s wrong?
The door opened when I pushed it…!? It doesn’t seem like the door was locked…
Did she forget to lock it? That’s not safe… Anzu, I’m coming in.
Ehhh!? Hidaka-kun, don’t you know it’s a bad idea to enter a girl’s room without notice!?
I’m not entering without notice. I informed her just now that I’m coming in.
Erm, no, that’s not the problem here…
Sound of walking in
Mm? What on earth…?
What’s wrong, Hokke~?
—Her room is completely empty.
Chapter 3
Several minutes later, in the Producer Room…
—Anzu, are you here? …………
She doesn’t seem to be here, either. If she isn’t in her room nor in the Producer Room, then where could she be? I guess the Sphere Stage?
………… Hey, isn’t this kinda weird?
Huh?
Anzu likes to keep things tidy, so I’m sure that’s why her desk is always clean and tidy too… But it’s way too clean for someone still in their work hours… Like, there’s literally nothing?
You make a good point. It’s unnatural how there isn’t anything placed on the desk.
…Mm? What are you all doing here?
Ahh, Tenshouin-senpai’s here. We’re looking for Anzu. We went to her room, but it was completely empty, so… We figured we may be able to meet here if we came here instead.
………… I suppose the truth will come out in due time even if I try to hide it, so I’ll let the four of you know. Anzu-chan resigned from her job yesterday, and left this place.
…What?
Well, I say she resigned, but she was no longer part of ES regardless. More accurately would be to say that she left Mega Sphere after her producer contract was terminated, I suppose.4
Forget about her position! More importantly, what the hell do you mean by “resigned”!?
What else could I mean except what that word entails? She resigned. Which means it wouldn’t be strange at all to see her room and desk clean and tidy.
No way… Anzu…
The next day, after Anzu left. The living area…
…………
(She really isn’t here, either.) (I just couldn’t get myself to believe what Tenshouin-senpai said yesterday, so I tried going around on foot to look for her instead…) (I’ve searched everywhere I could go in Mega Sphere, but Anzu was nowhere to be found.)
So what Tenshouin-senpai said really was true after all…? But why—…
This is awful…!
Mm? Over there is—
Uu… uuu… sniff… This just can’t be true… Why didn’t she tell us anything…? Tell me it’s anything but this…! This is just too muuuhhchh… Sobs…
…………
…Crying won’t help anyone here, y’know?
Sena-senpai, there is no need to put it that way… Narukami-senpai, please feel free to use my Handkerchief.5
Huh, it’s rare to see all of Knights gathered in one place. Narukami seems to be crying, but is there something wrong?
Ahh, Hidaka.
Ermm, that’s… just a little something in relation to Onee-sama…
You’ve all already heard about it…?
Hmm, so that must mean you guys in Trickstar know about it, too — About how Anzu quit being a producer.
Yeah, we learned about it yesterday. But don’t spread this around to other people, alright? It’s risky to have the ES idols in disarray.
That’s gonna be impossible. It’s already spreading like wildfire across all of Mega Sphere~ It’s gonna basically become common knowledge by tomorrow, I bet.
………… (I suppose so. That means the ES side is going to be thrown into more and more chaos.) (Does Tenshouin-senpai know about this…? I’m not up for it, but maybe I should report to him just in case. I’d also like to hear his thoughts about what we’ll do from now on.)
There’s nothing we can do if it’s already naturally spread to others, but at least try not to attract people’s attention on purpose with conspicuous acts. Knights gathering to have a grave discussion is already conspicuous enough, just to let you know. Right, see you.
Sooo~ annoying. I’m trying really hard to keep myself calm here. But Naru-kun’s this much of a mess~
You can’t blame me for that…! I can’t stay calm when things are like this! I’m so upset at how powerless and worthless I’ve been that the tears just keep coming… Why didn’t I ever provide support for Anzu-chan…?
…………
I feel the same, Narukami-senpai. I could not even protect one single person important to me… I’m a disgrace as a Knights member.
Even though Anzu-chan has saved us so, so many times… After all, because of Knights’ traits as a unit, we tend to have many bloody battles. It was the same in Requiem.6 If we went by what Leo-kun thought up, who knows how we would’ve turned out…! That’s exactly why Leo-kun had Anzu-chan come up with the details, right? Because if it’s her, she would surely make it a gentle world’s battle epic.
Mhm. And what’s more, Anzu achieved exactly that, just as I had hoped. She turned the story that I wrote with my blood into one written with red ink!
Ahh, yeah, that totally happened, didn’t it? And Anzu smells nice, just like Ma~kun. A person with tasty blood is proof of a good person~♪
Exactly. Onee-sama was always such a kind person from the very beginning. Those whom we must always serve are Anzu-oneesama, and our Fans who have exchanged love with us Knights.
I never once expected that we would lose a piece of that… It feels as though a hole has opened wide in my heart…
And she was so unreliable at first, too. She’d bring the most unthinkable things as refreshments, and she could barely express her feelings well. I’d keep needing to scold her several times, like, “Quit being such a mess!”7
But… Anzu genuinely faced those issues and fixed her mistakes. …I showed her just how much I approve of her determination, but now you’re telling me she gave in here?
…Yes. Exactly. We’ve all been saved by Anzu-chan in all these different ways… Yet we couldn’t do a single thing for her when she was suffering! I’m so frustrated with myself…! Even though this would’ve been the perfect chance to finally repay her for every little thing she’s given us! But now, Anzu-chan is no longer anywhere in Mega Sphere… It’s simply too much for me…
Chapter 4
—And that is what had happened.
I see. …Thank you for looking into it for us, Sengoku.
so anzu-san returned back to the [ground]…
…Now that I think about it, Anzu seemed to have a lot more worries on her mind ever since we came to Mega Sphere.
(When Neo-Six of Song had all that chaos happening, I thought she was just panicking over Ayase-senpai…)8 (But was this constantly weighing on her mind back then, too…?)
It had to have been the showdown against MELLOW DEAR US. As the producer, she might have felt responsible for the ES idols’ loss.
…No, I shouldn’t just assume what Anzu is feeling however I like.
The one thing for sure is that Anzu-anego had a lot weighin’ on her mind.9 I’m so pathetic. How did I never notice that Anego was sufferin’…
…It’s understandable that you hadn’t noticed. Anzu-dono has always been such a reliable figure. …We never once could have imagined that she’d disappear from Mega Sphere.
Yeah. We had all relied on her so much that the possibility never once popped into our minds. That just goes to show how much trust she gained from us. …I’m another person who’s been saved multiple times by Anzu.
yes, chiaki used to trouble anzu-san a lot in the past~
Are you referring to when he requested her to rewrite a project proposal from scratch?10
There was also a time when he collapsed from a whole buncha burdens he put on himself, and then got nursed back to health by her, right?11
…You should seriously apologize to her at least once, Morisawa-senpai.
W-Why’re you all talking about my side only!? She’s looked after you guys plenty of times too, hasn’t she!?
…Yeah. I feel like I used to rely on Anzu-anego over every single thing when we first became part of Ryuseitai.
Mm, indeed. And in fact, it is because she has been here with us that we have been able to perform various activities, as we are now.
Yeah, true. …I also owe her a lot for making me so many different kinds of yuru-chara.12
Ah, another story about the olden days? …Hold on, Midori-kun. That’s what you remember?
Ehh, what else was I supposed to mention…
i am very earnest, so i have never caused her [trouble]. if anything, i would always thank her for her constant hard work with “good girl, good girl”~♪13
…I was already aware of this, but we really have relied on her time and time again, haven’t we? This is so pathetic, realizing how precious she was only after she disappeared. If only I had kept my eyes on her more often, maybe then…
Here he goes again, this guy…
The same goes for the rest of us; we all did not realize in time, Morisawa-dono.
Yeah. …I’m aware. But as Nagumo said… As someone who calls himself a hero, it frustrates me that I never once noticed she was suffering.
…………
UGAAAH~!! I CAN’T TAKE THIS ANYMORE!
What’s wrong, Tetora-kun!? Why did you suddenly yell so loudly…?
It just ain’t me to sit here and talk ‘bout this stuff! I’m gonna look for Anzu-anego!
Look for her…? But Anzu-san isn’t in Mega Sphere anymore, right? From what Shinobu-kun heard, it sounds like all her personal belongings aren’t in the Producer Room anymore, either…
Isara-dono and the others said they tried searching for Anzu-dono in Mega Sphere, but could not find her.
It’s a different story if we could follow her trail and search for her on land, but… We’re all locked up in Mega Sphere in a sense.14 It won’t be easy to get ourselves a way out of here.
Exactly, so where do you even plan to go searching for her?
…I know. I know all’a that! But I can’t stand the thought of just cowerin’ back and mopin’ around here!
…Nagumo.
Besides, how are we even sure that Anzu-anego went back down!? Did anyone see her leave? She might actually be hidin’ somewhere in Mega Sphere all along, you never know! Isara-senpai and the others may have looked for her, but they didn’t check every corner of Mega Sphere, did they?
You… may be right there, but…
…ufufu. i [agree] with tetora. we may be surprised to find out that anzu-san is just playing [hide-and-seek]~♪ she might be waiting for us to find her even now.
Shinkai-senpai…!
…………
…Yeah. Nagumo and Kanata are right.
Morisawa-senpai? Don’t tell me you too—
Aaalright! Ryuseitai will now commence operation: Search for the missing Anzu!
Ossu! That’s way more like Ryuseitai alright~♪ Aight then, I’mma search the sports field!
I’ll try searching every corner of Mega Sphere Tower! Kanata, I’m entrusting you with the Passage Arcade!1
got it~♪
Then I shall ask the staff members! They may know something about her whereabouts.
Ehhh? Are you all serious…?
Yeah, dead serious! Come on Midori-kun, you’re joinin’ us!
Uuu, don’t pull me by the arm…
With how you guys are now, I bet you wouldn’t stop even if I objected, would you… I’ll give in and help out, I guess. ……I’m also worried about Anzu-san, anyway.
Ha-ha-ha! ♪ You aren’t honest as always, Takamine! ☆
Then let’s go! Ryuseitai, ready for action~!
Nearly an hour later. In a corridor in Mega Sphere Tower…
(Mm~… Anzu-anego wasn’t anywhere around the sports field…) (Morisawa-senpai and Shinkai-senpai messaged me ‘bout their findings, but it looks like she wasn’t there either.)
(All that’s left is Shinobu-kun and Midori-kun, but… At this rate…) …………
No! It’s too early to lose heart, Nagumo Tetora! You can’t give up just yet! I’m not givin’ up here while there isn’t any concrete proof that Anego went back down to the ground~!
…Yes, I’m aware.
…? That voice…
No, you don’t need to back me up. I am the cause of why Anzu-chan disappeared.
(NiceP seems to be on his phone…?) (And he’s talkin’ about Anzu-anego, I think…)
I thought if it’s her, she would be able to overcome this obstacle and show me a scenery I’ve never seen before. Those expectations must have become a heavy burden on her inside. Of course, I had kept in mind her feelings and responsibility. But even then, I thought that as long as it’s her…
No. Excuses will not change the fact that she left this place. Right now, I simply have to fulfill my responsibility as the one who pulled the trigger.
…Yes. I will prioritize holding the ‘Mainstream Megasphere’ event as I had planned. And for that… —I’ll request the presence of a new producer from the ground.
……! (Request the presence!? Did he just say “request the presence”!? That means he’ll call for someone to replace Anego, right…!?)
(This is seriously bad…!)
Chapter 5 In this chapter, Akatsuki are discussing Anzu’s disappearance and their worry, when the door bell rings.
The door bell rings
—Mm? Hold on. Sounds like someone’s here.
Ossu, Taishou! Hasumi-senpai and the others, as well!
Ah, Tetsu? Why’re ya in such a panic?
Umm, have you seen everyone else in Ryuseitai!?
The members of Ryuseitai, is it? I believe I caught sight of Sengoku and Takamine together a while earlier…
Did something happen to them?
No, nothin’ like that…
However, you look to be in a panic. That must mean you could not contact them through your ‘smar-to phone’, correct?
Smart phone…?
AAAAAAH~!! I could’ve just done that!!
You didn’t realize that?
Haha… I was so shocked that I completely forgot.
Good grief, you gave us a scare for nothing…
But there’s no doubt that something must’ve happened for him to panic that much, right~?
You’re right about that. …Oi, Tetsu. The hell happened?
Ermm, the truth is…

Translation Notes ↑ This is the French word of passage. Passage refers to the shopping arcades that were built in Paris.↑ Neo-Six of Song is the unit that went up against MELLOW DEAR US in Dynamic Diamond. The members are Makoto, Koga, Mayoi, Izumi, Ibuki, and HiMERU.↑ Since the start of July, each unit has been living with their unit members in a room in Mega Sphere’s Star House.↑ As of ES Year 2, Anzu is no longer affiliated with P-Association, the Producer Association in ES. Read more here.↑ Tsukasa can speak English fluently, so instead of saying foreign words in their typical spelling (katakana), he says them in English. The words in italics are all the words he says in English rather than Japanese.↑ Referring to Requiem, Knights’ Repayment Festival (Graduation) story.↑ Referring to Anzu and Izumi’s relationship in the early days of Yumenosaki Era; one instance of this can be seen in Izumi’s Mini Events from ! Era.↑ Referring to the scene Midori appears in Dynamic Diamond, when he saves Mayoi and Raika from falling off of a tower.↑ Anego means “big sister”. It’s a respectful way to refer to a woman older than the speaker, or to refer to an elder sister.↑ One of the biggest instances of this was in Supernova.↑ Referring to Hero Show.↑ Back when Midori was a first year, Anzu would often make him yuru-chara merchandise to encourage him; a story that mentions this is Tough Guy, and a story where he’s motivated thanks to her is Pirate Festival.↑ Kanata says this when he pats her on the head.↑ This was explained in Sailing Ceremony.

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] Mega Stream Arc – Mainstream Megasphere
entry.content:
Mainstream Megasphere LAST STREAM of Mega Stream Start Reading
Aiming for victory, Hokuto presses to be selected for the Japan vs. US Live Showdown. However, the producer, cornered, disappears from the Mega Sphere. Left behind, the ES idols are in shock. However…
Season
ES 2nd Year, Summer (Right after Dynamic Diamond)
Chapters
39
Characters
Translation
310mc
