Translation Notes ↑ Referring to Climax.↑ Kuji is a series of hand signs ninjas tend to do. Here is an article on kuji.↑ MDM happens at the end of August. It’s shown in the first main story of ES!! era.↑ Suit actor is a waseigo term. In a hero show (a live stage performance of hero VS villain) or tokusatsu, a suit actor is typically the stuntman in the full-body suit, who performs the stunts and action scenes. More information here.↑ Chiaki says gomen here, a more polite/softer way to say “sorry” compared to suman (the usual way Chiaki apologizes). Chiaki tends to do this more often when he’s more weak-hearted (showing his “true self”), such as in Sweet Halloween.

entry.title: Motor Show – Prologue
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
Akira
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
Peace
Season: ES 1st Year, Summer (Early September)
Location: Dojo
Just after summer holidays, in the evening…
Taishou. Taishou, please wake up.
…Fwah—!? H-Huh? Was I asleep?
Mhm, soundly so. Exhaustion must’ve built up inside you. I was taught that resting is another important aspect of being an idol — I would like you to avoid overworking yourself, Taishou.
Ahh, yeah, uh… Like I said, I’d prefer not bein’ called “Taishou”, Hiiro-kun.
…? Why not? You’re the one who told me to call you that when I first joined the Karate Club in Yumenosaki Academy — am I wrong? I’d rather you not amend your words so frequently, as it will only confuse me.
Uu~myu… I was young and dumb when I said that. Like, I psyched myself up and acted way too cocky, ‘cuz I thought I had to inherit the role of Taishou, so…1 Basically, I just want you to forget about it. It was such an embarrassin’ moment for me.
I’m not skilled enough to be called “Taishou”. I mean, when you first joined, I literally got obliterated by you in the exhibition match. But, well, I guess it was my own fault for havin’ my guard down.
No, that was my blunder. I wasn’t aware of the rules for the so-called “exhibition match”. I was taught in the dojo of my hometown that in battle, I must fight with the intent to kill — and did not properly hold back my strength.
But, while I had charged at you earnestly, and thus took you completely by surprise— You were still able to turn things to your favor with a counterattack, even after being struck so many times. You’re a splendid martial artist, Taishou.
Fufu, the other club members could tell something was wrong, so they came over to stop us… But it makes me wonder: if we had kept going, who would’ve won that fight? As you’re the more experienced one between us, maybe the judge’s fan would have been raised to Taishou’s victory?2
No, really, could you drop the “Taishou” thing already…? I’d prefer you callin’ me by “Buchou”3, or just “Tetora-kun”, since we’re both the same age.
Hm, very well then, “Buchou”… You are quite particular about such things, aren’t you? You seem to be more broad-minded at first glance, though.
Nah, I’m usually all over the place with things~ But I can’t help but get bothered by specific stuff. I don’t really feel like that’s manly of me, though…
…Anyway, we ended up chatting ‘bout random stuff, but — didja need me for somethin’? It’s a bad habit of mine to blabber on ‘til I dunno what the topic’s ‘bout anymore!
Fufu, that too proves you’re an excellent martial artist — it is a must to know where one lacks. I can barely tell where I lack, or rather, I lack the capability to tell, so — I hope to continue being under your care, Buchou~♪
Regardless, it’s nothing urgent. I’ve come for the usual training, that’s all. There is only so much I can train with on my own, so I wanted to ask if we could spar together, Taish—Buchou. Though I feel a little remorseful for waking you up from your sound sleep.
Oh nah, I don’t mind. I accidentally dozed off while doin’ my usual meditation, is all…
Maybe I really have been exhausted, like you mentioned. I’ve been doin’ as best as I can while keeping a close eye on everythin’, but… Lately, there’s such a huge gap between ES’s Ryuseitai-M and the school’s Ryuseitai, Ryuseitai-N…4 Like, Ryuseitai-N’s been staggerin’ in every single way, and I just can’t seem to make things work in the unit… It’s been daunting on me.
Then I just get more stressed about it, and start tryin’ to make an effort outta everythin’, only for it to all come to waste… that’s prolly why I’m this unbearably tired. Ahhh, I’m just so, so hopeless… It’s so pathetic of me. There’s nothin’ more wasted than wasted effort.
Fufu, please don’t be so down, Buchou. Aren’t you a little too harsh on yourself? From what I heard in school, Ryuseitai-N has been doing well. Splendidly so, especially compared to us underachievers. There is always someone below you, so look at me and cheer yourself up.
Nah, I feel like ALKALOID’s already surpassed us… or at least, you surpassed the Ryuseitai that I’m the commander of.5
Didn’t you guys go all out in the MDM? You guys’re bein’ called the “supernova of hope”. I’m sure you have a lotta clients wanting you by now.
Actually, are ya sure it’s okay to slack off here?
Mmm… No, I don’t think it is. We may have been able to overcome a crisis by successfully paying our debt, and avoided being evicted out of ES for the time being, but— I believe that we’re still at the very first step of being idols.
But due to overworking ourselves, the rest of the members are completely exhausted… though, I’m doing quite alright, due to my immensely large amount of stamina. So I don’t think we can do anything as a unit right now.
On the other hand, I do feel as though all our efforts would be in vain if we were to not take every opportunity that we have while the spotlight is still on us…
Ahaha, things aren’t goin’ well for the both of us, huh…♪
format_size
Prologue Progress at a Snail’s Pace Muddy Road Epilogue
Translation Notes ↑ “Taishou” here refers to Kuro. Tetora calls him by this title out of respect. It means “chief”, “boss”.↑ Hiiro originally says gunpai, a fan used in sumo wrestling matches to determine the winner.↑ “Buchou” means club captain/president.↑ Ryuseitai-M = Morisawa, the five-member Ryuseitai under StarPro, with Chiaki as the leader. Ryuseitai-N = Nagumo, the Ryuseitai in Yumenosaki with Midori, Shinobu and Tetora as well as many first-year juniors, and with Tetora as the leader.↑ “Commander” (taichou in Japanese) refers to the leader of Ryuseitai.

entry.title: Motor Show – Progress at a Snail’s Pace
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
Akira
Translation
310mc (Ryuseitai), Whisper (ALKALOID)
Proofreading
Amagiiz, Peace, TsubasaFL
Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Ch 4 - Ch 5 - Translation Notes Chapter 1
Season: ES 1st Year, Summer (Early September)
Warning: Stalking depiction and casual suicide mention in this chapter.
Location: Dojo
Hup! Haa! Hup-nnh!
…………
Ossu! Ossuossuoo~ssu! OOOOO—SSU!
…Buchou, you speak too much while doing a set of kumite, don’t you think…?1 It’s too dangerous to speak right now; we’re both moving rather intensely. You’ll accidentally bite your tongue if you get hit on the jaw, you know?
Ohh, Taishou also said the same thing to me. Ah— When I say Taishou, I of course don’t mean myself, but actually—
Mhm. You mean Kiryu Kuro-senpai from Akatsuki, correct? He was a member of the club until he graduated last year. I haven’t interacted with him much, so I don’t know him very well — actually, no, I have become more knowledgeable about him through you, since you often speak about him.
You must really respect this “Taishou” of yours, Buchou. I would much appreciate getting to have a match with him, at least once. One only forges himself by constantly taking on difficult challenges, after all.
I totally agree. Oh, wait, hey— Aren’t you also talkin’ while sparring? ♪
Hm, well, we’re currently outside of each other’s sparring distance. However, I once heard that by being vocal, you can relieve the unnecessary tension in your muscles and maximize your power output — So I suppose it depends on how you use your voice?
Fufu, have you been doin’ combat sports for a long time? That’s how you sound, at least. But you’re also new to karate, right? Like, you seem to have done a type of combat sport I’ve never heard of before in your hometown.
Mhm, it was called the Fist of Amaterasu Oomikami.2
The more you talk ‘bout it, the fishier it sounds…
Do you think so…? It seems as though my combat style — and anything else that was normal to me in my hometown — doesn’t exist in the city… In fact, I’m constantly bewildered by many things I’ve never once seen before in my hometown.
For example, cars and vehicles. When I first saw one, I was shocked and terrified — I thought a metal box was running on its own.
Ahaha, man, which era did you even come from? Well, to be fair, young people barely even drive nowadays, soo~?
Pardon me! Tetora-kun, Tetora-kun! I’ve come bearing wonderful news~!
Woah—! You surprised me… C’mon Shinobu-kun, you gotta bow before enterin’ the dojo!
Ahh, my apologies! I’m the type of ninja who’s quite ignorant to old-fashioned etiquette! Were this a certain era, I would have been decapitated! Thank the heavens it isn’t!
No, no, I’d obviously never go that f—
Eeek!?
……………
…Shinobu-kun, I see some sorta spirit behind you, like it’s haunting you…
Huh!? Don’t speak of something so terrifying! Taichou-dono would faint if he heard you!3
Ah— I meant Morisawa-dono when I said that! We have that one rule at ES to call him as such; I assure you that it isn’t because I don’t recognize you as our Taichou—
Ahaha, you don’t have to worry ‘bout that. Even if someone else recognizes me as one, I have yet to recognize myself as the leader, so— It’s actually way more confusin’ if you switch between the names, anyway. So you’re free to call me by “Tetora-kun” even when we’re at school.
Uuu, but… but…
Oh? Mayoi-senpai! He isn’t a spirit haunting anyone, Buchou. This is Ayase Mayoi-senpai, from the same unit as me.
Ufufu. Please don’t hug me so casually while you introduce me, Hiiro-san. It frightens me to have our distance shrunken so suddenly; I implore you to get along with me in a much more hesitant, uncertain manner! And carefully — as if you’re handling a fragile object…!
You’re asking for something so complicated, Mayoi-senpai…
Ahaha, Mayoi-dono is in the Ninja Association with me, so we were performing our club activities together in school. But I had something to inform Tetora-kun about as soon as possible, and so I rushed straight over to ES.
I requested Mayoi-dono to stay behind at school, but… I see that you followed after me in the end! I never noticed I was being tailed — you are quite the ninja…☆
Huh? Ah— yes, yes. Exactly, this is a ninja skill of mine; I definitely wasn’t stalking you or anything.
Fufu, it looks like you’re enjoying your club activities, Mayoi-senpai. I am too! I was even able to become friends with Buchou straight away. This just shows that we were able to overcome our hardships and finally enjoy our youth to its maximum extent.
That makes me very happy… Our victory gave us this outcome — this future. We should be proud of that, together~♪
Uguhh, so bright~!? I had been conducting acts simply for my licentious desires, but you’ve been walking straightforward on a life path towards radiance, haven’t you…!? Ahh, I wish to die! I’m so ashamed of myself!
Nihihi~ ALKALOID gets along well with each other too, huh? But Ryuseitai refuses to lose to you! For we are one for all, all for one!
And so! I’ve nipped us a job for all our sakes! Since Ryuseitai-N has been in bad shape for quite some time, I’ve found us a chance for a breakthrough! Go ahead, praise me, praise me~♪
And its name is: “Motor Show”! It’s likely the largest job we’ve gotten so far as Ryuseitai-N…!
Chapter 2
A few minutes later…
Hm, so what exactly is this “Motor Show”…? I can’t figure out the contents of the job through its name alone, although, I’m always unaware of what things mean. Mayoi-senpai, do you understand what it means?
Erm… May I first ask why we are participating in this conversation, as if it’s a completely natural thing…? I also don’t understand why there are these sitting cushions, tea, and confectionery in the dojo.
Ahaha, the dojo’s sorta hangout spot sometimes, like, it’s slowly becomin’ a place to chat ‘bout all kindsa things. Our Taishou even does his embroidery here, so~ It’s useful to have stuff like this around so we can relax in the room. Plus, this way we wouldn’t have to keep bringing them everytime we need them, either.
Although you have strict rules about etiquette and respect, such as needing to bow before entering the dojo, you’re much more lax around those types of things — It gives a sense of adaptability. Though, it is because we are a flexible unit and accept everything, that we are Ryuseitai.
Regardless, we have nothing to hide about this topic, and the truth is, we’re a bit short on people for this job, so we’re also searching for a unit that can cooperate with us. Whether you’re interested in this job or not, I would still like you to hear us out if you have the time to spare, ALKALOID.
Understood, Chief! I’ll make sure to pay close attention and not miss a single word you speak out of your mouth! I’ll even absorb your breath deep into my lungs! For your breath is so sweet, I have no need for any of these confectionariessss! ♪
…Shinobu-kun. I don’t wanna talk badly ‘bout someone I barely know, but are you sure he’s a safe person to have around? I can get him outta here with brute force if needed…?
No, it’s alright. I was also pretty nervous around him at first, but he is harmless. He’s very attentive and can do anything — He’s the one and only companion I have in the Ninja Association, so driving him away wouldn’t be helpful to me.
Mhm, Mayoi-senpai is a good person! He stares at Aira in a strange way sometimes, but he’s far from the type to do anything bad — he’s timid enough to still get shy over small conversations!
Uuu… I’m extremely sorry for being so suspicious and so afraid of strangers…
Fufu, I am the same as him, so I feel a connection.
In any case, ermm— to put it simply, Motor Show is a car exhibition. They’re going to announce the new cars they’re going to release and line them up in a spacious area. People will be able to examine the cars and possibly buy them if they’re interested. And we were requested to be the crowd puller for the exhibition.
While this isn’t a job from ES this time, it seems like we’re free to do what we like for this event, as long as we run it through with the client first.
Ahaha, but even if they say we’re free to do as we like, we prolly can’t do it the Ryuseitai way — by puttin’ on a hero show, right?
Ah, actually, there are instances of that type of hero content, like Kamen Rider Drive.
Ahh, now that you mention it, vehicles do come up a lot in hero sentai stuff too, don’t they? And I think Kamen Rider has practically done every genre by now, so I think we should be okay as long as we rearrange it a li’l… We could make it so that our enemy is a monster in the form of an automobile, or somethin’.
No, no, hold on — The event’s purpose is to sell cars, so I don’t think we should turn them into monsters, you know? But it is true that it’s easier to think about it from that angle, so it’s best to mention any idea you come up with, or any existing work.
Yeah, you’re right, since we’re only brainstormin’ ideas for now. Oh, that reminds me; there was a kaijuu-like robot called Crazygon in Ultraman, who would eat up cars, and—
…………
…………
Ah, ‘scuse us. We’re idols who advocate superheroes, so we know a lot ‘bout those kindsa stuff… Especially lately, we end up talking ‘bout hero stuff before we know it for some reason. I bet it’s pretty boring to listen to for anyone who isn’t interested in this stuff, huh?
Oh no, I can tell it’s an interesting topic for you two. But I don’t have a single clue what you’re saying, so I don’t think I’ll be able to keep up with the conversation very well.
Ahaha, we were like that in the past, as well.
Uu~myu… I didn’t notice how nerdy I was getting ‘til just recently, when my parents pointed out that I’m becomin’ more like a nerd and got worried for me. It’s all Taichou’s— Morisawa-senpai’s fault.
Why are they worried? Isn’t it wonderful to be engrossed in something?
Ahaha, you’re right. Shinobu-kun’s into ninjas, Morisawa-senpai’s into heroes… Midori-kun’s got his yuru-chara, and Shinkai-senpai has his marine animals— They all have such a sparkling look in their eyes whenever they talk ‘bout what they love, and it’s real charming.
In that sense, I feel like you’re a mystery, Tetora-kun. I heard that you got into karate because you admired Kiryu-dono, rather than out of love for the sport.
Do you have anything that you can say is just as important as your very own life? Or perhaps something that exceeds that, even? Ah, actually, perhaps it’s rarer for people to already have something like that at such a young age…?
Mm~… Wait, hm, it just dawned on me for a sec— Somethin’ just as important as my own life… Huh, nothin’ comes to mind, actually…? I guess if I had to choose somethin’, then it’d be Taishou…?
Chiiief~ You’re dear to me — I’m engrossed in you! You’re the apple of my eye…☆
Huh? Ah, okay! Thank you~♪
Chapter 3
(Something more important to me than my own life… Indeed, there isn’t anything specific that comes to mind for me either — not yet, at least.) (However, I am starting to like idols, and of course, each one of my friends is extremely dear to me—)
(Though they might not be more important than one’s own life… A car seems like a luxury, so I’m fairly certain that there aren’t many people who would buy one when they don’t even need it.) (I don’t quite understand how it works yet, but to try and sell such an item would be quite a difficult task, wouldn’t it?)
(What is Ryuseitai going to do? I haven’t the slightest idea of how they’re going to achieve that…)
Mmm~ Perhaps I was a little too hasty. You previously mentioned that you love vehicles, so I jumped to the conclusion that you’d love to take on this job, as well. I thought you’d enjoy being able to view all the new cars up close, regardless of how the job turns out… I wanted to see you happy and smiling, because you don’t seem to be so energetic lately.
Shinobu-kun… So I really did look like I was down in the dumps, huh…? I’m sorry, it feels like I really made you worry.
But yeah, I do actually like vehicles. Taishou doesn’t seem to do so well with them, though… So maybe this is one of the very few things I like regardless of Taishou.
But why did I even start liking ‘em anyway…? Mm~, I can’t remember. It might be useful for this job if I could remember why, though…
Oh? So we will take this job? I have reserved, or more like they secured, a spot on the job for us, so we are not officially the ones in charge of it yet… It isn’t too late to take back our word and tell them we can’t do it, you know?
No, it ain’t manly to take back your words. Plus, I do like vehicles and I am interested in the job, so if you and the others are okay with it, I’d like us to take it.
Lookin’ back on what we’ve done as Ryuseitai-N— It feels as if all we’ve done is trailing behind, or like, tryin’ to imitate everythin’ Ryuseitai had done last year, but we couldn’t actually do that well and ended up goin’ in circles. So it might be a good idea to have a change of pace and take on new challenges.
My interest has been piqued as well. I would like to use how Ryuseitai chooses to act as a reference point. Maybe it is because you follow your role model diligently and practice repeatedly, but I get the impression that you have an unusually solid foundation. If I observe your Ryuseitai, and learn from your example, I have a feeling that I will be able to see the proper way to be an idol.
Ahaha, is that how you see it? It felt like we weren’t getting anywhere with anythin’ we were doing, but… Yeah, I’m sure it wasn’t all a waste of time in the end. We should’ve managed to build up a lotta muscle.
Mhm, effort will never come at a loss to you. This is something we should also check with our companions, but— If our schedules align, I would like to observe you from up close while helping you out with that Motor Show thing.
Ossu! Aight then, as a fellow idol unit from StarPro, we’d love to work together with you guys for this job if you’re up for it, ALKALOID! We’ll show ya the ropes as your idol seniors~♪
Though, uh, I feel like we’re just gonna embarrass ourselves if I make such a strong declaration…
Fufu, you seriously sound downbeat lately, Tetora-kun. Please cheer up. You’re so down in the dumps that even Midori-kun is worried if you’re okay, you know?
Ack, I might be on death’s doorstep then… This isn’t good~ My enthusiasm’s supposed to be my strong point…
Aaalright! I’ll do push ups to pump myself up! One, two, three, four — Fake it ‘til you make it!
Um… This conversation has been a bit tangential, so I’m afraid I’m still a bit confused — If I am recalling correctly, Ryuseitai-N has quite a lot of members, doesn’t it? Won’t you be able to manage this job yourselves, rather than going through the trouble of asking for ALKALOID’s aid?
Mmm… I’m still inexperienced myself, so I can’t say this in a loud voice, but… Our newbies are yet to be well-equipped for a big stage, both skills and experience wise.
We were pretty rough around the edges when we first started out as well, so I believe anyone has the capability to shine if we simply let them develop and hone their own qualities— All the same, maybe enlisting anyone and everyone because of that wasn’t the greatest idea. They’re all mostly students who’re still clueless and helpless, and weren’t able to go the elite route and join units like Knights.
Right now, rather than a mixed bag of good and bad, it feels as though we have dozens of rocks lying around that’ll only be able to shine if we polish them with intense effort and care… Though of course, we will be having them assist us with the job as much as possible.
Ahaha, it’s like we’re treating them like they’re not good enough to do things on their own, even though I hated bein’ treated like that the most from last year. But now that I’m in the “parent” position in the unit, I finally understand how a parent feels.
If anythin’, it’s amazing how Taichou — how Morisawa-senpai managed to never give up on us and patiently help us grow. He’d constantly give us opportunities to shine. And even when we messed up, he’d cover for us perfectly like nothin’ was wrong.
I gotta learn from him… I feel like I’ve hit a wall right now, so I think I should at least open up and talk to him ‘bout it, too. Then again… He’s been busy as hell, so it might be hard to do that.
Chapter 4
Location: Hanging Garden
Next day, early morning…
Ooh, a big job? Let’s do it! I’m just bursting with motivation right now!
Fufu. Honestly, I strained my legs so much during MDM that I’ve been making an effort to avoid excessive use of them since then… But if we take that into consideration, I have no complaints.
“Motor Show”… If it is a car exhibition at its core, I wonder if that means our job will include… Pardon the strange example, but even if we were to just snuggle up to the cars like paddock girls and amiably entertain everyone, you could also call that “work”. …Actually, perhaps that would be tough work in itself as well, though.
I think something like that would probably be left to professionals… It seems as if we’re acting as the crowd-puller, making sure that things stay exciting until the event is over.
Indeed. The focus will be on Ryuseitai-N; we will probably just be providing backup for them. Of course, there is still a possibility that ALKALOID’s role within the event will change a bit the next time we discuss it, though.
Fufun, it might be good to shove ourselves into the spotlight before Ryuseitai can, and steal all the guests’ attention from them, though ♪
Ooh… You’re getting ahead of yourself, but in a good way, Aira-san. I think that’s a lovely thing. You seem to be quite burdened by various complexes… it makes me worry when you become unusually subservient at times.
Ahaha… I mean, I wasn’t popular at all as an idol, so…
But as part of ALKALOID, I’ve been able to play an active role in all sorts of stuff, like MDM. It feels like I can finally do the dazzling idol activities I’ve always dreamed of… I’m super pumped up! ♪ I’ll launch myself at whatever job we’re given, no matter what it is!
You did sooo well, Hiro-kun! It’s amazing how you got us such a nice job! That’s deserving of praise. Good boy ♪
Fufu. It was really Mayoi-senpai’s “Chief” — or rather, the individual known as Sengoku Shinobu — who brought the job to us.
What’s with that use of “Chief”? The word choice is as weird as usual…
Ah, come to think of it… Mayo-san, you joined the Ninja Association, right? Is that why you call the association’s leader, Sengoku-senpai, “Chief”?
Indeed. We met by chance, led by the power of love… a dear little fairy that calls himself a ninja…♪
And I’m in the Karate Club!
You’re in the “basket ball” club, right, Aira? What is “basket ball”?
Umm, that’s kinda hard to explain… But eh, I don’t plan on putting much effort into my club activities. I definitely prioritize our idol activities.
We’ve managed to keep our places as idols for now, so we returned to our classes, but, like… Class feels like a complete waste of time, so I’m always just itching to leave the whole time.
Fufu. Even now, we’re still on unstable footing. We may have narrowly escaped death, but there’s a saying to “not let your guard down after a victory”, so it is too soon for us to relax; we must keep focused and continue to actively take on work. Motor Show is a very timely offer for us.
Mhm. It was very fortunate that Buchou casually brought it up while we were training together. We really got lucky with this! …Ah, I said something that Nii-san usually would.
Ahaha. But really, doesn’t it feel like things are going suuuper well for us? Even though we were labeled things like “dropouts” and “underachievers” and mocked, it feels like our Cinderella story is finally starting! ♪
Let’s do our absolute best! Hip hip hooray~!
Fufu. You really are bursting with motivation, aren’t you. It’s reassuring to see, Aira.
I am admittedly a bit concerned about Motor Show’s theme… Cars are something I know little to nothing about.
Ah, I have a driver’s license, so if you wish, we could all go on a drive together so that you can grow more used to cars?
Whoa, really? That’s sooo cool; just as I’d expect, you’re fuuull of adult charm, Tattsun-senpai! ♪
Fufu. It is true that in the olden days, it was a way for men to show their status, but— That is less common in recent days. I have heard that the trend of youth losing interest in cars has continued to accelerate. But due to their price continuing to drop, it was easy to obtain one.
Ooh, you even have your own car? Woooow, how bourgeoisie~♪
Ah, that isn’t the case; it belongs to my family’s church rather than me. It is what we use to deliver food to others, so I cannot use it as I please. I have my leg injury to deal with, so using it would certainly aid in transportation… If I had the money, I do feel it would be good to buy one for my personal use.
Hmm~ Can’t you just buy one with L$? You’ll be able to get it cheaper that way… Though I guess that has nothing to do with being an idol. You’d lose just about everything if you got into a car accident anyway, so it’s not usually recommended for idols to drive themselves. Normally, one’s manager would arrange for a studio bus to be used, right?
Well, ES doesn’t really do the kinds of classic things you usually associate with idols, but… Ahh, I wanna ride a studio bus… it’s sooo idol-like…♪
Hm… you may be able to rent one with L$ if you claim you need it for work?
Oh, maybe? I’ll take a scroll through HoldHands and see…♪
Fufu. We’ve deviated quite far from our initial topic… That’s alright. It’s lovely to see everyone so full of energy. We who have already once fallen to the very depths have no need to still conduct ourselves as if we are ashamed of it.
Mhm. I have solid faith that we will reach that dazzling future waiting before our eyes.
Chapter 5
Location: Staff Cafeteria
Same day, in the evening…
—With that said, fortunately, it appears that ALKALOID is considering participating in Motor Show. I’m so grateful~ From what Mayoi-dono told me, they aren’t as tired as they thought they’d be from their workload during the MDM.
But they do have to keep certain things in mind, such as Kazehaya-dono’s lingering leg pain… So it’s possible that their fatigue was simply temporarily blown away because of a runner’s high, so to speak.
…………
Tetora-kun? Hellooo~? Are you listening to me?
Ah, yea. Sorry. You’re right, I’m just “Tetora-kun” in the end… I don’t have the right to be called “Taichou”… I’m the black shooting star, reflecting no light…
Huh!? What’s wrong!? You’re seriously turning more into Midori-kun, Taichou-dono! I understand how you feel, but please cheer up~!
…Did someone say my name just now?
Ah! You’ve finally arrived, Midori-kun! I’ve missed you~ We barely get to see each other lately… Were you able to finish up your solo work?
Yeah, I’ve missed you guys too… I need something to heal me… I just keep regretting every solo job I’ve taken… Ahh, I wish I could kill my past self for being so damn careless…
Ack, please don’t lose heart too, Midori-kun! The mood keeps getting heavier in here…!
Both of you, enough with the glooms! You can do anything with enough fighting spirit!
…Fufu. Yeah, sorry, that wasn’t like me at all. Midori-kun made me realize just now that I’m not even decent at bein’ depressed.
Huh? What the heck does that even mean…? That doesn’t sound like a compliment…
It is! I mean, you’re our biggest earner in Ryuseitai-N right now. That means your personality as an idol stands out, and now people wanna see more of you. I’m really jealous.
Ehhh… I don’t really stand out, though… Everyone else are actually the ones who’re so peculiar in their own way, it’s almost baffling to see… Meanwhile, I’m just a regular highschooler you’d find anywhere…
Ahaha, no regular highschooler would get chosen over professional models to be the cover page of a magazine, y’know. It was for a national magazine, wasn’t it? And thanks to that, people have been recognizing you — We’re now gettin’ tons of people comin’ over to our Ryuseitai-N live shows just to see ya.
Uuu… Hate it… It’s all because of that magazine that I can’t go one step into the streets without someone talking to me… I can barely respond back in a way an idol should… And I’m not even interested in fashion, but they still made me do yet another gravure photoshoot for a magazine today…4 They put weird sparkly stuff all over my body and then forced me to do a bunch of poses… It felt like I was abducted by aliens…
Fufu, you really seem to be getting a lot of those jobs lately, huh? You’re super handsome, so I think it’s great that you’re gaining the chance to make use of your best trait. I would also love to work in a job that makes use of my ninja arts, as it is my strongest merit.
Your unique ninja trait limits you a lot from having opportunities to shine as one, huh…? Yet the wacky thing about this industry is that there’s always a job out there for something…
Ahhh, out of all the jobs in the world, why am I working as an idol…? I should’ve just inherited our greengrocer shop… I miss all the vegetables… Not to mention, I could genuinely be motivated to work if I had to advertise tasty vegetables or yuru-chara… I literally couldn’t care less about anything related to fashion, so if you think about it, I’m being rude to both the client and the fashion designer by working on these kinds of jobs…
Mhm, mhm! You’ve gotten so much better now, Midori-kun! You aren’t acting on your selfish thoughts as much, and you’re being considerate of others! Wonderful, wonderful, Midori-kun! You’re doing a great job, Midori-kun~♪
Uuu… Thanks, Shinobu-mama—
Since when was I your mama!?
Ahaha, thanks Midori-kun, the mood’s back to our usual now. You really picked me up outta that mindset. It’s so heroic of ya to save someone~♪
Huh, I didn’t really do anything, though… I feel kind of bad actually; I just spilled every negative thought I had the moment I got here…
I thought the best choice would be to avoid showing my depressing side to anyone except people close to me, so I ended up building up a lot of stress inside… I feel like at some point, I’m going to reach my limit and accidentally let it all out… But I want to do as best as I can to fulfill a kid’s dream, so I’ll hold on for longer…
What’re you referring to by “a kid’s dream”?
Ahhh, from what I know, the person who’s been giving him a lot of jobs lately is a multi-millionaire’s daughter. Apparently, she fell in love at first sight when Midori-kun and I had the job that introduced strawberry picking to people—5
Yeah, that’s the one… It’s such a dirty move to have a higher-up mixed in with the general crowd… I appreciate her supporting me, but her love feels so heavy… I feel like she’s just been making me into her very own dress-up doll…
Ahaha, what’s so bad ‘bout gettin’ a chance to marry a multi-millionaire? Man, this kinda romance talk is unlike you, we rarely get to hear ‘bout this sorta stuff~♪
What’re you on about… She’s just a little kid, y’know… I’m pretty sure she only likes me for my looks… It’s like I can barely get my point across with her… it really makes you think of a certain someone—
…But if Morisawa-senpai was here, I bet he’d solve all our problems perfectly, no matter what they may be.
Uh, nobody mentioned that guy, though…? Besides, what’s dead is dead; we have to overcome our hardships on our own now.
Hold on a moment! Morisawa-dono isn’t actually dead, y’know…!?
As a Ryuseitai member, he is… He’s been doing way more work outside of the unit than I have…
You make a good point there, it does feel as though he’s left Ryuseitai in our hands… And he was very sudden and curt about it — Honestly, this was hardly what I expected to happen. For example, I can understand Shinkai-dono’s situation, as he has yet to finish dealing with the issue concerning his household, but… I always thought that Morisawa-dono would work hard as a passionate hero until his dying breath.
Hmph… All his “I love you”’s weren’t true after all; he’s all talk and no action…
No way, I’m sure there’s way more to it than that. While I didn’t think of him as that type of person back when he was still in school, he’s actually the sorta cunning guy who’s always thinkin’ ahead.
I should follow in his footsteps when it comes to that, shouldn’t I… The only people who can push forward through anythin’ without a single thought are a handful of geniuses and kids under their parent’s protection.
So I gotta start growing up… Not to mention, Motor Show deals with cars, and there was a time when that word was another way to call a guy an adult man… I won’t be suitable for the job if I continue to stay as a kid.
But… I really dunno what I gotta do to become an adult…
…………
…………
format_size
Prologue Progress at a Snail’s Pace Muddy Road Epilogue
Translation Notes ↑ Kumite is one of the ways to train in karate, involving sparring with someone else. Read more here.↑ This is referring to Amaterasu, the goddess of the sun in Japanese mythology.↑ “Taichou” refers to the leader (sometimes translated as Captain). It literally means “Squad Commander”. Since the word in English gets mixed easily with (Club) Captain, I’ve decided to keep it in Japanese.↑ Obligatory note, since googling “gravure” often results in risque modeling—The type of gravure modeling this refers to is more akin to the fanservice of looking cool or suave in photoshoots to appeal to the viewers.↑ Referring to Strawberry Colored Holiday.

entry.title: Naked – Change and Universality
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
ryuseipuka
Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Ch 4 - Ch 5 - Translation Notes Chapter 1
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (September)
Same day, in the evening. In a karaoke room…
This one’s our room!
Phew, I’m drenched in sweat after walking all the way here… I shall turn the temperature down a little.
We walked a pretty long distance, yeah… I get why we chose a place far from school, since we could get spotted by other students if it was somewhere nearby— But why are we holding our wrap-up party in a karaoke room? I’m already tired as it is from the live show…
Karaoke is held in a private room, that’s why! We won’t have to worry about people’s eyes on us here, and we’ll be able to relax all we want, right? That’s the only reason we chose this place, so you don’t have to force yourself to sing. If you’re tired, you’re free to lie down on the sofa.
fufu, i will personally be singing, though~ let’s have the first song be a [ryuseitai medley]~♪
On it! Tap, tap, tap… Send! ☆
You know the song’s digit number? Wow, you memorized that?
Mfun, I often sing karaoke with my friends!1 I also have the line distribution down to a T!
Huh, really… I’d personally never sing in karaoke.1 I’m already singing so much for work, so I’d rather be free from it on my days off at least.
No, actually, before that— I’ve never even had friends that I can go to karaoke with in my private time.
OOOHH…! Don’t say something so lonely, Takamine! If you don’t mind me, I’ll go out with you anytime!
After karaoke, let’s go to a batting cage! We’ll sweat our hearts out, and then have dinner at a casual restaurant!
Absolutely no way we will… Please don’t invade my private life. I’d much rather spend my time alone. I won’t have to overthink how to be mindful of whoever is with me, and I can go about doing things at my own pace.
Midori-kun, Midori-kun! Which is better, waffle fries or hash browns?
Huh—? Where’d this come from all of a sudden…?
I’m askin’ about the menu! I’m starvin’ like crazy, so I’ve been ordering every little thing I wanna eat, but I can’t decide on which fried potatoes to get.
Ahh… I was wondering why you had such a serious look on your face while fidgeting with the tablet, but you were just ordering food all along, huh. If you’re that unsure, how about going for a fried potato combo platter? It has a bunch of variety in it, and we should be able to finish the plate if we split it between the five of us.
I never expected that as a suggestion…! That’s Takamine for you; you truly get my favorite food…☆ I love fried potatoes, but I can’t order a lot of them when I’m alone. That’s why — the idea of a combo platter is just superb, because we’ll be able to taste and compare the different dishes! Of course, I’ll help out in clearing the platter!
It’s scary how he suddenly started blabbering out of nowhere. I wasn’t even talking about Senpai’s favorite food…
Aighty! I’mma go with the “fried potato combo platter” then! I’ll also order pizza, pasta, rice pilaf… Ah! I shouldn’t forget to order the takoyaki!
Ehhh… Aren’t you ordering way too much?
Not to worry. This karaoke parlor has a take-away option for any food you cannot finish in time.
Ooh, that’s so kind of ‘em! Aight then, I’ll just keep addin’ more as I like! ☆
…None of you plan ahead in any capacity. Just hand me the menu already, I’ll make the order.
One hour later…
Right. I’m sorry to interrupt you all while you’re having your own fun, but it’s about time we start our strategy meeting.
ohh, yes. we said that alongside the [wrap-up party], we would talk about what we will do as ryuseitai from now on, right?
Yeah. Although, our overall approach will remain the same. So in this meeting, I’d like to come up with a concrete plan for what we’ll do next. We’ve just finished performing a live show in Yumenosaki, the academy that was our “starting point”, so to speak— But thinking back on it, we haven’t actually done anything particular for our fans ever since Mega Stream ended.
That’s why for starters, I’d like to carry out a Ryuseitai exclusive live show, aimed at our fans. And if we’ll be going with that— Then I was hoping we could perform an entirely new song for them too, but what do you all think?
Hm, hm. So it won’t be a collaboration with a company or anythin’, it’s just purely a new song made for us?2
Yeah. Of course, we’d be more than willing to collaborate if a company sends us a word, but— We don’t have to push ourselves to find one, either. Making our fans happy is always the most important thing, after all!
And so, for the commander of this exclusive live, hmm…3
—Sengoku, could I ask you to take the lead?
…Bfhff!? Dihd yo’fhsay me!?4
I dihn’t eshpeht t’be nominahted…5 (Gulps down his food). I was so surprised that I almost spit out my takoyaki!
Fuhahaha, that was a close one!
But I’m being serious, Sengoku. You were absolutely glimmering onstage today. Without ever averting your eyes from your juniors’ worries, you did your best to encourage them all head-on. Seeing that performance of yours resonated in my heart, too.
What’s more, you looked even livelier than usual in our performance. That’s exactly why I’ve become so interested to discover what you could show us right now if you became the next commander!
Ahaha… You’ll make me blush saying that. I simply just put into words everything I had wanted to say, you know?
But because you all followed my plan, today’s live show ended in a massive success. Thus, to also express my thanks to everyone, I shall gladly take on the role of the commander!6
On that note, what sort of song would be good here?
Hmm… We haven’t really done anything proper on the ground this past month, so…7 We’re not necessarily having a fresh start, but something fitting for a triumphant return would be nice.8
That being said, you’re the commander this time, Sengoku. You’re free to decide however you like!
how about a [ninja] song that is fitting for shinobu? nin-nin…♪
Ahaha, that would be far too drenched in my color, you know. And besides, we already have “Nekketsu ☆ Ryusei Ninpouchou” as a song~9
ahh, that is right. that song was made for the sake of the [ninja association], right?10
…though, it seems that same [ninja association] is gone now.11
Chapter 2
Mhm. My apologies everyone, after all the efforts you put into assisting me…
No, no. You were the one who decided that, right? You don’t have to be apologetic over it.
…Mm? Speaking of which, what happened to the Marine Life Club, Kanata? Since Kanzaki graduated from school, has it been disbanded as well?
no, i heard from souma that he had it treated as a club under [suspended activities]. according to him, a group of [volunteer] students have been taking [care] of the club.
Ah, that’s good to hear. That clubroom can be considered a famous spot at the academy, after all.12 Even if its activities are suspended right now, there may come a day when students gain interest in marine animals again, and bring life back to the club. I hope it gets inherited by someone by then; it’d make me happy to hear.
yes. i hope the same…♪
A few days later. In the StarPro office…
Over here~ Anzu-dono~♪ (waves)
Ahh, my apologies for calling you over to this office! This is a personal consultation, so I should be the one going to you, but— You’re never in one place since you’re quite the busybody, so… I thought it would be much faster to ask you to come to me instead.
Mm! Come to think of it, that makes you similar to a ninja, no? You have no presence, and you appear in the most unexpected places…♪
Ah, I shouldn’t derail the conversation. I called you here to talk about Ryuseitai’s next course of action.
As you know, the commander role alternates between the members of Ryuseitai. And this time around, I will be acting as the commander.13 And so, we decided to make a new song for ourselves. However, even if I opt to commission a professional for the songwriting, I would still need to come up with the baseline concept as the commander, correct?
So for the past few days, I’ve pondered and pondered… But I simply cannot think of anything, it’s almost baffling to me~
Whenever I ponder over it in silence, random thoughts come to mind instead— And just last night, I could hear “nin-nin” in Shinkai-dono’s voice floating in my head…!
…Ahaha. Everyone said the same thing to me — that I’m the commander, so it’s fine to go with a ninja-themed song. But we’ve already performed one before.9 I’m a ninja idol, so I could perform a song like that countless times if I ever wanted to. That’s why for an opportunity like this, I’d like to do something extraordinarily special.
For a month, we weren’t able to do any sort of unit activities on land, correct? We’ve streamed many times, and that was fun in its own right, getting to interact with everyone… But all the activities that were part of our routine, like live shows and TV appearances, suddenly vanished from sight — I’m sure we’ve made our fans feel lonely because of that.14
That is why I’d like to make our next performance something that could blow all those feelings away — Something that will make them glad they waited for our return! A song that keeps in mind what makes us “Ryuseitai”, while still drawing out “fresh wind”… If I could just come up with something like that, it’d be perfect—
But the problem is, nothing comes to mind for what that “fresh wind” could be, and that is the most crucial part here~… To begin with, the current Ryuseitai is a unit that naturally changes color with every commander’s turn. It’s structured this way so that the member most suited for the matter is the one that acts as the commander. In doing so, we expand the range of our activities without the burden being loaded on one sole person — That’s the concept we have in mind.
That is all the more why I’m struggling, though. There’s bound to be something I can suggest precisely because of who I am right now, but…
Anzu-dono, you’ve come up with many projects up until now, correct? What do you do whenever you can’t think of any ideas?
When you’re stuck in a rut, you focus on doing something different? Hm, hm… I see. All this time I thought that an original creation is producing something new from nothing, but— An original creation could also be combining things I’ve seen and heard thus far, or adding in a different perspective, I see. So I could try my hand at something I don’t typically dabble in, and build up my own library of knowledge, so to speak…
Something I don’t typically dabble in, hm… Mmh~… …Studying is a weak point of mine, so in a way, I could consider it an unknown world to me.15
How about a song based on studying then? Something that feels reassuring to listen to when you have to study for a test or exam—
No, never mind. I’m hardly capable of studying properly — If I tried to sing a song about that, there would be nothing convincing about it. I’d like to bring in “fresh wind” that is much more befitting of idols, like—
Ah—! I’ve got it…!
No, no, wait. That’s far too tactless. Please forget I said that—
Uhya—!? W-Why’re you suddenly squishing my cheeks!? “Now you’ve got me curious, so you have to tell me”… I-I understand, really! Your smile is scaring me~…!
Ermm, you see… When I thought of “fresh wind” and idols together, what came to my mind is MELLOW DEAR US. They’re idols who’ve come from the U.S., and have built up a lot of momentum as of this moment. They are precisely what you’d call “black ships” to us.16
I have witnessed them perform a few times, but there’s still an abundance of things I don’t know about them. That’s why I thought that if I could watch them during their recording or practice session, I might be able to gain something from it, but… They’re unfortunately in a different agency, and I feel like it’d be presumptuous of me to request this out of the blue…
…Mm? Why are you patting your chest, Anzu-dono? You have your phone out— Eh!? Who are you contacting…?
W-What!? You’ve already reached an agreement with them!?
You truly are incredible as always, Anzu-dono! This is why you’re ES’ proudly talented producer…♪ Hm, hm. So MELLOW DEAR US is actually in the middle of recording something at a nearby TV station, is it? And I should be able to get the opportunity to have a tour of what they do in that location…
Yaaay, I’m so happy to hear it! We must move with haste! It’s time to depart to battle…☆
Chapter 3
“Wahh…! It’s a video of a squirrel this time.” “It’s stuffing nuts into its cheek pouch and moving its cheeks with each chew…”
“Sooo cuuute… I could watch this forever. ♪”
“Mhm, mhm! It sooo reminds me of when Chitose© stuffed his boxed lunch in his mouth quickly back in the dressing room!17 #NotMeOutingOurDressingRoomShenanigans #TodaysBoxedLunchWasTonkatsu”
“The squirrel’s behavior is charming, but I do not find Chitose’s conduct impressive.” “If you cannot conduct yourself in a more graceful manner, then there is no worth in you being alive, is there?”
“Having your existence invalidated just for eating your boxed lunch fast is craaazy! Kyahaha! ☆”
“Ahaha… I had to rush because we were running out of time before the recording started. And it’d be a waste to leave my food half-eaten, too.”
“That aside, though… I’ve been thinking about this since we came to Japan, but I never really catch sight of any wild squirrels here.” “I’d often spot them in parks back in the U.S. though.”
“Oh yeah, now that you mention it, I think you’re right… Then we could just make a project for ourselves where we go find a squirrel together, right?”
“That sounds like something that’ll end up as a pretty plain and simplistic video, but it might be interesting in its own way—☆ #WorkWhereWeDontLookOurBest #OurEditorsGonnaCry”
Oooh! Their conversation is so natural, and the aura they emit is stunning…! According to what you’ve said, Anzu-dono, they still don’t have much experience with variety programs…? Is that true?
…Ohhh. So they’ve been tasked to proactively appear in various variety programs, so as to have them build experience in a short amount of time. They’re being tailored to fit with Japan’s idol culture… is what I’ve understood. So the phrase, “When in Rome, do as the Romans do”, applies to large overseas enterprises too~
…Huh? This isn’t a policy from Thunderbolt, but rather a suggestion from you, Anzu-dono?
I see. MELLOW DEAR US is produced by both Nice-dono and Anzu-dono.18 Hm, hm. It’s starting to click in place now. Mm? No, I wasn’t thinking that they get special treatment from you. Regardless of their popularity in other countries, they’re newcomers in the Japanese idol industry. It makes sense that you would support them with hospitality.
Other units are also similar in that sense. Even us, Ryuseitai. We’re part of StarPro, and at the same time, we have you as a producer as well. That’s why I personally don’t think anything of it.
Well, if I had to say something here… I feel like it is getting more and more hectic for you now that you have more idols to produce~♪ And yet you’re still helping me with my personal consultation despite all that. I really am very grateful to you.
Mfun. Now that I think about it, you and I have known each other since our days in Yumenosaki together. Whenever I had a problem, you would help me and encourage me… I truly am indebted to you time and time again.
That is why I want you to stay the way you are, Anzu-dono. You excel at discovering an idol’s great points, and you always approach your job with the idol’s best interest in mind. I believe that that is precisely what makes you who you are.
I’m sure that I, too, will continue to be in your care moving forward. So I hope that we can stay in close terms for many years to come. It would make me very happy…♪
Sound of footsteps
—Ah! So you were here! Hello, thank you for all your wonderful work, Anzu-san. Yes. I’ve actually come to Japan on a separate business trip. Since I’m here just at the right time, I passed by to check how they’re doing. It appears they’re starting to get accustomed to Japan’s programs, too. I’m sure the staff back in the U.S. will be very happy to know this. ♪
(whispering) …Anzu-dono, Anzu-dono. Are they an acquaintance of yours? (whispering) They’re someone who works in the entertainment department of Thunderbolt… I see, so that is why you know them.
By the way, who is that boy with you? Is he your little brother by any chance, Anzu-san?
L-Little brother…!? I-I am actually, erm… technically in Ryuseitai, and… mumblemumble
Technically…? Sorry, I couldn’t hear you very well. —Eh? Wait, really, Anzu-san? He’s also an idol…? He’s Sengoku Shinobu-kun, from Ryuseitai…? Ahh, that was very rude of me. I’ve been studying up on Japan’s idols, but I’ve only just gotten hold of the Rhythm Link idols and not much else. This is quite shameful of me, as someone who works in the entertainment department. Sorry about that— Er, my deepest apologies, Sengoku-san.
No, no! Don’t worry about it at all, please! I’m not a particularly famous figure myself, really! If anything, I feel awful that I made you apologize when we haven’t even made proper introductions yet!
T-The point is! You really do not have to worry about it at all! Ahaha…
Thirty minutes later. After the tour was over…
…Thank you for having me~
That recording was quite abundant; there were talk shows, songs, and much more. I haven’t figured out the clue I need for the new song just yet, but I’m glad I came! It was good stimuli~♪
…Huh? Why do you look so anxious, Anzu-dono? I’m as energetic as ever, you know…?
…No, I’m sure it’s pointless to try and dodge the question. You see through everything, after all. The truth is… Being mistaken as your little brother by the Thunderbolt staff is still lingering in my head a little.
Ah! But to be clear, I am not against that or anything! I’m an only child, so I’m drawn to the idea of “siblings” much like anyone else.
It isn’t that part… You see, the moment I got mistaken as such, I was instantly reminded of something else. Back in spring, Midori-kun invited me to go to a zoo with him. When we got to the ticket counter, the teller told me that my admission was free.
I innocently cheered in joy, thinking there was some sort of special campaign going on… But it was nothing of the sort — I was simply mistaken for being much younger, that’s all. The zoo has free admission for middle school students and below.
Midori-kun comforted me at the time, saying that “I get mistaken for a college student sometimes”…19 But now, to my shock, I got mistaken for being Anzu-dono’s little brother… Do I really look that child-like to people?
Well, no, if I simply look young based on appearances alone, that’s still fine. But perhaps it’s because I had just finished watching MELLOW DEAR US perform, a unit that is very mature and cool… Now I can’t help myself from wondering… Have I actually grown up?
Chapter 4
The next day, at night. In the large bathhouse inside the Mega Sphere…
Pheww… The hot water really seeps through my body…♪ I was stuck at my desk just pondering and pondering, so my neck and shoulders are as stiff as a board.
Yeah, you were really focused on brainstormin’. How’s the new song comin’ along?
I haven’t progressed on that at all, sadly… I’m still at the concept stage. I may actually be struggling even more than yesterday~…
Ohhh. Well, we’re not in a rush this time, so I think it’s fine if you make progress at your own pace, Shinobu-kun. Ideas always come at the most unexpected moment, anyway.
Mhm. Although, whenever I think about how our fans have been waiting for us, I feel as though I shouldn’t be taking my time with things either. But even then, I cannot afford to deliver them something that is just “good enough”, so I shall take my time to think it over for now.
…By the way, Tetora-kun. Why is there a rubber duck floating in the bathtub?
Ahh, this? It’s Midori-kun.
Wha…? I mean, it certainly is a pretty green color, but…
Don’t tell me…! Did he turn into this form while I was shut in our room!? Poor Midori-kun…!
Ahh, but then again, perhaps this is exactly what he’s wanted? I feel like he’d be quite happy by it, in fact. Well, this duck cannot speak, though.
Ahaha. You looked pretty tired, so I tried cracking a joke— I was expecting ya to hit back with a remark, so I didn’t think you’d actually jump on the bit.
Either way, based on that, you seem alright. Looks like I was worried over nothin’.
Ooohh… I apologize for unnecessarily worrying you. I assume the reason you invited me to the bathtub was for the same reason, wasn’t it?
Yeah, but you don’t have to worry ‘bout it. I just wanted to do that, is all.
‘Cuz the best thing to do when you’re tired is to soak in some nice hot water~ Actually, I tried inviting Midori-kun to join us while I was at it, but he turned me down just as I thought he would.20 Then he gave me this rubber duck and said, “think of it as me”. Apparently, he got it as an extra from somethin’.
Ahaha. That is truly just like Midori-kun.
…Oohh? Look, the duck spits out water when you squeeze its belly. Ahaha! This is so much fun, it’s like a water gun~♪
Ooh. You hit the shampoo bottle right on the mark. You have such good control, Shinobu-kun!
Mfun, so you noticed! The fruits of my shuriken training are showing at such an unexpected place~♪ Nihihi~♪ Perhaps I have a knack for shooting from afar?
Aaalright! I’ll aim for the entrance’s label this time! Ninja Art: Water-Gun-no-Jutsu…☆
—Woah! What the, why’d water splash on me outta nowhere?
Ah! Taishou! Heya, I hope you’re doin’ well today!
Awawawa—! Midori-kun’s hot water splashed on Kiryu-dono’s face…! Please accept this ninja’s deepest apology~!
Midori-kun…? Is that what that duck’s called?
Mhm. Ah, no, there’s an actual reason behind this—
Ahaha, no need to explain. I’m guessin’ you were playin’ in the water with that, yeah? Nothin’ wrong with that, it’s good to innocently play around every once in a while, y’know.
Heeey! How cooold of you, Kuro-san, dipping in the bath ahead of me! You know you could’ve just waited for me, right?
The hell ya on about? As if I’d do that — The thought of two grown ass adults changin’ and gettin’ in the tub at the same time is just gross.
Ah, Mikejima-senpai was also with you. I can tell you two have a bit of damp hair… Were you doing strength training up ‘til now or somethin’?
Yep. When I dropped by the training room, I happened to come across Kuro-san. Just as I greeted him, he caught hold of me, y’see~ Sooo I had no choice but to get my body moving with him.
Don’t freakin’ lie. You’re the one who got up in my business. I was just goin’ through my trainin’ regimen when you decided to poke your nose and tell me about how my form looks off or whatever.
Hahaha! It’s ‘cause your self-taught style was getting waaay too out there. You were able to improve it before you got yourself hurt, so you should be thanking me! ☆ Pluuus, didn’t you also throw some comments on how I train? We’re in the saaame boat here…♪
(…Woahh. Looking at the two closely, both Kiryu-dono and Mikejima-dono are mighty muscular…) (Is this what “the body of an adult man” refers to? It sounds like they were doing a full-blown strength training session, too — It’s so cool how self-disciplined they are.) (The same goes for Tetora-kun. Though he may not be as muscular as the other two, he has a nicely-toned, defined body.)
(Meanwhile, when it comes to me… There was a time I did some strength training in order to build stamina, but—)21 (My body cannot really build muscle all that well, so I eventually became satisfied with the bare minimum at some point.)
(I have the necessary stamina for my idol activities, so I didn’t feel the need to train any further…)22 (But standing by them, I find I’m the only one who seems rather young.) (What’s more, I was even getting excited over playing in the water with a rubber duck…) (Am I still nothing more than just a child after all…?)
—Ohhh? Theeere’s a green duck floating in the tub; diiid someone accidentally leave it behind?
Nah, it’s apparently Sengoku’s.
Eh!? No, this doesn’t belong to m—
That’s the rubber duck we were entrusted with from our Midori-kun. I invited him to join us in the bath, but he turned down the offer, and then gave me this to act as his substitute.
Ahh, so that’s why he said “Midori-kun spit out hot water” in a panic earlier.
Oi, Sengoku. No need to huddle yourself into that corner. How about ya come over here? The tub’s got a lotta space, y’know.
R-Roger that…!
Sound of moving in water
Hahaha, are you neeervous? You ought to be shameless when soaking in a public bathtub. ‘Caaause you know, there’s a saying that goes, “baring your body bares your heart too”.23
Ahaha… Indeed.
This is a nice opportunity, so I shall take my time in the bath.
Chapter 5 Whew… Right, it’s time I dip out. Soakin’ myself in a hot tub for too long just makes my body feel sluggish instead, so.
Then I’ll also head on out. I feel pretty hungry after soaking in the hot water. Oh yeaaah, speaking of which, Kuro-san — Did you check out that new restaurant in the Passage Area?24 I heard they’re having a limited-time food challenge event right now.
“Food challenge”… Ah, the one where it’s all for free if ya eat the food within the time limit?
Yup! Not only will it be free, but apparently they also give out a prize. But of course, you’ll have to pay the bill if you fail. We just got done with some intense exercise. It’s a little too early for dinner, but still, wanna try taking on the challenge with me?
Haah… Why do I gotta compete with ya even after I get outta the bath… Besides, I dunno a thing about that restaurant. We’ve got no clue what sorta food they have, do we?
But well, I’m interested to find out what they’re makin’. I dunno if I’ll actually take on the challenge, but I’ll join you for dinner at least.
Mm? The two of you are gonna eat dinner together after this?
Yeah. If you’re hungry too, then how about you join us, Tetsu?
You sure!? Ossu, I’d be glad to join ya! ♪ Hey, wanna come along too, Shinobu-kun? You and I’d get to see Taishou and Mikejima-senpai’s eating style!
Me? Hmm~…
The offer sounds nice, but I must decline. I’d like to work out an idea for the new song while soaking by myself in the tub.
Aight then. But you’ll feel dizzy if you soak for too long, so be sure to get out eventually, ‘kay?
Mhm! Thank you~♪ (waves) Take care, everyone~
Sound of moving in water
(……Hm. The bathhouse feels a lot more spacious now that everyone has left.) (It’s so quiet that the only sound I can hear is of the water echoing.)
(…In times like this, I get the urge to do some “water escape jutsu” training…)25 (But this isn’t the time for that. I must rack my brain for our new song.)
(I’ve read in a book that the sound of water is good for thinking…) (Hence me deciding to soak myself in water… But I really just cannot think of anything~…) (I wonder how all the musicians in the world come up with ideas?)
(…Speaking of music composition, there’s Knights’ Tsukinaga-dono! Perhaps I could get his advi—)
(…No, no! You can’t!) (I have been specifically selected to be the commander this time. It’d just look awful on my part if I immediately rely on someone for this.) (While it isn’t a bad thing to ask for help, I should still try to make an effort in my own way first and foremost…)
(It’s fine if it’s shoddy for now, I just need to first put my thoughts in order…) (It won’t be too late to ask someone for advice much later.)
…Huh? The rubber duck is floating in the corner of the tub. A lot of time has passed since everyone left. I assume they’ve all left the changing room by now.
Tetora-kun is such a klutz~ Oh well, I suppose I’ll have to take responsibility for this Midori-kun and keep him safe. Ahaha. You got left behind, didn’t you, Midori-kun~♪
………… ……Say, Midori-kun. Could you listen to me talk to myself just for a little?
A thought came to my mind the other day, when I asked Anzu-dono to take me to where MELLOW DEAR US was working… as well as just earlier, when I saw the other three in the tub… I feel as though I’ve been left behind as the only one who’s still just a little child. Everyone’s so cool and grown-up…
Unlike me, who was getting happy over trying out the “Water-Gun-no-Jutsu~♪”… …Logically, I’m aware that everyone is different, and I am my own self. No matter how hard I try, I doubt I could ever build a well-defined muscular body.
But… Even Tetora-kun, who’s right beside me, is becoming more and more muscular. And Midori-kun as well — He sometimes gets mistaken for an older person. I know he always seems upset about it, saying that it just means he looks like he’s showing signs of age…19 But even then, I look up and wonder how nice it must be. I’m quite envious of it.
It’s likely as they say, “the grass is always greener on the other side”. But even then… I cannot help but think about how much I wish I could be like that… Midori-kun—
Fuhahahaha! ☆ Fancy meeting you here, Sengoku!
Uhyah—!? M-Morisawa-dono!?
Mm? Why’re you so surprised to see me? Huh? Are you the only one here? I heard you talking, so I thought you were with someone…
A-Awawa…! Erm, well, you see…! I was practicing the Cloning Jutsu…! By addressing myself, I can produce my very own clone… That is how the training goes!
I see now! I expect nothing less from you, Sengoku; you’re always refining your skills. I should learn from you.
Sound of moving in water
I’ll dip in next to you, if you don’t mind.
Sound of splashing into water
Mmm~ You can never go wrong with a big bathtub, huh. It just feels so nice! ☆
How’s the new song coming along, Sengoku? Are you making progress alright?
No, not at all. I still haven’t even figured out what sort of song I’d like to make. …Tetora-kun asked me the same question earlier. I assume everyone is concerned about the new song…
Oh, is that what happened… I’m sorry for asking you right after him.
But don’t misunderstand us. We aren’t trying to rush you. If anything, we’re itching to know out of excitement. You sealed off “ninjas” this time around — the being that practically acts as your very own weapon, right? We all get lost whenever we challenge ourselves with something new, and it’s natural to take time.
But you don’t have to rush yourself. I’m looking forward to the very moment you grab hold of what you feel like is the answer for you, Sengoku!
Morisawa-dono… Hearing that from you makes me—
……H-Huh? Everything suddenly looks…so fuzzy…? There are two… Morisawa-donos…? When did you learn the Cloning Jutsu—……
Sengoku!? What’s wrong!? Your face is bright red!
Uu, my eyes are spinning… Thud, plunk~…
Sound of splashing into water
Hey, wait! Hang in there, Sengoku! DON’T DIIIEEEEEE!! SENGOKUUUUUU!!
Story translation still in progress! 6 chapters left!

entry.title: Naked – Prologue
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
ryuseipuka
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (September)
2nd year of ES’s establishment, in September. In Yumenosaki Academy’s Auditorium…
…Ooh. There really are a lotta people gathered here.
Nihihi. I spared no effort in promoting our concert, after all~♪ I made it a point to say that “that” Ryuseitai will be performing a free-to-watch live show in school!
Isn’t it a bit too embarrassing to say “that Ryuseitai” as a member of said unit…?
Well, I admit that it is a little embarrassing… But it’s important to exaggerate things a bit. New candy products are promoted the same way, no? Like how they call the product a “huge favorite” or “talk of the town” when it was just put on sale! That’s why we’d only be at a disadvantage if we held back!
Fuhahahaha! It’s such a blessing to see all these students make time just to come here for us! Even though they surely have their own daily lessons and activities to get to!
It isn’t every day that you get to see alumni perform a live show in school, after all~ Even when there are alumni here, it’s usually for something complicated, like for a lecture to learn about the future of idols or the like. To be frank, an opportunity like this is extremely valuable.
yes~ i have [graduated] from [yumenosaki], so i do not know much about how it is now… but [live shows] in the school are typically performed by [students] only. so if they ever wanted to [learn] from our live show, they would [have] to come all the way to a [venue] just to watch it.
that is why i am sure that they are happy to have us come to them instead~♪
Mmh~… Even then, I don’t feel like people would be that excited to see us… For something like this, wouldn’t they all have been happier seeing a unit they look up to?
Jeez, Midori-kun, you need to have more confidence in yourself! Ryuseitai was a hot topic during Mega Stream, you know!1
Exactly, Takamine. I won’t go so far as to say we stood out the most or anything, but we’ve left pretty good marks during the stream.
Ossu, yep! It was all through live streams though, so it was kinda limited to that area at the time, as in like… it didn’t feel like it extended that far at first, but— When we came back down to the ground, we started gettin’ a lot more jobs thanks to the Mega Stream, and we even got a lotta comments from people.2 It made me more confident in myself, knowin’ that what we did wasn’t wrong after all.
That’s… Mm, well, you’re right about that. Like, if we don’t get even a little bit of payoff, then that month would’ve really ended up as nothing but a waste.
You’re too pessimistic, Midori-kun~ We’re bound to get plenty of payoff, not just a little!
After all, we’re going to act as role models for all the students who’ve come to watch our live show! Of course, there are likely some kids who simply want to check out something they don’t get to see every day, and some who are only here to browse— But I just know for sure that we hold the power to captivate all the students here!
ehehe. shinobu is [fired up] even more than usual today, isn’t he?
Mhm! I am the one who came up with this Ryuseitai live show, after all.
You see, how shall I put this… I feel as though in the eyes of these budding-idol students, idols themselves have become an “existence far beyond their reach” right now. An underclassman even consulted me the other day saying, “After watching the Mega Stream, I started to question if I’m genuinely able to work as an idol.”
Ahhh… Well, in reality, it was physically far up in the sky. If I were shown something like that, I’d probably assume it’s something from a whole different world.
Uu~myu… Not like that, I think it’s got more to do with scale and capability, yeah?
Yeah. But I don’t think what Takamine said is necessarily wrong, either. We’re all used to seeing idols through a screen. That’s basically the norm, in fact.
But— While we were in Mega Sphere, we might have appeared a little different to that kid who consulted Sengoku. In a place far from anyone’s reach, only the chosen ones get to shine bright— If we ended up looking like that in his eyes, then it only makes sense he’d feel anxious about his own future.
In his mind, our existence may have gone past admiration and ended up at being “humans from a different world”. Even though the reality is that we’re all fellow idols chasing after the same dream…
then let’s let all those [students] know that through our [live show] today. we will teach them that we are not a [fantasy], but [reality]. that we are [idols] who struggled and worked so very hard in [yumenosaki], just like everyone has…♪
…You’re right. I don’t think I’d like it if we were seen as nothing but sparkling beings who’ve never experienced hardships.
And if I were in their position, I’d just get depressed over it and lose motivation in the end… so I’m all for Shinobu-kun’s plan. …I don’t feel like things will change with just one live show from us, but— Still, it may act as a turning point for someone to see things more positively.
Mhm, mhm! That’s the spirit, Midori-kun!
Right, it is time we raise the curtains. Is everyone ready? One for all, and all for one! Let’s join forces to deliver energy and hope to everyone…☆
“—Fuhahahaha! I’m sure we’ve kept you all waiting long enough!”
“The red flame is the mark of justice! The sun of life, burning bright red!” “Ryusei Red, Morisawa Chiaki…!”
“The black flame is the mark of effort! The burning fighting spirit, stained with mud!” “Ryusei Black, Nagumo Tetora…!”
“The green flame is the mark of compassion! The great nature, growing infinitely!” “Ryusei Green, Takamine Midori…”
“the blue flame is the mark of mystery~ i have come from the blue sea~” “ryusei blue, shinkai kanata…!”
“The yellow flame is the mark of hope! The beam of miracle, shining into the darkness!” “Ryusei Yellow, Sengoku Shinobu…!”
“With the five of us together! We are Ryuseitai…☆” “To all our guests, thank you for coming today!”
“I’m sure everyone here is giving all their efforts in order to become an idol, each and every day.” “And for that exact reason, there may be moments when you feel like your existence is minuscule, or that all the active idols out there are nowhere near your reach—”
“But you know, we were not performing this well from the very start, either!” “We’ve had failures, and we’ve gone through many frustrations. Even now, we are training to improve ourselves day in and out!” “As we kept moving forward bit by bit, we managed to reach this point before we knew it — That is all there is to it!”
“So not to worry, for there is no need to rush yourself! Everyone has their own pacing!” “Today, we shall pour our all into our song with these feelings in mind! May our performance provide you with the strength to work just as hard tomorrow!” “♪~♪~♪”

entry.title: SELECTION 10 UNIT: Neptu Story
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
Tori
Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Ch 4 - Ch 5 - Ch 6 - Ch 7 - Work Lines Chapter 1
Season: ES 2nd Year
Hm. This song is quite different from Akatsuki’s, as my unit usually emphasizes on Japanese-style performances. I poured all my efforts into practice so as not to fall behind everyone else. Because of that, I barely got to truly take in how fresh and new this experience is to me… However, I can proudly say that my performance has turned out satisfactory. ♪
Yeah, while watching you improve each day, I also felt as though I couldn’t allow myself to lag behind. That feeling motivated me to refine my performance. You have my gratitude, Kanzaki. It’s because you were here that I was able to improve further.
Ooh, is that so!? Then what say we demonstrate our finely-improved song and dance on this ‘su-taij’?
Chapter 2
That reminds me, when I first heard ‘Deep into you’, the first thing that came to mind is The Little Mermaid tale.
i thought the same. the [lyrics] even has a “returning to foam” line, after all~
But the more we sang it, the more I felt like it reminded me of you, Shinkai-kun. I’m not too sure why I felt that way, though. But maybe it’s because the mysterious air you give off matches perfectly with the song?
fufu. makoto told me something similar~ the two of you are [quite alike], aren’t you~ but i am a hero, you know. i will not disappear and become [foam]~
Chapter 3
I am mentioning this very late in, but… When I first received advice from you, Tomoe-dono, I was absolutely stunned. I never expected your advice to be, “Try singing the song as if you’ve fallen in love with me, who’s right before your very eyes!”… Not even in my wildest dreams.
Ahaha! You truly looked dumbstruck at that moment!
Well, in practice, it did actually dramatically improve your singing, so I believe it was precisely the advice you needed!
You are quite right about that. This song’s theme is emotions of love… That being said, I am pretty unfamiliar with sensual love. If I hadn’t gotten your help, Tomoe-dono, I wouldn’t have been able to make sense of the emotions within the lyrics… Which would have led me unable to represent those emotions properly.
Chapter 4
(sways left and right) this [stage] is so beautiful no matter how many times i look at it~ i get to have a taste of how it feels to be a [fishie] swimming in the [sea]~
my favorite part is when the [foam] slowly floats up, it looks so [fairytale-like]~
Wahaha! I also love this sorta atmosphere~♪
fufun~♪ the idea came to me when i was talking about [dolphin]-san with mr. [bluebird]. i immediately thought, “we should add [foam] to the performance”.
Oh yeah, think I heard that you got the idea from how dolphins are real good at bubble rings.
Ahhh~! The inspiration, it’s coming to me, it’s coming to me! I gotta hurry and write this, or my masterpiece will poof into foam!
Chapter 5
Fufu. I can tell how particular the details are in this outfit. ♪ The ornaments looking like starfish and coral are just wonderful…
Yeah! If I remember correctly, the person who was in charge of making these outfits came up with the design right before the deadline, right? They added all our ideas too, like in the colors. I’m not feeling as hyper as Akehoshi-kun would, but I’m still so excited! ♪
That just shows how much everyone expects lots from us while cheering us on. That’s exactly why we have to liven up this stage to the best of our capabilities. That will be the ultimate repayment we can give to the fans and staff that have supported us.
Chapter 6
Oh yeah, after Shinkai-senpai’s stage direction was adopted, everyone brought up their own ideas, right?
Yes. There were plenty of choreography moves and practice methods I never could’ve thought up on my own, so it was an enlightening experience. Some of those methods could be utilized in UNDEAD’s live shows, too.
That’s one of the perks to Shuffle units, for sure! But on the other hand, problems you wouldn’t usually go through in your own unit can pop up…
Neptu has many free and unrestrained members, after all. However, I believe we were able to have a wonderful, exhilarating few days together.
Chapter 7
This level of massive success wouldn’t have been possible if it weren’t for us seven people, full of distinct personalities!
Yes, our live show turned out wonderfully. Actually… so you were aware you had a distinct personality, huh?
Wahaha! ☆ It was the best! I almost wish we could have another go on stage!
I know you may feel that way, but you still can’t rush back into the stage without permission, okay~?
Gosh, you’re saying things a Papa would, as always. What an overly helpful personality…
But, well, I suppose that’s what makes you you, Tsumugi-kun.
Work Lines
(GOOD) Love songs still make me nervous to this day…! (GREAT) It’d make me so happy to know if everyone enjoyed it!
(GOOD) i imagined it as a [love] by the [seashore]. (GREAT) we have some interesting members here, don’t we~
(GOOD) I got to display all my charms to my heart’s content! (GREAT) Even the outfit captures the feeling of the sea!
(GOOD) I got to sing the rap parts of the song, as well. (GREAT) The scenery naturally comes to your mind when listening to the song, right?
(GOOD) It has an “en-nui” atmosphere to it. ♪ (GREAT) You will surely experience a new, fresh atmosphere.
(GOOD) I feel like I managed to pull off a mature feel! (GREAT) The rhythm of the lyrics feels real nice, doesn’t it~?
(GOOD) The atmosphere of this song is different from the usual, isn’t it? (GREAT) This song carries a sweet, but heartwrenching feeling to it~♪
