ryuseipuka
Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Ch 4 - Ch 5 - Translation Notes Chapter 1
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (June)
Another few days later. After lessons were over, in the hanging garden…
Haaah~…
(Four notifications, huh…) (It’s felt like a heavy burden to check the messages in our request box since then, and now there’s four unread emails piled up.)
(I don’t know what I’ll do if I see another message like the last, so I keep putting it off and running away.) (Even though running away does nothing for me here…)
………… (Tenshouin and Anzu have fair points. Their claims weren’t incorrect in any way.)
(…But. Ryuseitai aren’t just idols.) (If Ryuseitai really was nothing more than a unit based on heroes—) (Then I would’ve transferred to another unit back when it was in such an awful, declining state.)1
(The reason I never left Ryuseitai no matter the state of the unit… was all because Ryuseitai are both idols and heroes.) (It was all because I thought that this unit would be the place where I could turn my ideals into a reality.)
…But reality is just full of things that don’t go your way… In fact, they hardly ever do.
—Woah!? That surprised me…!2 Ah, hey, Anzu! You tapped on my shoulder so suddenly that it made me jump.
…Huh? Ahh, you heard me talking to myself, huh…
Ahaha, how embarrassing. I was just being a bit grumpy, so please forget about it!
Ah, I see. The meeting the other day is still on your mind, so you came to see how I’m doing? It’s alright. You can rest assured that I don’t have any complaints about you, Tenshouin, or ES. I actually completely understand the circumstances. I’m already an adult, after all.
I really understand what the two of you said. I do, but… Every time I try to get myself to agree, my inner child has such a sad look to him… It’s hard to get my mood back on track.
Mm? Why aren’t I consulting with my unit mates about it…?
Ohh! You could tell I haven’t discussed it with them, huh! I expect nothing less from the renowned producer! You’ve got those so-called “eyes of foresight,” huh~? You littleee~☆
…Mmh. I was just joking around a bit. Don’t make that scary face.
Huh!? No, no, no! You’ve got the wrong idea! There’s absolutely no shot I’d ever think that my comrades are unreliable…!
Why, you ask…? Let me think… It’s because this is just my own selfish desire, and nobody else’s. And I can’t simply cause trouble to Ryuseitai just like that, can I?
Ahaha, you’re right. We’re talking about those four. They might say it isn’t any trouble to them. Although, I feel like Takamine might… But I think he’d help me out in the end as well, all the while saying it’s depressing and a pain to do.
Still, that’s exactly why I can’t stand the thought. I don’t want to just casually involve them in my own personal desires.
…………
A lot has happened with us too, right? After the commander role became rotation-based, I got to see Ryuseitai in all sorts of colors.
And each one took me by surprise — “Ah, so there were this many worlds inside of them all along.” It was so shocking to me… Before my eyes were worlds I’ve never once experienced before. Beautifully shining worlds, each packed with their own individuality that nobody else could ever replicate.
That’s why I end up thinking… I feel bad that I had made them accompany my own selfish world all this time.
Huh? Do I regret it?
Ah, no. Nothing absurd like that. Besides, it’s precisely because we walked down this path that I got to learn about each of their individual worlds. I believe our journey up until this point was necessary for Ryuseitai.
It’s just that… I also can’t help but think — Couldn’t I have noticed this sooner? That thought’s become like a tiny thorn that I feel lodged inside me.
Mm? I should tell them about that, too…?
Ah, mm. I suppose you’re right… I think your advice is extremely reasonable here, Anzu.
…Morisawa-senpai is clearly acting weird.
He truly is~ Even when we invited him to eat dinner at the cafeteria and then return home together, he immediately left in haste…
One way to go ‘bout this is hounding Morisawa-senpai down ‘til he’s forced to tell us his troubles, but… Somehow, I feel like it’d be wrong to do that, on a moral standpoint. Why does he always bear things on his own? Every time I think he’s finally acknowledged us, he goes right back to not dependin’ on us again. Are we that unreliable in his eyes?
i do not think that is the case~ not when it comes to chiaki. it is surely because he will always be a [child of three]. it is like when they say, “the soul of a child of three remains until a hundred”.3
Eh!? Morisawa-senpai was a child of three!? I always thought he was an only child like me…!
fufufu~♪
Eh!? Eh!? Why’re you pattin’ my head, Shinkai-senpai…!?
in any case. we cannot leave chiaki as he is. he is not giving his all in our [lessons], either.
Precisely. I would like to resolve Morisawa-dono’s worries for his sake, as well as avoid any risks of negative impacts on our ThanX Festival lessons.
yes, that is true~
puka puka…♪ puka puka…♪ (sways left and right)
Huh? I feel like it’s been a while since I’ve heard Shinkai-senpai’s “puka puka”. I think that’s just because he hasn’t really been water-bathing, though.
yes~ it is hard to [puka puka] outside of a [body] of water, after all.4
Then why’d ya say “puka puka” outta nowhere? This is the staff cafeteria, so you can’t go water-bathing, okay?
i will not. there was a smart protagonist in an old [anime], who would say “poku poku” when it was time to use his [head], so i [copied] after it. but i made mine “puka puka”. it is what they call an “[original] touch,” yes?5
I believe he’s referring to Ikkyu-san. Although, I’d like to point out that I don’t think that is something he says, but rather a sound effect.6
but it was [worthwhile] to puka puka. i just thought of a [good idea]. ehehe…♪
Eh? Thought of what?
—please lend me your [ears], everyone.
Chapter 2
Another few days later. When the ThanX Festival practice lesson was about to begin…
…Sigh.
(…I can barely focus on my lessons these days.) (I’ve been overthinking everything for so long that my feelings are now all over the place. It feels like I’m just drifting aimlessly through the air.)
(Come on, what’s wrong with you! Get a hold of yourself, Morisawa Chiaki…!) (You get nothing out of brooding and moping over this day after day!)
(Everyone has their own circumstances and situations.) (We all get tossed around by unexpected events, living our lives as we complain, worry, and grapple our way through.) (Even heroes have plenty of moments where all hope is lost, don’t they…!?)
(Well, those crises usually turn out well one way or another as the story goes on, though…)
(But this is reality. We aren’t living in a fictional story. It’s impossible by nature for happy endings to come true every single time.) (That’s why everyone makes a wish in hopes that it does, even if just a little bit… and pour in as much effort as they possibly can for it to happen.)
(This time around is unfortunate, but there’s no need to give up on everything.) (If it isn’t possible today, then maybe it will be tomorrow. If it isn’t possible tomorrow, then maybe it will be the next day. And if it isn’t possible this year, then maybe next year…) (I can just keep wishing for that without ever giving up — Until the day it comes true.)
…………
Alright! I’m done with this moping! I’m turning over a new leaf starting today! It’s time I focus on what I can do for the ThanX Festival!
Sound of door opening
Good mooooorning! ☆
Nin-nin, good morning~ Morisawa-dono.
Ooh!? What’s going on!? I came thirty minutes earlier than scheduled, but everyone’s already here! Huh—? Did I get our meeting time wrong!?
Nah, you didn’t. We just came here an hour earlier to prepare some stuff, is all.
Mm? Prepare…?
Ahh, you mean prepare for the lesson! Aww, I’m soo happy to see you guys this motivated for the ThanX Festival~♪ Now I feel myself fired up all of a sudden!
yes, there is that~ but for today, let’s perform a [hero show] together~♪
Eh? Hero show? Not our lesson for ThanX Festival?
yes. i think we need to take a breather sometimes, you see.
Hm. I don’t feel as though we’ve done enough lessons to justify taking a breather… It’s been at most a week since we started, after all.
Well, if you want to do it, then why not have one every once in a while, right!? We, the reborn Ryuseitai, are always about cherishing all the things we want to do! Alright then! ☆ Let’s have a hero show together, shall we!? So, who will take on which role!?7
Aaand in the end, he’s the one most into it…
I feel like the Red role is best suited for you, don’t you think, Morisawa-senpai?
Eh—? Are you sure? Aren’t there other people who’d want to be the Red role?
Ah, it’s all good. We have other roles we wanna do. So no need to hold back, go ahead and take it!
I see. I thought that the Red position would turn into a scramble unless we decide on it through ladder lottery or rock-paper-scissors, but I guess not.8
fufu~ chiaki’s [faith] in [red] is passionately hot, isn’t it~
If everyone has other roles they’d like to do, then I’ll take up the Red role! Right, so which roles are you all going to take?
i will be the [baddie] who came from the world of the [sea]~♪ i am the tiger shark kaijin.9 rawr~☆
Ooh, so Kanata will be the evildoer! Mhm, mhm. The kaijin is absolutely vital for the hero. I don’t think “rawr~” is what a shark would say, but we’re in an age of diversity now. I think it’s fine to have a shark that yells “rawr~”!
Ossu! I’ll be the Karate Kaijin! A master expert who wields the aurora belt, goin’ far beyond the levels of red and black belts.
Karate Kaijin, huh! Sounds like a tough opponent!
As one would expect, I shall be the Ninja Kaijin. I am a kaijin of remarkable skill, capable of utilizing ninjutsu from all times and places.
I’m going with a kaijin based on eggplants…♪
Eeek…! Don’t bring out the final boss out of nowhere—!
Mm? Hold on. Everyone is going to be a kaijin except me? I know I said that a villain is essential in a hero show, but four against one clearly puts the hero at a disadvantage, doesn’t it?
But in Sentai shows, the typical fight scenes have five to six heroes against one kaijin, right? In that case, it’s fine for the opposite to happen every once in a while.
Mmh~ Now that you’ve pointed it out, I suppose that’s true. I’m starting to feel like it isn’t fair if a fight doesn’t have a sole hero against several kaijins every now and then…
yes. so please make sure to cut your way through this [crisis] as [red], okay?
Chapter 3
fufufu. blasted hero of justice. tiger shark kaijin will be the one to take you down~
take this~ “eradicating all your solo fights-choo~p ☆”
Ow!? It isn’t as bad as your real chops, but you still put a lot of power in that, didn’t you!? It genuinely hurt, y’know!?
Next up, the Ninja Kaijin shall strike with his ninjutsu~
“I’d like you to stop spinning in circles all on your own-no-Jutsu~☆”
Wah!? Don’t swing a toy katana when you just said it’s a “jutsu”! Actually, how is this ninjutsu!? Isn’t using the law of physics just foul play!?10
I am a kaijin. Therefore, toying with you through lies would be my forte!
That’s the perfect example of a hero show! You’re such a good boy, becoming fully absorbed into your role…!
ORYAA—! “Couldja rely on the people around you for once already-straight punch~!!”
UHYOO!? N-Nagumo… I mean, Karate Kaijin…! You’re very powerful as it is, so please adjust your strength a little! I’d like you to throw your attacks more softly and gently, like cotton-candy!11
Don’t worry. I’m makin’ sure to avoid hittin’ ya, just barely.
You sure!? It’s extremely terrifying how every time you swing your fist, the air rumbles with a “BWON-BWON” sound, though!?
Fufufu… Prepare yourself, Morisawa-senpai… No — Hero of Justice. If I imagine myself as an eggplant kaijin, the thought of willingly hugging the hero starts to sound like a great idea.
“Enough brooding over your own personal issues-hug~☆”
UHYOOO!! I’m begging you, Eggp**** Kaijin, please don’t get near me! I’d rather avoid saying even its name, so I censored it…! I feel like I’m on the verge of getting rashes!12
Adding the beep all on your own… You truly are an all-rounded talent, Morisawa-dono~
…Mm? All these attacks have had strange names attached to them…
…………
Are you guys scolding me by any chance…?
Indeed, we are! You’re troubled over something, are you not?
You could tell…?
Obviously. How many years do you think we’ve been working together?
chiaki is [bad] at hiding things, after all.
Why aren’t you relyin’ on us a li’l more!? Sure, maybe we’re still inexperienced in your eyes, Senpai… But are you tellin’ me that even after all we’ve been through together, you still don’t feel like you can rely on us!?
—! No! That isn’t it at all…! In fact, there’s no one else who understands first-hand just how much you’ve all grown more than I do. You guys are all so genuinely dependable.
That’s why… That’s exactly why I couldn’t get myself to rely on you…
The heck… What’s that supposed to mean? Just so you know, this hero show isn’t over until you fess up, Senpai.
…………
…Alright. I’ll talk about what’s been weighing on my mind the past several days.
Time passes…
—And that’s what happened. I couldn’t bear to have you guys involved in my selfish whims. It’s absolutely not because I think you’re all unreliable in any way.
…Stupid Taichou!13 Why didn’t you tell us all’a this much earlier!? Why are you always like this!? Why don’t you understand that just as you wish for us to be happy, we also wish for you to be happy!? You said it before yourself! “It’s wonderful to have things you aren’t willing to give up”! “We, the reborn Ryuseitai, will continue to cherish that aspect”!14
That “thing you aren’t willing to give up” also applies to your wishes, and all of us in Ryuseitai want to cherish that, too! So quit tryin’ to give up without even consultin’ us first!
…………
Sorry… But there’s really just nothing we can do about this. I’ve already tried with all my power to negotiate with several parties, but every single one of them declined my proposal…
Are you really sure about that? I feel like we could still try thinking it over together, though…
from what chiaki said, a [countrywide tour] is not possible due to our planned [schedules], is that right?
Well, I guess it’s true that each of us have a packed schedule separate from one another, yeah.
Hrmm~… Schedule… Ryuseitai… Countrywide…
Hm. I might have come up with a genius idea… How about this for a plan? In order to have Ryuseitai spread across the country, we could have all of us fly around the country and complete the tour in one day, instead of taking multiple days from everyone’s schedule… What do you think?
So basically, we each go to separate places around the country, and interact with the fans there…?
Precisely! After all, while we do have the saying, “all for one, one for all”— I thought that if we simply cooperate on this plan together, perhaps we could complete the tour in one day.
…! Y-You’re right, if we do it that way, then the concerns that StarPro and Anzu brought up would be settled!
in that case then, i would love to have the [tower lighting event] happen in each place we go to as well, not just in one spot as we have it planned right now.
Aight then, we gotta call over Anzu-anego ASAP and rework the project one more time!
Chapter 4
On the day of Ryuseitai’s countrywide tour. In a certain region’s shopping mall…
Uu, what am I going to do… I’m super nervous…
(I do work alone sometimes when it comes to modeling, but I think this is the first time I’m all by myself for a Ryuseitai job…) (There’s normally always someone else with me, but this time I have to do a handshake event all on my own…?)
(We decided on this together, and Anzu-san is also helping us out to the best of her ability, so I kept telling myself I’d do my best…) (But I really feel like I can’t handle it after all…!) (Normally, if I ever flub my words, someone would back me up immediately, but… I don’t have anyone who could come to my rescue today.)
Ueehh… I’m starting to feel sick from the nerves. I’m as anxious as I felt when I stood up on stage for the first time. This is so depressing, I wanna die… Can I just run away here…?
Yeah, no, there’s no way I can… I doubt I’d be let off with only a scolding if I did…
Ah— That reminds me, Morisawa-senpai gave me a video and told me, “Watch this if you ever start to feel like it’s too much to handle”… I wonder what that was about…? Let me try watching it now—
“TAKAMINEEEEEE!! HANG IN THEEEREEE!! YOU CAN DO IT, YES YOU CAN! RELAX AND DO YOUR BEST~!! HIP HIP HURRAY, TAKAMINE! GO GO TAKAMINE! FUUUUUUU! ☆”
Uowah!? He’s so loud…!? I have to turn down the volume…! W-What is this…? A new way to harass me…? That was so loud that it attracted the attention of everyone around me… All their gazes are painful. I wanna die…
Mm? I see Tetora-kun and Shinobu-kun in the video.
“Morisawa-senpai, what’re you doin’?”
“Are you filming a video of some sort?”
“Ohh! Nagumo, Sengoku, you’re here at the perfect time! Takamine tends to get nervous, so! I’m recording an uplifting video to encourage him. Please give him some words of support too, guys!”
“Ermm, you doin’ okay, Midori-kun~? If you feel nervous, try to relax your heartbeat by breathin’ properly, ‘kay~”
“You’re a strong boy, Midori-kun~ I’m certain you can do it. I believe in you~”
Are you my mom…? Ehh… Why’re the two of them so casual about it? Can’t you show more concern for me?
“Oh! Kanata, Kanata! Kanata, please share some words to cheer Takamine on, too!”
“midori~ please do your best out there. if you keep at it, i will give you a [mascot] of a sea friend as a [reward]. it is a [new creation] you will surely love to see.”
I’ll follow you for life, Shinkai-senpai! That’s Shinkai-senpai for you. Always providing me with emotional comfort…♪15
…………
(Huh, I think I actually feel a lot calmer after seeing all of them be their usual selves…?) (Plus, thanks to the insanely loud sound in the video, I technically have everyone’s attention on me now, so… It’s like I have nothing to be afraid of anymore, in a way…) (I mean, I doubt I could stand out any worse than I did just now.)
…Mhm. I think I’ll do fine. Alright—
Everyooone~ Hello~☆ I’m Ryuseitai’s Ryusei Green, Takamine Midori…♪
Meanwhile, at a park in another region…
Fuooohh!! I am in sacred land in the eyes of a ninja enthusiast! Is this the very same site of the village where an extremely renowned ninja clan were said to have lived in secret…!?
Breathes in, breathes out… breathes in, breathes out…
Mfufufun~♪ Inhaling the air alone makes me feel like I, too, could become a ninja clan master of remarkable skill! I shall do it~! A handshake event befitting this place!
Now then, gather round, all those who are here! I am Ryuseitai’s Ryusei Yellow, Sengoku Shinobu! Have a look at the quintessence of my ninjutsu! ☆ Cartwheel! Back handspring! And then~ Moonsault! ☆ Target locked, shurikens at the ready: shubabababa! ☆
Ah! Thank you, nin-nin~ I am ever so grateful for all your cheers and applause~!16
Meanwhile, at a harbor in another region…
fufufu~ the [salty sea breeze] feels so nice~ perhaps it is time to return back to the [sea].
buuut~, that is simply a [joke]. ehehe…♪ i have already grown accustomed to the land, and i am here today for a ryuseitai job, so…
the blue flame is the mark of mystery. i have come from the blue sea~♪ it is nice to meet you all~ i am ryuseitai’s [ryusei blue], shinkai kanata ☆ i hope to make your acquaintance~
fufufu. everyone is waving their [hands] so much. let me wave back just as much. wave, wave…♪
…mm? there are so many people gathered around me now.
ahh, you would like to [shake hands]? of course it is fine. here, handshake~♪
eh? yes. this is a [soy sauce bottle]. i do not get to be in a port city very often, so i am here to eat lots of [fish] today~☆
really? then please tell me all about the [restaurants] that have tasty fish…♪ and as for you, you will tell me about the best [fish] for this season? thank you very much.
ahh, it is alright. there is no need to talk all at once. please do not rush yourselves. we still have plenty of [time]. let’s all [talk] one by one, slow and steady…♪
Chapter 5
Meanwhile, at an amusement park in another region…
The black flame is the mark of effort! The burning fighting spirit, stained with mud! Ryusei Black! Nagumo Tetora…!
How was that…?
I’m glad that you liked it! I’m so happy to know you’re always supportin’ Ryuseitai. Thank you so much~♪
—Right, next person pl…Woah!? A-Are you alright!? Heeey~! People at the back~! Please don’t push on the queue! If you keep pushin’ the people in the front, someone might get hurt, y’know?
Ossu! Thank you for your understanding!
Time passes…
Thank you so much for today, everyone! Please keep on showing your support for Ryuseitai, it’s greatly appreciated! ☆
…Huff, whew.
(The first part is over now, I think. The venue’s gotten quieter, too.) (I have a break ‘til the second part, but there might be people who’re tryin’ to get here at the last minute, so I’ll stay on the stage for a li’l longer.) (The handshake event is labelled as the Ryuseitai ThanX Festival, but I’m the only one here, so I was a li’l worried I’d disappoint the fans…)
(But everyone’s been so kind and friendly. I’m meant to cheer ‘em up, but I feel like I’m the one who got cheered up by ‘em instead.)
(I wonder how it’s goin’ for everyone else…?) (I bet Midori-kun’s insanely nervous. I can only hope the uplifting video we took for him comes to use…)
(But, well, he’s always managed to get through things one way or another, so I just know he’ll be fine this time, too.) (As for Shinobu-kun, I get the feeling he’s impressing all the local fans with his amazin’ ninjutsu and ninja knowledge.)
(And we all know what Shinkai-senpai’s like~ I’m sure he’s soothing even the people who were just passin’ by, and gettin’ along well with everyone there.) (And there’s no need to even worry ‘bout Morisawa-senpai.) (That guy is someone who’s liked by anybody, so I have a feelin’ he’s bringing energy to all sortsa fans, no matter who they are.)
…Oh, wait! I gotta note down these feelings, too. ‘Cuz I seriously don’t know what sorta words would work best for lyrics.
Aaalright~! I’mma make sure I also go all out with the second part~…!
After the handshake event ended in every region, at night. At the venue for the tower lighting event…
Mm? I got another message. Ah, the last one is Nagumo.
Hm, hm… I see. It looks like Nagumo’s handshake event was a massive success, as well~♪ Right, I now have everyone’s thoughts and their lines for the lyrics with me! Once this lighting event is over, all that’s left is for me to put together what they sent into full lyrics, and then our Ryuseitai song to convey our gratitude will be complete!17
Fufufu. I can already imagine what must’ve happened in each region just through the messages they’ve sent. The idea to compose a song all on our own for the ThanX Festival live show came to me completely on a whim, but… I never thought it’d turn out to be this incredible. I really can’t wait to sing this in front of everyone…♪
Mm…? I think the staff just called my name?
—Ah, yes. So the tower lighting event is about to begin, correct? Understood! We’re in your care then!18 (Oh—! I hear everyone’s voices through the intercom earphones.)
Heeey~! You guys! Great work out there! I just checked over the lyrics everyone sent me; thank you for thinking up such wonderful lines! Honestly, I’d love to continue praising you for your hard work while hearing out how your tour went today, but! I’ll save that for after the lighting event is over!
Is everyone ready to light up the tower in their region? You have the steps memorized, right? We light up the towers simultaneously right after my catchphrase!
“Got it! I’m ready to go anytime!”
“Mfufun~♪ I am good to go as well!”
“i am also fully prepared, chiaki.”
“I’m ready to go anytime, too… Please go with a straightforward cue so that my timing isn’t out of sync with everyone, okay?”
Aaalright~! Then here goes!
(…A lot of fans came to see us, Ryuseitai, today. It made me so happy. Thank you!) (I’m sure there are plenty of fans who couldn’t come meet us even if they wanted to, just like the kid who sent that fan letter…)
(—But it’ll be alright!)
“To all our fans who came to see us today, and to all our fans who couldn’t come see us… To every single fan out there, may this light reach you!” “This very light that we’ll shine out from every part of the country…!”
“The red flame is the mark of justice! The sun of life, burning bright red! Ryusei Red! Morisawa Chiaki!”
 “—tenLIGHT to~u!U~P! ☆”
format_size
Prologue As An Idol As A Hero Epilogue IRL Tower Lighting Event Fan ThanX Extra Content Song: OVERFLOW LIGHT UP!!!!! Mini Talks
Translation Notes ↑ Referring to Ryuseitai’s state back when Chiaki was a 1st and 2nd year, which is explicitly shown in Meteor Impact. Jin has also previously mentioned that the unit was in an awful state back when he was a Yumenosaki student as well, in Legendary Hero!.↑ As a fun note, Chiaki is easily startled by people approaching him; the most notable moments are in Astraea’s Atelier, but it’s happened in other stories like Witchcraft, and even back in his 2nd year of Yumenosaki, Meteor Impact, 2nd part Chapter 2.↑ An idiom that refers to someone whose disposition/personality never changes from when they were a young child, even after they’ve grown older. The English version of this idiom is “the child is father to the man”.↑ Puka puka means “floating” (Sometimes translated as “bubble, bubble”). As mentioned, when Kanata says this, it’s to do with his favorite hobby, water-bathing, where he “floats” in a body of water.↑ As a fun note, Kanata tends to do his own original touch to many things; a notable one is his Ryusei Blue catchphrase (“i have come from the blue sea”). See more in the notes for Yumenosaki Ryuseitai Song.↑ An example of this classic Ikkyu-san scene can be seen here.↑ Hero shows are skit-like performances aimed toward children, and it typically consists of someone playing as the tokusatsu hero, and someone else playing as the villain.↑ Ryuseitai have decided on who takes the hero role through rock-paper-scissors before, in School Festival 4, Chapter 3, as well as in Parallel World. Sort of related, but they’ve also decided on who’ll be the next leader through ladder lottery, in Tropical.↑ Kaijin (怪人) is a term in tokusatsu that refers to human-sized monster villains. You can find more information here.↑ Jutsu can also refer to sorcery, i.e. unrealistic techniques, hence Chiaki’s remark here.↑ As a fun note, Chiaki has noted (as well as been noted by others) that he has no physical fighter’s strength. One mention of this is in Supervillain, Supersized Villain 2 & 3, where he even compares himself to “weak meat”.↑ Chiaki despises eggplants, be it appearance, taste, or even its name. See here for more information. He was just recently in a crisis related to eggplants, in VS★GOURMET, Flood of Customers 3.↑ Tetora used to sometimes call Chiaki by this back in their Yumenosaki days together, like in Hero Show, Chapter 4, Supernova, Idling and Effort 1, and Orihime and Hikoboshi, Epilogue 2. (Fun note, all stories were set in summer, including this one!)↑ Chiaki said this in Stella Maris, Prologue. As a side note, Tetora treasures Chiaki’s words about Ryuseitai and their ideals; even the Masterpiece MV shows this in several moments, like 0:58-1:03!↑ One notable moment of Kanata doing this for Midori was in Morning Practice, a story set in their early Yumenosaki days.↑ As a fun note, Shinobu has a CG where he does gymnastic tricks, in Boarding Live (Seen in Chapter 5).↑ This is reflected in the song, OVERFLOW LIGHT UP!!!!!, particularly through Ryuseitai’s lines at the start. The Game MV also shows those lines on the screen, handwritten by each member!↑ Chiaki switches from his usual way of speaking to speak in polite language (keigo) with the staff.

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Beach
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
Akira
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Ch 4 - Translation Notes Chapter 1
Season: Yumenosaki Era, Summer
Location: Beach
Ahh~……
What’s wrong, Oogami? Your soul is leaving through your mouth.
Uu~……
I must admit, it’s hot enough to collapse. UNDEAD’s black uniforms absorb heat, so it’s as if we’re in an endurance contest. Did I use the right analogy? Anzu brought us cold sports drinks, so you should drink a bottle. It should make you feel a little better, Oogami.
GAAAAH! SHUT UPPP! It’s so freakin’ stuffy here and it’s pissing me off! Leave me alone! Don’t get anywhere near me! Body temperature is the deadliest weapon in this heat wave…!
You’ll only feel hotter if you cause a ruckus, Oogami.
The hell, you look like you’re doin’ just fine! You ass, you’re not breakin’ any freakin’ sweat!
I’m fine with the heat. My father’s home country is even hotter than this. Although, I’m not very accustomed to Japan’s humidity.
Ahn? I don’t give a damn about your family’s business! You’re lookin’ down on me, aren’t ya, Adonis? You’re thinkin’, “You can’t even handle this level of heat”, eh!?
You’re letting paranoia get to you. …Here, Oogami, have a bottle of sports drink.
Mgh— (Gulp, gulp)
Fhah! It’s too warm! The hell, does Anzu even try to care!? Bring me a freezin’ cold one! I’m gonna die from this heat…!
You wouldn’t drink it sooner, so it got warm. Don’t put the blame on Anzu, Oogami.
It’s not just her fault, it’s this whole summer’s fault, godammit! I know it’s the summer holidays and all, but why the hell do we gotta work in a suffocatin’ beach full’a crowds!? I was revved up to go ‘cuz we’re finally doin’ a live gig after so long, but we’ve just been doin’ anythin’ but that, from servin’ customers at a beach house, to pickin’ up litter on the beach…
Is this really a job for UNDEAD — for an idol!?
If you have complaints, direct them to our seniors who took on this job. Besides, you haven’t been working so much that it warrants complaining, have you? You’ll get scolded if you don’t perform seriously, you know?
Ahhn? As if I care! I’ve got no drive to serve any customers! I’ve been revvin’ up to sing with all my freakin’ might, you got it!?
I see, you’re quite the serious person then… Rest assured, Oogami. I believe Anzu is planning something. There should be a chance for us UNDEAD to be up on stage. I heard Ryuseitai is performing something called “Pirate Festival” at this beach. It was supposed to be Ryuseitai’s job only at first, but Anzu is making arrangements to allow us to participate last-minute. That’s apparently under Anzu’s production, as well. I believe it will be possible to make this happen. Anzu is rushing as fast as she can to make our outfits.
Anzu is such a hard worker. You should learn from her, Oogami. Don’t sulk so much, show some enthusiasm.
Ahhn? Pirate Festival, huh? Hell yeah, that sounds fun! Hah, instead of those Ryuseitai guys who try to be the good guys, us at UNDEAD are way more suitable for that! ♪ So, what’s the event like?
Pirates, huh… Are we gonna sing on a ship or somethin’? Musical instruments can get damaged by the sea breeze or water, though? What song are we gonna perform? We’ll constantly rock about if it’s on a ship, so wouldn’t it be hard to dance? Did Anzu seriously think this through?
You’re extremely eager… Do you like ships, Oogami?
Hah! Is there anyone who even hates ‘em? I can’t hold back my excitement, not with my chance to step in a ship and aim for the Dark Continent! Hya-haa! We’re in the age of discovery~☆
I see… You’re a boy through and through, Oogami.
Yeah, yeah~ C’mon, quit chatting and start working, you two~♪
Ah, you bastard~! Hakaze…senpai, this is completely different from what we were told! Why’re we servin’ customers!? This ain’t my style, man, do you not get it!?
Quit barking, Puppy Dog~1 We’re in front of customers, y’know? C’mon, smile, smile~♪ But man, I was tricked by Anzu-chan too, y’know? She told me, “Let’s go to the beach together”, so I agreed without thinking twice, but who would’ve known it’d be for a job~?
And here I was hoping I’d get to see Anzu-chan in a swimsuit~ But now she’s gone off somewhere, and I have to babysit a bunch of brats… Ahh, jeez, this sucks~♪
But sure, it’s fine. I like the sea anyway. We’ll be staying over for this job, so I’ll have plenty of opportunities to get on with Anzu-chan, anyway~♪
Hmph! What, you in heat or somethin’? Is that seriously all y’can think about!?
Haha, quit arguing with me, it’s overbearing. More importantly, did you guys see Sakuma-san anywhere?
He mentioned only at the last minute that we’ll be participating in Pirate Festival, which means it wasn’t meant to be our job at first, right~? Serving guests without really knowing what’s going on is fine I guess, considering it’s fun getting to flirt with girls in swimsuits… But I’m curious what our actual job is meant to be, is all.
Anzu-chan ran away when I tried hitting on her, so I lost my chance to ask her. I figured Sakuma-san would know in that case, yeah?
Ahhn? Oh yeah, I haven’t seen that Vampire Bastard around… He either skipped out on the whole thing or he burned to ashes from the sunrays, I guess?
Ahh, dammit! I don’t get what’s goin’ on, but it pisses me off! It’s all ‘cuz of the summer, god freakin’ dammit!
Chapter 2
Taichou-dono~! (waves) Look, look! Us Ryuseitai first years just had our outfit fitting done! Anzu-dono’s work is top-notch as always!
It fits me perfectly~ Twirl, twirl~♪ However, the job’s called “Pirate Festival”, while our outfits look much more like that of a navy’s…? Is this truly alright~? We don’t have the wrong outfits, do we?
And if I may, my seniors, hurry and change your attire, as well! We’ll rehearse together! ♪
Mm! Sorry, Sengoku, but there’s been a change of plans! We’re busy with a different matter, so we’ll be joining you much later! Follow Anzu’s directions, and get yourselves ready beforehand!
Hrmm? Roger that, but is there a problem of some sort~? We’ll feel helpless without Taichou-dono and Shinkai-dono! Don’t the five of us make Ryuseitai?
You’re absolutely right, but! It appears that Pirate Festival has become a joint live show between Ryuseitai and UNDEAD, so we have to do a briefing with the other party!
Oho, with UNDEAD? I’d really rather not, as those people are scary~… But, well, if that is our task, then I shall fulfill it! I’m a kid who can bear it! ♪
You’re such a good boy, Sengoku! ♪ Sorry for how sudden this was! Any complaints should be sent to Anzu! I assure you that we’ll join you later on, so please let the other two know about the change of plans, Sengoku!
Understood, nin-nin! Speaking of which, the individual who was floating in the sea was from UNDEAD too, no? I see, so he was in the sea for the sake of our joint live~♪ Is he alright? I have with me a secret remedy that boosts one’s nutrition! I would be glad to share some, if you’d like~☆
Mhm, this is a vitamin drink, no matter how you look at it! The same one you find in convenience stores! If you mean Sakuma, Kanata’s looking after him over that shade after we picked him up from the sea, so there’s no need to worry! The three of you have nothing to fret over; I’d like you to focus on your practice instead! ♪
Very well, nin-nin! I shall take my leave then! May luck favor you in the battle~♪
Now he’s saying “battle”, huh! Mhm, it’s absolutely wonderful to see Sengoku so energetic all the time! With such highly-spirited first years joining our unit this year, this makes us, Ryuseitai, safe and secure~♪
chiaki~? (sways left and right) it seems that rei finally [woke up]~
Ohh, that’s great news! Sakuma, are you alright!? Are you alive!? Why on earth were you drifting in the sea!? Who tried to get you!? I’ll avenge you!
Uu… Don’t make so much noise near my ears… I’m suffering from heatstroke, and your voice is making my head ring in pain~…
I see! My bad! I was born with this loud voice! Fuhahahaha! ☆
Mm~, truly a man akin to the midsummer sun. I am not good with that; you stand on the opposite end of us demons of the night… Nevertheless, I can see that I am in your debt. I am grateful that you carried me to a shaded shelter. I was merely seconds away from turning into ash.
…I’m sure I’ve worried you as well, Shinkai-kun.
no, no, we are [friends], aren’t we~? ♪ but. rei is [bad] with [water], so why were you in the [sea]?
Mm. I did not want to walk outside under the blazing sun, either. However, fate had me caught up in a matter I could not ignore, you see.
mm~? rei’s [way of speaking] is hard to understand, isn’t it?
Don’t you know that they say one man’s fault is another’s lesson, Shinkai-kun?2 In any case, I studied abroad for a little while. A friend that I became acquainted with at the time opened up a beach house around here. It appears he married a Japanese surfer, then decided to migrate to Japan with her and make it his home.
That blockhead made a bold decision of his own, it seems…♪ All the same, while he got to open the beach house he dreamed of in Japan, it seems he isn’t quite familiar with marketing strategies. That is when he came for my assistance.
He asked if I could perform a live show and attract a crowd for him, you see. I cannot bear to refuse a friend’s request. Everyone in UNDEAD seemed to have the free time, so I invited them with me, and took a great journey to come all the way to the sea. I asked Young Lady Anzu to officialize this as an UNDEAD job… And so, unable to just watch the state of affairs, I have been helping with serving customers and cleaning around the beach house.
However, I collapsed under the sunrays, and accidentally fell into the sea.
ahh, and that is why you were [puka puka]-ing in the [sea]~♪ (sways left and right)
This beach is pretty close to our school, so I’m not too sure about the “taking a great journey” part…
But I see, you truly cherish your friend! I see you in a different light now, UNDEAD! No matter your weakness with the sunlight, you still rose to action for the sake of your friend! With all your might, you stood your ground against the hardships through the power of friendship! I’m so deeply moved…☆
We have our own job to do as well, but I’d still like to help you out! If you need helping hands, you’re free to rely on us Ryuseitai all you like! ☆
Oh? Now that’s a proposal I did not expect. Aren’t you folks at Ryuseitai known as ‘allies of justice’? I was under the impression that such beings would be incompatible with us, the demons of the night…? I have never once heard of an ‘ally of justice’ who assists ‘evil’, whether in ancient history or modern times, you know?
Fuhaha, that’s ridiculous! Allow me to be blunt! Opposing and exterminating ‘evil’ is not what makes us ‘allies of justice’!
Hm, I see. That is sound logic. I thought you were a fool with no thought in his head, but it seems that I should revise my understanding, hm? You’ve caught my interest, so allow me to ask. It has been a while since I’ve asked someone a question…
O hot-blooded man akin to the sun, the spearhead of Ryuseitai… Why are you an ‘ally of justice’? What is your form of justice? What do you hope to accomplish by behaving as an ally of justice? For what reason did you become an ally of justice?
Fuhaha! It’s because they’re cool, of course…☆
Mhm, it appears that I have greatly overestimated you…♪
Chapter 3
Ahh, jeez, this is sooo annoying~! It’s hot, it’s crowded, our work schedule is a mess, and I’m piled up with stress! This sucks! All of you should just die! We were supposed to finish this while it was still breezy in the morning, but it’s already midday!
Ahaha. Properly performing the job even with all your complaints is how you roll, isn’t it? It’s been a while since I’ve seen Izumi-chan’s work mode, acting all sweet and friendly~♪
Haah? How long do you think I’ve been doing this work? Separating your private life from your work life is the absolute basics, ‘kay? But seriously, how’s a swimsuit photoshoot supposed to be our job?
Why can’t the girls do it? Don’t we have some in our agency? The heck are they thinking? They keep putting all the jobs on us lately, aren’t they? I mean, sure, we’re guaranteed to bring sales if we were in the magazine, but I don’t want to be sold so cheaply.
I don’t want to get a sunburn either, and how will they compensate me if I end up getting spots on my face, huh? Is the agency going to take responsibility? It’s such a pain to use anti-UV stuff, and sunscreen comes from my own expenses, mine. Can you believe these people?
Hey, are you even listening, Naru-kun?
Yes, yes, I’m listening~ Good grief… All you ever do is complain! You’ll miss out on so much if you don’t just enjoy yourself, y’know~? I’m way more stressed anyway, my skin is seconds away from breaking out~♪
That aside, look over there, Izumi-chan. Anzu-chan’s on the other side of the beach!
Huh, Anzu? Does that mean Yuu-kun’s here, too? Wawa, what am I going to do! I didn’t think I’d get to see him today, so I’m just wearing my school uniform! W-Where’s my swimsuit… Ahh, I left it at the hotel!
Mm~ I can’t see properly because of the bright sunlight, but I think those are the kids from Ryuseitai? By Yuu-kun, you mean Yuuki Makoto-kun, right? I don’t think he’s with her…?
Ehh~ What a let down! Anzu’s seriously useless! I won’t tolerate it if she got close with Yuu-kun, but at the very least, she could’ve taken on the cupid role and pulled me and Yuu-kun to each other!
Gosh, you’re so self-centered. The world doesn’t revolve around you, okay?
But, huh, I wonder if she’s working even in her summer break? Must be tough, I’m really impressed~♪
Wait, she isn’t protecting herself at all from the sun! UV rays are the biggest enemy to our skin! I wish she’d at least use a parasol~ Ahh, gosh, I really just can’t leave her on her own, can I…?
Izumi-chan, I think it’s some kind of fate to encounter her today, so… Let’s at least go over there and greet Anzu-chan~♪
Ehh~? Count me out! Yuu-kun isn’t even around, is he?
Gosh, you’d just twiddle your thumbs with nothing to do if you went back to the hotel. We’re indebted to Anzu-chan all the time… So let’s help her out in some way, to repay the favor~♪
Haah? I don’t want to work more than necessary, though~? Or what, is Anzu going to pay us for this?
Now now, let’s just go already~♪ Anzu-chaaan~! Yoohoo, fancy meeting you here! ☆
Mm? Anzu-dono, someone has come over to us…?
Ah, those two are from Knights! I think they’re older than us? I should always greet my seniors! ‘Suuup, thanks for all your hard work! ☆
Oh my, you’re so energetic in this hot weather! I love polite kids~♪
So suffocating~ Ryuseitai together in the height of summer is so suffocating~… Wish you’d all just die~… Are you guys going to perform a live show or something? The heck is that weird get-up for?
Ossu! Anzu-san made these for us — They’re the costumes for Pirate Festival! We Ryuseitai take on the navy role, so we’re wearin’ military-like uniforms! ☆ Military uniforms are so cool, aren’t they!? It’s like a man’s epic adventure! Salute~☆
Chapter 4
Umm… Anzu-san, my outfit feels a little tight, actually…?
Midori-kun, didja grow taller since we last had our measurements in April? Anzu-san has been makin’ outfits based on the data back then~3
Heheh! Taisho’s asked me to help out with carrying sewing materials before, so that’s how I know! You’re gonna keep growin’ bigger, huh~ I’m jealous, Midori-kun~♪
Uu, I wish I could share my height with everyone… We always look uneven in Ryuseitai whenever the five of us line up; it’s not really well-balanced, is it…?
That’s the charm of us Ryuseitai! We’re all different, and we’re all wonderful! ☆
You’re on good terms, aren’t you? I’m a little jealous… So you’re practicing for that so-called Pirate Festival?
Yep! We’re starting with outfit check-ups, and then we’ll do a rehearsal take! I’d say we’re still double checking if there’s any problems with our costumes and how far we’ve progressed~? After that, we’ll change into our sweatsuits to practice!
It’d suck to have these costumes go to waste from the sweat and sand, right…? By the way, Sengoku-kun, it feels hot… Why’re you hiding behind my back…?
P-People I do not really know scare me~! Spare me, spare me!
Ahaha. By the way, Pirate Festival is split into three parts! The first part is “Navy”, second part is “Pirates”, and third part is “Navy VS Pirates” — That’s how it’ll go down! UNDEAD joined us suddenly, and they’re the pirate role, so~ They’re gonna participate startin’ from part two!
The plan is that, while we perform the first part, UNDEAD will prepare themselves, from the outfit check-ups to rehearsal! After all, UNDEAD’s participation was decided outta nowhere! So they aren’t prepared to start anytime soon~ That’s why we, Ryuseitai, will stall for time ‘til they’re done preparin’ everything! ♪
Ohh~ Everyone’s hurrying about as always. Changing up plans while also needing to look after two units at the same time is a little too much all at once, isn’t it? We have some time to spare since we’ve just finished our photo shoot work… So if it’s alright with you all, how about we help with some of the smaller tasks?
Naru-kun, just so you know, I am not helping out. Could you stop deciding on my schedule without my permission?
Gosh! Who do you think negotiated with the agency to get you back in photo shoot work after you skipped out on it for a good while? Can’t you repay me a little for the debt you owe me?
I never asked you to do that, though? And even if you didn’t do anything, there’s no chance that the agency was ever going to let go of a strong asset like me! You’re being so condescending, it’s sooo annoying~! And I only got involved in this photo shoot job because you forced me into it!
If anything, I’m the one who’s being inconvenienced! I don’t want to do any photo shoot work until Yuu-kun’s back, okay? I can’t shine in photos unless it’s with Yuu-kun!
Right, right, please forgive me for all that. Good grief…
Anyway, well… I won’t force you, but… Anzu-chan, you’re still a novice as a producer, right? It’s fine to rely on us a bit more, okay? We can start with motivating all those guys…
By going to that store and buying a cute swimsuit, how about it? It’s not sexy at all to be in a sweatsuit, you know? There’s a few lovely swimsuits I’ve had my eyes on. I’ll buy you one, Anzu-chan.
I can’t wear it myself, after all…♪

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Epilogue
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
Akira
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Translation Notes Chapter 1
Warning: Derogatory term used in this chapter.
Season: Yumenosaki Era, Summer
Location: Pirates Stage
Ahh, jeez…! I had to go along with the whole Pirate Festival thing until the very end, and I’m sooo~ exhausted! I was worked to the bone for nothing! This is the actual wooorst!
Yes, yes, thank you for your hard work, Izumi-chan. Everyone’s having a barbeque on the other side as a wrap-up party, it seems~ Since we’re here and all, let’s go eat dinner with them, too~♪
Ehh~ I don’t want to eat greasy stuff like meat at this hour, though?
You sweated a lot while working, so you’ll be fine. The calories between how much you take and how much you’ve expended will balance out, you know? We have to reward ourselves every once in a while~♪
Here, I brought us meat. Say “a~hh”~♪
Mgph… Hey, I can demand a reward from Anzu, can’t I? I can’t stand to work without pay, but a barbeque barely cuts it~! Well, I guess it worked as a way to occupy my time, though~?
Mm~ Thing is, Ryuseitai and UNDEAD both participated in Pirate Festival, making that two unit participations, right? That wasn’t part of the original plan, so… I doubt Anzu-chan has the funds to compensate us on top of everything else, y’know? Pirate Festival was an exciting hit, and it seems the profits from the merchandise were pretty good…
But it all got deducted to pay the necessary expenses, so I don’t think there’s any left for us~ It didn’t end up as a huge disaster in costs nor for the event itself… That’s a big relief to know, so I’d feel bad for poor Anzu-chan if she had to deal with your demands too, you know?
We’re the ones who decided on our own to help her out, so let her off this time, okay? I’ll pat you like a good, good boy, so bear with that for now~♪
Nuah—? I told you not to casually touch me, didn’t I, shitty okama!?
That being said… Where is Anzu-chan, anyway? I would love to pat her head for her wonderful hard work… She worked suuuper hard, after all. ♪
Ah, yeah… Seems like she’s running around the beach in the mascot costume with that huge Ryuseitai first year?
Ahaha! ☆ Please wait for me, Anzu-san! How are you moving so quickly in that costume!? That’s amazing~ Ahh, and now you tripped…♪
Are you alright? It’s hard to run on sand, isn’t it? I’ll pull you up by the hand, so let’s have a lovey-dovey time tonight~♪
Midori-kuuun~ You look very happy, so I’d rather not interject from the side— But the sight of you running on the beach holding hands with a mascot costume is a little bit surreal, you know~?
This is my first time ever seein’ Midori-kun laughin’ so innocently like that. He really loves Anego, huh…?
No, wait, it’s yuru-chara he loves, right? Mm~mh?
She promised him that she’d go on a date after Pirate Festival was over, after all. But that Captain Kidoairaku costume belongs to the beach house, I believe. She cannot take it back with her, so for the date…
She’s pouring her all to have a wonderful time with him, like two love birds. Anzu-dono has quite the sense of responsibility too, or perhaps it’s that she has a lot of energy~? She surely had her own rough time with this event, yet she is running about so energetically… Meanwhile, I cannot even move anymore… I truly must build more stamina once and for all. I will only drag everyone down at this rate.
Mm, so eat meat for that purpose. These have finished grilling.
Yeah, eat up, eat up! There isn’t much meat, but Kanata caught plenty of seafood for us, so we have an abundance of them! Takamine also asked his home to bring over vegetables! This is one luxurious barbeque! ☆
Here, I’ll give you eggplants! Eat eggplants! They’re cooked nicely! I dislike them, so I’d rather you eat them! Uuu, just looking at them gives me chills!
You won’t grow strong if you’re picky with food, ermm… Morisawa-senpai?
Yeah, I’m aware of that, but… Eggplants are the one thing I can’t stand no matter what. At this point, I can only assume something must have happened in a past life.
…Hold it, Nagumo! You’ll hurt yourself with the fire, so don’t get near it.
Uu~ Lookin’ at fire gets me in a weird mood! I wanna do it too… I’ll swap turns to grill the meat, so please go ahead and take your turn to eat… Ermm, Otogari-senpai?
Mm. I’m hungry too, so I’d greatly appreciate it if you could swap places with me. While I’m at it, I’ll bring over food for Hakaze-senpai as well, who’s being hung from the pirate ship’s mast as punishment.
Ossu! Great work out there! Aaaighty, time to grill this place up~♪
Stop at once, Nagumo! I’ve told you several times that you should never handle fire! We’ll only have a fire disaster! I’ll do it instead, so leave it all to me! I’m Ryusei Red, and red means flames! You understand, don’t you?
Ehh~… Well, that’s fine too, but at least let me help ya! ♪
Heeey, Sengoku-kun! Midori-kun, Anego, and the others too! (waves) Let’s all eat food together~ Today’s meal will give us energy for tomorrow…☆
Chapter 2 Hakaze-senpai, are you alive? Here’s meat. There’s fish, as well.
yaaay, fish~♪ is there soy sauce? (sways left and right)
I’ve seasoned the food while grilling, but any other seasoning is up to the person. I see that you’re very close to Hakaze-senpai, ermm, Shinkai-senpai? Ah, if I recall correctly, the two of you are in the Marine Life Club, correct?
yes~ are you also interested in [sea creatures]? (sways left and right)
Sea creatures can grow endlessly big, so I am a little interested to know the secrets behind that, but… You see, my friend is also part of the Marine Life Club. I hear a lot of stories from him, so that is how I know, that’s all.
ahh, [souma], yes? thank you for [taking care] of him…♪
And you, as well. Thank you for taking care of Kanzaki and Hakaze-senpai.
Heey~ You enigma boys, could you quit chatting with each other and spare some mercy~? Let me down from the mast already, I’ve reflected on myself by now, really~
Being tied up with ropes is just going to leave marks on me… People will get the wrong idea and think I have weird tastes, and I seriously don’t wanna be tied up by anyone, y’know~?
Shaddap! You need to reflect on yourself a li’l! Hey, Adonis, you don’t have to feed this guy any food, got it!? Gimme that plate! I’m starvin’ out here!
Oogami, it’s bad manners to snatch someone else’s food.
Shut it! Just hand it over! Do it already, I don’t have the patience for this!
Hey, Vampire Bastard~? Adonis brought over meat, so quit bein’ so down and eat! Get your nutrients and build up stamina to prepare yourself for tomorrow’s live show!
Ooh, Doggie. Why thank you, I shall gladly eat this…♪
Hm. So you wanted to give Sakuma-senpai something to eat. You’re kind, Oogami. This won’t be enough for two people, so I’ll bring extra.
Hah! UNDEAD doesn’t have enough firepower when this guy isn’t at full energy! And this time he was only useful after the sun set! So eat up and sleep well so we can perform together from the very damn start!
The live show today ended up with us beaten to the ground by Ryuseitai of all units, man!
Well, there was no helping that. We were much more dishevelled compared to Ryuseitai, after all.
You bastard~ Whose fault do you think that is, huh? I’ve got no interest in losin’ over and over again! Hakaze-senpai, you better take things seriously tomorrow, too!
Yes, yes, as you wish~…♪
Fufu. You’re being chewed out, aren’t you, Kaoru-kun. However, reflecting on yourself is necessary as well. It would do you good to try racking your brain over something other than love sometimes…♪
Mm~ I don’t wanna pour my all into something other than girls, though. I don’t even know how to act towards guys, let alone juniors, so~? I can’t believe you two manage it just fine, Sakuma-san, Kanata-kun~
Kukuku. We, the Three Eccentrics, are simply doing what we wish our former seniors had done for us… It’s simply a means of compensation. I don’t think it is anything worthy of praise, is it?
[juniors] are cute too, you know? kaoru, join us in getting along with them~♪ (sways left and right)
Ryuseitai’s full of good boys, after all~ Meanwhile, our unit just has stupid brats…? I mean, did I really do something so wrong to deserve this punishment? We may be members of the same unit, but idols are all about kicking each other down, no?
but we are no longer in an [era] like that, so… if you do not reflect on yourself, i will [chop] you~♪
Wawah—? Kanata-kun’s hand-chops seriously hurt, so spare me, ‘kay~? I’ve reflected on myself by now, really, really~♪
Chapter 3 Uu… In the end, I got hit in the face by Koga-kun, even though I’m against violence~ I’m just gonna freak out all the girls with my face puffed up like this! I can’t even hit on them… Even though we’re at the beach of all places!
Shut up. We have a live show tomorrow too. Pirate Festival is an overnight stay job, and we’ll be performin’ for a couple’a days… So you just gotta get rida the swellin’ before you get up on stage. Hey, Adonis, get some ice. The swelling’ll go down if he cools it down.
You’re overworking me, Oogami. …But, well, this is necessary. We will win tomorrow. We’ll use everything to grow stronger, even our losses… We’ll grow day by day, and become bigger than everyone.
Mm, that’s wonderful. I will also do my best not to collapse tomorrow. Ahh, I feel young again, after so long… My friend also expressed his gratitude for everything, since Pirate Festival brought over a full house~♪
It sound like the sales at my friend’s beach house were through the roof. It seems that Pirate Festival has become the talk of the town, so we should have more guests tomorrow.
If we perform another sloppy live show like today, it will bring disgrace to UNDEAD’s reputation, understood? Young Lady Anzu has provided us with a future, a course of action… So let us plunge forward with the sails fluttering ahead.
Awaiting us all is a grand adventure brimming with hardships, and treasure full of gold riches~♪ Let us scrape up every dream out there… And with the Polaris star as our guide, we head forth toward new land — O fellow companions of mine, O beloved arch-enemies of mine.
yes. the [sea] is vast and big, after all. the [earth] is round no matter where you go~ (sways left and right) so we can have a [grand adventure] for as long as we like~♪
Kukuku. You look elated, Shinkai-kun.
yes. [rei] and [wataru] as well, you two have such [wonderful smiles] these days~♪ is it all thanks to anzu-san? (sways left and right)
Indeed, it is as if we have the goddess statue at the bow of our ship. She blesses and guides our sails. We must show our gratitude to her, for she is a young lady akin to a miracle…♪
We must stay beside that Young Lady. She may be able to restore the youth we wasted away in a worthless battle… Although, I can only hope “those two” return soon enough.1
But I suppose it’s alright. If the Five Eccentrics come together again, it may complicate matters… And right now, my fellow companions differ from back then. This place of belonging is where I choose to be content and set as my final resting home.
Oi! Not that I care, but you’ve barely eaten anythin’! You better eat a full meal. Just how incompetent are ya? What, you need someone to be your caregiver or somethin’, ahhn?
Do not rush me, Doggie. I am having my fill of this moment, slowly, at my own pace… Can’t you tell?
Ahh, this year’s summer may turn out to be much hotter than usual. In more ways than one…♪ I feel like I might dry up from the very heat. I do not even have the appetite for food, though strangely enough, I am in a comfortably pleasant mood…♪
Even though the sun has already set, there is radiance overflowing akin to the sun, centered around Young Lady Anzu… I feel myself this close to being reduced to ashes… It is simply far too dazzling for a feeble old man like me, you know?
Everything is glittering so bright… This season is truly unkind to vampires, good grief. ♪

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Navy
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
Akira
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Translation Notes Chapter 1
Warning: Suicide mention in this chapter.
Season: Yumenosaki Era, Summer
Location: Navy Stage
Fuooohh~!! A-At long last, Pirate Festival is about to begin~! I’m so nervous~! No matter how much time passes, I’m still not accustomed to the atmosphere just before a live show starts! I’m shaking in my boots~! No, in my ninja tabi! Auh, auh~?
You okay, Sengoku-kun…? Do you want to smell some herbs that help calm your nerves…?
Midori-kun, you sometimes pull out plants from another dimension, don’t you? Like vegetables!1 How do you do that? That’s Midori-kun’s ninja skill…☆
I’m not a ninja, though… But I get nervous too, so it’s for my own use, I guess…?
Ahaha, but I am very happy that you’re being thoughtful of me! ♪ We take on a lot of odd jobs in Ryuseitai, but this Pirate Festival is the first time in a while that we perform a job that is actually typical of an idol! There are so many guests, too! We must fire ourselves up for this occasion! We, Ryuseitai, are capable of anything as long as we assemble together as five!
Fufufu. Midori-kun always says “I’m depressed” and “I want to die”, yet is remaining calm and preparing himself for the performance… So I cannot allow myself to cower in fear! I shall do my best~♪
Yeah… Don’t worry, I’ll make sure to die before the performance starts…♪
Huhhh!? Why are you tying a rope around your neck!? So it isn’t that you were calm, you were simply reaching a state of enlightenment after preparing yourself to die!? H-Hey, Tetora-kun! We need to stop Midori-kun from killing himself! I am physically incapable of doing it on my own! This is an urgent mission…!
…………
Ossu. I’m done meditating. You two~ Our guests have arrived. You shouldn’t make a ruckus onstage, ‘kay? There’s no place for us to run or hide now.
T-Tetora-kun’s so calm…? How impressive! So cool…☆ He is a first-year student just like us, yet we’re so spineless in comparison…!
Uu… I’m sorry… I’m so sorry for chickening out…
Ahaha. I’m nervous too, though. Our two seniors are late to join us, after all… It just bein’ the three of us first years feels nerve-wracking. Where are they, and what the heck are they doin’~ Those two troublesome seniors of ours? But this is just like a karate match! You lose if you get weak-kneed!
That’s why — focus, effort, guts! Anything’s possible as long as we have guts! Ossu! ☆
Ooh, he is sort of acting like Taichou-dono right now… You’re so reliable, Tetora-kun! ♪
I don’t want Tetora-kun to become a pervert like Morisawa-senpai… Stay the way you are forever, okay…?
Well… I was told that whenever the third-year members aren’t around, I should act as the temporary leader, so~? I’m Ryusei Black, so Red—… Taichou’s not someone I can become, but…
At the very least, ‘til Taichou and Shinkai-senpai are back, I hope to grit my teeth and fight ‘til the very end! I believe in ‘em! I just know that if we stand our ground, our seniors will come rushing back to us! And so, let’s fire ourselves up! Midori-kun, that rope is part of the stage set, so you can’t touch it, ‘kay~?
Uu… You’ve become way too reliable now, Tetora-kun…
He’s a first-year student like we are, but I feel a gap between us~ We must devote ourselves to our training too, Midori-kun! ♪
Uu… But it’s scary, I don’t wanna… I wanna run away… H-Huh?
What’s up, Midori-kun? If you need the toilet, you gotta go fast~ ‘Cuz Pirate Festival is for real ‘bout to start soon!
No… I think I saw some kind of yuru-chara walking around selling drinks and uchiwa to the guests…?2
Hrmm? Ahh, that’s Anzu-dono! She’s in a mascot costume~ She’s working so hard under the scorching sun, truly incredible! ♪ I only hope she does not collapse from heatstroke, though…?
It looks like the two Knights members are also helping out with sales and linin’ up the guests…? Even though they’re idols, too~ They’re doin’ the back-end work, huh…♪
Ossu! We aren’t all on our own! There are people supporting and cheering for us! So let’s show our guts and deliver the best sta— Er, where are you goin’, Midori-kun!?
Anzu-senpai…! W-Who is this character!? Ohh, it’s the mascot character for the beach house, the one that UNDEAD is helping out…? You’re using it to promote the beach house after making it an authorized character for Pirate Festival…?
Ahh, this is repayment for allowing UNDEAD to participate in Pirate Festival, huh…? You’re really good at negotiations and plan adjustments, Senpai… Or maybe not that good, considering you’re being made to sell stuff in a mascot costume in the middle of summer…?
Um, no, it’s adorable! It’s the absolute best! Anzu-senpai is the cutest in the whole universe…☆ Uwaah, uwaaahh…♪ The way it looks like it’d barely get popular, the way its design looks so sloppy!
It’s healing me~ I feel myself thinking, “Ahh, it’s okay for me to be alive, too”!
Chapter 2
Wowow, this is amazing, the absolute best! Ahh, it’s totally a yuru-chara no matter which angle I look at it from…! ☆3 W-What’s its name? Huh, “Captain Kidoairaku”?4 I don’t get it at all! That has nothing to do with a beach house!
It’s like they forced in a parody of the legendary pirate, Captain Kidd…♪5
Midori-kuuun~? You need to come back to the stage, so enough hugging the yuru-chara, okay?
Also, you shouldn’t get in the way of Anego’s work, y’know~?6
“Anego”… I-I’m so sorry, Anzu-senpai… Pirate Festival is about to start, so I sadly have to go now, okay? Please do your best with your work!
I’ll also do my best. I’ll pour all my efforts, at least every once in a while. That’s why… After Pirate Festival is over, please go on a date with me.
Ehhhh!? What are you saying with such a serious expression!? I don’t understand, it’s simply impossible for a ninja like myself to understand Midori-kun~!
Ahhh, he got a head-start! I mean… Ermm, um, we’re in public! We’re in the eyes of our guests, y’know!? Don’t forget that Anzu-san is everyone’s producer!
Ahh, right, the person inside is Anzu-senpai… No! There’s no “person inside”! Please, go on a date with me while wearing the costume! If anything, it’ll only upset me if you take it off…!
Midori-kun, Midori-kun! Anzu-dono is struggling to respond to that, can’t you see~? For now, let’s return to the stage already~! Mm-nininini! W-What incredible power…!
He isn’t budging one bit when it’s me pushing him alone! Help me out here, Tetora-kun!
Midori-kun, spare us from any weird behavior! Our seniors are already goin’ over the capacity of what’s acceptable — if you also stray off from what’s common sense, Ryuseitai will just turn into a Super Weirdo Group, y’know~!?
Ugh, sorry, stay quiet for a second. Anzu-san is saying something…? Her voice is muffled through the costume, so I can’t really hear well…? Hm… You’ll do anything for me later, even go on a date, so you just want me to do my best in Pirate Festival for now…?
Got it! I’ll do my best with that reward in mind! ♪ I’ll put my all into this! Please watch me — No! Please cheer for me, “Captain Kidoairaku”! I dedicate this performance to you…☆
You should also dedicate it to other people outside of yuru-chara if possible, okay~? C’mon, just hurry back to the stage already! The first part of the song is startin’!
Ahaha. Perhaps we should have Anzu-dono wear a mascot costume for our live shows moving forward? It’s the first time I ever see Midori-kun so full of motivation~♪ And as for me, all this clamor has loosened my nerves enough to feel calm! Aaalright, let’s do this, nin-nin! We shall sail through Pirate Festival’s first part, “Navy”, safe and sound~!
Ossu! We’ll deliver the best performance we can, enough to fill in for our seniors’ spots and more! I’m sure our seniors are watchin’ over us from somewhere…☆
Yeah, exactly! Nagumo, Takamine, Sengoku! I’m so moved! By your determined spirits! That’s exactly what makes you the Ryuseitai warriors that I personally saw promise in…☆
Huhhh!? Us first years were finally prepared to take on this stage on our own, but he showed up just fine~! This guy seriously can’t read the room, can he!?
Fuhahaha! That’s a compliment! Justice involves not reading the room at times, after all…☆ Anyway! I’m sorry we’re late, you guys! There’s no need to worry now, theeere, there! ☆ We couldn’t meet up with the UNDEAD members, and we couldn’t have a proper briefing either, as it appears there’s some sort of quarrel!
I really struggled with the negotiations and a lot of other things, y’know~? And Kanata jumped into the sea for some reason, so searching for him took a lot out of me!
i am sorry, chiaki. but i just really [love] the sea…♪ (sways left and right)
Mm! It’s good to have things you love! But I’d like it if you could be on the same page as us every once in a while! I’m not one to say this, but — Kanata’s really is such a troublesome one~♪
fufufu… look, over here, everyone~ our [friends] from the sea have come to [watch] our [live show]~♪
Mm! Those slimy-feeling friends would only get in the way of our performance, and some people may find it unpleasant, so please take them back to the ocean!
Uuu! I don’t really like these kinds, they’re so slimy and glossy!
eh~…?
In any case! The five of us together are Ryuseitai! Gather around, everyone! Let’s join forces and liven up this Pirate Festival! ☆ Don’t worry! It’s true we barely got to do a briefing or practice, but—! As long as each unit displays their unique capabilities, Pirate Festival will surely end in a massive success! That’s what I believe in!
Fufu. As always, this guy only ever talks with energy and nothin’ else, but… Strangely, I feel a sense of relief just by havin’ Taichou around. Aaaight, I’ll also enjoy this as much as I like! But let’s start with returning to the stage, ‘kay, Midori-kun? Quit huggin’ Anego already!
Uu… Senpai, please don’t forget our promise, okay? Please watch over me, I’m also pouring my all for once~♪
Yippie~! This is getting so much fun now~♪ Mmm~!! It feels good to bathe in the sunlight every once in a while! Ninjas are destined to live in the shadows and die within it, however!
Ohh, you’re as nimble as ever, Sengoku! I want to do that too! I’d love to try gliding through with the rope, like woosh~! It looks like what you’d see in a wire work action scene, and it’s so similar to what you’d see heroes do! ☆7
Ahaha. It would be difficult to accomplish this without consistent training~ And the rope might break with Taichou-dono’s weight, you know~?
ryuseitai always turns out [this way] no matter the [live show], doesn’t it…? (sways left and right) jumping, hopping, and playing all about! fufufu…♪ this is so much fun. it is [completely different] from the past. this is happiness… puka, puka~♪
Yep! It’s absolutely wonderful to see everyone smiling! Let’s not fall behind the summery sun and shine bright with all our power, too…☆ Pull up the anchor! Ready the sail! It’s time to embark on our journey, my Ryuseitai comrades!
We’ll be the ones to protect the peace of the sea! ☆
Chapter 3 (Hm. I think our song performance was smooth sailing for the most part…?)
(Aaalright, we’re doing great! It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that Pirate Festival’s first part, “Navy”, is a massive success!) (The audience is responding superbly, as well. It looks like Anzu is exerting herself wonderfully! The two members from Knights are also helping her out, though I’m not sure the reason they’re doing so.) (Even that warped Sena is helping out, huh…?)
(Fuhaha! Our producer’s so popular! ☆) (Pirate Festival is an event outside the school’s doors, so the typical way Yumenosaki operates wouldn’t have worked out here… That’s why I was a little worried at first.) (But Anzu was an ordinary person before coming to this school. So on the contrary, maybe she was able to avoid being fixed to Yumenosaki’s common practices, and flexibly adapt to the situation?)
(I can see that you got to make great use of your special traits, Anzu! ♪) (This is a live show on a regular beach, so we have to avoid bothering the visitors unrelated to our event.) (Audio and noise have to be kept in mind, as well. She must’ve worked hard to prepare everything, huh?)
(Wonderful job, Anzu! I’ll make sure to hug you lots later! No, I’ll shower you with praise! It’s thanks to you that we’re all having a blast…☆)
~♪
(Ohh, it’s unusual to see Takamine so motivated! He really is a boy who can do it if he tries! I just knew he had it in him!) (That’s a good look on his face — the look of a man determined to fight! So you could smile like that too, huh! ☆)
Ahh, oops… My apologies for stepping on you, Tetora-kun! I’m not entirely accustomed to rope work…! I still find heights a little frightening~!
Ossu! Don’t worry ‘bout it, I’ve trained my lower body! Anyway, we’re in the middle of the performance, so no talking! You’re shinin’ bright, Sengoku-kun~☆
Ahaha, a ninja shining bright of all things…♪
(Mhm, mhm, Sengoku and Nagumo are also displaying their own incredible traits!) (How absolutely wonderful! These are the youngsters that will carry on the future of Ryuseitai! I’m so happy, you guys! I love you all…☆)
ahaha~♪ (sways left and right) until we reach the [end] of the [horizon]~ everyone [together]~♪ will puka, puka…♪
(Mhm, and Kanata is Kanata! He seems to be ignoring the choreography and tune and instead moving around at his own pace, yet somehow, he’s harmonizing with everyone just fine!) (In fact, he’s backing up the rest perfectly!)
(Just what you’d expect from Shinkai Kanata of the Three Eccentrics! His fundamental abilities are truly remarkable, huh?) (If he could just learn to be more cooperative, he’d become the best idol out there, y’know…?)
(That being said, when Kanata sings, various sea animals gather around the stage at random… Woah—! Was that a dolphin?) (It’s spinning in a circle…! It’s like an aquarium show in a way…?)
chiaki~ your eyes are [darting about]~ let’s [focus], shall we? come on! our [friends] from the [sea] are also [cheering] for us~♪
Y-Yeah! It’s more like they emerged from another dimension rather than the sea, and I feel like there’s a few creatures I’ve never seen before swarming about, but!
I’ll pretend I didn’t see anything! I’ll just look to my front…☆ (Well, the event is called Pirate Festival — so there’s no point in only us, the “Navy” group, standing out, is there~?) (UNDEAD are acting as the “Pirates”, but I wonder if they’re doing alright…?) (They may look like outlaws, but they’re still people who properly do their job! I’ll believe in my fellow Yumenosaki companions!)
(Our future is shaped through the power of trust! Fuhahaha! ☆)
Umm, Morisawa-senpai, haven’t we gone past the time scheduled for the first part…? Won’t we get scolded if we don’t immediately leave the stage…?
I got really into it for once, so I’m exhausted, y’know…?
Yeah! You did wonderful today, Takamine! Theeere, there~♪ (pats head) Once the guys at UNDEAD show up, we’ll withdraw immediately! We have to stall for time until they’ve finished preparing themselves! One for all, all for one! That’s what justice is all about! That’s what love is all about! No, that’s what Ryuseitai is all about…☆
Ahaha, sorry, but I’m cancelling all love from filthy guys~♪
Ohh, UNDEAD! You’re late! Fuhaha, we got tired of waiting for you! ♪
Sorry, sorry. Our stupid brats just wouldn’t stop complaining~? Ryuseitai has it so nice with such obedient juniors~♪
Yeah, these juniors are my pride and joy! ☆ You have it rough — or rather, the whole of UNDEAD does, huh? Hang in there! You’ve got this! Human relations need you to throw yourself at them! There’s no other way but to clash with each other face-front!
Huh, is that so~ Is that how you see it…? Ryuseitai really is so suffocating, huh~♪
