Translation Notes ↑ Midori does this in other stories too, like Biblio.↑ Uchiwa fans look like this, idol fans often customize their own uchiwa to bring to idol concerts, adding their a picture of their favorite idol’s face or putting words like “make a peace sign”, etc.↑ Yuru-chara; yuru meaning “loose,” “laid-back,” + the word “character”. yuru-chara are a type of mascot character, and their defining feature is their peculiar designs, ranging from bizarre-cute to adorkable. They’re well-known for being used all across Japan for PR purposes for companies, prefectures, etc… For more information read here.↑ Kidoairaku (喜怒哀楽) is a 4-character idiom to mean “human emotions”, made up of the kanjis “joy”, “anger”, “sorrow”, “satisfaction”. Also, you can see how Captain Kidoairaka looks through Midori’s Buddy card.↑ Referring to William Kid.↑ Anego means “big sister”. It’s a respectful way to refer to a woman older than the speaker, or to refer to an elder sister.↑ Also known as “wire fu”, it’s when stuntmen or actors utilize wires on their bodies to move around and perform action scenes.

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Pirates
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
Akira
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Ch 4 - Translation Notes Chapter 1
Season: Yumenosaki Era, Summer
Location: Pirates Stage
Aaalright, looks like UNDEAD is all ready to go! We have to hand over the stage to them, so it’s time we switch places! We’re withdrawing, you guys!
Understood, Taichou-dono! The art of escape is a fundamental skill for ninjas~♪
…Urp. I performed a lot of rope work, so I feel a little seasick! My eyes are spinning~!
Your brain’s all shaken up, I’m guessin’. That happens to me when I get struck on my chin. I’ll lend ya my shoulder, so how ‘bout we head out together~?
Ahh, I think it’d be quicker if I just carried him… Up we go~♪
Wawa—! Don’t carry me under your arm, Midori-kun! It’s so embarrassing, as if I’m a little child! This is humiliating~!
kaoru~♪ (waves)
Ohh, Kanata-kun, great work on your side~♪
fufu. please do your best out there, i am [cheering] for you~♪
Thanks. But also, we’re gonna have a live showdown in the third part, so are you sure it’s fine to cheer us on~?
i [dislike] competing~ or rather, i am just not [interested]. i am [satisfied] enough if everyone is [smiling]…♪
Huh… Well, I guess that’s how it’d be for you. But sorry to say this, I’m not holding back, okay~?
i see~ ehehe, then [please] go easy on me…♪ (sways left and right)
Right back at you. I don’t really wanna exhaust myself~ But I don’t wanna lose, either. So the best case scenario is that you guys hold back~♪ But, well, lots of girls in swimsuits are watching today, so I’ll give it my all in my own style~ Sorry, but I’m not letting anyone else stand out! ♪
Alright now, it’s time for the second part of Pirate Festival: “Pirates”! The pirates are us, UNDEAD~ Give us a huge round of applause and lots of cheers as the main leads, okay? ♪
Girls only, of course~♪
UGAAAAAAAHH!!
Woah, Koga-kun, you’re so loud~ Don’t bark so much, okay? You’ll drown out all the girls’ squeals.
SHUT UUUUP!! I’ll friggin’ kill you! Why the hell are we locked up in a cell!? You better not start hoggin’ the damn spotlight, y’hear me~!?1 I was so excited to get the show started, dammit! Get me the hell outta here! I wanna sing already! I had to hold it in all this time and now I get treated like this!? Quit freakin’ messin’ with meeee!!
Hakaze-senpai. I also think this is a little too much. Oogami was really looking forward to singing. And the iron cell bars are hot, so touching them could burn us.
Ahaha, Puppy Dog doesn’t know how to “stay”, huh~ Be a good little boy, won’t you? I’ll give you a beef jerky later~♪
GUAAH! I’ll friggin’ kill you, damn playboy! You’re also someone who’s always pissed me off! Get me outta here! Get me out, god frickin’ dammit! UGAAAAHH! You’re gonna pay for this! I’ll make you one with the sea along with that Vampire Bastard!
Hm, speaking of which… I still haven’t seen Sakuma-senpai anywhere; is he not participating in this live show?
Ahh, did I not mention this? Basically, Sakuma-san’s weak to sunlight, right? He’d just collapse if he performs under the direct sunlight, so… For this live show, he’s benchwarming, I guess you could say…?
He has a separate role to do~ Well, just look forward to it, m’kay? Like obedient little kids~♪ Good boy, good boy~…
Woah—!? That was close… Don’t try to bite me! You’re not trained at all, are you~?
GRRRR!! I’ll put ya to your death! I’ll make sure to kill ya even after you’re dead~!
Quit it already~ Sakuma-san’s benchwarming, so it’s on me now to lead Pirate Festival as a substitute. That’s why I’m the captain of all you pirates~♪ Going against the captain of the ship will have you thrown into the sea, ‘kay~?
Ahhn, you’re the captain!? As if I’ll accept that! UNDEAD ain’t some cozy ‘n chummy place like Ryuseitai, aight!? We abide by the law of the jungle where the strong eat the weak meat!
Meat? Are we talking about meat?
Zip it, Adonis! It’ll only complicate things! Hey, Hakaze…senpai, you asshole! By lockin’ us in here, you’re hopin’ to get all the spotlight and have all the swimsuit girls squeal at you, aren’t ya!? Is that all ya can ever think about!? You perpetually-in-heat bastard!
Messin’ with people of your own flock puts you even lower than a dog! I’ll never forgive ya! Did that Vampire Bastard ever approve of this!?
So loud… Look, I’m sorry for this, but stop talking in human language, ‘kay? This scene’s meant to be where I, the mighty pirate, just captured the “Fierce Beast, Koga-kun” and “Rare Beast, Adonis-kun” from a mysterious island~♪
You’re just makin’ up anythin’ for us, arent’cha!? You’re really pissin’ me off…! I’ll make you pay for this…!
(Mmh~… I stayed quiet as I couldn’t fully grasp what’s happening, but I have a feeling this is going down a bad path.) (No matter how sturdy this ship is, it will get overturned at this rate.) (After seeing Ryuseitai’s live show full of solidarity, us being at odds—… No, our freewheeling manner itself is too transparent.)
(Showing such a disgraceful sight would only confuse the audience. Our reputation as UNDEAD would decline… is what I conclude.) (We’re only able to participate in this Pirate Festival after asking for a massive favor, as this was meant to only be Ryuseitai’s live show at first.) (We can’t cause trouble to Anzu and Ryuseitai.)
(The live show has already begun, and we’ll only give a bad impression by yelling and fighting onstage…) (If Sakuma-senpai was here, he would have handled control over both Oogami and Hakaze-senpai…)
(But he doesn’t seem to be here. There’s no choice now, I should put some effort to break through this situation.) (I’m not very good at taking action, but it’s a bad trait of mine to be overly passive.)
(Oogami was extremely excited for the Pirate Festival, his eyes sparkling by the thought…) (It’s likely impossible for us to get along in peace like Ryuseitai. I have no choice but to do this through UNDEAD’s style.)
(You said “the strong eat the weak meat,” didn’t you, Oogami? I think so, too. That’s what UNDEAD is all about.)
Chapter 2
“What is happening here? You’re far too noisy with the yelling… Yawns ♪” “You’re disturbing my beauty sleep, good grief.”
Whoa, that surprised me—!! Gah, Vampire Bastard~! Where the hell did ya go off to!? Actually, where are ya even talkin’ to us from? I hear your voice, but I can’t see ya~…?
“From above, right above. The sail part of this pirate ship-replica stage is in fact a screen, and one can display footage through it…♪” (waves)
“I cannot efficiently perform my activities during the day time, after all. I even collapsed from heatstroke, so I will now be participating through this screen, instead of pushing myself.” “These sorts of situations occur in television programs and idol stages and the like, no? They call it a ‘friend appearance’.” “The sun will set in due time, so rest assured that I will be joining the live show then. ♪”
Aight… Hey, wait, why’re ya givin’ off such a nonchalant vibe like you’re on a vacation in a cool place, huh? We’re sweatin’ our asses off under the hellish burnin’ sun here! You think you’re so lucky, ahhn!?
“Don’t snap at me, you’re a good boy, aren’t you? There was actually a possibility that I wouldn’t even be able to participate due to bad health…” “Young Lady Anzu was kind enough to provide me an opportunity to show myself, you know?”
“I would like to repay such kindness. What do you say we turn this Pirate Festival into a success… hm?” “In terms of the setting, I am the ship’s captain, commanding all you pirates—” “But through a blunder, I was captured by the navy squad, and I am now on the brink of being executed, you see.”
“Thus, you are my courageous fellowmen who will battle against the navy in order to rescue poor old me. That sort of flavoring is what we are going with, so off you go with your duties. ♪”
Aight then… Yeah, I’mma grab you by the back of your neck and get you up on this stage no matter what! So wash that neck as you wait!2 I don’t really care if you end up gettin’ executed before that, though!
“Mm. By the way, I am currently in Yumenosaki Academy’s infirmary. The academy is close to the beach you are at, so I had Chiaki-kun carry me.” “It’s cool and refreshing here with the air conditioner, such divine heaven…♪”
“I apologize for making you feel so lonely, Doggie.3 I’ll be sure to pamper you a lot later on, so hold it in for now…♪”
GUAAH!! Everything’s pissin’ me off! I don’t even know what to get annoyed at anymore, man~!?
“You have quite the energy, Doggie… I’m not entirely sure what is happening there, but I have left it in Kaoru-kun’s hands for now.”
“So I suggest that you abide by that, yawns ♪” “Forgive me, I no longer have the energy… I shall sleep for now.”
“I recorded my dancing and singing in advance, so I shall end the talk here and play that footage now~♪”
Ah, hold it right there! Throw a complaint at Hakaze…senpai, dude! He had us both locked in a cell for some reason!
“I would not know about that; why is that even happening…? Kaoru-kun, would you mind doing me a favor and not be so mean to them?” “Although, I assume you have something up your sleeve, no~?”
Mhm, mhm, exaa~ctly that! Leave this to me~ Good night for now, Sakuma-san~♪ (waves)
“Mm, good night… Well then, best of luck out there. Sleepy, sleepy~♪”
Aghh, he turned off his screen! That bastard, he’s seriously just gonna sleep and leave us all locked in here~!
Ooh? Looks like Sakuma-san’s dancing and singing is playing now, which means the song has started~ Let’s switch gears and head off! No more chatting! Now then, let’s enjoy this live show~♪
Alright, your attention, everyone! I’ve kept all you guests waiting, haven’t I~? I, Hakaze Kaoru, will lead you through the best cruise ever~♪ Instead of your cheers and claps, send over all your feelings of love! My adorable Little Mermaid princess-chans…♪4
SHIIIT~! That bastard! Gettin’ all ahead of himself! The hell you mean by “Little Mermaid princess-chans”, so gross! Wait, hold on, are you seriously gonna start the show all on your own!?
Get me out, get me out! Get me the hell outta here! I’m a proud wolf, dammit! You can’t just lock me in a cell! GAAAAHH!!
Calm down, Oogami. Don’t kick the cell, you’ll only hurt your foot. We’re going to dance soon, right? Keep your energy and strength for then. There’s no need to exhaust yourself pointlessly. You’ll only wear out in this heat.
Ahhn? Why’re you so calm, Adonis!? Aren’t you even a li’l bit frustrated!? We’re not gonna get a chance to perform at this rate, y’know!?
Don’t worry, Oogami. I’ll do something about this. I’ll tear off both the cells and chains. I won’t let anything come in the way of our freedom.
The hell you on abou… Woah!?
Fnnhh…! Nghhh…!!
Oooh!? What’re you doing!? Don’t tell me you’re gonna bend the iron bars…!?
I am. The iron bars softened up after absorbing so much heat. Bending them is possible.
No, no, no way it is! It’s impossible through a human’s strength alone! That’s why prisons use cell bars, yeah? Even if it’s you with your gorilla-like insane strength, there’s just no way…?
Please stand aside, Hakaze-senpai. I don’t have the capacity to adjust my strength right now. I’m going all out. I’ve grown stronger. I’m no longer a weak being incapable of anything. This cell is too cramped. I’m sorry, but I’ll be breaking out of it.
What’re you sayi— W-Wait, eh!? Are you seriously going to break the cell!?
Chapter 3
When I was young, I was always trapped in a cell just like this one. Confined by my terrifying elder sisters, I was pushed to work like a slave.
But I have grown strong. And I have become strong enough to protect “oppressed beings,” similar to how I once was.5 I will defend myself… and I will make sure to support and protect Oogami and Anzu. I will be the one to protect weak beings.
Adonis, you’re so…♪
…Hold on! I almost let that slide, but you…! Don’t you dare lump me in with the “weak beings” group, y’hear me~!? You’re only one step above me in our body builds and nothin’ else! I’m always ready to go for a fight! You’re nothin’ but Adonis, so come at me right now! Hey, hey, don’t you freakin’ dare look down on me, m’kay!?
I’m sorry. I don’t bully weak beings on principle.
UGAAAAH!! You can really hit a nerve sometimes! Is UNDEAD just full’a people who piss me off, huh!?
If that caused you discomfort, I apologize. Please stay quiet for a moment, I can’t focus.
Hnh— Nhhaaaaaaa…!!
Uhyaa!? H-He seriously bent the iron bars! No, no, how is that even possible!? Youngsters are seriously so reckless~… Mm~ The cell is part of the stage’s set, so…? It may look like typical iron bars, but maybe it’s made of plastic or wood painted in black?
Ahh, jeez… You didn’t have to worry so much, I was going to let you out when the third part of Pirate Festival starts, y’know~? I was going to have you build up frustration in the second part, so that you can explode it all in the third part… While Sakuma-san isn’t around, this plan would’ve been our only chance to win against Ryuseitai with just the three of us, yeah?
That’s exactly why I hardened my heart to act all cold-hearted and everything~ But now you’re making it all go to waste, jeez!
That’s only an excuse, isn’t it, Hakaze-senpai?
My elder sisters would also push unreasonable things on me by saying that it’s “for Ado-chan’s sake”… But I will never let myself get tricked by such exploitable excuses ever again. I will carve out my own path. …Oogami, stand back; I’ll break open your cell, too.
Fnnhh…!
O-Ohh! Awesome, you’re a big help, Adonis! You’re a pretty good guy, arent’cha! Let’s beat the hell outta that lady-killer and throw him out to the sea, you and me~♪
Wai— Time out, time out… Don’t get so heated up, okay~ It was juuust a little joke~♪
You think you can get away with callin’ this a joke, idiot!? Shut the hell up! Awwright, the iron bars are bendin’ open! I can finally get the hell outta here! I can sing! I can perform a live show with all my might…☆
Aaand I’m out! Hya-haa! I’m free after so long! Mmm~ The feelin’ of freedom ☆
Phew, I’m exhausted… I’ll rest for a bit; I’ll leave it to you for now, Oogami.
You got it! You can count on me! This is where Pirate Festival really begins~! Charge forward to the horizon and beyond, Pirate Ship “UNDEAD”! The treasure’s all gonna be mine! Gyahahaha! ☆
Chapter 4
Awwright then, prepare yourself, Hakaze…senpai! It’s time for the juniors to have fun overthrowin’ their seniors~! ♪ We’re still in the middle of the performance, so I’mma let you off with one hard blow for now~! ♪
Wawa, don’t grab me by the collar~! The guests are watching, y’know~? At the very least leave my face alone, seriously! Someone save me — This kid’s eyes look for real~!?
T-This isn’t right! Violence isn’t right! I have to stop them! As an ally of justice! And it would only be a detriment to UNDEAD if they end up with a full-on brawl onstage! In the worst case, they’ll have their activities suspended, and even if that doesn’t happen, their reputation as idols will severely drop…
Ryuseitai, we’re called to action! We have to stop them from doing anything stupid!
Ossu! You can count on me, Taichou! Fighting’s what I’m real good at, and controllin’ the ferocious pirates feels like the type of job a navy’d have! Salute~☆
Try to be as gentle as possible, okay, Nagumo? If we start fighting too, we seriously won’t have any control over the situation anymore…!! Let’s speed up our plans and start the third part: “Navy VS Pirates”! Please play the associated song, Anzu!
We’ll somehow make this all look like it was just part of the performance and nothing else! Otherwise, the live show Anzu planned will only sink like a ship!
And I’m sure nobody would want that! Right!? For the sake of our producer — No! For the sake of justice! We’ll restore love and peace back to the Pirate Festival stage!
yaaay, come on over, all you lovely [dolphins]~ let’s sing together~♪ (sways left and right)
You don’t have to call over unnecessary extras… Ahh, the stage is getting so chaotic… I don’t like crowds… But Captain Kidoairaku is cheering for me, so…?
Mnh~ Performing a live show in succession without rest is draining~ I have to build more stamina after all…!
Mmh, it looks like Ryuseitai is trespassing on our stage. Hakaze-senpai, Oogami… Let’s stop fighting amongst ourselves and unite for now.
You don’t have to make up, but we won’t have a chance to win in this live showdown unless we band together.
Tch… Fine, punishin’ our dumbass senior comes later! Straighten yourself up! We’re gonna sing! We can’t allow ourselves to lose to Ryuseitai! We’re UNDEAD, dammit!
Yeah, yeah. Jeez~ I’m not a fan of this sorta ruckus, y’know? But it’s hard to be a proper senpai… I’m impressed that Sakuma-san can manage it so well.
You unmanageable boys, be careful not to fall off the ship with all your clattering, okay~?
Duh! Awwright, off to the starboard! It’s time to sail full speed ahead~☆ Haha! ♪ I’mma make sure to stand out so hard, that Vampire Bastard won’t have any place for himself once he’s back! Let’s make this extremely showy…☆
Ooh, that’s Gokaiger!6 So you love those shows too, UNDEAD guy!? Exactly, that’s exactly what comes to mind for pirates! Fuhaha! “It’s the pirated version, though”…☆7
UGAAAAH! Don’t start clingin’ to me, Tokusatsu Nerd! We’re enemies here! Don’t get chubby with me!
Let the pirates and navy come at each other like no tomorrow…☆
“…Oh dear, dear me. ♪” “I only had my eyes off of everyone for a moment, but it has already turned into such an uproar. Young Lady Anzu’s projects always turn out this way… Such a noisy clamor.”
“I cannot sleep like this… Yaa~wns ♪”
Ahhn? You seriously slept!? The sun’s about to set, so get the hell over here already! We can’t get ourselves revved up without you here, dammit!
“Right, right. Wait a moment, Doggie. Adonis-kun and Kaoru-kun, as well…” “This reality before me seems much more exciting than a dream all on my lonesome. ♪ ”
“I cannot allow myself to drift to slumber just yet…♪”

Translation Notes ↑ As a fun note, several scenes here are referenced again 10 years after this event’s release; in UNDEAD’s Fan ThanX Festival, Velvet Ship (which is also based on pirates).↑ Lit. meaning “prepare your neck for the execution” (hence why Koga says it here), but is mainly used as a figure of speech to prepare yourself for something severe.↑ Rei calls Koga wanko, a cute way to refer to a dog.↑ Little Mermaid is ningyo hime (人魚姫), literally “mermaid princess”.↑ For those interested, Adonis in his childhood is shown in SWING NIGHT; his unbloomed CG is also how he looked as a child!↑ Gokaiger is a pirate-themed sentai series. Koga’s line references the catchphrase said by Captain Marvelous (Gokai Red). Fun fact, Kaoru’s VA, Hosogai Kei, plays one of the pirate villains: Basco ta Jolokia!↑ One of Gokaiger’s gimmicks is to transform into previous sentai squads. The villain typically exclaims the name of that sentai squad in surprise, and Gokaiger responds with this one-liner (fitting for the pirate themed sentai squad!). Here is a video of it (first 20 seconds).

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Prologue
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
Akira
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
jiaimidori
Season: Yumenosaki Era, Summer
Location: Beach
Yah-hoooo!! It’s the seaaaaaaa…!! ☆ O Mother Sea! Our mother who protects us living creatures, treats us with love, and raises us fondly! We’ve come to see you! Burning their souls a bright red just like the summer sun, your filial sons are now here! OKAASAAAAAAAN!! GENKI DESUKAAAAAAAA!!1
the seaa~ so vast~♪ so big~♪ i am hooome~☆
………… ……Why’re those two at max energy when it’s this insanely hot? Shinkai-senpai’s always so calm, but even he’s more energetic than usual for some reason.
Ahaha, he must truly love the sea. But who would have thought that all of us in Ryuseitai would get to sleep overnight for a job together!
It is my first time going on a small trip with people I am close to! I am also ecstatic~☆
Ughh, I already wanna die… I didn’t want to be around this goofy bunch until summer break was over…
Man, I thought you wouldn’t even come, Midori-kun! I’m real happy you joined along! Let’s do our best in this job together~☆
Ughh… Morisawa-senpai came to my house early in the morning…2 He kept ringing the doorbell saying, “Takamine! We’re going to the beach! This isn’t the time to be sleeping! Good moooorning~!”…
I figured I’d avoid more trouble in the future if I accompanied him instead of ignoring… Uu, I just wanted to relax in my air-conditioned room for summer break… Morisawa-senpai is so freakishly suffocating that it’s surpassing critical levels… Now he’s yelling “Yah-hoo~!” to the ocean, but I don’t even have the energy to point out how weird that sounds when it’s not on a mountain…3 Shinkai-senpai’s “I’m home” confuses me too… What they’re yelling is just odd in general… The more I think about it, the less it makes sense… I wanna die…
Ahaha, I also feel exhausted already! I do not go outside much during the summer break. I am the indoor type of ninja, after all! ☆
Midori-kun, you do not have to carry my luggage on top of yours if you’re tired, you know~? For you see, this summer, I have been trying to build more stamina through strength training whenever I can!4
You’re tiny, Sengoku-kun, so you don’t have enough physical strength, do you…? I’m pretty used to carrying things thanks to all the greengrocer work, so it’s fine…
Ossu! ☆ It’s great for training! And carrying luggage is the first years’ job! That’s how it goes in sports!5 Fortunately, our seniors didn’t bring any luggage even though we’re sleeping overnight, so we’re having it easy! ♪ Also, this doesn’t really matter much, but…
My Ryuseitai uniform is black, and I feel like it’ll just absorb all the heat! Just imaginin’ it makes me feel super stuffy~! Can’t I be “Ryusei White” in the summer time at least?
Actually, I think I’d want to perform our live show in swimsuits… Ideally, I’d like to be inside somewhere, where it’s nice and cool…
You can do this, you two! First is patience! Second is endurance! Third, fourth, fifth is perseverance! That’s what it means to be a ninja~☆
Just don’t overdo it, guys… I’m worried… If the two of you first years collapse, I’ll end up being the only one to deal with our weird seniors…
You guys! I’m happy to see you getting along, but it’s about time we give our greetings at the job site, so follow me! ♪ Shout as loud as you can from your very gut! Gather all the energy in this world and release it from your mouth! That’s our ultimate finishing move! I call it: Ryusei Cannon…☆
Taichou-dono~ Your bad habit of skipping past the explanation each time is showing! What sort of job are we going to do, exactly?
Ah, I wanna know, too! Actually, I didn’t even think it’d be work at first, so I brought over my swimsuit~♪
Me too! Let’s play a game together with the beach ball! Oh, and I want to try out the ninjutsu art of water-escape~♪6
Everyone’s so energetic about something… Meanwhile, I just wanna bury myself in the sand and die…
Fuhaha, wonderful, wonderful! We should enjoy ourselves to our heart’s content while we have the chance! Relish the beach, relish the summer break! Let’s shine with all our might, enough to rival the summer sun! Fuhahaha…☆ Anyway! Anzu is waiting for us at the job site, so you’ll get the details faster if you ask her! I’m bad at explanations! Don’t think, just feel!
Anzu-dono is there? Did Anzu-dono entrust this job to us?
Mhm! That’s what I heard! She’s such a hard worker even during the summer break! I’m sure she’ll be a wonderful wife to someone! Ha ha ha! ☆
puka, puka…♪ (sways left and right)
…Oh, Kanata, don’t dip in the sea in your clothes. We aren’t in school right now, so the police might get called on you if you behave in a bizarre way, okay?
sea~ so nice and warm~♪ puka, puka…♪ (sways left and right) this is so much fun~ i am so glad i came. …mm?
…………
oh, a drowned body…? no, that is not it. this is… rei, right? rei, why are you floating in the [sea]? that is my [job], you know~?
Is there something wrong, Kanata? If there’s any trouble, you can talk to me about it anytime!
ermm… rei is floating in the [sea] for some reason?
Mm… That guy is from UNDEAD, right? Why is he in the ocean? Er, is he even alive?
no clue. rei always looks like a [corpse], so~…?
Ha ha ha! ☆ I don’t really get it, but okay! For now, let’s pull him out of the ocean!
Helping people is also Ryuseitai’s job! This is looking to be a good omen, huh~? We’re bound to have an exciting summer! Fuhahahaha…! ☆

Translation Notes ↑ “Okaa-san” is mom, “Genki desuka” is “are you doing well?”. For a voiced version of Chiaki yelling this, see Chiaki and Tetora’s group moment in the Fireworks Stream.↑ It’s shown in Morning Practice that Chiaki decides to pick up Midori from home to make sure he joins practice, and it eventually became a habit.↑ Referring to what mountain climbers usually yell to their teammates when they’ve split up on a mountain, to signal that they’re safe and doing okay.↑ As a fun note, Buddy happens sometime after this story. In that story, Shinobu tries to build muscle by helping Midori out.↑ Here, Tetora says taiikukai-kei for “sports”. “Taiikukai-kei” is a word used to describe those who are part of a sports club. taiikukai-kei has a strict hierarchical system, and juniors are expected to take on errands for the team and their superiors.↑ Known as suiton in Japanese, it’s one of the ninja arts of escape. In the case of the water-escape jutsu, the ninja dives into a body of water to infiltrate or hide, and then uses a bamboo as a snorkel. Shinobu has done this before in Air Ride; his CG showcases it!

Translation Please Note: This is a partial translation of the story.
Um… Ever since we met… and you took my hand… All the anxiety and suffocation I felt deep inside started to fade away, bit by bit. And at first, I didn’t get why the world around me was starting to gain color… nor why my life was starting to change every passing day… But I feel like I understand why now. It’s because every day, you would give me something new to ‘love’… with each day being a little more than the last… When we were happy, we’d laugh together; when we were sad, we’d cry together… When things were rough, we’d work it out together, and when we were having fun, you’d hold my hand— It’s through those moments that you gave me something new to ‘love’… That’s why I’ve grown to love myself, just a little bit. I… still don’t fully understand what love is, but… I hope that these feelings deep inside my heart could be called something like that. Even though I would always immediately give up on anything and everything, this was the first time I ever thought to myself that I don’t want to give up on something. You are the only one I don’t ever want to give up on. So, um… Could you please continue to stay by my side, forever? I know I’m still a pathetic, unreliable person… But I truly want to give you all the kindness that I have… That’s why — I will always love you.

entry.title: Sailing Ceremony – Prologue
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
Coming Soon!
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (July)
Three days after the Four Sky Kings’ live show. While having a sneak peek of the idol-oriented Mega Sphere…
Ahahaha! ☆ What is this!? It’s miiindblowi~ng! How’s it floating in the air!? A total mystery! So sci-fi!
Don’t mess about too much, Akehoshi. This is still technically part of our work. We’re in Mega Sphere, where the new program “Mega Stream” will be held. We were invited to have a look around the place in advance. What if you fool around so much that you end up getting lost?
That’s when you come pick me up at the lost child center, Hokke~!
Why would there be a lost child center in Mega Sphere? This isn’t a department store.
Where’s your enthusiasm, jeez~! Anywho, how about we go to the bow of the ship? I just gotta know what’s over there~♪
…Good grief. You’re the same as always even high up in the sky. You do realize an iron mass is floating in the air, right? What if you fall off?
I don’t think that could actually happen, Hidaka-kun~ Plus, seeing an airship this massive is totally going to light up a young boy’s heart!
Look over here, Ukki~! Come to the bow! The view is amazing!
Whoaa, you’re right…!
Now close your eyes…♪ (Holds Makoto from behind)
I’m flying…! (Spreads his arms wide open)
What is this, the Titanic?
Woahwoah, you guys are playing with fire! What if you fall off the ship!? You know we’re high up in the sky, right!?
Ahaha, there’s a thick glass wall, so it’s fiiine! ☆
Yeah, yeah! It’s such a shame that I couldn’t get to feel the wind blowing…!
C’mon, Sally~, c’mon over! Don’t worry! It’s fine to lean against the glass~♪
Quit it! You’ll make my heart stop!
Sigh… You seriously left that sense of fear somewhere, man~ I mean, you jumped off a helicopter onto ES building’s rooftop before.1 You’re so reckless that I’m terrified you’ll get yourself seriously injured one day, y’know?
Exactly. If you get injured by something stupid, you won’t be able to participate in the Mega Stream.
Sally~’s fine, but I don’t wanna be told that by Hokke~, m’kaaay~ You called Mega Sphere an “iron mass” of all things.
Anyway, this, uh, “Mega Phone”? Does anyone know how to use it?
If memory serves me right, that’s the device that works even in higher altitudes where the signal’s bad, right? As I understand it, it’s like a rental smartphone specialized for use in Mega Sphere.
On the other hand, we can’t use our own smartphones here, so that’s inconvenient.
Since we had to travel up here by helicopter, I downloaded a few manga beforehand, but… Phone calls and text messaging seem like a dud.
Although, that being said… “Mega Phone” and “Sphere Ring”, huh… I can barely comprehend what those mean, and it doesn’t really feel real to me.
Like, what the heck do they mean by “Transform”? This isn’t a sentai show.
I bet Chi~chan-senpai’d be happy about that, though.
Ahh, I was wondering what it was vaguely reminding me of… Right, sentais and transformations are specialties exclusive to Morisawa-senpai, yeah?
In reality, it’s just stage production to look like a transformation. Based on what I saw in the Four Sky Kings’ live show, it doesn’t seem like anything changed about their physical ability.2
Well, yeah. That’s why those aspects aren’t as much of a surprise as Mega Sphere itself, or like, I feel as though they’re easier to accept.
Fufu. Mega Phone feels like a cutting-edge type of smartphone, so it’s pretty easy to understand. I’m interested in nerdy gadget stuff, so I’m just itching to try it out.
It might be fun to try disassembling it, too. If I can discover some sort of security hole, I might be able to get hold of top-secret info~♪
Is it just me, or is that “young boy’s heart” getting outta control now?
Well, either way, I don’t get the sense that the general practices we do will work here. The new program doesn’t seem to be about singing and dancing as idols typically would, either. I hope it’s at least something that extends back to our idol jobs, though.
I don’t think we’re going to fight a monster villain out of nowhere, but… What on earth will they make us do here…?
“—Welcome, my friends! Are you enjoying yourselves in Mega Sphere?” “You don’t get to see something like this in your daily life, so I’m sure you’re all awestruck by the Nice view from above!”
Mmh, a video started playing on the Mega Phone…?
I guess this Mega Phone also serves as a tool to relay us info?
Let’s all be a little more quiet, you two. It sounds like NiceP’s gonna talk about something important.
“—Right. It’s time for the main topic.” “To all my friends gathered here with me. Starting today, I’ll have you all live-stream.” “Mega Sphere has just taken off for departure, and we will not be returning back to the ground for a month.” “That is what ‘Mega Stream’ is about: the program that will stream everything there is to do with idols. This is our brand new challenge to face.” “Mega Sphere has all kinds of establishments set up, split into five areas: Residential, Entertainment, Business, Sports, Stage.” “Although, it’s still under development, so only the Residential and Stage areas are complete.” “To begin, I’ve assigned your rooms by unit, so please do use it as you please.” “Nobody told you you’d be staying over? Fufu, I can tell what you’re saying even if I can’t hear any of you.”
“This shouldn’t come as a surprise, really. After all, Mega Stream has already begun.” “My friends, for the duration of a month, you will be living together in Mega Sphere!” “Every single event that occurs here will be recorded and streamed to the whole world—”
“That is the ultimate reality show known as ‘Mega Stream’…☆”
So we’re confined to this place for a month…!?
EHHHHHHHHH…!?
What about all our work starting tomorrow!?

entry.title: Sailing Ceremony – Setting Sail (Partial Translation)
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
ryuseipuka
Chapter Index Context - Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Ch 9 - Translation Notes Context Note: This is a partial translation of the story.
(You can also read the prologue for the context!)
After the idols entered Mega Sphere to check it out, NiceP suddenly announces that they will be working at the Mega Sphere for one month, and cannot leave it until the end of the month.
NiceP then kickstarts the Mega Stream, a month-long program where idols live stream themselves to gain Nice!’s. They are live-streamed 24/7 in public spaces, and they can also start their own live stream on their Mega Phone.
In Mega Sphere, units live in a room together. The unit rooms are not filmed for the live stream for privacy.
Chapter 1
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (July)
Next day, first day of Mega Stream. In the bedroom assigned to Trickstar…
Yaaawns… Mmm… It’s already morning…?
Ah! Ukki~! G’morning!
Oh, finally. We got tired of waiting for ya, y’know~?
We’re all up and ready to go. Yuuki, go wash your face so you can join us.
Mm? Huh? Everyone’s gathered around me… What’s wrong? Didn’t Mega Stream start already? I recall being told that the live-streaming would start this morning…
Mega Stream? What’s that?
Huh!? Was Mega Stream just a dream all along…!?
That’s totally possible, actually! I mean, there’s no way a gigantic structure can float in the sky…! Not to mention all that “Four Sky Kings” and “Transformation” talk! That’s just something you’d hear in a manga or game, right!?
Exactly! It was actually all a huge prank by NiceP…! The Mega Sphere we saw was just a VR world all along!
I-I knew it! They got me good~!
Are you done with the charade, Double Dumb Duo?
You’re so mean, Hidaka-kun! I managed to throw back a dumb boke joke to Akehoshi’s boke while I was still half-awake, y’know!
Yeah! You should at least call us “Mega Idiot Duo”!
I can’t tell what the difference is at all.
You guys sure are having fun, huh~? Well, I guess this is way better than not getting used to this environment.
You went for your daily morning walk, right, Subaru? How’d that go?
I did, but Daikichi isn’t with me, so all I really did was walk around in Mega Sphere on my own~ But this is a special live-streaming project and all, so I thought it wouldn’t be right to just go back to sleep. I walked around the area without really bothering to present a side of me targeted for the stream, and it all got streamed on Mega Stream through and through.
Sorry. We got a late start all because of me… I’ll get myself ready, so if you all want to participate in Mega Stream as soon as possible, you’re free to start without me.
No, I don’t think we need to rush so much. That’s why we waited for you in the first place. We’re dealing with NiceP, the same producer who set up the unprecedented program “4piece”. Who knows what sort of penalty awaits us if we take one wrong move.
Penalty…?
Well, regardless of NiceP’s intentions, we don’t know what could happen here. There’s no point in taking action without any real thought, so we were observing the situation ‘til you woke up, Makoto. Besides, it’s not like you were just sleeping in for no real reason, right? You looked like you were grappling with the Mega Phone all day yesterday. Didja get hold of any new info?
They gave us this device without any real explanation, so it took me a good while to make sense of things, but— After connecting it with the explanation NiceP gave us yesterday, I think I managed to make sense of the overall rules.
In Mega Steam, other than the living space in Mega Sphere— As in, other than “Star House” and the rooms for the staff, every single area is live-streamed 24-hours all throughout.
Star House… I think he said it was a living space for stars to gather in. Did NiceP give it this name?
Ahaha. Personally, I find the name more clear than “living space”. Anyway, there are multiple AI cameras in Mega Sphere that track the Transformation item, so you can’t get away from the live stream no matter where you hide, it seems.
Huh, really? NiceP, you watchin’~? (waves)
……? Huh? I don’t think there are any cameras here…?
Oh yeah, our privacy in Star House is protected — I recall NiceP saying that.
Mhm. It’s really only the rooms each unit was assigned, though.
Whaaat~ You should’ve said so earlier!
Well, there’s a bathroom and a restroom, so it’s only natural it’d be private.
Actually, can we use the public restroom…? My common sense tells me it wouldn’t be live-steamed, but I’m worried now, y’know?
Ahaha. I’m sure we’re good on that one. It’s also written in the rule book found in the Mega Phone.
Rule book? There was something like that?
Yep. I think it should be in everyone’s Mega Phones. Having it all documented like this really screams “USA”, doesn’t it? Y’know, being a contract-based society.
You’re right, there really is a whole text written up here. There’s a lot written in here, so it’s probably a tough job to make sense of it all, but it looks like the text is searchable. Which means that first things first is to have a good grasp of Mega Sphere and Mega Stream’s rules.
Yeah, though I’m sure NiceP told us the most important details yesterday.
Rule number one: Anzu-chan is in charge of the planning and management of Mega Stream. Every day, eventful moments from the 24-hour live stream will be compiled and broadcasted in the “recap show” during prime time TV. Rule number two: Idols who worked hard through live-streaming or have high favorability can obtain high ratings, known as “Nice!”, via the viewers’ phones. And lastly, rule number three— The top six idols who obtained the most “Nice!”s will be chosen for the weekend special, and have a live showdown with the Four Sky Kings.
Why six? We won’t fight four versus four?
Ahaha, NiceP said the Four Sky Kings are way too powerful, so a number difference wouldn’t be a huge hurdle for them. But I’m guessing there’s just some professional constraints to the whole thing… Either way, there’s a special program every weekend in Mega Sphere, and the live stream acts as a way to choose the members for it.
This weekend’s special is “Sailing Ceremony” — A ceremony to celebrate setting sail, huh. So it’s a live showdown suited for sailing of this ship, Mega Sphere.
Well, I suppose they really went all out to prepare for this event.
Ohh~ I don’t really get it, but it sounds fun! ☆
Live-streaming, huh… Feels like a whole other thing separate from how it’s like as an idol.
Yeah, since it looks like our grading changes based on the number of fan votes — as in, the number of high ratings. Up until now, a lot of our matches were decided based on voting during the venue, so our strategies might change quite a bit here.
It’s not that I’ve never live-streamed before, but I never imagined I’d be part of such a large-scale project as this. I’m not entirely sure in what way Anzu is involved with Mega Stream, but all the same, I’m sure she’ll be of help to us.
Mhm, mhm, she’s the “Goddess of Victory”, after all! ♪
Right. Let’s get a good handle of that 24-hour live-streaming, and grab hold of our participation rights for Sailing Ceremony. Yuuki, Isara. You two are aiming for that just as much, right?
Chapter 2
A few minutes later. In front of the Mega Sphere Tower, a facility for live-streaming in Mega Sphere…
24-hour live stream, huh… I think we’re automatically getting streamed just by being here, but… How do we go about making an eventful moment for ourselves?
For entertaining live streams, that’s obviously gotta be the mentos and cola challenge! That’s how you get the cola’s carbon dioxide bubbles to erupt like crazy! I’ve always wanted to try it out! ☆
Yeah, uh, I’m pretty dang sure “mentos cola” as our first idea is way too risky.
Really? I think it’s pretty popular as an idea, though.
I mean, I guess that’s true, but… You sure? We’re idols, not funny streamers, y’know?
Eh~? That’s such a narrow view! Idols want to explode cola too, y’know!
Okay, now it’s really obvious that you just badly wanna do it. Think more seriously about this, man~
Haah… Maybe I shouldn’t have said “eventful moment”…? First we get locked up in a weird place outta nowhere, then they tell us to live-stream and get good ratings in said weird place…
Uuu… I feel like my stomach-ache’s gonna make a return after so long.
Ahaha, all these chats are taking me back to the old days. Back when we were in Yumenosaki, we’d always have fun chatting about random things every day. Maybe we just have to show that relaxed daily life of ours on stream, too? I mean, look! Our conversation just now got us a “Nice!”. It seems like there aren’t that many units out and about right now, so we’re at a stage where just talking outside gets us a “Nice!”.
Hm. So just mentioning our daily life has people’s interest piqued? This reminds me of when Yuuki and I fought each other in a game stream.1 To be honest, I faced an utter loss against Yuuki, as it was a game, but — I understood then that what’s important isn’t your skill in games, but showing who you are to the viewers throughout the stream. I can see how Mega Stream asks for the same.
Ohhh! That means if we just keep throwing dumb boke jokes, our viewers will give us “Nice!” instead of a tsukkomi comeback! ☆
Uh, no? ……Or maybe yes?
Alright then, you join our talk too, Hokuto. I’m gonna be rundown by these two boke at this point, y’know?
Right. I’ll join in as a tsukkomi.
Ahaha. I feel like Hokke~’s also a boke like us, though~
…Mh? What’s that?
What’s up, Hokke~? You leading us in for a comedy? Ah! Did you spot a UFO or something!? Where, where!?
No, it’s not a UFO, but I did catch sight of something as baffling as that.
Something baffling? What’s that about…?
♪~♪~
Huh? Who the heck is that?
Huh!? W-Why’s Anzu-chan and some guy walking around holding hands!?
Is that her boyfriend?
Huh!? You have got to be joking, right…!?
Not faa~ir! So unfair, so unfair! I wanna go on a walk while Anzu pulls me by the hand, too!
Pull you by the hand? Isn’t that a li’l off?
Oh no! Akehoshi-kun’s charging in on those two…!
Anzu-san, let’s go over there next—
Nu-uh! I wanna hold hands with Anzu, too!
So Anzu, you and I will join hands on your left! ☆
O~i… Calm down, Subaru. Anzu looks confused with both of her hands held.
This is just like the Ooka Case.
Ah! The one where the real mother and the fake one fought over who gets to keep the child, right? It’s an old story that’s all about how “the real mother would relax her grip and let go”.2
Ehh!? Then I gotta let go of her hand!
There! I let go! So now I’m Anzu’s real mom!
But you’re not her mom at all, are you!? This sort of thing might also get filmed live, so you have to be more careful with what you’re saying!
U-Ummm…? There’s suddenly so many people around me… Did I mess up somewhere…!? Erm, no, wait… H-Hello there…?
Hello. So, who the heck are you?
I’m Tsuzura Chitose, and I’ve been given the opportunity to be the assistant director of Mega Stream. I’m new to this field of work, but it’s nice to meet you.
Assistant director?
Ah! You don’t have to show respect to me or anything, though…! Sorry. Even though I have this big label on me, I’m just like a handmaid of some sort. I think I’d be happy if you just treated me casually, probably. I dunno…
So basically, you’re one of the staff members for Mega Stream? So thaaat’s what it was! I’m Akehoshi Subaru, from Trickstar!
This Hokke~, Ukki~, and Sally~!
Don’t introduce us through nicknames. You’re convoluting things.
I’m Hidaka Hokuto. I’m the leader of Trickstar. We’ve been on close terms with Anzu since our Yumenosaki Academy days. She’s an irreplaceable person to us, and a close member of our unit.
Ah, mhm. Anzu-san told me about her time in Yumenosaki Academy. She was the first student in the Produce Course, right?
Yep. When she transferred to Yumenosaki Academy, she produced all sorts of idols as the only student in Produce Course. I’m Yuuki Makoto. I’m in charge of intel gathering in Trickstar~♪
And Ukki~’s also got the glasses role!
What do you mean by “glasses role”!? Well, I mean, it’s true that glasses are a part of my identity, though!
C’mon now. Don’t make him try and follow along at a weird pace on our first meeting. Sorry about all that. Trickstar’s full of weird guys, y’see.
Let me introduce myself formally; I’m Isara Mao. Nice to meetcha!
And also a magician! Right, Sally~☆
You just call me that ‘cause of the “Sally~” nickname.3
By the way, I can’t use magic. I’m just a li’l more dexterous than others.
Uwaah…♪ So Trickstar’s an idol unit that can do a comedy bit too, huh? That’s amazing…!
Heh…♪
Why do you look a li’l proud of that… I don’t want that, m’kay? A comedian idol unit just isn’t it!
Ah! This isn’t the time to be all nice and chill! I know a li’l more about Tsucchi~ now, but there’s still the most unforgivable mystery left to unfold!
Why’re you holding hands with Anzu, Tsucchi~!? That’s so unfair!
I-Is “Tsucchi~” about me…? Woow, that makes me so happy, it feels like we’re on good terms. Thank you for the nickname…! Ah, sorry. That’s not the point here, right? Sorry that my thoughts are jumping all over the place. Ermm… I feel super relaxed when I’m holding hands with someone… Like right now, I feel a thump, thump… Ahh, so relaxing…♪
Uh, yeah, that makes no sense.
Huh? He begged you in tears, so you couldn’t refuse him, Anzu…?
Things will turn out awful for me if I make any more mistakes, so…
Hmm…? Even then, it doesn’t have to be Anzu’s hand, does it?
Y-You’re right. It’s weird how I’m getting help from a girl who’s younger than me, right?
I don’t really think that way or anything, but — You’re not the only one who wants to hold hands with Anzu, y’know? Am I right or am I right, Hokke~?
Don’t put this on me. Still, how long do you plan on holding hands with Anzu—
Ah! I just came up with a great idea! While Anzu and I hold hands, I’ll hold Sally~’s hand~ Sally~, hold Ukki~’s hand! Hokke~, you come here too!
Now Tsucchi~ just has to hold Hokke~’s hand, and… Alright, done!
Heh-heh! Now you won’t feel nervous anymore, right, Tsucchi~?
Ehehe, holding hands with everyone really puts me at ease…♪
…Isara, what on earth is happening here?
Beats me. Why are we holding hands and making a circle in the middle of the street?
Thank you, Akehoshi-kun, for doing all this for me…!
Ahaha, you don’t have to overexaggerate so much, Tsucchi~! This is just a friend group coming to life, y’know! ☆
F-Friend group…! Are you sure…? Is it really okay that I join you…?
Mm~… I can tell Tsuzura-san is the same kind of air-headed boke as Hidaka-kun.
Ehehe, I get to have a nickname, and I even get to be part of a friend group… I’m so happy…♪ I’ve learned you all by heart now — Trickstar. I’m glad you were the first people I met… I think…♪
Chapter 3 Soo… Anzu, Tsucchi~, what were the two of you doing here? I don’t feel like this place has anything to film as a recording…?
Ah, so about that— We were on our way to the Sphere Stage.
Sphere Stage?
I think that’s what that huge dome’s called. I think it’s where the Four Sky Kings had their performance… This place’s already floating up in the sky, so it’s kinda terrifying that there’s even a gigantic dome built on top of it, too… It’s like my sense of distance is completely off. It’s like the same with the tower over there, everything’s just mega jumbo size here.
Even though it looks like it’s nearby, it’s actually surprisingly pretty far, right? We’re all feeling a bit disoriented after being brought up here so suddenly, but I also feel like the reason we can stay calm is because of all these facilities. We’re idols, so there’s also the fact that we wouldn’t want to disappoint our viewers… But this place looks like a rented out amusement park, so if we weren’t here for work, part of me would’ve wanted to enjoy going around the place, if you get me. I can feel the intense passion NiceP had when opening the doors to Mega Stream, basically.
Yeah. Of course, there’s likely people who aren’t too happy about this, as well. Thunderbolt may have gone through the effort of adjusting our work schedules behind the scenes, but it’s still a very massive change for everyone.
Mhm. Nice-san did mention that he wasn’t sure if everyone would accept this, but that he just had to do it no matter what. It seems like Mega Sphere’s construction was a huge project that took over ten years — Even before Nice-san became employed in Thunderbolt… But back then, Thunderbolt was aiming to construct a huge place for TV celebrities. Apparently, they were pretty surprised when ES first came out loaded with such cutting-edge facilities. So that’s another reason why Nice-san is so overenthusiastic about Mega Sphere. This is an establishment that urges idols all across the world to come and challenge themselves, through Sphere Lives and cutting-edge live streams. That’s what Mega Sphere is all about, is what he said—
Hm. I can’t deny that he’s pouring every bit of effort into this. Even when ES came about, I found it pretty impressive to see an establishment that gigantic prepared for use, but—
Yeah, Mega Sphere’s even beyond that, isn’t it?
Ahaha. I can just hear Eichi-senpai grinding his teeth in anger~♪
Would he? It seems to me that Tenshouin-senpai is thinking of improving the idol industry further and further. Maybe he’d be happy that there’s someone who feels the same?
Mm~ But I also feel like he’d instigate a competition from closed doors.
Oh, whoops. You two were on your way to the Sphere Stage, yeah? Is there something you gotta do there?
Mhm. It looks like Switch is live-streaming in front of the Sphere Stage, so Anzu-san said she wanted to take a closer look— Right, Anzu-san?
Hm. I see… They aren’t just letting themselves be filmed, but starting a live stream on their own, too. That’s Sakasaki for you; he’s always quick to take action. This is the same guy who excels at coming up with strategies. By live-streaming voluntarily from the start, he’s likely trying to demonstrate Switch’s appeal to the viewers.
Yeah, and Sakasaki-kun and Harukawa-kun seem the type to get super interested in anything modern. Maybe an idea would be to use the 24-hour live stream to show our typical daily life, and for anything else, we live-stream by ourselves through our Mega Phone or the studio.
So basically, show off all your charms by making use of different types of live streams, yeah? And there aren’t any units live-streaming from their phones, so it’s likely to attract attention.
Yeah. Thanks to Switch taking a head start, I feel like I’ve gotten the gist of Mega Stream.
We can’t let ourselves get a late start, right!? Let’s all live-stream together! We need a loooad of “Nice!”s to get chosen for the special program, right? Then we gotta strike while it’s hot! ☆
We don’t know if this is something good to strike just yet, though. But either way, we can’t just sit here doing nothing, either.
I think a chatting stream sounds good for starters. It seems like all our viewers will send us comments, so let’s make sure to answer them all.
We’ve got ourselves a plan, then. We’ll start with what’s easy to do, and then gradually turn it into something better. Us in Trickstar aren’t skilled enough to devise the flawless strategy, after all. Let’s just try things out with trial and error!
Yep! With that settled, it’s time we find a place to live-stream! ☆
See ya later! Anzu! Tsucchi~! (waves)
We’re gonna make our live stream the greatest entertaining show ever, so look forward to it, okay? ☆
Sound of running footsteps
That was Trickstar— They’re very, how should I put it… full of spirit, aren’t they…? But they’ve got some great talent, being able to get accustomed to this place immediately and enjoy themselves. If I were in their shoes, I think I would’ve immediately tried running away— Huh? Are you sure it’s okay not to take notes? Oh no, I almost forgot! I’m going to encounter lots of ES idols, so Nice-san told me to take notes of them so I don’t forget their characteristics…! I-I just forgot right now, it wasn’t an actual mistake, so my life won’t drop down, right…? Please, Anzu-san. Keep it a secret from Nice-san, won’t you…? Hah, I’m so glad — I was this close to getting fired… …? Switch’s live stream will end if I take too long with my notes? You’re right. We should go to where Switch are. I’m sure Switch is having a fun live stream that’s on par with Trickstar, after all~♪
Chapter 9 This chapter is Ryuseitai’s first appearance in the main story.
MEGA STREAM: Ryuseitai live-streaming while on a stroll
“Now then! This is Passage Arcade, the center base of our work!”
“Passage, according to what I’ve researched, means ‘a lane you pass through’ in French. Just as the name implies, this seems to be a pretty spacious area!”4
“Ohh, that’s real fancy~ I never knew that!”
“and our [room] lies on the [floor] above this arcade, yes?” “living together in the same [room] sounds so [refreshingly new] and fun~♪”5
“Mhm. Even though it’s only the first day, I’m also having fun living alongside Shinkai-dono~♪” “What about you, Midori-kun? Your thoughts on this new lifestyle, if you may!”
“…………” “I wonder if I’d feel at peace if I got pushed off Mega Sphere right now…”
“Hold it! Don’t make hasty decisions, Takamine!” “Guys, pin Takamine down! Reality hasn’t hit him yet after all!”
“fufu. then you can count on me~♪” “tetora, shinobu. please hold down his [arms].” “i will restrain his [torso]…♪”
“Ossu!”
“Understood!”
“Guh—!”
“Hold o—I give, I give! I haven’t even moved yet, and I just felt like saying it, that’s all…!”
“Huh, what’s going on? It’s getting noisy over here~?”
“I think Ryuseitai is live-streaming… Did something happen?”
“Chi~chan-senpai, you’re so loud~! Can’t you be a little more quiet?”
“Ah, sorry. It seems like Takamine hasn’t been able to accept the abrupt change in environment…” “So we were live-streaming as we were taking a stroll, to get him used to the new surroundings.”
“Ah~ I see now. Takamin can’t handle stress like a little animal after all, yeah?” “No matter how mopey you get, you won’t be able to go back to the ground, so aren’t you better off just making do however you can for one month?”
“That logical argument hurts to hear, y’know…!?”
“Forget about me, I’d rather just be left alone, please… I don’t want to be filmed, and I just want to shut myself in the room…”
“No need to be so gloomy, Takamine. The comments are filled with people worried for you!” “For now, you should show our fans a brave face, to keep them all at ease.”
“You do know you’re the one who started this live stream, right…!? Don’t act like you’re solving the problem when you’re the one who created it in the first place!”6
“Everyone watching us, I’m so sorry… I feel like it’s enough to just see me during live shows or from my jobs, so please leave anything beyond that for another time…”
Sound of running footsteps
“Ah—Midori-kun ran off!”
“We have to hurry and chase after him!”
“Takamine, wait! I just wanted you to feel better, really…!”7
Sound of running footsteps
…They’re gone.
Well, that reaction is normal, I’d say. I was baffled at first too, but still… Are we adapting to Mega Sphere a little too fast…?
We got thrown into a jungle during the SS qualifying round, so maybe that’s what’s made us feel like we can get through anything, no matter the situation. We’re also pretty used to Akehoshi-kun and Hidaka-kun’s reckless acts, so this might just be the everyday thing for us.
What an awful way to get used to things…
But you know, it seems like Takamine-kun’s reaction got a pretty big response from people. Everyone here’s too used to unusual situations, so maybe it felt more relatable with such a realistic reaction instead.
I’m going for realism too, though~ But I guess Takamin’s reaction is a lot easier to empathize with?
Your scale’s really big after all, Akehoshi-kun. Well, that just shows that you have a knack for being an idol, though. But it looks like there were a lot of “Nice!”s when you spoke with Morisawa-senpai and Takamine-kun. Here, look at the archive. There’s a sudden surge of “Nice!”s right at this moment.
Right when I spoke with Takamin and Chi~chan-senpai? But why?
Well, the three of you were in the Basketball Club together, as seniors and juniors. There’s some comments saying “I wish I saw them talk to Mao-kun too~”, so maybe they were looking forward to the Basketball Club members talking to each other.
That so? Huh, but are there really that many fans who know that we were in the Basketball Club?
Mm~ I’d hate to talk to Chi~chan-senpai just to get a higher rating. He’s way too excitable and it’s exhausting.
You’re saying that? You two are the same type. How about you try and understand how it feels to be me, trying to match everyone’s pace in the live stream earlier? It was chaos when you started to casually rouse the viewers. But well, talking to my senior tires me too, so I can understand.
Anyway. In other words, getting to see a surprising side of us is another charm to Mega Stream.
Yup. It’s because we’re all stuck in the same place together that unimaginable combinations could happen. Maybe the current feel of Mega Stream right now is enjoying the surprising outcomes from various idol combinations.
Huh~ Then we should probably try talking to people outside of our unit, too. For example, I could try talking to members of the Basketball Club or the previous Student Council members.
Sounds great, I love that! Then maybe I’ll go talk to Shinonon! I feel like we might get a surprising outcome from that, like Ukki~ mentioned. Plus, if we all work in separate places, it might make Anzu want to feature all four of us in the compilation video, yeah?
For more of Ryuseitai in Mega Sphere, see: Mega Stream: Follow Closely! and Mega Stream: Self-Introductions

entry.title: Sailing Ceremony – Towing (Chapter 1)
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
ryuseipuka
Context Note: This is a partial translation of the story.
(You can also read the prologue for the context!)
After the idols entered Mega Sphere to check it out, NiceP suddenly announces that they will be working at the Mega Sphere for one month, and cannot leave it until the end of the month.
NiceP then kickstarts the Mega Stream, a month-long program where idols live stream themselves to gain Nice!’s. They are live-streamed 24/7 in public spaces, and they can also start their own live stream on their Mega Phone.
In Mega Sphere, units live in a room together. The unit rooms are not filmed for the live stream for privacy.
Chapter 1
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (July)
Next day. On the third day of Mega Stream…
“Our noon live stream ends here!”
“Come watch us tomorrow too, everyone! Ossu!”
fufu. today’s live stream went [swimmingly] too, didn’t it~ tetora? you seem quite [at home] when it comes to [hosting] now, don’t you think?
No, no, I’m still nowhere near that level yet. I’ve only just gotten a handle of the live-streaming know-how.
What’s way more surprising is Midori-kun. He’s been talking ‘bout yuru-chara and vegetables and the like… I never thought he’d have such a huge knack for live-streamin’.
Nah, I don’t really have a knack for it or anything…
I think it’s just that in a way, all five of us in Ryuseitai have different interests, so we can rake up a lot of ‘Nice!’s even when live-streaming solo, that’s all…
On top of that, we’ve been regularly doing collaboration live streams, so our viewership never grows stagnant.
The “#IWantToSeeRyuseitai’sSphereLive” campaign also came to our advantage, giving us a steady foundation… This is truly the fruit of our labor.
Well now. Seems like you Ryuseitai folks are enjoying yourselves with Mega Stream, huh?
Tori-kun… You were watching us?
You’re so insolent, commoner! You should be humbling yourself before one of the Four Sky Kings! Show some respect!
Ha haa~!
Wh—He actually bowed his head down!? Why? Gross!
Fufu. Tori-kun’s attitude can be a little aggravating here and there, but if I just think of this as a historical drama, it actually feels quite pleasant! ♪
Yeah, he sounds like an evil magistrate — y’know, those baddies whose whole thing is to get defeated.
Hah!? You saying I’ll lose? As if!
Well, enjoy getting ahead of yourselves while you still can~♪ The Four Sky Kings’ power is on a monstrous level. Even if six opponents were against us, they’d have nooo chance of winning…☆ The rest of the kings haven’t been breaking a sweat one bit; they’ve just been taking it easy, ‘cause they’re saving their energy for the real thing!
Now he’s settin’ himself up even more as the ‘baddie who’s just gonna get defeated’…
Yeah, feels like this is foreshadowing him losing spectacularly…
this is what we call the ‘death flag’, isn’t it~?
Fits perfectly with “The Four Sky Kings Die” title-drop, indeed! ☆
Q-Quit talking with such insolence!
Wait, I don’t see Morisawa-senpai here — Where’s he gone to, anyway?
He’s the one with flying marks outside of the Four Sky Kings, right? So he’s been working alone without Ryuseitai, huh?
Ahh, that? In regards to Morisawa-dono — He’s attempting to become a hero to rescue all the lost idols.
He has been performing collaboration live streams since yesterday, under the name of “Live Stream Supporting As I Please in Mega Stream”!
Live stream supporting as he pleases…!?
He’s not even the one managing the Mega Stream, so why the heck would he do that!? It literally makes no sense…!
Yeah, I thought the same at first, but… It looks like Morisawa-senpai has pretty influential power right now, so…
Yup! Morisawa-senpai is currently the most popular idol in Mega Stream, right after the Four Sky Kings. He’s so powerful right now, most idols would immediately grab onto the opportunity to collaborate with him if he said he’s interested.
So Morisawa-senpai proposed an idea to us, sayin’ he wants to utilize that influence to collab with all sortsa people.
That way, he may be able to rescue a certain person. That is what Morisawa-dono is aiming for! ♪
Rescue? What’s that about…?
For more of Ryuseitai in Mega Sphere, see: Mega Stream: Follow Closely! and Mega Stream: Self-Introductions

entry.title: School Festival 4 – Epilogue
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
Yuuki Yoshino
Translation
310mc
Proofreading
Shie
Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 Chapter 1
Location: Running Grounds
…………
(O-Oh no… This is where we were supposed to meet, right…?) (Uu~ But no one’s here… What do I do…? Should I call Nagumo-kun…?)
Fweh…? (Is that Transfer Student-san coming over here…? Yup, that definitely looks like her…)
(It’s good that she’s here, but we can’t perform our act without Nagumo-kun, since he’s the delinquent role… Guess I really should call him…) …………
(Mmm~ He’s not picking up… Oh well, I guess I’ll explain the current situation to the transfer studen—)
……Huh? (Some bad-looking guys are talking to her, I think…? Whaa… Why’re there guys like that in our school…?)
(Wait, no— This isn’t the time to think! I have to go save her…!) (Uuu… I have to, but my legs won’t stop shaking… I can’t do it…) (Nagumo-kun, please pick up the phone…! I can’t do this alone…!)
(Ah— She’s about to be taken away…!)
(Ahh!! It’s now or never, Takamine Midori…! If you desert her now, you’ll regret it for the rest of your life…!)
S-Stop…! Don’t you dare lay a hand on her…!!
(Ahh… They’re glaring at me… Are they gonna punch me…?) (I don’t wanna get hurt… I’m terrified, and my legs are shaking… But somehow, I don’t regret doing this at all…)
(Maybe I’ve done enough, then… I’m sorry I couldn’t save you heroically, Transfer Student-san…)
Midori-kun!
(Huh…? That voice… Ah, Nagumo-kun’s here…)
(He’s rushing over here… He’s really just like a hero…♪)
Location: Hero Show Stage
Hero show time…
“The red flame is the mark of justice! The sun of life, burning bright red! Ryusei Red, Morisawa Chiaki…! ☆”
“the blue flame is the mark of mystery! i have come from the blue [sea]~♪ ryusei blue, shinkai kanata…! ☆ (sparkle)”
“The black flame is the mark of effort! The burning fighting spirit, stained with mud! Ryusei Black, Nagumo Tetora…! ☆”
“The yellow flame is the mark of hope! The beam of miracle, shining into the darkness! Ryusei Yellow! Sengoku Shinobu…! ☆”
“The green flame is the mark of compassion… Healing everyone with yuru-chara and stuff… Ryusei Green, Takamine Midori…”
“With the five of us together, we are Ryuseitai…!”
Aghh, there’s way too much attention on us… I said my line, so it’s alright for me to go in a corner where no one can see me, right…?
Ahaha, I completely understand how you feel. I do not want to stand out much, either. And anyway, Midori-kun, you may say that now, but— Just earlier, you protected Transfer Student-dono from the delinquents, did you not? You really stood out in the crowd then.
Ughh… I really wanted to run away back then, though… They were terrifying… Even I think I managed that way too well… I don’t typically have that much guts in me… Maybe I experienced that thing where you get tremendous courage at any sign of danger…?
You were super cool~♪ All the girls nearby had hearts in their eyes!
Mm~… It’s true that I was the first one to jump in there, but the ones who drove them away were you guys, y’know…?
I’m kind of late to saying this, but thank you, everyone…♪
No need to thank me! I’d be a disgrace as a man if I were to abandon a comrade in danger!
…I made a huge mistake. When I heard that Taisho was a delinquent in the past… I thought they were super cool people.
But… reality showed me otherwise. They’re not cool at all. Delinquents aren’t anything like Taisho. There are super uncool delinquents out there… In fact, it’s Taisho who’s the only exception.
There are plenty who aren’t considerate, and just do as they like… I finally understood that today.
Chapter 2 But, you know… Although we were unable to follow through our original plan, since an actual delinquent appeared… In the end, we were still able to save a frail Transfer Student-dono from delinquents. In a way, something good came from an unfortunate incident. We even managed to get more people to come to our hero show, and now we have a full crowd.
If only this part of our plan got ruined, too… Sigh… I really wish that had happened…
Mm~ I’d rather have this than not havin’ anyone’s attention on us! We’re idols, after all — It’s important to stand out. We gotta stand out even more, and make this whole crowd remember our names!
Noooo… I don’t wannaaaaa…
Oh jeez, Midori-kun! You’ve been standing out for a while now, so just accept your fate already! Heh-heh~ I’m feeling super excited~♪
Ossu! I’m gonna sing as loud as I can! “I’m Nagumo Tetora, Ryusei Black! Follow my lead, everyone…!” “♪~♪~♪~”
Ooh! What a powerful voice! Nice one, Ryusei Black! You’re doing great, Ryusei Black…! ☆
Please don’t pat my head. The show’s not over yet, so don’t start relaxing.
Also… Sorry for making you feel anxious, Taichou. I kept saying how much I wanna be a cool delinquent, and never bothered to look around me.
No, it’s alright. It seems like you don’t want to become one anymore, and that’s enough.
Yeah! I’m actually kinda glad I didn’t get to act out my role in the end.
And, seriously… I never wanna come across another real delinquent ever again. I was almost petrified in my spot when I saw them ganging up on Midori-kun and Transfer Student-san.
But you didn’t stop, all so that you could save them. You’re a wonderful hero, Nagumo! You were so cool! I’m so proud of you!
Like I said! Please don’t pat my head! Should we even be talking in the middle of our performance, anyway?
No, I’m pretty sure we shouldn’t be.
Ahaha! In our school’s live shows, it’s become a tradition to talk in the middle of them! Looks like it’s now something I do, too!
That’s not funny! We’ve got little kids here, so they might get bored and leave if we keep talking to each other!
That would be a shame! In fact, this is a hero show for kids! We shouldn’t forget about our purpose here!
“Children, watch over our heroic figures! Now then, let’s get this hero show going~!” “♪~♪~♪~”
Taichou-dono is performing with so much energy~ He’s jumping around while singing… Does he not get tired?
Mmm~ I think he has a different amount of stamina from us… It frustrates me to say this, but my performance a second ago took a lot outta me, so I’m gonna stay in the back to recover some of my energy.
I’ll leave the rest to you and Midori-kun.
Okay! You lit a fire in us, after all~ All we have to do now is make that fire burn even more! “♪~♪~♪~” C’mon, c’mon! It is your turn now, Midori-kun~♪
N-No, I’m fine… I’m just going to stay here where no one can see me…
(Ahh, but everyone’s having fun performing… This isn’t the right time to be fighting against it, I guess…)
(Just what is up with today… Every time I don’t wanna stand out, I stand out even more…) (Ahh~! Dammit, I don’t care anymore…!) “♪~♪~♪~”
midori~♪
Fweh? W-Why are you calling out to me…? Ah, am I in your way…?
no, you would never be in my [way]~ the five of us together are ryuseitai, after all.
every time we do something, it excites lots of people. and when people enjoy what we do, we also become happy, right? “♪~♪~♪~”
(Eh? Eh? Did he call out to me just because I was nearby…?) (He’s a strange one… But the kids seem to like him…?) (They’re cheering him on whenever he does a hero pose…)
(Huh? Is that kid trying to tell me to go for it…?) (A kid just cheered me on… But, that does make me a bit happy, I think…)
(Even I don’t want any of these kids’ smiles ruined… That’s why, I’ll try to work as hard as I can…♪)
“♪~♪~♪~”
