Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Ch 4 - Ch 5 - Ch 6 - Ch 7 - Epilogue - Translation Notes Center of the World 1
Season: Yumenosaki Era, Winter (Before graduation season)
Location: Studio
Ossu, hello! I’m Nagumo Tetora from Ryuseitai! I’m enterin’ the studio if you don’t mind~! ☆
Ughhh, what’s with the ruckus… Is this an ambush?
Woah—! You startled me!
I was just ‘bout to ask if anybody’s in here, but then I spotted you from underneath the kotatsu, Sakuma-senpai~♪ You still haven’t gotten rid of it?
It’s Ritsu­-senpai, not Sakuma-senpai. You have to get it down right. I still feel a little cold… Like I’ll really start feeling lonely if I put this round table away… It’ll make me realize how we’re going to say our goodbyes to each other soon enough.
Anyway, you got something to do with Knights? Sorry to say, but I’m the only one here today.
Mm~… I guess I came at the wrong time. Does Knights have the day off?
Well, everyone had their own business to tend to, soo… We had a quick meeting, practiced a bit, and then stopped for the day. We’re an individualistic type of unit, so we’ve got days when that’s all we end up doing. …Although, we’ve been having more days when we’re all together.
Ohhh, that’s real enlightening. We’re the complete opposite from you guys. We always try our best to group up. We’re all ‘bout “All for one, one for all.”
“The five of us together are Ryuseitai” is how we roll, after all.
Huh. Then I guess we’re something like, “Even alone, we’re still Knights.”
…But seriously, what’re you here for? Keeping up this conversation is getting exhausting.
Oh! Sorry for takin’ up your time! Umm… Is Narukami Arashi-senpai around, or…?
Nacchan? They said they wanted to run around aimlessly to let off some stress. So they’re probably over at their club, yeah?
Ah! Oh yeah, he was in the Track & Field Club, wasn’t he? I didn’t check the running grounds… I came straight over here once my practice session was done. Thanks for the hint, Saku— Ritsu-senpai. I’ll go check out his club.
Right… Ah, I could text them that you’re coming over to see them first. Although… I guess they’re still running right about now, so they probably left their phone in their bag.
Ossu! That’d help me out, thank you! Heheh! I thought you were the type to be blunt with things, but you’re actually really nice~♪
It all depends on the time and place… I’m feeling lonely today, that’s all.
But I’ve got a question for you, uh… Tekko-kun, was it? You good friends with Nacchan or something?
I’m not Tekko, I’m “Tetora”! Nah, I’m not~ I’m not so good with how he talks… I haven’t ever really talked to him outside of work-related stuff!
Ahh… Yeah, it’s typical to be confused by how they talk when you aren’t used to it…
…Oh, Nacchan immediately replied back to me after I sent them a message. Looks like they’ve taken a break just now.
Oooh, then I should be able to meet him if I just go over to where he is, right? I’ll go rushing to the running grounds straight away! Righty then, I’ll leave you alone now! Thank you so much for all your help~!
(…And he dashed off. Youngsters sure are energetic…)
(But really, why did he want to see Nacchan… Aren’t those two complete opposites? Like, I don’t think there’s any connection between the two…)
(Ah, wait… Nacchan’s been doing something society keeps expecting from them, I think…) (If he came over to see Nacchan ‘cause of that rumor… Then he’s probably going to set Nacchan off, huh…)
Sorry, I’m back for a second longer!
Eeek—! Sheesh, you freaked me out… Why’re you back here? Did you forget something?
Ah, no… well, I guess you could say I almost forgot to do something… I brought over a blanket for you, so please use it, Ritsu-senpai~♪
Huh? Why a blanket?
Fufun, you’ve been in that kotatsu for so long that you’ll start freezing as soon as you leave it. So if you end up sleeping inside of it, you’ll eventually get a cold.
Which is why I got you a blanket. I use this one durin’ our occasional Ryuseitai sleepovers. I know I’m doing somethin’ you didn’t ask for, but I just kept getting more worried.
Mm… I’m fine, though~… I’m healthy as long as I drink blood.
You can’t let your guard down like that~ It looks like everyone’s been getting a cold lately, so I want you to take care of yourself. You need to take care of your health for work~♪
Haha, sorry for talkin’ like a wise guy… Alright, I’ll leave you alone this time~♪
Yeah, bye bye~ (waves)
Mmgh~… This blanket stinks like a guy…
(Mm~… I don’t get that kid at all… He looks like he’s just a bit dumb, though…) (That’s exactly why people like me, who overthink things way too much, would prefer avoiding people like him…) (You can’t use logic to read a beast…)1
(Although… He did get worried about me, and went all the way to bring a blanket for me, so I doubt he’s a naughty kid.) (But depending on the situation — a good kid, a reasonable argument, or even a white lie can sometimes hurt someone’s feelings more than anything else.)
(It feels like something bad’s gonna happen… I’m seriously starting to get worried.)
Center of the World 2
Location: Running Grounds
…………
Heeeeey, Arashi-saaaaaan! I see you showed up for the club todaaay! It’s Mamaaaaaaa! ☆
…There’s really no need to yell. I can tell it’s you from a hundred kilometers away, Mama. You do realize you’re incredibly huge, right?
Hahaha! You’re unusually in a bad mood, huuuh?
Mm~… If you of all people noticed with one glance, even when you’re so thick headed… then this is a much more serious case of depression than I thought. Gosh, I’d really rather not be seen in an awful mood…
But the thing is… Graduation season and Repayment Festival is in just a few weeks, right? So I suppose even I’ve been feeling gloomy about everything?
That isn’t the only reason, is it? I heard about that job you took… Buuut everyone loved it, so what about it upsets you?
Well, I guess it’d be a little too dense of me if I seriously asked you that… I know I’m waaay too late in saying this, buuut I don’t think you should’ve taken that job in the first place, y’know?
It was a photo album that emphasizes your cool, manly side, right? The sales were off the charts with all sooorts of good reviews, weren’t they? Even my shut-in2 little sister knew about it.
Hm? You have a sister, Mama?
My incompetent sister… She’s the complete opposite of me, and I don’t really understand her. Plus, she’s mentally fragile and never leaves her room.
Ahaha, that really is the complete opposite of you, who’s always traveling all over the world~
Yeaaah, we’re complete strangers to each other’s worlds… But aaanyway, enough about my life; we’re talking about you right now, Arashi-san.
A job that emphasizes your manliness… Isn’t that the sorta thing you’d haaate to do?
Mm… I mean, I should be super happy, since my beauty was appreciated by everyone… And the positive reviews are bound to be a blessing, especially if I plan to continue working as part of Knights… Even Izumi-chan praised me for it. For once, he genuinely told me I did a good job.
I shouldn’t be upset at all. I should be twirling around in excitement. That’s how I roll… That’s how Narukami Arashi would react. At this point, I wouldn’t feel hurt at all by people’s words, whether it’s telling me I’m manly or cool… Or hurtful things, like “disgusting” or “shitty okama”3… No matter what anyone says, I love myself most.
That’s how it’s supposed to be, but… I can’t help but feel so discontent.
Mmm~ Yeah, this really is a serious case, huuuh…
There’s only one thing I can say here: If you need my help, I’ll do whatever it takes for you. If you wanna continue pursuing manliness and get more praise, theeen I can help you out. I myself tend to get good reviews for that sorta thing, sooo I could share my advice with you on how to expand your horizons.
But if you can’t stand to be in a position where all people want from you is manliness, then I’ll destroy anything and everything that forces you to do that. You’ve got two options! I’m terrible at taking precautions, sooo it’s gonna be all or nothing from me! Alrighty then, what’s it gonna be!?
When you get involved, everything is taken care of in a flash without me even getting involved, and I don’t like that… So as always, I choose neither.
I’ll find a middle ground for myself. …Besides, Mama, aren’t you busy now that we’re reaching graduation? Do you even have the time to take care of others right now?
Hahaha! I’m in a solo unit, so I’ve got nooothing to do with all those generation change problems. I’m taking it pretty easy lately~♪
Huh… I suppose you have countless options to choose from for your future career, too. …Hm?
Heyaa~! Nice to meet you, Narukami-senpai! I’m Nagumo Tetora from Ryuseitai! ☆
Mhm. Ritsu-chan sent me a message, so I knew you’d be coming. …But why did you want to see me?
Ossu! The truth is, I wanna learn the secrets to manliness from you, Narukami-senpai!
…I thought so. It’s basically a catchphrase at this point for you to mention how your dream is to be a “man among men”, isn’t it?
Huh…? Erm, how come you know so much about me?
Ufufu, I love hard-working boys, after all. And you’re the epitome of one… So I’ve had my eyes on you, Tetora-chan. ♪
I-I’m not a fan of being called by “-chan”, to be honest…
Oh my, how rude of me. It’s not manly after all, is it? …Hmm~ What shall we do here, hm? I don’t have any plans for today, so I could spend time with you, but… Are you sure you want it from me? I think there are people much more suitable for this out there…?
I assume you saw my photo album, but… This is how I usually am, you know? I’m not quite sure if I can teach you the secrets to manliness.
Ossu! I totally saw your photo album. You looked super duper awesome! I admire you! The way you were like, oozing manliness…!
That’s the sorta manly guy I wanna be! So please, teach me your ways!
…………

Being kind enough to laugh off and forgive your junior for making a dumb mistake is also a sign of strength.
I wanna be strong like that, too. Instead of forcibly scrapin’ off my effeminate parts, I wanna turn it into a strength like kindness — And then I’ll wrap myself in it, and grow into a great man.
Just like her. First things first: I gotta start learning to love that side of myself~♪

Translation Notes ↑ Originally, Ritsu says “You won’t get anywhere playing Shogi with an animal.”↑ Originally, Madara refers to his sister as a Hikikomori, which is a term to refer to people who are withdrawn from society, especially in public.↑ Okama is a Japanese derogatory term used towards effeminate men.↑ Usually I translate 女々しい memeshii as sensitive/soft, but considering this story is related to gender, I decided it’d be best to keep it literal (the literal meaning is effeminate/like a girl).↑ “Reserved” in Japanese is lit. “watery,” hence why Ritsu mentions that vampires aren’t good with running water.↑ Tetora’s name lit. means "Iron Tiger". It’s also in his first solo song title, IRON HEART TIGER!.

Chapter Index Ch 1 - Ch 2 - Ch 3 - Ch 4 - Ch 5 - Ch 6 - Translation Notes Guardians of the Garden 1
Season: ES 2nd Year, Summer (June)
Hmhmhmm~ Crispy lettuce and bright red tomatoes~♪1 Yaaay, I finally got to buy the ‘Vegetable Panna Cotta’ from the Vegetable Dance collab…♪2
(It was sold out no matter which convenience store I went to, and I didn’t expect that I’d have to go through five whole stores to find it…) (But since I’m the son of a greengrocer, I just have to try a dessert made with vegetables at least once.)
(I wasn’t really sure at first if a dessert collaboration with a trendy song could actually sell well… But when I looked it up on social media, it seemed to have pretty good reviews.)3 (I saw comments saying, “it’s tasty” or “I don’t like vegetables, but this is fine for me to eat”, so I feel like I can expect a lot out of this.) (Most of all, having the spotlight on vegetables is an honor in itself…♪)
(I hope this boom makes more vegetable-based recipes gain popularity…)
(Ahh, but then again, it’ll get busy at the greengrocer if that happens, and then they’ll call me over to help… I feel like that’d be a pain…?) (I want vegetables to sell well, but I’d hate to get involved with a busy season.)
But who would’ve known that song Morisawa-senpai and co. made in 4piece would get this popular… You really never know what could happen in this world.4 It frustrates me to know that song came to be not through a greengrocer, but through Morisawa-senpai and the others…
But, well, I guess that’s just how trends work. If you could easily make something go viral just by aiming for it, people like Anzu-san and idols wouldn’t be struggling so much.
Well, whatever. More importantly, I need to hurry back home so I can take my time eating this panna cotta…♪
Sound of flapping wings
—Uhya!? T-That surprised me… What? Something like a black cloth suddenly flapped near my face…
—A crow?
Oh, what… Don’t startle me out of nowhere.
…? It’s still looking at me from the treetop…? Ehh… Scary…
Actually, it feels like crows are increasing in number lately… I spot them around Seisoukan, too. Crows are so big even though they’re birds, and they can be ferocious sometimes, so it’s scary…
It’d be fine if they were the cute ones in games or picture books, but real crows aren’t like that, so… Not to mention, they’re a natural enemy to farmers, since they ruin crops. I’ve also seen videos of them stealing people’s food along with the package…
Ah—Don’t tell me it wants my panna cotta!?
I have to be careful… I struggled so hard to finally get it, so if a crow takes it from me now, I’ll fall into something worse than depression… I have to get out of here quickly.
Location: Seisoukan Dorm Common Room
Hmm, what will I do… I was thinking of eating it in my room, but maybe I could just eat it here in the common room. I can watch TV while I eat, too.
Mm~…
…Mm? Is that Isara-senpai on the sofa?
Mm~… What to do now… I dunno what I could do with something like this…
I wonder what’s wrong… He seems troubled over something…?
Isara-senpai? You’ve been groaning for a while now, what’s wrong? Is there a problem?
Ahh, Takamine! You heard me?
Well, yeah, because you were mumbling so much— Huh, wait… Is that a mini tomato seedling in your hands?
Ohh~ You got it! The tomatoes haven’t even grown yet, but you still figured it out through one look! That’s the son of a greengrocer for ya~
Not really, I just recognized it because I tried planting one for my research project back in elementary school. So what’s up with that seedling?
Right, so~ The stylist assigned to me has been into kitchen gardens lately.
Ohh, yeah, small kitchen gardens are trending lately, it seems. Because of Potager Garden or something…5
Yep, yep. I got one from that stylist after they offered to share one with me.
Hah… Isn’t that good? What’s troubling you exactly?
Well, you have to properly look after plants, right? So with that in mind, I’m not too sure if I’ll be able to consistently take good care of it~ I don’t even have any knowledge of how gardening works, either. So I’m worried it’ll just wither away.
Hah? Why would you get yourself a seedling with that sort of mindset… You shouldn’t have taken one then.
It stings to hear that…! That’s ‘cause I was agreeing to their conversation up until that point, so I can’t just refuse them when they offer me a share, can I!?
So you just accepted it without properly thinking it through. I know I’m not one to talk, but that’s just too irresponsible.
I’ve learned my lesson…
With that said, could you take this seedling, Takamine?
Hah!? I don’t want it. I’m not consistent enough for it either…
C’mon, don’t say that! You have both the know-how and the experience of gardening, so I’m sure looking after the seedling would go better with you than with me.
It’s just not possible for me, no matter how much you flatter me.
Please~ Do it to help me out!
No. It’s a pain…
C’mon, just this once~!
Ehhh…?
Location: Seisoukan Dorm Courtyard
—Ahh, dammit…! In the end, Isara-senpai pushed on me this mini tomato seedling… So depressing…
I can’t allow myself to throw this away, so I figured I’d plant it in the courtyard for now, but… Mm~… The flowerbeds are always kept nice and tidy, and things could go wrong if I plant the seedling here. Someone might pull it out thinking it’s just some random weed, which would be really sad for the seedling…
Ohh. I think this area is good, it wouldn’t stand out here. It’ll get good sun exposure, too.
Here we go… Dig a hole, then plant it in… and—
There we go. Let me also water it a little… Come on, grow niiice and big…♪
Guardians of the Garden 2
Several days after he planted the mini tomato seedling…
Fufufu…♪ I wonder if the mini tomatoes are ripened enough to eat now~? I’ve been growing them with minimal knowledge, so I don’t think they’ll turn out as tasty as how professionals do it, but… Just the fact it’s a vegetable I grew from scratch, all on my own, makes it feel special. It annoyed me at first when Isara-senpai pushed this on me, but taking care of it is starting to be fun now. If these mini tomatoes grow nicely, maybe I could try growing other vegetables, too. Like cucumbers or okra… And if I could make more space, sweet potatoes might be nice, too—
How about I end your life right this instant?
Eep~!? I-I’m sorry! I won’t be careless and grow more vegetables, so please don’t kill me…!
Eh?
Eh? I said something that is actually completely impossible for me to do, so I thought you were threatening to end my life…?
Ahh. So you heard what I said just now. I let my anger get to me and blurted out some unsettling words. I deeply apologize for soiling your ears. That was not intended toward you, so please rest at ease, Takamine-sama.
Well, I’m glad to hear that, at least…
Erm. Then what made you so angry to say something so unsettling?
The source of my headache is this piece of laundry.
Woah, what is this? The shirt’s so ragged and dirty… It’s all muddy and torn apart everywhere. It doesn’t even look like laundry, it just looks like a piece of trash.
Precisely. It has now become one with the garbage. Although it looks like this right now, it was a clean shirt when I first put it up to dry. But a crow came in and turned it into this.
Eh!? Crows again…? I’ve been seeing them more often around the dorms lately… But they’ve been inside the premises, too?
Yes, they have. However, since people frequently go in and out of here, it has kept them cautious, so they rarely show themselves.
But why would the crows want to dirty the laundry so badly? Is it to play around?
No, that isn’t the case. It appears that during the breeding season, they steal hangers to build nests. As such, they purposely remove the laundry from the hanger. And today was another day that a few pieces of laundry disappeared, and when I went searching for them, I found them fallen in the courtyard, tattered and dirty.
Hangers? Huh, crows are pretty nimble to be able to do that.
This is not the time to be impressed by them. For several days now, pieces of laundry have become sacrificed over and over again, and I cannot withhold my anger any longer.
Ahh, so that’s why you said something terrifying.
Yes, it accidentally slipped from my mouth.
Well, that’d make anyone get angry. All the laundry you’re cleaning is getting tattered, dirtied, and the hangers stolen…
I turned a blind eye to it at first, as it was a rare occurrence. However, if they intend to threaten our peace, then I have no choice but to go all out, as well.
I will make sure to teach them a lesson so severe, they never dare to set foot in these premises ever again.
Your smile makes it even more terrifying…! Ermm… I understand how you feel, but please be gentle about it as much as possible…
By the way, why are you in the courtyard, Takamine-sama? The residents of this dormitory rarely ever come to this area.
Ahh, I thought of looking after some mini tomatoes, so I’m growing them at the edge of the courtyard.
Mini tomatoes…? So is it a kitchen garden of some sort?
Well, you could say that.
Fufu. So you have gardening as a hobby, as well? You truly are the son of a greengrocer.
No, it’s not really a hobby of mine or anything… Isara-senpai just forced this seedling on me, and now I’m looking after it from force of habit…
But I think it’s starting to get fun. It’s almost about time for it to ripen enough to eat, too.
How wonderful. I hope it ripened to be delicious.
Ah, right. It’s about time I go water the seedling. If you ever end up drawing something, please show it to me first, Master Artist! Master Artist’s new drawings are the treasures of this world, after all!6 It’s a promise…☆ Alright, it’s time I go!
Sound of footsteps
Ermmm… Drawing is not necessarily my hobby either, though…
Well, no matter. More importantly, I must think up a way to prevent any more damages from the crows.
(I have read in a book before that crows are intelligent, and avoid any places they sense danger from.) (One method that has been used since the past is to hang up the remains of a crow to deter them.) (I also read that they sell imitations of that in stores, but—)
Master Artist Fushimiiiiiiii~!
—!? Takamine-sama? Why on earth are you so panicked?
Please let me help you drive back the crows!
Eh…?
Guardians of the Garden 3
Warning: Brief mentions of intention of bird harm in this chapter.
—Does that mean you’ve fallen victim to the crows too, Takamine-sama?
Exactly! I was about to water my mini tomatoes, but the ones that were going to ripen today were nowhere to be found…! The crows were totally behind it! There was a black feather nearby!
I was so excited to finally get a taste of them today after days of looking after them…! Don’t you think it’s awful!? They’re birds, yet they try to steal people’s food…! We have to kill them instantly, right now!
I know I’m not one to speak, but… Please cease from saying anything disturbing. Someone may get the wrong idea if they hear.
Nevertheless, your strong will is crystal clear to me, Takamine-sama. This makes both of us victims of the crows’ misconduct.
As of this moment, it has only been the two of us who were affected, but it’s only a matter of time until it spreads to others. We must do something immediately…
What do you have to do to make crows go away…?
I, too, was thinking up methods for that a moment ago.
Mm~…
Ah! Master Artist Fushimi’s… Or well, Himemiya-kun’s house is pretty big, and the plot is pretty wide too, right? So don’t crows appear often? What do people do about crows over at Himemiya-kun’s house?
The Himemiya Family is extremely thorough in its supervision, down to the very corners, so crows do not appear in the first place. There is always someone going in and out of the garden, like the gardeners. Also, Young Master’s pet dog, King, often runs about in the garden throughout the day.
Dog… Makes sense, I bet a dog is like a natural enemy to crows. In that case, there are plenty of people in the dorms with a pet dog, so maybe we could ask one of them to let their dog around the garden…?
King is quite a massive dog, though an old one as well. However, the dogs I see in the dorms are mostly the small ones, and they would not be suitable for this sort of thing. In fact, there’s a possibility that the dog may get harmed by the crows.
Ahh, I see… Yeah, it’s probably dangerous for a small animal to be up against a crow… Plus, now that I know it might be dangerous, it’d be hard to ask one of the dog owners for help.
…………
I believe I must do a thorough research on crows after all.
Huh? You won’t research about how to drive away crows, but on crows themselves?
Yes. As the saying goes, “know thy enemy, know thyself, and you will win a hundred wars”.
Ermm…?
In battle, do you know what is deemed the most crucial factor in turning the tides of the outcome? It’s ‘information’. In other words, if you fight with the thorough knowledge of both your allies and your enemies, you will never lose any battle ahead.
Huh… Well, that’s true… When up against a boss in a game, I’d look at its stats and weaknesses, I guess…?
Hmm. So modern games also make use of Sun Tzu’s heihou.
Hey-Ho…?7
…In any case. In order to drive away the crows, we need to research more on crows themselves.
The library might be a good place, then. There’s books of all sorts of genres, so I’m sure we can find the book we need.
Location: Seisoukan Common Room
…Mm?
Ohh, Takamine and Yuzuru. Ossu~♪ (waves) It’s not that I’ve never seen you two in the same room, but this is still kind of an unusual combo, isn’t it? Why’re you guys looking so solemn?
Ah! It’s the main culprit of this whole incident…! Unforgivable…
Culprit!? The heck do you mean? I don’t recall doing anything…
All culprits say that.
Ehh!? Okay, to be clear, I seriously did not do anything…! Is someone trying to pin a crime on me without my knowledge!?
You see… (Explains the situation) We are now on our way to research more about crows.
Mm~… I get why the two of you were together now, but… Heeey, Takamine~? Based on that story, how did I become the main culprit of this? Isn’t it the crows?
If you never pushed on me that seedling you accepted without proper thought, I wouldn’t have fallen victim to the crows in the first place, that’s why.
I really am sorry about that!
Alright, let’s do it this way then! I’ll also research about crows with you guys! Let me off through that then. Will ya?
Well, that’s just obviously what you should be doing here in the first place.
Ahaha, you’re as strict as ever, Takamine~
However, your help is extremely wanted here, Isara-sama. It’s much better to have helping hands for this, after all.
Yep, you can count on me~ I have just the time right now, so of course I’ll help out.
Guardians of the Garden 4
Warning: Mentions of intention of bird harm in this chapter.
Several hours later. Back at the Seisoukan Dorm’s Courtyard again…
Master Artist Fushimi~ I went around and asked a bunch of people and managed to collect some reflective items, like discs that were about to be thrown away.
Thank you very much.
By the way, Takamine-sama, if I may? I would like to request that you refrain from calling me “Master Artist”.
Eh? But to me, Master Artist is the greatest artist who creates the best drawings ever, and I can’t think of any other respectful title to call you by, so… Is it really not okay…?
Hah… Rather than not okay, how shall I put this… I do not mind you calling me however you like, but the fact that you still continue to call me “Master Artist” feels embarrassing somehow.
It’s okay! Master Artist is always the absolute best. Please have more confidence in yourself!
Ermm, that is not the problem here, either…8
…?
Well, no matter. We will address that issue gradually. For now, let us focus on our task at hand. Right then, Takamine-sama. Could you please hang up everything you’ve collected at a suitable height, while leaving a space in between each? I’m currently preparing the eyeball balloons, so I will not be able to work on the task. Although, it might be quite heavy labor, as it needs to be hung up in a high area.
Ah, okay. It’s fine. If anything, these sorts of moments are the only times I ever get to put my unnecessarily tall height to good use.9
Heeey~ I set up the balloons on the other side.
Though… you sure this is gonna work…?
I wouldn’t know that… But from what we found out at the library, birds tend to be scared of the eyes of their natural enemy. And we also learned that they get startled by light reflection and avoid getting closer, so we’re going to put that to the test right now.
And anyway… Having this many huge eyeballs around is scary in general, not just to birds.
I getcha, it is pretty creepy~ Feels like we could have a small test of courage here if it was nighttime.
Time passes…
—All right, we managed to set up everything in this area, I would say. It is now time to find out if this truly has an effect on crows or not…
Ah, a crow’s come over already. Will it take the hint and fly away…?
…………
Ermm… It started to groom itself while looking at all the disks and balloons we’ve set up…
Ah! It looked at us and chirped loudly!
Dammit~ It annoys me for some reason~ Is it mocking us or something!?
I avoided this plan at first, as I worried it may negatively influence Young Master’s schooling, but… Very well then. If we are being ridiculed, then I have a plan up my sleeve.
Let’s immediately capture that bird, tear it from limb to limb, and have it displayed for the rest of them to see. It was written in the book that it is possible to bring fear and caution to crows by showing them a fellow crow’s corpse.
Could you not say something so disturbing with a smile outta nowhere!? I’d hate to see the courtyard have something like that hung up!
Me too, I’m absolutely certain I’d collapse if I saw that…
Is that so… I suppose I’ll drop this idea if that is how everyone feels. I do not wish to bring fear to the whole of the dormitory, either. However, if our traps had no effect, then we must think up a new method…
Mm~ Let me think…
Ah! I kinda remember hearing that crows don’t like it when you line up bottles of water…?
Isn’t that mentioned for deterring cats, not crows? That’s just a myth, anyway. It wouldn’t work at all on cats.
Woah, Arashi!? What the heck are you doing here?
That’s my line. I got curious when I saw the three of you scampering about, so I came to see what’s going on.
We were working together to drive away the crows that keep coming to our dormitory.
Oh yeah, I’ve been spotting crows here and there lately.
But it’s not just that they’ve been here and there, they’ve also been ruining stuff in the dorms, like laundry and vegetables on the soil.
I see… So that’s why you’ve been trying to do something about it, huh? But like I said earlier, bottled water wouldn’t work at all on crows. Neither would they on cats, of course.
Then why’s misinfo like that spread around so much… It’s just a bother to everyone.
It works for one little kitty at first, but then it just gets used to it almost immediately, you know?
Cat… If we show the crows Narukami-senpai’s cat, is there a chance the crow’ll be on guard and not get close? In the manga I’ve been reading lately, crows and cats are shown to be like rivals…10
No, no. Crows are scary to cats too, you know? There’s been little kitties who got injured by crows before.
But, well, they are equal in a way, so I suppose you could call them rivals. But I could never let my cat do something so dangerous.
Perhaps there really is no other choice but to hang up the corpse of a crow—
No thank you.
Good grief, Yuzuru-chan, please don’t. That would just be traumatizing…
And anyway, you can just make the crows think it’s a corpse from their pack, no? I think even a drawing will do for that. Fortunately, we have Yuzuru-chan here, so~
Pardon…?
Guardians of the Garden 5
Good grief. Takamine-sama, Isara-sama, Narukami-sama… All three of you are being so troublesome. Asking me to draw a picture of a crow… I simply cannot imagine this having any sort of effect on all these intelligent crows.
—All right. It’s done.
Oh? Lemme see~
Woah—! This is one heck of a drawing~ It feels intensely eerie the same way a ghost in a horror manga would… As if the dead crow suffered a miserable fate.
Dead crow…? I believe I drew an alive crow, actually.
Eh!? Even though it looks so tragic…!?
Of course I would draw an alive one. There aren’t really any references for a dead one, after all. I simply drew this based on the image from a manual.
Mm~ I did happen to hear that Yuzuru-chan’s drawings are dreadful, but my, it truly is… It feels like this could appear in my dreams tonight.
Well, while we feel dread, there’s someone here who’s cheering in joy…
Uwaaah~… I never knew something could embody the very epitome of anxiety in this world so perfectly… Even I find myself hesitating to get close to it…♪
Huh? Is it just me, or is Takamine seconds away from worshipping this thing?
For the time being, let’s try showing this to the crows in the courtyard.
Sigh… Though I doubt it will have any effect. It isn’t even a drawing of a dead crow…
Heeey, you crows~! Look at this! If you keep coming here, we’ll make you go through the same fate as this guy~!
Wah~! I expect nothing less from Master Artist Fushimi’s drawings! The crows are flying away in panic! Incredible as always…!
I simply cannot make sense of this…
Ah, but they’ve already figured out that it’s a fake after all! They came back immediately to survey the place.
Of course they would. This is nothing but a drawing in the end. We are underestimating crows far too much.
Ehh? Even though it’s giving off a super threatening aura… Crows really have some nerve. If it were me, I’d never want to come back here ever again.
But what are we gonna do, then? We did everything we could, and none of it worked. It frustrates me to say this, but we’re losing miserably to these guys~
I guess we really do have to find some way to directly intimidate the crows. If only there was a natural enemy here that isn’t of equal strength to the crows… Something that’s super terrifying in their eyes.
From a crow’s perspective, I’d say they find even human beings scary, though.
Do they really? I mean, I guess they are scared, but… It’s like they know we won’t actually harm them for real, or like… it feels like they’re making light of us. After all, if a crow flies away, we don’t have the wings to chase after it~
Something crows are genuinely terrified of… This reminds me, there was a time before when—
Huh? Master Artist Fushimi, is something wrong?
I may have an idea of what could be a natural enemy to crows.
One week later. In Seisoukan Dorm’s Courtyard…
Woah, amazing! The crows keep flying away the more the hawk chases after them…!
It’s really well-trained, it flies back as soon as it hears the falconer’s order~ Oh! It’s flying out again!
Falconry is pretty impressive, isn’t it? But my, I’m surprised Yuzuru-chan thought up this idea.
The Himemiya Family had once exchanged contact with a certain family, and was then invited to one of their banquets. The performance for that banquet was a falconry. I remembered that during the banquet, the falconer mentioned that they were recently taking on various jobs, from performances to prevention of harmful birds. And so, through the Himemiya Family, I inquired if they could take on this task for us.
So the crows won’t come here anymore?
Yes. Based on what they have informed me, falconry is extremely effective against harmful birds. This method also avoids altering the atmosphere of the area.
I bet~ I wouldn’t want the courtyard filled with eyeball balloons and Yuzuru’s drawings.
I am also reluctant to show such things to the Young Master and everyone else in the dormitory.
In any case, I can now freely hang up laundry to dry. Takamine-sama, please feel free to devote yourself to your gardening without restraint, as well.
Guardians of the Garden 6
Location: Seisoukan Dorm Courtyard
Hmhmhmm~ Crispy lettuce and bright red tomatoes~♪1
The falconry yesterday was so cool… People who use hawks are called falconers, I think? I never knew there was a profession like that. I was stressed out by the crows for the past few days, but thanks to the falconer, I can finally grow vegetables with peace of mind.
I worked really hard to grow them all on my own, so it’s pretty depressing that I never got to try a single one. There were some that should have ripened by today, so I hope I get to have a bite today…♪
Ah, here it is. It really was a good idea to plant it here. It’s right at the corner, so it won’t be competing with the other plants for nutrients, and the sun exposure is good. Let’s see… Which one is the reddest right now…?
…………
Mm!? Huh!? But why…!?
Time passes…
Heeey, Takamine~ What’s the matter? You suddenly told us to come to the courtyard… Did something happen?
Ah, Isara-senpai, Master Artist Fushimi, Narukami-senpai… Hello, thank you for your hard work. Um, so… Bad news! The crows are still causing harm…!
The crows are still causing harm…? What do you mean by that, Takamine-sama? Please explain to us in a way we can understand first.
Ah, ermm… I always come to water my mini tomatoes at a specific time, and so I came here to do just that today… The crows are now gone, so I was really excited to finally get to try one of them… But please look here.
Oh my, there isn’t a single ripened red one. There’s plenty on their way there, though.
Yeah, exactly. After the falconry was over yesterday, I definitely spotted about two to three mini tomatoes that’d be ready to eat by the next day. But there isn’t a single one of them here today… That’s why I figured the crows must’ve taken them again.
…………
What about you, Yuzuru? Did your laundry… Or more like, did your hangers get taken again?
No, the laundry remained clean and dry. I have not seen any crows since yesterday, either.
Yeah, I also haven’t seen any today. I don’t get the sense they’re around anymore, even if we checked the area. Was the hawk so scary that they took just the ripened ones and flew away?
No. To crows, an area that has hawks would be a matter of life or death. I think it’s unlikely that it would come for food in a place that it wouldn’t want to be in for even a moment. This is an urban area, not somewhere near the mountains, so I believe there would be plenty of other places for them to find food.
Then, does that mean the one behind my mini tomatoes disappearing isn’t a crow…?
I believe that might be the case.
It wasn’t a crow!? Then who the heck was behind it?
You know as much as I do… I haven’t got a clue, either…
However, there might be a way to pin down the culprit. Fortunately, there seems to be a few tomatoes ready to ripen by tomorrow. Everyone, please listen to what I have planned.
The next morning, in Seisoukan Dorm’s Courtyard once more…
Yawns, morning~… How’s it looking? Are the mini tomatoes still there?
Yes. They were still there when I checked in the early morning.
Up until now, the culprit has been eating only the ripened ones every time. That means they should come to eat it today, too. If we stay hidden here, the culprit should show themselves soon enough.
But who could be behind it? A cat wouldn’t eat tomatoes.
Could it be a dog, then?
If a wild dog slipped in here, that’s a much bigger problem than crows in my opinion. That, or it’s very likely a different kind of bird.
Mm~ I feel like no bird would try to come near here now that a hawk flew around the area~ I mean, the hawk feels like the king of birds, and wouldn’t any bird be scared of it?
Huh? Someone’s come over…
That’s… Hiiro-sama, isn’t it?
Oh yeah, Hiiro-chan’s mentioned before that he usually works out in the morning, so that must be what he’s doing today.
—Ahh!? He just ate one of the tomatoes!?
Woah!? That surprised me…!
Midori-kun, everyone, good morning. What are you all doing behind the bushes? You let out a loud yell all of a sudden, so it startled me.
I can’t believe Amagi-kun was the tomato thief all along…! That’s so awful of you!
Eh? Thief…? What on earth do you mean? I swear to God that I didn’t do any misdeed like that! Please believe me!
Ermm… That’s gonna be hard to do when you were caught red-handed, y’know?
We are talking about the mini tomato you just ate, Hiiro-sama. Those tomatoes were being looked after by Takamine-sama.
Ehhh!? These weren’t wild plants!? I’m sorry! I genuinely thought they grew on their own!
Ahh… So Hiiro-chan thought these grew naturally. Well, I can see how you’d think they’re wild plants, since they were growing in the corner of the courtyard. There isn’t a name plate on them either or anything.
Which means… Amagi was accidentally stealing them ‘cause he got the wrong idea?
Mhm. I’m of course aware that I shouldn’t steal anything from someone’s vegetable field. But I thought these mini tomatoes were wild plants… I didn’t think they’d be Midori-kun’s. I’m sorry, Midori-kun.
Ah, no… I know now that it’s just a misunderstanding, and I’m the one who didn’t plant it in a way that makes it clear that it belongs to me. I’m sorry for the confusion.
Uuu… This was such an unexpected conclusion that I just feel exhausted now…
Fufu. It took twists and turns until we reached the truth, but it seems the case is now closed.
Yes… I’m sorry. I caused such a big fuss…
There’s the saying that “all’s well that ends well”, and both Takamine-sama and Hiiro-sama got to clear up misunderstandings between each other, so I would say this is a good conclusion to end on.
Ah, speaking of ending… Could I have that crow picture you drew, Master Artist Fushimi?
Eh? …Well, I was only going to dispose of it, so I suppose I don’t mind.
Yaaay! ♪ I got off to a really bad start, but if I get to have Master Artist’s latest drawing, then this really might just be an “all’s well that ends well” ending after all…♪

Translation Notes ↑ Midori is singing the ‘Vegetable Dance’ song. The full song can be found in VS★GOURMET; Flood of Customers, Chapter 3, sung by Chiaki, Mayoi, and Raika. Ryuseitai (especially Midori) react to the song in the following chapter.↑ Panna cotta is an Italian dessert. Image and information can be found here.↑ Midori often looks up topics on social media, usually in relation to Chiaki. One example is shown in VS★GOURMET; Flood of Customers, Chapter 4.↑ In 4piece, the ‘Vegetable Dance’ song went viral on social media after Chiaki, Mayoi, and Raika’s singing got broadcasted. Chiaki was also surprised that the song became a hit, since it was made on the spot to overcome his hatred of eggplants. (See: VS★GOURMET; Flood of Customers, Chapter 3 & 4)↑ This might be referencing the specialist shop for kitchen gardens called Potager Garden.↑ Midori often asks for Yuzuru’s art; some recent examples in ES 2nd year are in the cross scout unsafe and in Midori’s WILDLAND mini talk.↑ Yuzuru says 兵法 for “art of war” (referring to Sun Tzu’s military text), but Midori misunderstood it as ヘイホー. This is possibly a reference to Shy Guy from Mario, as it’s the same name they’re called in Japanese.↑ As an extra note; Midori calls Yuzuru gahaku, a respectful title used for artists. On the other hand, Yuzuru typically speaks in humble language, known as kenjougo, and it involves the speaker putting themselves down while respecting others.↑ Midori has expressed this sort of sentiment about his height before; one notable moment is in Hero Show, Chapter 2.↑ I’m not fully certain if this is referencing a real manga, but if it is, one possible reference could be Haikyuu. The volleyball teams Karasuno (crow) and Nekoma (cat) are rivals.

Warning: This story contains suicidal ideation and explicit reference to suicide in Chapter 4 and 5 respectively.
Season: Yumenosaki Era, Summer (June)
Location: Classroom 1-A
zz… zz…♪ …Mmm— H-Huh? Was I asleep?
Good morning, Takamine-kun~♪
Hwa? Aah, umm…?
Fufu, you’re still half-asleep~ Do you know where you are? Or could it be that you don’t remember my name?
No, I remember… You’re my classmate, and everyone’s unique here so… Also my house is a home business, so it’s fundamental to learn people’s names… Um, Shino-kun… Did I sleep through the whole class by any chance…?
That’s right~ And then classes ended with you still sleeping, you sleepyhead. You looked like you were having a good sleep, so I couldn’t get myself to wake you up. But I’m on day duty today, so I can’t go home yet if you’re still around.
You could’ve woken me up then… I-I’m sorry, okay…? Ahh, dammit… I’ve been so tired lately. Ryuseitai’s practice sessions are getting more and more intense… I’m still not used to this idol stuff… Um, Shino-kun… I’ll help you out with your duties as an apology…
Ah, don’t worry~ It’s all done with. I’m usually doing part-time jobs in school, so I’m used to these trivial jobs, and I’m also good at them.
I see… Uuu~ But I really do feel bad for this… Oh, I know, I’ll give you carrots as an apology… I also have asparagus…♪
Huh? Why do you carry around vegetables with you? It’d help with my food expenses though, so I would be happy to take it~♪ (Fufu, whenever Takamine-kun talks, he’s usually mumbling like he’s in a bad mood, and he’s pretty big…) (I thought he was a bit of a scary person at first.) (But when I talked to him, he was surprisingly easy to get along with… like he has a soft-like feel to him…♪)
(Shino-kun really is a good kid… I wonder how you’d have to be raised to turn out this way…) (He’s kind of timid and gets startled over things at the very same time I would, so I feel a connection…)
…Umm, what is it? I feel weird being stared at — You’re good-looking, so it strangely makes my heart beat fast.
Ah— Sorry, people tell me that often… Sometimes I get weird misunderstandings when I look at other people’s bags with yuru-chara plushies attached to them… Fufu… There’s no point in chit-chatting like this, so how about we go home…?
That’s true~ But I have nothing to go home immediately to do. It’s raining heavily outside, right? Us Ra*bits scheduled to have practice on the roof, but had to hold it off in the end. And it’s a scramble to get the indoor practice rooms on rainy days… It looks like we couldn’t get to rent one now. It’s times like these that I feel how tough it is being a frail unit. But I can practice at home. I plan to do some independent training~ The walls are thin at home though, so I can’t really be moving around and singing so loudly.
That so… Ryuseitai’s just finished a big job, so we’re on break now… And if I go home I’ll just be told to help out in the store, so maybe I’ll go somewhere else to kill time… Going to my Basketball Club for practice is also tiring… Maybe I’ll borrow a book from the library room and read it casually…
Oh, you read books too? I didn’t expect that~♪
Well, only sometimes… I like to read books at home rather than going outside… I’m pretty much an introvert, so~♪
Me too~ I like to read books, draw art, look at the stars… I prefer that over sports activities, and I work with hobbies like that better. Ehehe. If you’d like, how about we go to the library together? I just remembered I have a borrowed book that I have to return soon, so I have to go there at some point anyway. But only if it isn’t a bother, of course~♪
It’s not a bother at all… Just looking at you soothes me…♪
Really? That makes me happy~ I’m Ra*bits, so I should be like a little animal who soothes you. Ehehe, bounce bounce~♪ —Wah!?
Watch out! Be careful, okay? It’s raining today, so the floors are easier to slip on…
O-Okay. Ahh, I was this close to falling over… I shouldn’t be frolicking around… Ehehe, thank you for holding me back up. Takamine-kun, you really do have a heroic feel to you…♪
Bind and Unfold 2
Location: Hallway
Here I go~♪ Woosh, sliiidee~♪
Ooh… Shino-kun, you’re amazing… You got a 3.57 meter record.
Yaaay~♪ A new record~!
My turn now, huh… My steps are bigger so I should have an advantage… Sliiide~♪ Ahh nope, I get scared halfway that I’ll trip and immediately stop myself…
Ehehe, Player Takamine reached a record of around 2.3 meters~♪
“Player”…?
My turn now, sliiide~♪ Oh! Did I make a new record again?
Yep… You definitely passed over four meters; I think you may have a natural talent for this…
Ehehe, sliding on the slippery corridor while on the way to the library is really fun. Although at this rate, we won’t reach it.
It’s fine though, isn’t it? It’s not like we’re in a hurry… The book you borrowed won’t be due until a little later too, right…? Besides, this is fun… You think up some great things, Shino-kun…
Fufu, I’m poor, so I usually play games that don’t cost money. Like trying to make mazes in notebooks or braiding my little sister’s hair~♪
That’s amazing… I never know what to do with my time, so I’m envious…
Hey! Don’t play in the corridors!
Eeek…!?
Woah—!? Shino-kun, don’t hide behind me… (Ooh… He’s trembling… What’s wrong…?) (I don’t really get what’s up, but I have to protect him.)
Hmm? Ryuseitai’s Takamine and Ra*bits’… Shino, is it. Don’t play around so much here. It’s gotten slippery from the rain, so you could slip and hurt yourself if you aren’t careful enough. Hmph… I suppose you don’t seem to be actually violating any rule though, so I’ll let it slide this time. The weather report says the rain’s only going to get worse. Instead of fumbling around, go home immediately.
Ah— Alright, got it… Sorry…
There’s no need to apologize. You guys didn’t do anything wrong… Just be more dignified — So incorrigible.
(Ah, he left… What was that about… I think we got scolded for some reason, though…) (I guess he was just warning us not to slip and hurt ourselves… So basically he was worried about us or something…?) (Hmm, but there are other ways to say that, right…?)
…………
Shino-kun…? It’s okay now, the vice president went off somewhere, so…
D-Did he? I’m so glad~ I’m sorry for hiding behind your back… I don’t really know how to deal with Akatsuki members…
I get it… Those people are kind of scary, aren’t they… Although, when you compare that glasses-vice-president to the person who carries a sword or the Karate Club person, he seems weak… But I get nervous just remembering he’s an upperclassman or part of the Student Council… Whenever Morisawa-senpai does something dumb, that person scolds him with a death glare… So even though I haven’t actually done anything wrong, just encountering him makes me think I might get scolded viciously… My big bro is also clever, and they’re pretty similar, so I cower back at encounter…
Ah, so you have an older brother? I’m also an “Onii-chan”~ I have a cute little sister and brother…♪
Ooh, I’m envious of you being the “Onii-chan”… I’m sure you have a warm family…♪
AAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!?!?
…!? Wha—!?
W-What!? There was a weird voice just now, right? A scream…!?
I-I didn’t just hear a scream, wasn’t there also a rumbling sound of something crashing down? Like something heavy fell down! D-Did thunder strike down…?
Bind and Unfold 3
Location: Library Room
E-Excuse me~
Hey, let’s go back Shino-kun, I have a bad feeling about this… This is scary, what’ll we do if it’s some ghost…?
Fufu, you believe in ghosts and such, Takamine-kun?
Uuu… Of course not, but it being scary or not is a different story… When I was young, I was told if I get picky about food then the Wasteful Ghost will come over, and it’s traumatized me since… My parents or brother would go overboard and start throwing rotten tomatoes at me saying “What a waaaste~♪ What a waaaste~♪”… I hate it, I hate rotten tomatoes…
Oh, I was told something like that by my parents, too. They didn’t throw tomatoes at me though, that would’ve instead been a waste. Fufu, this must be a thing in our area. You live nearby, right?
Yep… In the greengrocers store in the shopping district…
Oh, that’s right. Then I might’ve bought things from there before. But vegetables are usually cheaper when bought from a supermarket, so probably not that many times.
I can’t even respond to that… We can’t win against big companies that can make large amounts of their product and send it all over their branches… Small businesses are so tough…
Ehehe, but from now on I’ll go to you, since it’s your store.
Ah, then I’ll also sell you the average quality vegetables for cheap… Your home isn’t that well off after all… You’re usually nibbling on bread crusts during lunch break…
Oh, that would be a huge help. We’re not so poor to the point of food being a problem, but since my siblings are still growing, I always prefer to use my food expenses on them instead, no matter what. Ah— I ended up chatting away… I shouldn’t be relaxing like this.
I ended up doing the same too… It’s easy to talk to you, so it just happened on its own…
Really? That’s the first time I’ve been told that~ Since I’m bad at talking, you see~♪
AGHHHHHHHH!?!?
Eeek!? T-There’s that scream again…!
Mmm… W-We really weren’t imagining it then. It’s still scary, but it was the right choice to check what’s going on. If there’s a scream, then it must mean someone’s in trouble, right? I don’t really know what happened, but we have to save them.
You’re right about that… Ermm, where did the scream come from…? There’s thunder loudly booming outside so I can’t really tell…
Hmm… It has to be in the library though. But I don’t see anyone here, do you?
Shino-kun, can’t you follow the trail of the sound…? You’re a rabbit after all, right…?
Eh? Well I am in Ra*bits, but I don’t have ears as good as one… But I’m fairly good with scents, maybe I can trail it through smell like a doggie? (Sniff, sniff)… Oh! I smell vegetables from you.
Ahh, that’s because I have them with me as emergency snacks… I’m still annoyingly growing up so I can get hungry easily… Would you like to eat a carrot, Shino-kun…?
Fufu, you really do think of me as a real rabbit, don’t you?
Umm… Sorry for interrupting your fun chatter, but pleeease help me.
Wah… Is that you, Aoba-senpai?
Is it someone you know…?
Ahh, um, he’s the library committee member. He’s usually there whenever I go to the library, and he sometimes helps me out in finding books, so that’s how I’ve talked to him before. Umm, Aoba-senpai, what happened? Those screams that we heard… Were they you…?
Uuu… That voice is Hajime-kun, right? P-Please lend me a hand!
I’d love to but… Umm, Aoba-senpai, where exactly are you? I can hear your voice, but I don’t see you, you know~?
Ah, I think its somewhere here… Look, there’s books scattered about…
Ah, you’re right! Aoba-senpai~ Are you here?
…………
Eugh, somebody died… Don’t look, Shino-kun…
Wha? Huh? Why? I don’t like my eyes covered~!
I-I’m more or less alive~ Hello Hajime-kun, and…?
Ah, hello… I’m Takamine, in the same class as Shino-kun… Erm, Aoba-senpai, right? What are you doing over there…? From what I can see, it seems you got flattened down by the collapsed bookcases…?
Yes, that’s exactly what happened~!! Please help me! They all fell down one after the other like dominoes, I couldn’t move away fast enough! I dreaded I might die buried alive like this… Ahh, how unlucky… Is it all because I lent my lucky item to Rei-kun?
Bind and Unfold 4
Warning: Suicidal ideation in this chapter.
Ahhh, you really saved me! It really is good to have kind juniors~♪
I’m really glad you’re safe~ But why were you trampled down by bookcases? Takamine-kun had the physical strength to make it through, but I would have never been able to help you out of there if I were on my own. I don’t really understand how this happened, but please be more careful, okay?
I got scolded by my junior…! Ughh, it’s not like I like being trampled by bookcases either! I was organizing the bookcases as part of my duty as a committee member. During these times, the old books get moldy from the rain, so I was carrying all the valuable old books down to the underground archive where the humidity level is adjusted for preservation purposes. In their place, I’d carry up books from the archive to put them in the blank spots of the bookcase. In other words I’m, well, swapping books. It’s tough doing this when there aren’t enough committee members.
Um, before that, what is the underground archive?
Ahh, there’s something like a library downstairs. I also only learnt about it when a friend told me in my first year. And because it’s underground, nowadays it has old books you can’t get a hold of, and there’s even prohibited-looking books collected from somewhere by Natsume-kun in there. It’s pretty interesting. If you’re ever interested, I’ll show you around sometime. But right now I don’t have my glasses and I can’t really see well. Just walking is difficult, so I can’t do it now.
Ah… Now that you mention it, you really aren’t wearing your glasses today. The impression you give off changes dramatically, you look like an elite from a prestigious school~♪
Yeah, you look like my big bro…
Huh? In what way are you seeing me? I haven’t looked at myself in the mirror without glasses for a while, so I really don’t remember how I looked without them!
Fufu, you look cool~ I think you look more superb without glasses~♪
Is that so? Ooh, you youngsters are making me blush! But my glasses are my lucky item, so I don’t usually want to take them off, you know~?
Fufu. You really like things like fortune-telling, lucky charms, and Buddhist prayers, right? Even your book cover is somewhat mandala-patterned.
Ahh, I got that from a friend long ago. It’s worn out by now, but it’s something that has memories to it, so I can’t get myself to throw it away.
I know what you mean~ I dried up a flower I received from Tomoya-kun and now use it as a bookmark. Tomoya-kun saw it when he came to my house a few days ago, and I got pretty embarrassed… He didn’t seem to remember the flower, though.
I think the conversation went way off track… Um, Aoba-senpai, like we asked, why were you trampled by bookcases…? I feel uneasy not knowing the answer to things like that, so…
Ahh, sorry. Erm, like I said, I was organizing books. I lent my glasses to a friend for a little while, or well, midway at work they were taken away from me… So I couldn’t see very well and, um, an accident happened. I lost my balance on the stepladder and collapsed on the bookcase… The impact made it tip back over to me, like the bookcase was saying “it’s my turn now” as it toppled over me. Ahh, I really thought I was going to die… And today’s been raining heavily, so everyone’s already gone home or something — No matter how many times I yelled for help no one came over. I was this close to thinking about giving up on this world and finding happiness in the next lifetime. Not that there’s any proof that you can be reborn again, though~ Even if I did reincarnate, I’d probably be a bug or something. I’ve committed many sins, after all.
Hey! What’s all this fuss about!?
Hiiahhh!? D-D-D-Don’t scare me like that, Keito-kun! …It is you, right? I can’t see well so I’m not sure! You aren’t some thunder, right? Even though I heard an explosive rumbling sound!?
Aoba. …What happened to your glasses?
Ahh, I ended up lending them to Rei-kun. He was saying something like he was bored because of the rain, so I suggested he borrow some books. But it seems like he couldn’t read small text, so he just took my glasses with him.
That’s unfortunate. So that vampire is causing trouble to people as always, huh… I was even thinking he was finally being more considerate to his surroundings, but people don’t change that easily, it seems. Well, it’s fine. Wait here a bit, Aoba. I’ve been keeping some spare glasses in the Student Council office, so I’ll bring them over. What’s your eyesight?
Hmm… I’m not sure. I haven’t done an eye test in a while, so I don’t know.
Hmph. If you have time to go to a fortune-teller or a medium for weird consultations, then at least go get an eye test, too. You are absolutely beyond help.
Bind and Unfold 5
Warning: Explicit suicide reference in this chapter.
I’m back. Now then, choose any glasses you like.
Ehehe, how’s it looking, Takamine-kun? I think I got it to look cute~♪
Uh, don’t expect me to be able to judge aesthetically… I have no idea… I feel like hairstyles can be as whatever…?
…Exactly what are you people doing?
Ah, welcome back Keito-kuuun! You were really quick, just like you said you’d be!
What’s this all about, Aoba? If I’m seeing this right, it appears that your junior is fiddling with your hair…? If you don’t like it, then say so. Why are you being so timid?
Ahh, please spare me the lecture. I’m aware I’m hopeless, but if I’m constantly being told that I’ll definitely get mopey about it. Besides, it isn’t like I don’t like it~ When I complained about my hair suffocating me from the humidity of the rain, he said he’d tie it up for me. And then I ended up letting him do as he likes. I can’t do my work anyway since I can’t see anything without glasses, so I thought of taking a break while waiting for you~
I’ve said this far too many times, but if your hair irritates you, then get a haircut.
And I keep telling you that no can do, it’s part of a Buddhist prayer so I can’t cut it. Though, during rainy days, it starts curling up from the humidity and feels ticklish on my skin.
I know what you mean~ I also can’t cut my hair due to how Ra*bits works, but during these days it’s really humid, so combing my hair is tricky.
Ah, a buddy! Handshake~♪ Although I think your hairstyle suits you perfectly, so it’s fine as it is. But for me it doesn’t seem like it suits me, doesn’t have a single advantage, and only causes a great deal of pain~ Even Natsume-kun often gets angry at me for it.
I think it’s best to do your hair as you like though… Summer’s coming soon, so if you keep it long, it’ll probably get all the more suffocating…
Fufu. Well, having long hair has its benefits too. Whenever my sister wants to do a new hairstyle, she attempts it on my hair first. Maybe it’s to release stress, but she usually makes it into an endless braid. She likes my hair a lot, saying “Onii-chan, don’t cut it!” But my little brother says I look like a girl with long hair… He’s too embarrassed about it, and we no longer have baths together.
Ahaha, not that it matters too much, but you fiddling with my hair while we talk makes it feel like we really are in a barbershop~♪
Is that so? What would you like your hairstyle to be, mister? Would you like a bit of trimming~? Just kidding~♪
…Well, isn’t it nice that you’re all having fun.
Ah, I’m sorry… I shouldn’t be making noise in the library, I’ll reflect on it.
So long as you understand it’s fine. There isn’t anyone else here for the library, so I’ll overlook it this time… You don’t have to be so obedient about it, Shino.
Ah, alright. Umm, so you know who I am? I thought the vice president, a person from Akatsuki, wouldn’t be interested in who we were.
…Don’t give me that ill-mannered tone. Hmph. So you have more backbone than you look, in fact I’d say it makes it a good thing about you. If you’re going to snarl at me then you’re on, come at me whenever.
…………
Ahaha, don’t make him all tense pleeease, this is a place to enjoy books peacefully.
That’s true… That aside, you have work to do as the library committee member, don’t you? I basically finished my duties for the Student Council, so I’ll help out if you want.
Eh, are you sure? It’d be a huge help, thank you Keito-kun~♪
Don’t thank me. I was originally a committee member, but then threw that duty onto you, and you ended up fumbling about on your own from then on. I feel a little bad about that. Let me make up for it at least, or else I won’t feel like I can move on.
Fufu. There’s a lot of implications behind your words… I need better reading comprehension for this~ You troublesome person.
That’s just how I am. I can’t change this late in.
…That aside, Aoba, choose your glasses. I’ve brought frames that would suit you, and the lens come in variety, so adjusting the strength should be possible.
Waaah, I’m sincerely, extremely saved by this. Why do you have so many kinds of glasses with you? As always, you love glasses, don’t you, Keito-kun~♪
Well, I’m the type that, when I get attached to something, I pursue it to the end. If I had inherited the temple like normal, I would’ve probably become a monk who practices austerity.1
Ahaha, nothing happens once you die~ So please live as long as you can, okay? I’ll try to do that too, as much as I’m allowed to. But well, if it ever ends up seeming impossible, I’ll put my hope on the afterlife and hang myself!
There’s no such thing as reincarnation, or at least I don’t accept that idea. You work hard in this lifetime. If you live on, you get to have your hair tied up by your cute junior, and other things too… There’s surely good to living, you know?
Bind and Unfold 6
Location: Underground Archive
Here I go, Vice President-san~ I’ll put the books from the higher areas down there. It’s a dictionary, so it’s pretty heavy, and my arms might get wobbly… I apologize if I lose my grip.
Hm, alright, go for it. I’ll hold onto the stepladder you’re climbing. Be careful. There’s no need to rush, so just do it slowly.
Yes! Alright then, heave-ho…☆
Ghfff!?
Ahh— I-I-I-I’m so sorry!! It landed directly on your face! Are you okay!?
…Did you do that on purpose? Do you really hate me that much?
A-Absolutely not! There’s been thunder crashing down for a while now, and every time it happens I jump!
Want to change places, Shino-kun…?
Ah, I’m fine, the bookcases around here are in a complicated layout… So no one but me can enter these cracks — or rather, reach the books we’d need. Fufu, since everyone’s really well-built here. That must be so nice… I want to grow bigger too, but I can’t really build up the muscle. I really do have to start eating better food for this, don’t I?
I wouldn’t say you’re that small, though… Aren’t you the most well-built out of all of Ra*bits…?
No, no~ Everyone’s surprisingly tall in the unit, so I’m the second shortest. And if I get bigger I think I wouldn’t be as cute…? It wouldn’t be Ra*bits-like…? That’s what I think at least, but we’re all in our growing periods, so…♪
Hey, quit blabbering about and move your hands.
Ahh, I’m so sorry!
You shouldn’t nag about everything, Keito-kun~ You can help to the best that you can, okay? This is primarily my job, so just having everyone help me out is… It’d make me feel bad if you overdo yourself.
No no, I’ll do my very best! Ehehe, I owe you a lot, and I doubt I can go home because of the heavy rain, so… I’ll pass the time here until the rain fades.
If it’s passing time you want, then that’s exactly why it’s better to read some books… You really are a good boy, Hajime-kun.
Fufu. I feel like I’m holding people back and only being a bother, though.
Not at all, you’re really helping me out here~ If I can finish organizing the underground archive, it’ll be one thing done with. This place isn’t like upstairs and hadn’t been touched, so it’s been an enormous amount of work. Natsume-kun did as he pleased and made it sound-proof… So you can play some music, or be noisy to an extent, so long as you make all the bookcases fixed in their place. That’s why, I’ve always thought about letting kids who can’t borrow a lesson room come here instead whenever there’s heavy rain. And so that I can do that, I’m taking all the valuable books to the Secret Room. I don’t think anyone will steal them, but it’s just in case. There’s really no reason to rush, so please take your time.
Ahh, if you can make this room a place to practice that’d be helpful. A frail unit like us can never rent practice rooms… So we end up having a massive amount of free time on days like these.
Huh, so you’ve thought of something like that, Aoba.
Eh? Is this possibly something I shouldn’t do without permission?
Well, normally you should be getting permission. If you report it to us we’ll accept it. Lately the academy’s been very lively with activities, and the insufficient amount of practice rooms and other has been a problem, so this is good timing. This is only a suggestion, but you could make it so that as a reward for helping out with the library work, people can then use the underground archive as a practice room. Your problem will be resolved in a swipe. How about it?
You’re all about efficiency, aren’t you~ Alright then, I’ll write the document with that notion. But before that, I should at least get things done with to the barest minimum. With the speed it’s going, I’ll be done by dawn after an all-nighter.
Go home when you’re meant to. …The same goes for you two. If the rain doesn’t stop, I’ll prepare a car and force you to go home. If I ask my brother, he should bring a car over.
Your family’s car isn’t a hearse or something, right?
We have a normal car, too. We have a lot of work at the temple that needs us to go around everywhere, so my brother put the benefit and the interest for cars together, and started collecting vehicles. Kiryuu saw his motorbike and was incredibly impressed.
Hmm, your brother does seem the type to like that stuff. But I’m kind of bad at dealing with him~ He starts lecturing me whenever we meet. Though, well, you were like that in the past, too.
It’s because I can’t exorcise your darkness, since I’m a novice. I still need more training.
Bind and Unfold 7 Umm… I have a small question; this book has a sequel, right…? I really liked this story when I was young, so I want to read it after so long…
Which book? Ahh… I’m sorry to say this, but… the author of that book passed away, so it’s forever a discontinued series. I read it before too; it ended right at a really good part, didn’t it? I really get how you feel about wanting to know what happens next. Ah— But there’s a fan work by a fan of the story who wrote their own sequel, and I know just where it is. I think that fan was as curious as you and ended up writing it. Keito-kun, Keito-kun, that book… Do you have the books by Mizuhanome-sensei around with you?
I almost want to say that I burnt them, but it’s probably somewhere in the storage room if I were to look for it. I’m warning you now though, it’s nothing compared to the original. Just an amateur fan work… It’s nothing interesting.
Fufu, I thought it was really well written, though~ I liked it.
I’m not satisfied with it. Mizuhanome-sensei thought it would be impossible to convey the original author’s world view in a manga, so they uncharacteristically put together a text-only work instead, but… It just went to show how inexperienced they were as a writer, and that they’d been using their art to compensate for it.2 I got a lot of advice from you on how to write… Aoba.
…? Mmm, I got mixed in with some conversation…?
Don’t worry about it. It has nothing to do with you, it’s only a story of the past.
Fufu, you see Takamine-kun, Keito-kun may not look it, but he really likes to think up stories—
Aoba! Stop saying needless things!
Ahaha, you don’t have to be so flustered~♪
You really make me want to punch you sometimes. No wonder you were Eichi’s biggest friend; you even rub me the wrong way just like him. You better come over to my temple once for training, that way I can beat you up without needing to hold back.
I don’t like being hurt~ I keep telling you I’m not an animal, so you don’t have to hurt me for me to understand. Just words would be enough.
Hmph, anything said to you is just wasted effort.
Ehehe, you two get along well~ I didn’t expect it.
That’s how you see it? As you can see, this guy’s the type you can’t leave alone, so I end up severely lecturing him, that’s all. We’re absolutely not friends.
Ehh~ We’re friends though, aren’t we? We were both bookworms since long back, and ended up meeting each other often in the library, and that’s how we ended up talking. We even lent each other our favorite books and stuff. If only I could have aaalways had friendships that were easy-going like that but… Life doesn’t go as you always want it to, does it?
That’s why I think it’s interesting. That’s how I’ve started to think lately.
I can feel the implications behind all that~ Ehehe, even though we’re only a few years apart… Third years really do have a mature feel to them.
We’re only putting up a front, you know~? We’re all just sensitive delicate teenagers, after all. Don’t think of us as adults who can take in anything; please go easy on us too, okay?
Don’t say something so pathetic. Shino, it’s fine, alright? If you ever have anything to say, go ahead and say it. Even if it’s hostile or hatred, feel free to hit it at us. Although I’d rather you don’t hit me with a book. I’ll die if you hit a critical spot, and the book might dent, too. You’re so damn rash.
Like I said, that wasn’t on purpose, really! …I-I’ll be okay next time! I’ll do my best, I’ll definitely do it right! Here I go~ Heave-ho! ☆
Oh, you did it perfectly this time, good job, good job~♪
Shino-kun’s a real hard-worker… Umm, I’ll do some work too… I look like I’m the only one who’s slacking off while everyone’s doing their best… It feels all wrong…
Fufu, alright then, please help me out a bit. We’re going to be pasting barcode labels onto old book collections.
Ah, I kind of like doing small work like that…♪
I thought so~ Just because you’re well-built doesn’t mean I should assume you like manual labor, right? Ah, that’s right… I’m changing the subject but… I just remembered Natsume-kun asked me to think about a live show that’s enticing exactly because it’s on a rainy day. It’s fine if you keep working, but if it’s alright, I’d love to think up ideas with you all. If you think up something that can be used as material, then telling me about it is good enough. Three people together have the wisdom of Manjushri, so with four people, we’ll think up something even greater.3
By the way, Manjushri is a bodhisattva that governs wisdom—
Ah, we really don’t need that kind of trivia~ I’m sure we’d all love to talk more, but talking around so many books might make the mold and dust get in your trachea and hurt your throat. That’s why I didn’t want help from idols, since it might be a problem to have that happen… But I was lonely all by myself too, so I’m a little conflicted with my feelings. But it’s more or less a happy feeling, so I want to think this was the right choice.
Epilogue Alright, we sorted most of it out.
Great work~ You really are amazing at this, Keito-kun. Ahh, I’m sooo thankful for all the help.
Hmph. You don’t have to keep thanking us. It’s my duty to assist, that’s all. We killed enough time until the rain showers passed, and I got to move around without needless thoughts for once, so I also feel thankful. I have to think a lot when doing my Student Council work, and I’m the vice president so I can’t be shoddy with my work. But since the library work is your job, even if I do make a mistake it’ll be under your responsibility in the end.
Wha— You’re cruel! Are you saying you don’t care what happens to me!?
If I did, I would’ve never helped you in the first place… If you need it, I’ll give the library committee some budget and get some new members. Do you?
Oh, no~ Actually, other than a special job like this, I usually have way too much free time, so it’s enough with only me more or less. Most of the big work that used to be for the committee was taken by the Student Council, anyway. Like managing the budget of the school’s funds like a bank, or the supervision over the school’s social media. Next year onward, the library will be like a sub-section of the Student Council and merge with them, right? So until then I’m here. I’ll make sure to make it possible to hand it over in a way that won’t let our juniors suffer, so please do help me out on that, Keito-kun. Thank you so much for today.
Like I said, stop thanking me… Hm?
Oh, Anzu-chan! Good evening~ Do you have something you need at the archive? You want to borrow books or materials? You’ve come at the right time~ I just finished organizing the books~♪ What kind of book are you looking for? —Wh—AHH!?
That was close! Please be careful, Aoba-senpai…
I-I’m sorry. I was this close to falling down… I’m not used to these glasses so my perception is all wobbly…
Do you have a problem with the glasses I lent you?
Nooo, that isn’t what I—… Wait, Takamine-kun, what are you doing sitting down here? If you aren’t feeling well, I’ll help you to the infirmary, okay?
Ah, no, I’m used to labor work, so I’m feeling alright, but… It looks like Shino-kun got so tired out he ended up sleeping…
zzzzz…♪
See… He’s sound asleep while leaning right on my shoulder, so I can’t move… Sorry, I tried to help since I wasn’t doing anything, but… One of the books I picked up looked interesting and I ended up reading it only to sleep midway into it, and I ended up being no help at all…
Ahaha, it’s fine~ It’s the thought that counts. I’m happy with that, enough for tears to come out. You’re all still kids after all, I’m not asking for end results.
Please don’t treat me like a kid, our age doesn’t differ that much… But I guess I can’t say anything when this is how things turned out… C’mon, Shino-kun, wake up… It’s dark outside, we should be going home now…
Mm~ (fumble)…… (nibble nibble) ♪
Ughh, don’t eat my uniform… Eh, I’m going to keep getting bigger and need to buy a change of uniform anyway, so I guess it’s fine…
Fufu, you two get along~ I’m jealous.
Hey, you left the transfer student hanging; respond back properly.
Aahh…? I’m sorry about that, so what really brought you here… Anzu-chan? Eh— You brought back my glasses? I see… Looks like stuff happened on that side. So Rei-kun lost my glasses, and tried to look for them all over school? Then he finally found them, but he was up all day so he got tired and ended up sleeping in his coffin… And as substitute, you came to bring back the glasses instead, right? It really would’ve been fine if you had given them to Rei-kun… But that person surprisingly gets worried over things like this, huh. Fufu, yes, I got them. It’s been a while, my glasses~♪
Hold on Aoba, you’re already wearing glasses, so don’t try to put another pair on top of them. The frames will get damaged, and the lens will get scratched up, too.
Glasses this, glasses that, so annoying~ Mmh… My glasses are a bit dirty, so until I clean them up, I’ll wear the glasses I borrowed from you, Keito-kun. Since the friendship I feel from you is warm and makes me happy.
Hm… You’ve said a prayer with those glasses, right? It’s unusual of you to keep aside your “lucky charm” like that. What’s with this change of mind, Aoba?
I’m changing too, bit by bit, you know? Changing ever so slowly alongside this academy… And I’m deeply hoping this change will be a good thing. I can’t stay as I was in the past, but I’m a dunce so I’m not changing all that well either… But this should be much more delightful than halting myself in one place. There’s no such thing as a rain shower that won’t stop, and if it rains, then you also get to see a lovely rainbow. I look forward to things like that and hope that they’ll be that way, and so… Today, tomorrow, and even the day after, I’ll keep living.
format_size
Translation Notes ↑ Specifically, a monk who practices austerity to the point of death and mummification.↑ Keito doesn’t use any pronouns when talking about the fan work author until he says the next line with “I”. But in English, I needed to add a pronoun and went with “they”.↑ i.e two heads are better than one.
