entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] 2026 Shinobu Sengoku Birthday
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Era
ES!! 2026 (18 years old Shinobu)
Birthday Quote
Day 1 Thank you for the birthday wishes! This is always such a special day to me, thanks to everyone celebrating my birthday~♪
Day 2 I’m ever so grateful that my lord came to see me~♪ I hope to work together with you today, as well!
Day 3 Yaaay, you came to see me again! I’m so happy I got to greet my lord today, too~♪
Birthday Party Stream Preparing for the Birthday Party Stream
I’m so thrilled that the both of you agreed to appear as guests for my stream today…! It made me so happy~♪
Of course I would! It’s your birthday, Sengoku! ☆
Yeah. Although… I can see why you’d ask Morisawa, as he’s in your unit, but why did you ask me to join?
The truth is, I had already decided that I’d request this from the first person outside of Ryuseitai who sends me birthday wishes.
And I just so happened to fit that exact criteria, huh? This is a wonderful opportunity for the both of us, so I’ll make sure to fulfill my role as a guest.
I very much appreciate that! I’d love your help in bringing smiles to everyone who’ll be coming to celebrate my birthday~♪
Start of the Birthday Party Stream
“Thank you all for coming to my birthday stream~♪” “I’m so happy that there’s this many people here to celebrate my birthday!”
“…Ahh, right! I have called over for some special guests today, in hopes of making this more enjoyable to everyone here!” “Can you guess who those guests may be?”
“Fu fu fu. I will not give the answer just yet, so please look forward to the stream while making your guesses~♪”
During the Birthday Party Stream 1
“Tadaaah~! ☆ The first guest is Hasumi-dono!”
“I’m Hasumi Keito, from Akatsuki. Happy birthday, Sengoku.”
“Yaaay~♪ Did you know? Hasumi-dono sent me a happy birthday message as soon as it became my birthday!”
“I just happened to realize it was your birthday today, that’s all. I didn’t expect you to reply back immediately, though.”
“I was waiting in anticipation, knowing I’d get messages from everyone. There were other people who also sent me birthday wishes afterwards~♪”
“Hm, that’s all because of the type of person you are, Sengoku. I should also learn more from you.”
During the Birthday Party Stream 2 “To everyone watching! Let’s say happy birthday to Sengoku one more time, together!”
“Three, two, one… Sengoku, happy birthday…☆”
“T-This is a little embarrassing, but… I’m very grateful that you’re here today, Morisawa-dono!”
“Of course I’d come rushing to my precious comrade’s birthday! ☆ I’m so happy I get to celebrate your day like this!”
“The comments are overflowing with birthday wishes to you, too. It really shows that you’re loved by so many people, Sengoku.”
“Fufu, that makes me so happy to hear. I’m ever so grateful…♪”
During the Birthday Party Stream 3 “It is about time this live stream comes to an end.”
“I feel a little lonely ending it here, though. Time flies by so fast when you’re having fun.” “Of course, it goes without saying that I’m grateful to all of you viewers, but I am also just as grateful to our guests, Hasumi-dono and Morisawa-dono. It is thanks to them that this stream ended with lots of fun.”
“Ahh, right! Please do post your thoughts about my quiz on social media!” “I shall be checking just how well everyone knows me…♪”
Birthday Work
Shinobu’s Work lines during his birthday! (GOOD) I truly hope you enjoy my birthday stream! (GOOD) I’m so happy you came to celebrate my birthday!
(GREAT) I plan to do ninja poses, as well~♪ (GREAT) Everyone’s desires to celebrate my birthday reach all the way over here!

entry.title: [Yumenosaki Era] 2016-2019 Tetora Nagumo Birthday
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Era
ES! (2016–2019) (16 years old Tetora)
Birthday Quote 2016 Today’s my birthday! It’d make me real happy to celebrate my birthday with you, Transfer Student-san! ♪
2017 Waah! You’ll celebrate my birthday!? Kuuuh, I’m so happy! I’m so deeply moved…!
2018 Ossu! Thank you for celebrating my birthday! I think I’ve gotten a li’l closer to becoming a man among men!
2019 Is this present for me!? Thank you so much! I’m so happy to get a present from you, Anego~!
Birthday Greeting Alrighty, I’m all pumped now! I’m gonna keep working harder and harder to boost my "man among men" level~! ☆
Birthday Course 1/3
Ah, Transfer Student-san! ‘Suup~☆ Look, I got presents from Midori-kun and Sengoku-kun~♪ Ossu! Today’s my birthday!
What did you get?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Umm, I got a yuru-chara cushion called "Kalbidon" from Midori-kun… And a treasured ninja scroll…? From Sengoku-kun! Ahaha, they both picked stuff they like! But I’m super happy~♪
I got different stuff from ‘em… Oh! This kalbi beef bowl is also their treat! They ordered a big meal just for my sake… Taisho’s lunch boxes are always tasty, but nothing beats a kalbi beef bowl~♪
Happy birthday.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Thank you, Transfer Student-san! I’m so happy to hear it from ya~♪ Ahaha, Midori-kun and Sengoku-kun look envious~ Birthdays are so nice! It feels like you’re the main character…☆
Ooh…! ☆ I’m happy to hear that from you, Transfer Student-san! Mm~ It feels different from when a friend says it to me. How so, you ask? …I’ll keep that a secret, if that’s okay~♪
2/3
Woah, woah, hold on!! Midori-kun and Sengoku-kun told me that we have Ryuseitai activities after classes, so I came here, but…
Umm… What’s this ‘bout? "Today’s protagonist"…?
Your birthday isn’t over yet.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Woah!? I hear a familiar laugh!? Ah, it really is Taichou… And Shinkai-senpai, too!? Why’s everyone saying their catchphrases!? No, this isn’t the time to be dumbfounded! Ossu! I gotta put my all in my catchphrase, too!
That was a lie, it’s actually a birthday party…? T-Then this was all planned… Wait, were you in on it, too, Transfer Student-san!? Uu~myu, I didn’t notice at all… Everyone’s way too good at acting!
Once again, happy birthday!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Huh? You said happy birthday to me during lunch already, though…? …That was just to let my guard down? Y-You got me! Ahh, everybody got me good~! Ossu! Thank you, everyone! I’m super moved to have a party like this! ☆
Woah, you surprised me! You even got party poppers? Mm? I’m more calm than you expected? Hehe, maybe it’s ‘cuz I’ve been training well…♪ Taisho’s always tellin’ me to stay calm, after all~
3/3
Thank you so much, Transfer Student-san! I heard that you were the one who planned most of this! We all had such a blast! I got to have the best birthday ever~! ☆ Like, I dunno… I even feel like I got one step closer to becoming a man among men!
Yeah, for sure.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Heheh, so you see it that way too, Transfer Student-san…♪ I’m gonna keep doing my absolute best, not only as a man but as an idol too! So that I can grow and become reliable! So please keep watching me, always and forever…☆
Ooh, you can tell, Transfer Student-san!? Ooohh, I’m so fired up now! I’m gonna improve myself to become more manly! I’ll challenge myself with a new workout plan… And maybe carrots, too~… Actually, I think I’ll do that when I feel like it. That’s fine, right?
I’m so glad.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Kuuh~! I’m so happy, I’m shedding manly tears… Woah!? T-Taichou! Don’t hug me outta nowhere!
Wait, why’re you crying…? Gosh… You’re such a handful, aren’tcha~?
Ossu! I want Taisho to see how much I’ve grown, too—… Mm?
Taisho…!? Huh, huh!? Why’s a Taisho-looking guy here!? Waah, waah, it’s the real thing! Ahhh, you guys wanna make this the best day of my life that badly, don’tcha~!?
Birthday Story Chiaki Uu… Uuu… You’ve grown so much, Nagumo! I’m so emotional…! Ah, um, I know you’re still growing. But I got hit with emotion when I imagined how much more you’re going to grow! I see it before my eyes! Your figure in the future…! You’re shining bright and looking reliable alongside Sengoku and Takamine…☆ Oh! Don’t turn away with a stunned look! Hahaha! ♪ I won’t let you get away~ Happy birthday, Nagumo! Let me hug you lots as celebration! Squeeze squeeze~☆
Midori Happy birthday, Nagumo-kun. Did you like the Kalbidon cushion I gave you…? It’s like this kalbi beef bowl yuru-chara was made just for you… I’m glad I found it, because it made it easy to choose a present for you… Hm? It’s nice for hugging? Mhm, isn’t it, isn’t it? And the wobbly feel to its face, and how you can’t tell which part of it is meant to be like a kalbi bowl is amazing…☆ Heheheh, I’d be so happy if this cushion gets you more into yuru-chara…♪
Shinobu Tetora-kuuun! Happy birthday~♪ You celebrated my birthday the other day, remember? I have been so excited for this day ever since! I was so, so happy when everyone celebrated my birthday… So I wanted to, um… celebrate m-my precious comrade’s birthday too… I was worried getting too into it would not work out well, but… Did it make you happy? Ehehe, that is wonderful news. I hope we continue to get along with each other, Tetora-kun…♪
Kanata happy [birthday], tetora. good boy, good boy…♪ oh? do you not [like] people patting your head? ah, so you do not like being [treated] like a [child]. you have become an [adult] now, even though you are still just a [child], fufufu…♪ i am not making [fun] of you~ i think it is just fine that you are like that, it is just like [you]. ufufu, you did not like me [treating] you like a [child] when you have grown a year older, yes? then let’s [shake hands] instead. let’s keep getting along, okay~…♪
Kuro Yo, Tetsu. I see you’re havin’ a great time. Li’l Lady told me that they’ll hold a birthday party for you, and I was gonna come over to it like everyone else, but then Morisawa told me to wait ‘til he gives me the signal, so… I guess they made me join the party in a really flashy way, but… was it really alright for someone like me to be the surprise guest? Ohh? So you were okay with it, huh… Aight, I won’t say anythin’ else if you’re that sure ‘bout it. Haha, as long as you’re happy, Tetsu. Happy birthday…♪
Tomoya Tetora, happy birthday~♪ It’s pretty festive here with your seniors around. I’m really glad I got to come to a party this lively. I should’ve given it to you earlier, since I bet you have a ton of them by now, but… Um, Hajime and I also got you a present. Could you take it? Yep, it’s a bento box. You looked like the type with a big appetite, so we thought you may need a bigger one. Tell the senior who makes bentos for you to make your portions bigger, too~♪
Hajime Happy birthday, Tetora-kun. I’m so, so happy I got to celebrate a friend’s birthday like this~♪ Wawa, please don’t bow your head down~! I-I want to thank you for everything, too! …Heheh~♪ That’s right, both you and I speak politely, don’t we? I feel more relaxed speaking politely, but what about you, Tetora-kun? Hehe, I thought so. I think you’re fine just like that…♪ Talking like this doesn’t mean we’re trying to be distant, after all. Let’s keep getting along, please~♪
Hinata Hyahoo~! ☆ Happy birthday, Tetsu-kun! Ahaha, whoops, I jumped on you hard! Hmm? I’m too excited? Of course I am, it’s your birthday! Tetsu-kun’s mooom~ Thanks for giving birth to Tetsu-kun~☆ Let’s hype things up even more! How about a match between us two? If we have one with a game you might end up losing hardcore and being sad on your birthday, so we could have one with our fists for today! Heh heh heh… You gotta beat me first if you wanna be a man among men…… Just kidding~♪
Birthday Present
When gifting Tetora a flower box… Anzu-anego, thank you so much! Hehe! ♪ I don’t really get flowers often, so it’s a li’l embarrassing~ But it means a lot to me to get flowers from you, Anego. I’ll cherish ‘em!
Birthday Cake
Chocolate Cake (HAPPY)
There’s chocolate all over my mouth? Ahaha, I ate it all up ‘cuz it was so tasty. This is pretty embarrassing, please don’t look~!
Fruit Tart (GOOD)
You made this too, Anego? Impressive as always! I really respect you~♪
Shortcake (OK)
I could make this too since it’s a shortcake, right? I mean, it’s not like this could turn charred black, yeah?
Birthday Motion
Birthday Skill: Today is Tetora’s birthday. Chasing after the back of the senior he admires, “I’ll do my best with all my energy today, too!” Birthday Story Directory

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 1] 2020 Tetora Nagumo Birthday
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
Yuumasu
Translation
310mc
Era
ES!! 2020 (17 years old Tetora)
Birthday Quote
You remembered my birthday, Producer!? ♪ Ossu, I’m so thankful! I’ll be sure to become a strong man and show just how much I’ve grown…!
Party at the Agency 1/3
Thank you for makin’ a birthday party for me, Producer! Um, you put a lotta effort into this party, but… You must be real busy with your producer work, so are you sure everything’s okay with the preparations?
Don’t worry about it.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Gotcha. If that’s what you say, Producer… —Wait, you just yawned! I saw it! You haven’t been gettin’ enough sleep…! Please make sure to rest properly tonight!
No, please let me help out with preparations for the next birthday party! I’m good at manual labor. I can easily carry the chairs and tables~ Please ask for my help, okay? All for one, and one for all…☆
Preparing is fun, too.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You really love working, don’tcha? That’s fine then, but please don’t overwork yourself. …Gosh, don’t try to wave it off with a laugh. I’m real worried ‘bout you, y’know?
Haha, I get how you feel. Preparations are fun, but the sense of accomplishment after the event is over is amazing, too! I’m so glad to hear you’re enjoying yourself, though…♪
2/3 I’m playing Old Maid with Ryuseitai, but… I keep losing! It’s so frustratin’… Do you have any tips on how to win, Producer?
Don’t show any emotion.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Huh!? They can tell what I’m thinking just by looking at my face? So that was my downfall… No wonder I kept losing. Don’t show my emotions… Mmm, the more I put focus on it, the more I overthink it~!
Uu~myu, you sound like Taishou whenever we’re training. If I don’t show any emotion, they won’t be able to tell my expression, right? I’ll give it a shot! Ossu!
You need to have luck on your side.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I keep losin’ ‘cuz I always pull the old maid? That’s true… But the other members still win when they pull it, so there must be some other reason… I’ll keep thinkin’ up a way to win on my own!
I need to have luck on my side… Hmm, so I’m not in luck, huh… …Huh? No, that wasn’t me making a joke, though!? Ahaha, well, I’m glad it was funny at least… But it’s real embarrassing that I accidentally made a pun…
3/3 I got to have a real fun party thanks to everyone! Ah, that includes you too, ‘course! I wanna give all these happy feelings to someone else, too!
You’re just itching to do that, huh?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ahaha, I was told I don’t have to clean anythin’ up since it’s my birthday, but… It’s just making me more restless. So Producer, please let me help out with the clean-up!
Ossu! I just can’t hold back to go all out and do a hero show or live! Hm? There was a job you wanted to tell us ‘bout? You’re awesome, Producer! All of the Ryuseitai members are here too, so let’s go and talk to ‘em ‘bout it!
You have a lot of presents, don’t you?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ahh, this fancy wrapping is a present from Narukami-senpai! You’re curious to know what I got? …Actually, I don’t wanna ruin this pretty wrapping, so I still dunno what’s inside. Narukami-senpai said I don’t have to open it immediately since she can hear my thoughts on it in the dorms, so I plan to open it once I get back.
I got presents from a lotta people. Look at this! Taishou gave it to me! Ehehe, he stitched a bag to put my karate uniform in~♪ He apologized that it isn’t a typical kinda gift, but I was super happy to get it!
Birthday Story With Chiaki Happy birthday, Nagumo…☆ (arms wide open)
You did the same thing on Shinobu-kun’s birthday, didn’tcha…? …Ah, sure, why not.
Ohh!? I didn’t expect you to come and hug me…!
We’re talkin’ ‘bout you, after all. You’d totally hug me even if I didn’t want it. I’d be better off just bein’ a man ‘bout it and go for it myself, instead of running away~
Ohh! You really read right through me…! You’ve grown so much, Nagumo!
With Kanata tetora, happy [birthday]. let’s [shake hands]~♪
Mm? I don’t mind, but why…?
last year, you said that you did not want to be [treated] as a [child], so i thought you would prefer [handshaking] over a pat on the head. but are you perhaps in the mood to be pat on the head today? that is fine by me~ i will pat you lots, since it is your [birthday]. good boy, good boy~…♪
Ahaha, that wasn’t why I asked, but thank you lots anyway, Shinkai-senpai! ♪
With Shinobu Happy birthday, Tetora-kun! Please do accept my present for you~♪
A shuriken…? Wait— This is really heavy…!?
Heh, it is a weight I got just for you, Tetora-kun. If you were to lift it like a dumbbell, you will surely build muscle~♪
Ohh, it has a practical use for it! I’ll totally use it whenever I’ve got the free time~♪
With Midori Why’re you sighing, Midori-kun?
I wanna say "happy birthday" to Tetora-kun, but everyone keeps talking to him, so I can’t find the right timing to… I’m never gonna be able to say it before the party’s over at this rate… I’m so depressed…
Haha, c’mon, no way that’s happening! I mean, you just said it to me right now!
Huh? …Wait, you’re right. I had my head down, so I didn’t realize I was talking to you, Tetora-kun. But I should say it while properly looking at you, so… Let me try this again: happy birthday, Tetora-kun…♪
With Hiiro Happy birthday, Buchou. You have so many of your companions here. I can tell that you’re loved dearly, Buchou.
Ehehe, that’s too kind of ya to say~ But it really feels nice to have your birthday celebrated, huh? Mm? Why’re you starin’ at me, Hiiro-kun?
Ah, I was concerned about you since our training in the gym, as you didn’t seem at ease, but… I’m relieved to see that you’re enjoying yourself now.
Ahaha, that’s ‘cuz I couldn’t stop thinking ‘bout how there’s gonna be a party after we finished, so I was a li’l nervous. I wouldn’t have been able to calm down if I was all on my own, actually. I’m real glad you were there with me, Hiiro-kun…♪
Birthday Cake Interactions List of office interactions that appear when the specified character gifts a present to Tetora.
I always hear so much about how hard you’ve been working!
Hehe, that makes me a li’l embarrassed to hear~
tetora’s birthday party is so much fun~
Please enjoy yourself today!
This present is for you, Tetora-kun!
Ohh, thanks, Shinobu-kun!
Let’s keep supporting each other, Tetora-kun.
‘Course, I’d like that too!
I’d like to celebrate your birthday too, Buchou!
That makes me real happy, Hiiro-kun…♪
Please do use this for your daily skincare routine.
I’ll be sure to use it tonight!
Tetsu, you’ve gotten manlier, haven’tcha?
Taishou…! I’m so happy you think so!
Tetora-chan, happy birthday~♪
Thanks, Harukawa-kun! ♪
I hope you have a fulfilling year, Tetsu-kun!
Imma work hard to become a man among men!
I made this for you, Nagumo-kun! ♪
Seriously!? For me!? I’m so happy!

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 1] 2021 Tetora Nagumo Birthday
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Era
ES!! 2021 (17 years old Tetora)
Birthday Quote
Thank you for celebratin’ my birthday, Producer! I’ll always be in your debt…! Is it alright if I check what you got me for a present? ♪
Birthday Event Event Preparations 1/3
Hello, Anzu-anego, thank you for your hard work! You’ve got somethin’ to talk to me ‘bout, right? It’s kinda refreshing to get a solo job, too… I’ll do my absolute best, so! You can entrust me with anythin’!
You’re so reliable.
It’s my goal to become a man among men, after all! I’ll always put my all in any job! But I dunno if I’ll be able to do good on a job that needs thinking… If it’s that sort of job, I’d like to think up plans with you!
Let’s sit and talk about it.
Ah— Sorry! You’re right, we can’t relax if we talk while standing. I got too ahead of myself… Then please sit here, and I’ll sit across from ya! I’d love to hear what you have in store for me!
It’ll be a fun job.
A fun job… Will I get to move my body a lot? Like a sports variety show? Ah! Is that the planning you’re holding? Show me, please!
2/3 So the job was ‘bout my birthday event, huh? Shinobu-kun mentioned something ‘bout that, too. Shinobu-kun’d prolly do some ninja arts in his event, right? I’d love to do a fun event that’s suitable for me, for the sake of everyone who came to see me!
What about a hero show?
I always do hero shows with everyone in Ryuseitai, but maybe a solo show where I fight against the kaijuu would be good. If we’re gonna do one, I’d like to be sure how big the stage will be. I wanna do some super flashy, cool action moves…☆
How about displaying a karate move?
I don’t get a lotta opportunities to show off my karate to my fans, so that sounds nice! There’s somethin’ captivating ‘bout demonstrating martial arts moves that you won’t get to see with kumite, so I’ll show off my Karate Club Captain moves~♪
Let’s make the segments fun.
The Question Segment and Request Segment, right? I’m so excited to see what sorta questions and requests I get~♪ I’ll make sure to give everyone a taste of who I am so that I can make everyone happy!
3/3 Aight, we’ve got a good idea of what to do for the event. Thank you for taking the time out of your day for me, Anego! That said… Birthday events have a lot more thinking to do than I thought. They all sound like fun stuff to do, so I’m excited for the day, but… I’m a li’l worried I’ll get too into it and forget what we’ve got planned.
Would you like cue cards?
While we could do that, I’d rather look at the audience during the event. I’ll just make sure to remember everything before the day of the event! I wanna burn the image of everyone’s fun, excited faces into my mind, after all…♪
You can get through it with ad-lib.
I could make things even more fun if I manage it…? So in other words, turning a predicament into an opportunity! I’m used to ad-lib through hero shows. If anything goes wrong, I’ll manage through it so that I can heat up the crowd!
That’s charming in its own way.
"I think your fans would love to see that side of you, too"…? I see, you could look at it that way, huh? I was really caught up with making sure I don’t look lame, but… I’ll only go in circles if I overthink it, so I’ll just go with the usual me~♪
Opening Speech
Heya, everyone~! Thanks for coming to my birthday event! I’ve been so excited to see you guys ever since I heard ‘bout this event! Actually, I checked the venue out from the curtains beforehand… And I could tell how you guys were so excited to meet me just through your expressions! It made me wanna get on stage already! But this isn’t just gonna be for celebrating my birthday — I wanna make you all happy too, and have fun together! I thought up a lotta stuff for us~♪ Let’s have a blast together ‘til the very end~!
Hover/Click the chibi to see the quote! Question Segment First up: the Question Segment! I’ll answer all your questions. Ossu! First question: "What’s the trick to being as energetic as you, Tetora-kun?" Hm, hm~ It’s gotta be sleepin’ early and wakin’ up early! And eating lots! I know it sounds simple, but it’s real important to stay energetic. Our health comes first! Next question: "What do you like to eat on your birthday?" Hmm… This is a tough one…! Uu~myu, I guess it’d be any meals with meat! A first-class kalbi that was grilled through the reddest flame is just perfect. I’m droolin’ just at the thought…♪ Ah! But Midori-kun pointed out that all I’d been eating is kalbi… But let me off for my birthday at least — I’d love to eat my fav food on my birthday!
Hover/Click the chibi to see the quote! Request Segment Next up is the Request Segment! I’ll respond to your requests with all I’ve got~! This request says, "I’d love to do exercise with everyone"… Which sounds real fun, so! I’ll teach you all a simple work-out exercise! This is simple enough to do at any time, so you could try it out whenever you have the time to spare, like on the train and stuff~ Let’s start by standing up. Take a huge deep breath, then let your belly go back in… Yeah, yeah, just like that! C’mon, even if you’re not used to working out, let’s all build our bodies to be healthy and sound together…☆
Hover/Click the chibi to see the quote! Surprise Segment The lights turning off was a real surprise~… I’m glad they came back on immediately. …Wait, huh? There’s a cart outta nowhere. Wait, is this the surprise!? I guess I should open the present box on top…? Aight, here goes… This wrapping seems like clothes…? There’s a letter with it too, who could’ve… Ahh~! This is Taishou’s handwriting! So this is all from Taishou…!? Kuuh~! I’ll treasure this for life! This is the best surprise I could ever have…!
Hover/Click the chibi to see the quote! Closing Speech …I had a blast in this event, but it looks like it’s time we say our goodbyes. Thanks a bunch for today, everyone. I had so much fun that it’s bumming me out that it’s all comin’ to an end… But even if it is, the fun memories will still stay within me! I’ll never forget today, so please don’t forget ‘bout it either, everyone! I’ll work hard so we can have another celebration like this next year. ‘Cuz I wanna show you all my manly, grown-up self after all my hard work. So I hope you can keep supporting me~♪ Ossu!

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 1] 2022 Tetora Nagumo Birthday
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Era
ES!! 2022 (17 years old Tetora)
Birthday Quote
Thank you very much, Producer! Whatcha think? Have I gotten closer to the image of a matured man?
Party with Everyone 1/3
I’m so excited for everyone to show up for my party~♪ Did you also prepare my birthday party, Anzu-anego? Hehe, I’m super duper happy! Huh? Is that also for me…?
Could you take it?
Ooh, it’s a teddy bear! It says "Happy birthday, Tetora"! Did you get this for me, Anzu-anego? I’ll gladly take it~♪
Could you clip this on your clothes?
A teddy bear? Ah, so I can clip this on my clothes, huh? Oh, I get it! Clipping this cute teddy bear is a mark of being a man among men! I’ll totally clip it on!
2/3
There’s a lotta food on the table~ Can I really eat this all? Aw yeah! I’m gonna eat all I want today~! What do you recommend, Anzu-anego?
The barbeque.
You truly get me! I couldn’t take my eyes off the plate of kalbi, y’know! Let’s eat it together, if you’re alright with that, Anzu-anego! You can leave the grilling to me!
The steak.
Ooh, there’s steak! It’s pretty thick, so it should fill me up! I usually eat barbeque, but steak is nice too! I’ll eat some~♪
3/3 Aight, it’s ‘bout time to call it a day. It’s so much fun to have fun with everyone, the same way in a live. I know it won’t be enough as repayment, but I wanna celebrate everyone’s birthday with all I’ve got, too! Thank you so much for today, Anzu-anego. I’ll cherish this teddy bear, too~♪
I’m so glad you had fun.
Hehe! It’s a party prepared by you, so ‘course I’d have a blast! It’s such a shame that it’s coming to an end. But I’ll keep workin’ hard so that I can have another celebration like this next year!
Do you have any resolutions?
I’m aiming to be a man among men, as always, ‘course! I’ll do everything I can wherever I go for that sake, whether it’s during a Ryuseitai live or in my Karate Club activities! …Well, I guess that’s what I’ve always been doin’, though. So please keep supporting me, Anzu-anego!
Opening Speech
Heya everyone! Thanks for coming to my birthday party tonight! I’ve actually been real excited to see what sorta party is in store for me…♪ And so many people have come just to celebrate a big party for me… I’m so blessed! I want you all to enjoy yourselves to your heart’s content! Ossu! Aight, let’s get the party started~!
Hover/Click the chibi to see the quote! Food Talk Tetsu-kun! Sorry for interrupting you while you’re enjoying the savory meat, but — Happy birthday! ♪
Oooh! (munches, munches… gulps)! Thanks, Hinata-kun!
Ahaha, you’re such a glutton~ But you’re growing up, so how about you also eat some of that veggie you’re not good with? Look, I brought one over!
Eugh!? N-No, anything but carrots~!
If you’re aiming to be a man among men, then you should overcome your weaknesses! …Just kidding, this is actually a cake in the shape of a carrot. Try it out~
Huh!? Really? (munch, munch)… Mgh!? It really is a cake! And it’s super tasty!
Ahaha, I gotcha good with this surprise! Happy birthday, Tetsu-kun…♪
Hover/Click the chibi to see the quote! Presents from ES Idols This present is… Wha—!? It’s the work-out gear I wanted!!
Happy birthday, Nagumo. Did you like HiMERU’s present?
This is from you, HiMERU-san!? Thank you so much! ☆ But how’d you know I wanted this?
Fufu, it was a simple deduction. HiMERU saw that you threw away your broken work-out equipment, and then looked over options for the same equipment over and over again. Which can only mean one thing: You found something to replace your broken equipment, but you had still been hesitating whether to buy it.
Wooahh, you’re amazing, HiMERU-san! That’s incredible deduction skills! I’ll make sure to repay you on your birthday!
Fufufu, HiMERU quite likes your sense of your duty. HiMERU is excited for that day. ♪
Hover/Click the chibi to see the quote! Birthday Wishes from ES Idols Tetora-kun, happy birthday!
Nagumo-kun, happy birthday~! I’m so happy you’re enjoying all the food we made!
Thank you, Shinobu-kun, Aniki! Wait, there’s food you guys made!? Which one!?
That would be the sweets. I would love to see you try and figure out which ones we made…♪
If you figure it out, we’ll give ya a grand prize~
Ooh, that’s just how I like it! I’ll make sure to get this right!
Hover/Click the chibi to see the quote! Closing Speech Time just passed after all the greetings, eating, and present opening… I’m sure some of you have work from the early morning, so it’s ‘bout time we call it a day. Right then… Thank you so much for making the time for me! I’m gonna keep growing stronger this year, both as an idol and as a man! ☆ So I hope you guys come celebrate my birthday next year, when I’ve grown even more! Aight, thank you for tonight! Ossu!
Birthday Special Motion
The special chibi motions for Tetora are Chiaki and Hiiro! ※ Special chibi motions show a different expression from the rest of the idols. Birthday Cake

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 1] 2023 Tetora Nagumo Birthday
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Era
ES!! 2023 (17 years old Tetora)
Birthday Quote
Ossu! I’m super thankful to hear those words from ya! I’m real happy, ‘cuz growing older makes me feel like I’m getting a li’l bit closer to becoming a man among men! ♪
Birthday Moment Moment Event 1/3
Let me open HoldHands first… Okay, look over here, Tetora-kun!
Woah— Morisawa-senpai and Shinkai-senpai are dancing all’a sudden…!? Ahaha, they’re yelling “happy birthday”. Did they take this video for me?
That’s an incredible birthday surprise!
Yeah… They weren’t sure if they could make it to your party because of work, so they came up with this idea for you… It’s crazy how fast they are to take action…
Woah, I seriously didn’t expect this at all! I’m real happy~♪
Happy birthday.
Thank you, Anego! ♪ Hehe! It feels real nice to have my birthday celebrated by you and my seniors…♪
2/3 Oh yeah, Anzu-san — Are you here to take Tetora-kun to his party?
Huh? But wasn’t my birthday party gonna start a li’l later? Ohh… You wanna see me after the party’s over? Gotcha!
I’m excited.
Ossu! I’m super excited for it too, Anego~♪ I don’t have anythin’ to do after the party, so I’ll be waiting for ya!
It’ll be pretty late at night, sorry.
I don’t mind at all~♪ If anything, I’d like to thank you in advance for all your hard work! Where will we meet? I’ll work out a li’l at the meeting spot ‘til you come!
3/3 Oh yeah, I should thank Morisawa-senpai and Shinkai-senpai for the video!
Then, what say you take a video for them, Tetora-kun?
Ohh, good idea… I’d like to do more than just thank ‘em, then…
How about the three of you take a video together?
Fweh—!? Where’d this come from…!? D-Do I seriously have to do it, too…?
I won’t force ya, but I’d love it if you did, Midori-kun! C’mon, please? ♪
How about you dance for yours, too?
That sounds like a great idea! I’ll show my gratitude through a dance! I’ll need to go to the dance room first, then. Aight, I’ll see you later~♪
Birthday Night, Part One 1/3
Oh! Anego, ‘suup~! Thank you for your hard work today! You don’t have to apologize for being late. I was workin’ out ‘til you arrived. And now I feel super refreshed after taking a shower! ♪
You were working out even on your birthday?
Yup! It’s best to get my muscles moving every day! Plus, I ate a lotta food today, so I gotta burn all those calories away!
2/3 Thanks for preparing my birthday party! I heard the work was split between people for the decorations, the cake, and all that. I’m real happy everyone did that for me! Please let me help out on their birthdays, too!
That makes me happy to hear.
‘Course I’d help, y’know! You can always ask me for any sorta help. Leave all the manual labor to me! I’ll do my best with cooking, too~♪
3/3 I got lotsa presents at my birthday party~♪ Not only from Ryuseitai, but even from my circle members Hiiro-kun and Taishou! They gave me stuff for working out, and even clothes~♪ I’m so excited to try ‘em out!
Did anything else happen?
Hmm… I got a present from Saegusa-senpai too, as part of Ibara Lecture. It was basically a review worksheet of all the mistakes I did on the last test… He told me to make sure to complete it before the next session.
Birthday Night, Part Two 1/3 Huh!? You got me a present, too!? Thank you! Ohh, a brooch! It really stands out from its size~ Mm, I don’t typically wear brooches, so I don’t really know where best to clip it on… Where do you usually use it?
On shawls and such.
Ohh! That’s right, I remember Narukami-senpai using a brooch like that before! I’ll ask Narukami-senpai or HiMERU-san a whole lotta other ways I could use it once I get back to the dorms!
2/3
I don’t have a shawl with me right now, so I just clipped it on my clothes~♪ Hehe! Thank you, I’m real happy to know it suits me~♪ I got lotsa different presents today, but a brooch is a first time for me. I feel like I got to end tonight with the most glittering present~♪
I’m glad you like it.
I’d have been happy with anythin’ from you, Anzu-anego! ♪ Oh, that only makes you less sure what to get me next time…? Uu~myu, but it’s how I really feel…
3/3 Thank you again for today. Even Morisawa-senpai and Shinkai-senpai came to my party despite their busy schedules…! It was real lively with so many people ‘round. But that ended up makin’ me cut my time short with talking to everyone in Ryuseitai, and I feel like it’s a shame… Ahaha… Maybe you’re right, Anego — Maybe I’m feeling a li’l sad that today has reached its end…
(Calls on the phone)
Hm? What’re you doing…? Huh!? Everyone from Ryuseitai is still at the agency’s office…!? Thanks for letting me know, Anego! I’m off to see ‘em before the day ends!
Birthday Phone Call I was still feelin’ too giddy after my birthday party, so I had to call you at least once, Anego…♪ …It was fun for you, too? Hehe, I’m so glad to hear that! Let’s continue to enjoy our daily lives together!

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] 2024 Tetora Nagumo Birthday
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Era
ES!! 2024 (18 years old Tetora)
Birthday Quote
I’m so happy to get birthday wishes from you! Heheh, do you think I’m growing a li’l bit more into a great man compared to last year?
Birthday Morning 1/3
One-two, one-two~♪ Ah— Anego, g’morning~! Are you on your way to work? I didn’t expect to meet ya here. I was having my morning run!
You’re energetic from the morning, aren’t you?
Ossu! I feel like doin’ exercise in the morning improves my state for the day! How about you and I do it together next time, Anego? Let’s shed some refreshing sweat together~♪
Now that we’re here, please let me say it.
Huh? "Happy birthday"? Thank you! I’m so happy to get your birthday wishes as the day starts in the morning!
2/3 Don’t worry, I haven’t forgotten ‘bout the Cheki photoshoot today.1 I got advice from Midori-kun, ‘cuz he does photoshooting work a lot~♪
Oh yeah, speaking of Midori-kun… He said that he realized later on that when Shinobu-kun asked him for advice, he only mentioned the fundamentals of photoshooting.
Did you get any other advice?
Ermm, he said that if the staff members prepare some kinda prop, it might be good to try using it… He also said the same fundamentals that he told Shinobu-kun, which is that you should listen to the cameraman’s instructions. And also, that it’s good to get a nuanced grasp of how the photo should be taken.
The fundamentals are important, after all.
That’s true! Karate’s the same; you’ll never be able to improve your skill if you neglect the fundamentals. First things first, I’m gonna make sure the fundamentals Midori-kun taught me are stuck in my mind!
3/3 Oh, woops. I got too into our conversation. I’m gonna head back to the Seisoukan Dorms for a sec. I sweated a li’l, so I’ll change my clothes to refresh myself. I’m looking forward to today’s photoshoot, Anego!
Me too.
Ehehe, it’ll feel so reassuring to have you ‘round during the photoshoot. I’ll make sure to have lots of Cheki photos. I’ll rev my gears and do my best!
See you then.
Yes, see you then! I’m so glad I got to talk to you, Anego. Aight, it’s time I head off! I’ll be waiting at the lobby!
Birthday Photoshoot
It’s time for the photoshoot! Let’s begin! Birthday Photoshoot Start
Hello, I hope you’re all doin’ well! I’m in your care for today’s photoshoot! Hm? Ahh, you’d like to do my makeup straight away? Aight, please do so! I’ll stay put.
My skin looks great? Ahaha, looks like me doing skincare every day is showing great results. I also made sure to eat the right foods in preparation for today, so I’m glad to hear that!
table { margin: 0; }
Snap! Birthday Surprise (Huh? Anzu-anego and the staff members are bringing somethin’ over… Is it party poppers?)
Woah— You surprised me with that poppin’ outta nowhere!
Was that a surprise for me? Thank you for the birthday celebration! Ooh, there’s even a suit for me as a gift! So I should wear this for the photoshoot, right? I’ll change into it straight away!
Hm, so the real present is that suit you’re holding, Anzu-dono? Thank you very much for the gift!
Snap! Birthday Suit
How do I look? I hope it looks good on me…
Ehehe, it’s kinda embarrassin’ to get a pour of compliments…
But I’d bring shame to myself as a man if I just stayed embarrassed. This is the suit that Anego prepared just for me, so I’ll wear it proudly! Thank you for the stylishly cool suit, Anzu-anego~♪
Snap! Birthday Photoshoot in Progress How’s it, Cameraman-san? It was perfect? I’m glad to hear that! Ahh, it’s time for a break? Gotcha! Mm? What’s up, Anego? Ah, are you askin’ me if I’d like somethin’ to drink?
Ah, I’ll fetch it then. Please just stay seated, Anego. There’s no need to hold back. Please let me fetch somethin’ to drink for you and the staff members, as thanks for taking care of me today.
Snap! Birthday Photoshoot End 1 Whew, the photoshoot is over. Thank you for all your hard work! Huh? Anego, why’re you holding a camera? Hm, you’d like to take a photo to commemorate today? Please feel free to take a photo anytime!
Cheki Photos Let’s take a Cheki photo of Tetora!
“I’m grateful for all your wholehearted support♪” Birthday Photoshoot End 2 Aight, let me just sign on this Cheki photo… There you go! This is for you, Anego. This very last Cheki is a present to you. Thank you so much for today! I had loads’a fun with the photoshoot~♪
Snap! Birthday Cake

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] 2025 Tetora Nagumo Birthday
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Era
ES!! 2025 (18 years old Tetora)
Birthday Quote
I’m so thankful to have my birthday celebrated by you! I’m itchin’ to open everyone’s presents already, too~♪
Before the Birthday Live Stream
Oh yeah, I wanted to tell you this for a while now, Anzu-anego… Thank you so much for all the efforts you poured into this live stream!
Ahaha, your face looks like it’s saying, "Where did this come from all of a sudden?", I can tell! You don’t usually show your emotions on the outside, but you’re sometimes easy to read~♪
The truth is, Morisawa-senpai told me all ‘bout it. That he spotted you working hard ‘til late at night… And you even adjusted my schedule, got the set-up for the live stream ready… I know all ‘bout how you’ve prepared so much for me.
That’s why, before the live stream starts, I wanted to properly express my gratitude!
Birthday Live Stream Start
Transform! Birthday live stream with @Nagumo_Ryusei, start!1
Let’s send Nice!’s to Tetora and enjoy the live stream!
I’m grateful to you all comin’ to my live stream! Getting to celebrate my birthday with everyone… This is the best birthday ever~♪
Hehe! I’ll do my best with this live stream so that it turns out to be a special day for everyone as well, so! I’m lookin’ forward to spending time with all of you!
Oh yeah, I’m happy to see so many comments comin’ my way already… And I plan to respond to as many requests as I can as long as I have the time, so please feel free to send as much as you like~♪
Also, thanks to everyone in Ryuseitai helping me practice answering questions one by one, I feel confident that I can manage this.
I’ll answer any and all questions as manly as possible, without any hesitation, so please look forward to it!
During the Birthday Live Stream 1
"How can I get stronger?"
I’ll read this comment next. Hm, hm… "I’ve decided to take the karate promotion exam"?
Oohh! That’s somethin’ I’d totally want ya to do your best to pass! I’m sure it’s nerve-racking, but go for that challenge while believing in yourself!
Ossu! I’ll keep answering more questions now that I’ve got the pace~♪
Erm, next up is… "How can I get stronger?"
Mm~ There’s all sortsa things when it comes to strength, and I’m still nowhere near that level compared to Taishou, but… there’s one thing I can say for sure!
Establish a goal, and work hard training for it every day. If you just keep up the hard work, you’ll surely grow stronger; that’s what I think~♪
During the Birthday Live Stream 2
"I’d like a pep talk."
Somethin’ that’s surprised me is that there’s a lotta requests asking for a pep talk.
…And as soon as I said that, more came in!
Everyone’s reasons are different it seems, like "It’s so I can study for a subject I’m bad at", or "I can’t get myself to confess to my crush, so I’d like a pep talk"… But I can tell that you’re all tryin’ your hardest to change your current state!
Ossu! If you’re fine with me, then I’d be happy to fulfill that request!
Q&A Time
Note: Before the idol’s birthday, Enstars official twitter opened a form to gather questions for the birthday idol, and IRL fans could send in one question per idol (Seen here). The following questions were selected from that form.
Ossu! Thank you all for coming to my live stream! I’ll be answerin’ questions you’ve sent me, so please look forward to it!
Hehe! It always makes me happy to have my birthday celebrated, no matter how old I get!
Please tell us your strength training work-out regimen.
Ooh~! I’m so happy there’s someone interested in strength training! Aight, I’mma answer that right now~!
I make sure to have push-ups, sit-ups… and also squats to improve my muscle movement throughout my whole body. This is a pretty popular way to train, actually. I also do some training that uses equipment for box jumpin’! I’d love you all to try it out, too~♪
Do you take after your dad, or your mom?
Mm~ I haven’t really thought ‘bout it much, but now that you mention it… I feel like I’ve heard ‘bout how boys tend to take after their moms…?
Well, no clue if that’s actually true or anythin’, though. There was never a moment when I talked to my friends ‘bout it, either…
Ah! But I’d say I prolly take after my dad when it comes to being an outdoor person. He used to take me fishin’ with him a lot in the past~♪2
Are you planning to get more ear piercings?
Hmm, I can’t say for certain, since who knows what’ll happen in the future… But for the time being, I don’t have any plans to do so.
But the other day, Hiiro-kun told me he saw an ear piercing that would suit me in a store. He said it has a similar feel to the one I own.
He observes me well, huh~ Well, I’m pretty curious what sorta ear piercing it is, and Hiiro-kun’s feelings made me happy, so I’m hopin’ to check out that store sometime!
Birthday Photo Booth List of office interactions that appear when the specified character takes a photo with Tetora.
Let’s take a commemoration photo with the birthday idol, Tetora!
Birthday cake is also available! Click here for the office interactions that appear when a specified character gifts a present to Tetora.
I became an Onii-san ahead of ya!
Happy birthday, Tetora-kun…♪
A photo of the two of us feels kinda embarrassin’.
Fufu, it turned out to be a great photo!
I can really sense your passionate feelings!
I’ll wish you a happy birthday as many times as possible!
I’m so happy to have my birthday celebrated!
my heart also feels warm~♪
I’d love to do weight trainin’ again, Sazanami-senpai.
Sure, I’d join ya anytime.
This is the manliest photo ever!
Hell yeah, lookin’ great~♪

entry.title: [ES!! Era Year 2] 2026 Tetora Nagumo Birthday
entry.content:
Characters
Writer
H.E. Staff
Translation
310mc
Era
ES!! 2026 (18 years old Tetora)
Birthday Quote
Day 1 Thank you for the birthday wishes! This year’s another year where I devote my whole soul to becomin’ a man among men~♪
Day 2 Thanks for coming to see me today, too! ♪
Day 3 ‘Suuup~! ☆ I was waitin’ for ya, Anego~♪
Birthday Party Stream Preparing for the Birthday Party Stream
Thanks for the food! I’m fully powered up for the stream thanks to that meat cake!
I’m real glad to know you gobbled it all up! It makes me feel like it was worth the effort~♪
I’m sorry that I ended up eating some, too. Even though it’s not my birthday or anything…
C’mon, whaddya mean by that? Tasty food gets only tastier when you eat it with people! ♪
Yep, yep! We’re all pals who ate the same meat cake, so we gotta make sure to hype up Nagumo-kun’s stream~♪
Kuuh~ That’s so reassurin’ to hear! I seriously look forward to it, thank ya!
Start of the Birthday Party Stream
“Ossu! Thanks for coming to my birthday stream, everyone! I really appreciate it!” “I hope to show all of my fans here today just how much more I’ve matured!”
“There’s some big guns comin’ in as guests to celebrate my birthday, so let’s get this place started~! I’m gonna host the stream, proper manly man style!” “There’s a quiz contest waitin’ for you all too, so I hope you enjoy the stream with me ‘til the very end~♪”
“Right, it’s time we begin!”
During the Birthday Party Stream 1 “The first guest is Aniki! C’mon, let’s clap for him~!”
“Happy birthday, Nagumo-kun~♪ How was the special birthday meat cake I gifted ya?”
“It was literally the best! It was basically the embodiment of high-quality protein, and even my muscles are happy over it~! ♪ I’ll show everyone a photo of it later!”
“By the way, I made you a surprise cake too. I’ll fetch it over right now~♪”
“Ohh, a surprise outta nowhere…!? I’m so sure it’s gonna be tasty if it’s made by you, Aniki!”
During the Birthday Party Stream 2
“Happy birthday again, Tetora-kun…♪”
“Fufu, that feels embarrassin’ somehow~ Ah! I see a buncha comments for you too, Midori-kun!”
“Ehhh? What if I’m being slandered…”
“Most are asking, ‘Midori-kun, from your perspective, how’s Tetora-kun doing lately?’”
“Mm~ I think he’s become even more reliable than he ever was. Although, I just hope he doesn’t overwork himself like a certain someone…”
“Ahaha, thanks! I’m doin’ fine, so I’mma keep pushing forward more and more!”
During the Birthday Party Stream 3 “Thanks to Aniki and Midori-kun, this turned out to be such a memorable birthday party!” “And it goes without sayin’ that I’m super grateful for all of my viewers here!”
“By the way, how was the quiz contest…? Did anyone figure out what I ate this morning…?”
“Even if you couldn’t, I’d still be happy to know if this got you all to know a lot more ‘bout me!”
“I’m gonna keep pushing forward with my goal of becomin’ a man among men, so! Thank you all for today! Ossu!”
Birthday Work
Tetora’s Work lines during his birthday! (GOOD) I’m real glad you’re all here to celebrate my birthday! (GOOD) I hope you all enjoy my birthday stream!
(GREAT) Feel free to ask for a screenshottin’ session! (GREAT) I’m grateful for all your support in my daily life~♪
Birthday Quiz
Let’s play Tetora’s birthday quiz and become Tetora PhD Masters! Questions come in either multiple choice or thinking up the answer.
What was the first thing that Tetora ate this morning?
Rice with egg Protein Miso soup Toasted sandwich
What does Tetora call Niki?
Niki Aniki Shiina-senpai Nii-san
In “Scout! Decorate”, the name of the yuru-chara Tetora encountered is “___ ____-chan”. What goes in the blank?
Give yourself time to think before looking at the hidden text! After you’ve thought up an answer, hover/click below to see if you were right: Berry Happy (ベリーハッピー)
What does Hiiro call Tetora?
Tetora-kun Student Council President Buchou (Club Captain) Chairman
In “Reverb ★ The Stella Maris Across the Horizon”, what was Tetora’s assigned fish among the [catchphrases] that Kanata came up with?
Tuna Salmon Pufferfish Sea bream
In “On Two Paths／Dragon’s Head”, Tetora bought a book in the bookstore called “Monthly Issue: _____”. What goes in the blank?
Give yourself time to think before looking at the hidden text! After you’ve thought up an answer, hover/click below to see if you were right: Karate (空手道)
In “Cross Scout: Blossoms of All Trades Solidarity”, what is the menu item that Tetora asked if it’s alright to order in the Chinese restaurant?
Give yourself time to think before looking at the hidden text! After you’ve thought up an answer, hover/click below to see if you were right: Shark fin soup (フカヒレ)
In “Scout! Card Battler”, what is the name of the card Tetora used in an Idobato match against Koga?
Drifting Cloud Rakshasa Wandering Deity Roaming Fierce God Lone Yasha
In “Scout! Tough Guy”, which of these is what Tetora said Shinobu had taught him?
Vanishing jutsu Secret path in school How to be favored by your senior The trick to calming your nerves
What does Tetora have a habit of saying, that Shinobu has mimicked before?

entry.title: Christmas Live – Chiaki Produce Course: Winter Needs Warmth
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Christmas Live
1/3
Mm!? Don’t make hasty decisions, Anzu! Don’t let yourself die…!! Are you so worried over something that you’d even dive into the fountain in this cold weather…!?
Alright then! Go ahead and consult this reliable senior of yours! ☆
I don’t particularly have any worries.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I see. You’ve become an adult now, huh? Pat, pat~♪ You didn’t know anything at all when you first transferred here, right?
Yet you’ve grown this much… Uu, I’m so happy! ☆
You tend to not see a worry as one sometimes, don’t you? I’m worried you’ll overdo it and collapse!
I once said you were like a mother, but honestly, you’re more like a kid I can’t take my eyes off of~☆1
I was just passing by…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You may say that, but the fountain’s on your mind, isn’t it!? I also get the urge to dive in when there’s an ocean before me, but it’s the winter season right now!
It’s dangerous to swim in the fountain during the winter, so make sure you don’t do it, okay?
So I just misunderstood. Sorry, I jumped to the wrong conclusion! See, what happened to Kanata was only just recently, right?
So I got worried for you too, but I’m relieved to know it was nothing bad in the end!
2/3
Whenever it gets this warm, it’s easy to get sleepy, huh…☆
Mm? You look sleepy too, you’re rubbing your eyes. It’s hard to resist the warmth of the room heater, huh?
(Hugs)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Stop! Stop right there, Anzu!! It’s suicide to try and hug the heater, you hear me!? Come over to this side.
Sheesh… You’ve got unpredictable parts to you just like Kanata, it’s scary…
Ohh, it’s so rare to get a hug from you, Anzu! ☆
There, there, I’ll hug you all you want…♪ Yup, my body temperature’s pretty warm, after all! It acts as the perfect water-heating pad!
(Gets closer to the heater)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ha ha ha! Are you trying to make yourself warm by putting your hands on the heater? You look like a cat doing that~
Mm, it’s heartwarming to see! ☆
Hold it there, Anzu! Don’t get close to the heater, you’ll catch a cold! Heaters dry up the air, so it’ll hurt your throat.
It’s possible to catch a cold from a sore throat, so you have to be careful.
3/3
Sip, sip… Sip, sip, sip… Mhm, delicious! ☆ Ahh, Kanata fell asleep, so. I’m drinking the soup in his stead.
It’d simply be a waste to not drink soup while it’s still warm, right?
You can have more if you’d like.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Woah, I don’t think you need to put so many vegetables until it pools out…? Plus, I think I see a vegetable that looks like an eggplant in there.
Uuu, please take out the eggplants! I’m begging you, Anzu!
Ooh, you’re so thoughtful, Anzu! ♪ You’re so observant, picking up on what someone wants.
Mhm, I’m sure you’ll be a wonderful wife…☆
There’s eggplants in it!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Guh…! Cough, cough, coughcough…! Y-You… should’ve… told me that… e-earlier…
Uuu, this has just made me hate eggplants even more…
Egg…plants…!? Uuu, eggplants are the one thing… the one thing I…!
I hate eggplants, to the point I can’t help but think something happened between me and them in a past life. Sorry, but is it alright if you eat the rest of this…?

entry.title: Christmas Live – Chiaki Produce Course: Junior of Concern
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Christmas Live
1/3
I feel like lately, Nagumo’s attitude towards me is just getting drier… Compared to me, Anzu’s pretty adored by Nagumo, huh…
At this point, he mentions you almost just as much as he mentions Kiryu! ☆
I wonder why?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I could easily answer that, but I’d rather you notice it by yourself! I’m sure that’d make Nagumo happy too, so~?
In other words, please give it a thought on your own! ☆
That’s because he adores you as an “older sister,” you see! After all, he typically calls you “Anzu-anego”!
Please keep being on good terms with Nagumo, Anzu!
He’s just hiding his embarrassment.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
It doesn’t seem to be him hiding his embarrassment to me, though…?
Well, no matter. Nagumo’s a boy too, so I’m sure he wants to stand on his own two feet.
Seeing it that way makes even that attitude of his quite heartwarming! ☆
He speaks rather bluntly for something like “hiding his embarrassment”, though…? Even when I ask him for something, he just looks at me with an “Ehh~” look.
I don’t think he hates me or anything, but I don’t feel as though he adores me, either.
2/3
Anzu, thank you for fetching us a job…☆ We’re going to participate in StarFes too, of course.
So this Eve’s Eve Live is the perfect rehearsal for us!
It’s hard to say, isn’t it?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Mm? Do you mean “Eve’s Eve Live”?
Yeah, I also thought it’s a little hard to say. But it’s already been advertised, so we can’t change it this late in.
True, I feel like I could accidentally fumble saying the name…! But well, it’s a live show performed before Christmas Eve, so “Eve’s Eve Live” makes sense.
It may be a basic name, but I like how it’s easy to understand! ☆
How’s preparations going?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Mm, we’re moving pretty smoothly without any problems for now. That being said, problems could still occur even when things are moving smoothly.
So we’ll have to brace ourselves properly and take the plunge with the live show! ☆
Mm, Nagumo brought over Santa-looking outfits for us. We didn’t have time to prepare, so I was actually thinking to perform with the Ryuseitai uniforms at first, but…
Thanks to these Santa-looking outfits, we can liven up the place in a Christmas Eve-like way! ☆
3/3
That Nagumo… Mhm, he’s truly grown big! ☆
Ohh, Anzu, you heard me talking to myself. Well, no matter! Please keep watching over Nagumo as he grows!
Do you have a fever by any chance?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ha ha ha! Nagumo said something similar to me! You and Nagumo may be similar in a way.
Or rather, maybe Nagumo became more similar to you…?
An ally of justice never catches a cold…! Well, that’s what I’d like to say here, but you nursed me in the past, so…1
The cold weather is getting harsher lately, so make sure not to catch a cold either, alright?
Err…?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
This isn’t the moment to tilt your head; you need to reply back energetically, don’t you? Nagumo changed not just because of Kiryu, but because of you, too.
Don’t forget that, okay? ☆
Ha ha ha! You won’t know what I mean if I just say it out of nowhere, huh? You see, Nagumo grew splendidly, even though I had first thought he was a worrisome kid.
And when I realized that that’s also because of you, Anzu, I felt a little emotional! ☆

entry.title: Christmas Live – Midori Produce Course: On My Mind…
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Christmas Live
1/3
I’m so sorry for crashing into you the other day… You’re tinier than me, yet I bumped into you pretty hard…
I’m worried that you may had gotten hurt…
You just pushed me aside a little, that’s all.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You picked up the vegetables with me even though I pushed you…?
Even if you feel fine right now, I’m still worried. I’ll take responsibility if I injured you, okay…?
It hurts when that happens, doesn’t it… The same sort of pain you get when you hit your toe on the edge of something…
Ughh, just imagining it makes me feel depressed…
I just scraped my knee a little, that’s all.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Did you get it treated at the infirmary…?
Ohh, there were bandaids, so you put one on. And it didn’t hurt, either? I’m so glad to hear that…♪
Huhh!? You should’ve told me much earlier, y’know…? You’re wearing tights, so if it scraped you, it must’ve really hurt…!
That’s just how heavy I am, huh… Ughh, I’m really just so sorry…
2/3
Anzu-san, did you wash your hands properly afterwards…? I mean, our hands touched when we crashed into each other, right?
The vegetables inside the boxes were also full of dirt, so it was on my mind…
(Shows hands)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Huh? What’re you doing all of a sudden…? Ahh, you wanted me to check if there’s any dirt on your hands?
I know you don’t talk much, Anzu-san, but I’d prefer you say that out loud if possible.
Anzu-san’s hands are so small and cute…♪
U-Um, could I hold your hand? Uwaah, thank you very much~♪ Your hands are soft like a little animal’s paws, I can’t help the urge to touch them…
I didn’t have time to wash them.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Were you so busy with work that you didn’t have the time…? You’re a workaholic after all, Anzu-san…
I don’t feel like I could ever follow after you…
Ahh, it was pretty busy after all, rescuing Shinkai-senpai and everything… But it really was just surprising at that moment.
So I’m just relieved and glad you were there when it happened, Anzu-san…♪
3/3
Umm, Anzu-san, you’re on good terms with the fine member “Fushimi”, right…?
Erm, see, I want him to draw a picture for me in my notebook… I’m now a huge fan of that drawing he made, so if possible, I also want his autograph…
You liked it *that* much…?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You don’t understand the beauty of that drawing, Anzu-san!? S-Sorry. I lost my composure a little…
But, I wanted you to know that that’s just how incredible that drawing is to me, that’s all…
You mean you don’t have that sense in you, Anzu-san!? I thought you and I were the same, but all along, you were just a horrible traitor…
N-No… I won’t forgive you, even if you wore a yuru-chara costume, okay…?
I’ll try asking.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Um, I know I’m the one who requested just now, but still, are you sure…? There’s people out there who don’t like it when they’re asked for an autograph…
If I give off the impression that I don’t have any manners, I might die by the shock…
Really!? Waah, uwaah, thank you so much~♪ It’s rare to find someone who can draw a droopy-looking illustration like that, y’know?
It’s no wonder that he’s part of the strongest unit in Yumenosaki Academy, huh…♪

entry.title: Christmas Live – Midori Produce Course: Melancholic Live Show
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Christmas Live
1/3
I’m so depressed… I wanna die… I felt some peace when we got days off from Ryuseitai activities…
But now I’m being forced into participating in the Eve’s Eve Live, and it’s so depressing…
(Shows the drawing in the notebook)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
T-This drawing…! Ahhh, my head’s spinning from the healing energy~…☆ That Fushimi person’s drawings really are just amazing, aren’t they?
I think I’d want to display this in a picture frame, even…♪
Did you draw this turkey, Anzu-san? Your drawings also have just the right amount of droopiness…
But that Fushimi person’s drawings are definitely the best~♪
Sorry.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
N-No, Anzu-san, you don’t have to apologize… It’s Morisawa-senpai who asked you to find work for us, right?
Morisawa-senpai’s always just doing unnecessary things, don’t you think…?
W-Woah, please lift your head…!
You just looked for a job for our sake, right?
Your hard work for our sake makes me really happy, so…♪
2/3
Anzu-san, what do you think of a green-colored Santa-san…? Santa-san’s just got to be red-colored, right…?
Uu, I feel like a fraud and it sucks, so I want to change my clothes…
I want to wear it, too.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Then do you want to wear mine…? Ah, okay, guess that’s not happening. Ughh, and I thought I could get away from work with this…
Working even on holidays is just so depressing…
Oh yeah, Tetora-kun mentioned that too many outfits were made…?
Then how about I ask Tetora-kun for you…?
I’d also like to see Anzu-san in a Santa costume…♪
The green-colored version also looks good!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Is it because my name means green…? Well, my Ryuseitai uniform is green too, so I guess it does put me at ease to be in this color.
Red would’ve meant wearing the same outfit as Morisawa-senpai, so maybe it’s good I’m in the green one…♪
You… think so? If that’s what you say, then I feel a little more confident now…♪ Even if my body is green outside, my heart is bright red inside…♪
Ahh, but then again, I’d be Morisawa-senpai that way, which I definitely don’t want…
3/3
It’s too cold to perform a live show outside, and I just wanna go home…
Is this… vegetable soup? Uwaah, it looks so warm and tasty~♪
There’s ginger in it too… It’ll definitely warm me up…♪
There’s still more.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Erm, I’m full by now, so no thank you. This soup’s got a lot of vegetables in it, so it keeps me full pretty well…
Yawns…♪ I feel sleepy now, I think…
Then could I have more…?
Huff… Huff… Haah~ It’s warming me up inside and out…♪ Um, could I have another…?
I made it with the vegetables you gave me.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I’m sorry for giving you damaged ones… I’m always indebted to you, so I wanted to give you the better ones, but…
If my parents found out, I’d get a good scolding…
By that, do you mean when we crashed into each other…? You could’ve made something for your family with them, instead of us, though…
But that’s just like you, isn’t it, Anzu-san~♪

entry.title: Christmas Live – Tetora Produce Course: Before Christmas Eve
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Christmas Live
1/3
…Ah, owch!? Is this an enemy invasion!?
Oh, it’s Anzu-anego. ‘Sup there! ♪ Ahh, I wasn’t responding even when you greeted me, so you did a hand chop on me.
(Gives a hand warmer)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Why a hand warmer…? Ahh, ‘cuz the chilly air counter-acts any preventions to the cold, huh.
Givin’ me somethin’ to avoid catching a cold… You’re kind as always, Anego! I wanna learn from ya so I can also become a considerate man~♪
Hot…!? It gave me a shock to have that hand warmer on my cheek outta nowhere~!! Uu, that spot stings for some reason…?
I think I’m better off with this hand warmer being cold, actually.
Were you pondering over something?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I don’t have any worries right now, though…?
I guess if I had to mention somethin’, then I wanna be a li’l more dexterous. ‘Cuz it’s a li’l frustrating, like, I would’ve able to help out Taishou a lot more if I had nimble hands~
Actually, it’s more like I was meditatin’~ One time, I felt my bones almost crackin’ when I tried to sit in zazen position.
So ever since then, I’ve switched to meditation~♪
2/3
Just a few more nights~ and it’s Christmas~♪
Ahaha, Anzu-anego, you look happy about it, too. So you’re also excited for Christmas?
Not really.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
So you’re not interested in Christmas, huh… Well, I guess I can’t disagree that "we’re not kids anymore"…
But I wanna enjoy the day, y’know?
Huh!? You’re not!?
I get it. You’re not a kid anymore, after all.
Mmm~! I gotta become more mature like an adult, too!
I am!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Yeah, if we be good kids, Santa-san will come by.
That being said, from where does Santa-san come by, anyway? I’m kinda curious.
Ahaha, Anego is so cute, clapping her hands in joy~♪
Wait, sorry! It’s rude to call someone older than me cute, right? I’ll reflect on myself and do zazen meditation, so please forgive me!
3/3
Ah, Anzu-anego. Perfect timing~♪ I have the day off from Karate Club practice today, and there’s no Ryuseitai activities, either. I have the spare time, so is there any job I could do?
You could help me out with shopping.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ohh? You asked for a job upfront, huh?
You’re such a hard worker, Anzu-anego! I respect that ‘bout ya! But don’t push yourself too hard, okay?
Ohh, a person from fine asked you to do a bit of shopping. Then I’ll help ya carry the stuff~
I’m pretty decently strong despite how I may look, so feel free to rely on me all you like! ♪
Mm~…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You look like you’re struggling to think of somethin’, and it’s making me lose confidence… Well, to be fair, there’s a chance it turns into a disaster if I help out…
But, but! I really don’t mean to do anything bad, y’know…?
Oh, so you also just got yourself a job, huh? Then I’m guessing it’ll be pretty tricky to find me a job.
Ossu! Then this Nagumo Tetora will find a job all on his own~♪

entry.title: Christmas Live – Tetora Produce Course: Difficult Trial
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Christmas Live
1/3
Welcome~ Would you like some tasty cake? ♪
Ahh, Anzu-anego! Hello, thank you for the hard work as always! Me? I’m helpin’ out Hinata-kun with his part-time job~
Shall I help?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Seriously!? It’d be a huge help~! Ah, but you have a job to do too, don’t ya?
Mm, no, I feel bad to rely on you, so I appreciate the thought.
I appreciate the thought, but you have your own job to do, right? Leave this to me; I’d rather you focus on your own work, Anego.
I’ll prove to ya that I can do a great job superbly~♪
How admirable of you.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You’re the same too, arent’cha…?
I heard from the grapevine that you asked for a job all by yourself. I’m the same!
It’s not being admirable, it’s just natural to help your friend out, y’know~♪
Ah, would you like some cake, too?
I can sell it to ya cheap thanks to some part-time special rights, so please go ahead and buy some!
2/3
Uuu, attractin’ customers is harder than I thought…
Ah, sorry for complaining to ya, Anzu-anego. But, but! I can’t tell that to Hinata-kun, you feel me?
I’ll teach you some tips and tricks to pulling customers.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I just have to try talking to ‘em first? But some of ‘em aren’t interested, or are just passing by.
Yeah, attracting customers really is hard after all…
Hm, hm. So I should try greeting the passer-bys that are lookin’ at me? That makes sense, since there’s some who aren’t interested even if you talk to ‘em…
You really are incredible, Anzu-anego! I’m learnin’ so much~♪
You can talk to me anytime if you like.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
A-Anego…! My chest’s this close to trembling from emotion! You really are a reliable person, just like Taishou!
I seriously do respect ya~♪
You’re free to talk to me too, Anego! You’re always helpin’ me out, after all.
So I’d like you to rely on me sometime, too.
3/3
It really is too cold now to be wearing the school’s idol uniform, huh~
Ah…Ah-choo! ☆ Uu, did I catch a cold…? If Taishou was here right now, he’d scold me for not trainin’ enough!
You should wrap a spring onion around your neck.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Anzu-anego, that sorta treatment is all wrong~ I heard you’re supposed to eat it to take effect, not wrap it.
Ahaha, even Anego makes some mistakes, huh~
I hear that a lot, but does it really work…? Hmm… It’s good to steam it and wrap it in a towel before putting it around your neck, huh.
I’ll try it out tonight for sure! ♪
You should warm yourself up by taking a bath.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
To help circulate my blood, right? I heard that it’s good for that. I also have a nice, warm bath whenever I feel myself catchin’ a cold.
Plus, having a bath in the cold season is the absolute best~♪
But you can’t take a warm bath when you’ve got a high fever, y’know? It’s dangerous to get in the water like that! You have to be more careful with yourself too, okay, Anzu-anego?

entry.title: Climax – Chiaki Produce Course: Tough Being a Parent
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Climax
1/3
Anzu! What’s up? What are you doing here? Oho, have you come to see the gallant figure of the basketball captain? This may be your last chance, so let it imprint right into your very eyes…☆
That isn’t why I’m here.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Mhm, mhm, I understand completely. You’re embarrassed, aren’t you? …Woah!? Why’re you hitting me without saying anything!? Fuhaha! You really are like a tomboy! ☆
Mhm, you were looking for Akehoshi for something, I see. He’s gone to buy himself a drink, so he isn’t here. He’ll likely be back if you wait around, though.
…It’s going to be lonely.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
So that’s it, I see, I see! But there’s no reason to feel lonely — This is no eternal parting! Alright! I’m going to hug you tightly with all my gratitude for everything you’ve done! ☆
M-Mmm… Please don’t take what I said so seriously. I did say it lightly, but—… I’m sorry about that. I-If you keep looking so sad, I won’t know how to deal with this…
2/3
Ooh, Anzu! You’re here at just the right time!
The truth is, I was on my way to the Student Council office with Kanata, but we strayed off somewhere in the middle… Have you seen him anywhere?
I haven’t seen him.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I see. Just where did he go off to? …Oh, the figure I see over there looks to be Kanata? Anzu, sorry for stopping you for this! Farewell…!
Ahh, honestly, I can’t take my eyes off of him for one second. Oh well, if I wait here at the corridor, we’ll surely meet each other again. Would you like to chat until Kanata comes back? ☆
I saw him a second ago right over there.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ooh, so that’s where he was. Seems like he’s talking to someone. I’m glad I got to find him without too much trouble, and it’s all thanks to you. Thank you, I’m grateful…☆
Hmmm? Is he looking through the window…? Oh right, you can see the fountain from that window, right? He can really be troublesome when it comes to this. …Woah!! I think he’s planning to dive in from here!! I-I’m going to go stop him…!!
3/3
Huh, there really are heart-shaped ornaments wherever you go… Oh right, it’s going to be white day soon. I almost forgot! Anzu, what do you want as your white day gift?
Please give me work.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Hmmm, so you want work. But Ryuseitai has nothing going on right now… And I’ve left Repayment Festival to the kids, since it’s junior-focused… So I’m sorry to say that there isn’t any work I can give you.
Hahaha, you really do love work, don’t you! ☆ But sadly, there’s nothing I’m doing for my unit right now. Alright then! How about I go find out if there’s anything you could do…♪
The thought is what counts…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
There’s nothing you specifically want, huh… But I won’t be satisfied with that. There’s no need to rush, so if you find something you want, tell me.
Hm, the thought… That’s tricky somehow. But letting your feelings be known is the most important thing! Anzu, thank you for everything…☆

entry.title: Climax – Chiaki Produce Course: Justice Will Prevail
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Climax
1/3
I’m being asked to take jobs after graduation by the people I work with in the industry. Thanks to their help, I won’t have so much trouble with work for awhile.
Tenshouin lent me a hand too, which has helped me become one step closer to my dreams.
It’s going to get exciting, huh.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Yeah. I still have worries over the obstacles I’ll face, but…
I don’t plan on giving up the dream I’ve had since I was young! I’ll be glad if you could continue to support me, even after I’ve graduated…☆
Yeah! Now I can relax a little… …At least, I thought I could, but I’m just so worried about those three right now. Will they be fine on their own…?
Are you going to become a hero?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I can’t become a hero in a tokusatsu show just like that. But if anything happens to you, feel free to call for me. I’ve always been your hero, after all! ☆
I’ve got my start line for now. It’ll take a while before I can become a fully perfected hero. For the most part, I’ll be doing idol activities…☆
2/3
Mm, I can’t believe Takamine saw me that day… I’m embarrassed at how hard I tried to put up a front to be cool…
It actually makes me look pathetic instead, doesn’t it…?
That’s not true.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
R-Really…?
I prefer to avoid showing my shameful side to the kids, but… For some reason, it’s relieving hearing that from you, Anzu…♪
Are you trying to comfort me? Thank you, Anzu!
Graduations really do just feel sad and lonely. I wanted to at least stand proud in front of the kids, and yet… I’m so pathetic.
Please stay the way you are.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Huh!? Do you mean that I should keep being pathetic!? You have moments where you say horrid things like they’re nothing, don’t you…? Even if it is pathetic, I want to keep up the cool act at least for these final days.
Do you mean that being this way is also cool in itself…? You give some great advice. As you’d expect from a producer! Let me praise you! Good job, good job! ♪
3/3
I thought those three would be fine on their own, but there were a few moments that were cutting it extremely close.
But they aren’t kids anymore. I’m sure they’ll be able to take care of Ryuseitai. And Kanata and I will be able to graduate without any worries…☆
Ryuseitai will definitely be okay.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Yeah! There’s no need to worry about those three anymore! ☆ Graduating and leaving your beloved kids behind really feels lonely, though… To be honest, what I really want from the bottom of my heart is to spend more days with you and Ryuseitai in this academy.
I’m sure those three will continue to shape Ryuseitai in their own way. Kanata and I both believe in that! So please keep watching over them as their producer for us…☆
I’m truly indebted to you.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Anzu, don’t look so sad. It’s a hero’s duty to make people smile, so please let me fulfill it! So that your smile becomes everyone’s strength…♪
You’re going to make me blush if you say that so eagerly…♪ But I’m the one who’s indebted to you. I’m sure I put a lot of work on you. Let me say the same thing back: Thank you…☆

entry.title: Climax – Midori Produce Course: Novice Hero
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Climax
1/3
Sigh… I’m so tired… Why do I have to go to the basketball court when it’s so cold outside… I just want to go home and relax…
G-Good luck!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
If all it took was encouraging words, I wouldn’t be suffering this much, y’know… Ah, but if you cheered me on in a mascot costume, I might get the motivation…♪ Could you please wear it sometime, Anzu-san?
There’s nothing to work hard for, though… I can’t be bothered. I’m just not motivated somehow, I just feel depressed instead… But this is the last time we’re together, so I’ll suck it up and go.
Basketball court?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Yes. We’re going to have a farewell party at the Basketball Club. We’ll celebrate our upperclassmen’s graduation and have fun with sweets and stuff. It almost doesn’t feel real that they’re graduating, though…
Yeah… I get why we’re here, because we’re the Basketball Club and all… But why do we have to play outside? We could’ve done it inside, like the gym… Can I go home before anyone catches me…?
2/3
Hello, Anzu-san. What’re you doing here so early in the morning…? Yes, I’m helping my family with the store. If you’re looking for a particular shop, I can help you.
I’m here to buy vegetables.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You’ll cook some for lunch? Ahh, you’ll cook food for you at the cafeteria… You make use of that in school, huh? Then I’d be happy to help you find the seasonal vegetables, so please do ask me any time…♪
…You want avocadoes? Yes, we have some.
But avocado isn’t a vegetable, actually. It’s a fruit. They’re always next to the veggies, though, so people tend to confuse it for one.
I’m on my way to the pharmacy to buy band-aids.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ohh, you carry some in case anyone gets injured? …It’s true that there can be a few small accidents when practicing a dance routine. Fufu… You’re always prepared for anything, I’m impressed…♪
…Huh? Are you injured somewhere? Um, it’s not for you…? That’s good, then… You can be absentminded sometimes, so I was worried for a second.
3/3
Ah—! I’m so sorry. I was thinking about something while walking, so I didn’t notice you… I saw something I shouldn’t have seen… I dunno what I’m supposed to do in times like these… I wish I could just erase my memory of it entirely…
What did you see?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Um, I saw someone crying, even though they’re never the type to…
…Huh? "Oh, you saw me"? I don’t mean you, Anzu-san…? Ahaha, you teared up a bit while yawning? That’s a cute reason to cry…♪
Ah, um… I don’t think this is something I can tell others… I might’ve just been imagining it anyway…
…I’d rather keep this to myself for now.
(Reach hand out without saying anything)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
…Mm? Are you wondering if I had a nightmare? Please don’t pat my head out of nowhere… You surprised me, y’know?
I don’t dislike it, but it’s kinda embarrassing, like I’m a little kid…
Um… Why did you reach your hand out…? Whaa!? I might be able to forget if I get hit!? I-I don’t want to get hurt… Sometimes you think up terrifying things, Anzu-san…
