entry.title: Climax – Midori Produce Course: Path To Compassion
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Climax
1/3
You and Sengoku-kun were way too panicked… You just ran off out of nowhere.
And then even brought over some troublesome people…
I’m sorry…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ah— I’m sorry… I went too far. I can’t believe I said that when you’re just so worried for me… I’m so depressed, I wanna die…
Ah— Um… Please don’t worry about it, Anzu-san. I know both of you were just worried for me, and that’s why you went and called for them… I’m so sorry for making you worry.
Were we a nuisance?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I feel frustrated that everyone saw such a miserable side of me…
But well, thanks to that, I got to say what I wanted to tell everyone and get it out of my system… I don’t know if that’s a good thing or bad thing, though…
I feel like I just had to face this head on no matter what this time around, but… I really don’t ever want to go through this again.
So I’m glad everyone came over.
2/3
Everyone is working hard in preparation for Repayment Festival, huh… All for the sake of conveying their gratitude through their performance… Ahh, please don’t worry about me.
Let’s do our best together.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Yeah, about that… I plan to just support them as a fan this time. I’m so envious of you, Anzu-san. You’re always full of motivation.
It’s too late by now… I’m sure they’re both sick of me at this point, anyway. I’ll just support them from the sidelines. I’m cheering you on too, Anzu-san.
Will you do something from now?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I’m going to go back home now, but why do you ask…? You’d like me to peek at a Ryuseitai practice session with you…?
…How on earth do you expect me to see those two after everything…?
Yes, I have to help my family after this. Everyone in the shopping district is preparing their stalls for the day of Repayment Festival. I’m used to it by now, but it’s always a lot of work…
3/3
Our seniors really will graduate, won’t they… A lot has happened the past year…
But the reason we were able to remain as the five of us is also thanks to you, Anzu-san.
Thank you.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Whaa, that’s what made you cry…!?
I don’t want to see anyone’s tears ever again. So please smile, Anzu-san…♪
No, no, I’m the one who’s grateful. So please don’t bow your head, Anzu-san…! Let’s continue to support each other from now on, okay?
It’s because of everyone’s bonds!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Bonds…? That makes me feel a bit embarrassed somehow. But I got to confirm to myself that I really do love everyone in Ryuseitai…♪
Of course! They’re my comrades who fought alongside me for a whole year, after all!
—I bet that’s what Morisawa-senpai would say… Something must be wrong with me if I really imitated him of all people…

entry.title: Climax – Shinobu Produce Course: Endurance Of A Shy Person
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Climax
1/3
Anzu-dono~ Good morning~☆ Mm, I’m helping Isara-dono with Student Council work. I’d do whatever I can for Isara-dono’s sake! ♪
Shall I help you?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I’m happy you’d like to help, but…! I must work hard on my own, for the sake of maintaining the Ninja Association…! So please do watch over me for now.
R-Really? I’d love that! To be honest, I was not sure if I could accomplish this task on my own… It’d be reassuring to have you around, Anzu-dono~♪
Sounds like a lot of work.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Sigh… Actually, my task is to search for someone, but I cannot find them. …Huh? They’re taking a break today? That’s why I could not find them, huh? My research was insufficient~ I failed as a ninja~!
Not at all. There’s nothing I cannot accomplish! ♪ I cannot keep depending on you for everything, Anzu-dono. So if there’s anything you need help with, please rely on me!
2/3
There hasn’t been any Ryuseitai activities lately, so I haven’t been seeing Tetora-kun and Midori-kun as much… Our classes are different too, so at most, we just phone call or spot each other on the corridors. Are they both coming to school every day…?
How about you check Class A?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Mmm… I’ve been avoiding doing so as my reason to see them is far too trivial, so I would only bother them… But I don’t want to be incapable of talking to them ever again…! I’ll try to go visit them now~♪
I’m very shy, but I did try to build up the courage to visit them the other day. But neither were there…! I wasted my effort… Anzu-dono~! A-Are they avoiding me~!?
Actually…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Hmm, you’re looking for them, too? If you’d like, how about we search for them together? I wish to speak to them, too~♪
So they really haven’t been showing up in school!? I wonder what happened… Huh? That was a lie? I was seriously worried, you know~! Please don’t tease me like that~!
3/3
Hmm~ I’m wondering what to give my classmates for White Day… I’d like to prepare something before the day comes… Anzu-dono! Please help me think of something~!
I’m sure anything would make them happy!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
As long as I’m sincere about it? Y-You’re right! I don’t have to overthink it. Thank you so much for your advice, Anzu-dono…♪
Hmm, would something practical work…? But I want to be sure I give them something that’ll make them happy… U-Uuu~…? I won’t be able to decide like this~!
Maybe sweets?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Oh yes, Yuuta-kun gave me cookies. Hm? Cookies mean "you’re my friend"?
I-I’m so happy! Yuuta-kun is a precious friend to me, too~♪
Since it’s White Day, perhaps marshmallows…? Huh!? Marshmallows means "I hate you"!? E-Even if it’s just a rumor, I can’t risk giving something like that~!

entry.title: Climax – Shinobu Produce Course: Guiding Them To Hope
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Climax
1/3
Personally, I want to participate in Repayment Festival, no matter what… I want to provide Taichou-dono and Shinkai-dono with reassurance before they graduate. I want to show them we’ve grown so that they can graduate without any fear…!
Let’s do our best.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You also believe we will be fine…? ♪ Exactly! We haven’t been active in Ryuseitai just for show. We shall get through this together, even without Taichou-dono’s help!
Will we really be able to participate…? No, I mustn’t lose heart. In the worst case, I shall participate all on my own, if nothing else. …Nay, I much rather participate with all three of us~!
I wonder how it’ll go…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Mm… I assume Tetora-kun and Midori-kun feel the same. But it feels like neither know how to bring the topic up, and that is why things have been awkward. I have to be the one to bring the topic up…!
…P-Please just say that it’ll be okay! A producer mustn’t say something so concerning~! We will participate! Our feelings are one and the same…!
2/3
On that day, I tried to catch up to my seniors as soon as possible, but I failed to… It really reminded me just how little stamina I have. I was trying my best to build my stamina up, but it appears that it wasn’t enough!
Hmmm…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I have the impression that you’re growing a lot due to how producing works… Hmm, I shall learn from you and move around much more! Having stamina is fundamental as an idol, too~♪
My seniors were simply just too fast…? I suppose you are correct… But in that case, I would like to work hard so that I do not fall behind them.
You’re doing fine.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You believe that I’ve built more stamina? I’m so happy to hear that from you, the producer…♪ Then I shall do my best to build up some more!
Huh!? It is alright because I’m still young…? We are only a year apart, you know? Please don’t act much more mature than me, like Tetora-kun did~! Don’t leave me behind~!
3/3
I was worried what would happen for a while, but it seems like we will be able to get through today~♪ Tetora-kun does not seem to be in top-shape, so I am a little concerned about him… But I shall make sure that I accomplish my duty as part of Ryuseitai…!
You really are the Yellow of a sentai squad.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Do you think so, Anzu-dono? I’m so happy! The yellow color in sentai squads is the one who livens the mood~♪ I shall do my utmost best to be that for Ryuseitai…!
I am Ryusei Yellow, after all! I am doing my best to be the positive character at all times! However, perhaps I should be much more sensitive and sentimental this time…?
How exciting!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Heh! Of course! If we don’t enjoy ourselves, neither will our fans. Even if our members have decreased, we shall show them what Ryuseitai is all about!
W-What’s the matter, Anzu-dono? You have such a suspicious-looking grin on your face! First the seniors, and now you — What is everyone scheming~!?

entry.title: Climax – Tetora Produce Course: As The Future Commander
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Climax
1/3
‘Sup, Anzu-anego! ☆ Thanks for all your help in the Dragon King Competition! Thanks to you, I got to express every bit of my feelings to Taishou!
Next up is Repayment Festival…? Oh yeah…
Things just keep getting hectic, huh?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You’re helping around the place for Repayment Festival, huh? Thanks for all your hard work, Anzu-anego! You had to do so much back in Chocolat Fes for us, like how to make chocolate and stuff… Please don’t overwork yourself too much, or you’ll hurt yourself.
Repayment Festival is centered around us underclassmen, right? I may be the next commander of Ryuseitai, but I can’t decide on things with my opinion alone. Please give me more time to see if we’ll participate or not.
What’s wrong?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ah, it’s nothin’! I was just thinking… That being said, I don’t think I can tell you what we’ll do for Repayment Festival yet. But once the time comes, I’ll talk to you ‘bout it!
…S-Sorry! I gave you a vague response! Ah nah, I was just thinking about what’ll happen to Ryuseitai after our seniors graduate. I’m pretty anxious more than anything right now…
2/3
Ossu! Thank you for coming over to the dojo! But Taishou isn’t here right now. He’s busy dealing with somethin’ in his unit.
But if I’m to be honest, I wish we could’ve trained a bit longer before he graduates…
Shall I be your partner?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Like, a sparring partner!? Ah, not that? You meant as someone to talk to? Sure, I’d love to get some advice from ya~♪
Whaa!? You’ll be my sparring partner…!? You aren’t a martial artist, and I could never throw a punch at a lady… Taishou’ll get mad at me if I ever did.
I think you’re pretty strong already.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
It’s ‘cuz I’ve been training as much as I can so I can be on par with Taishou. I think I was able to show him I’ve grown lots in the Dragon King Competition. It’s all thanks to Taishou and my seniors in Ryuseitai that I’ve grown this much…♪
You know how strong Taishou is, right, Anzu-anego? I’m still nowhere near that point, not even on the same footing as him! So I’m gonna grow stronger and stronger!
3/3
…Hm? Why’re you staring at me? Is there somethin’ on my face? I seem more mature? Even you’re saying that, Anzu-anego? Seng—Shinobu-kun also said something like that to me. Did I really change that much~?
Shinobu-kun?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Yeah, as in Sengoku-kun! I’ve decided to start calling him by his first name. I didn’t know what timing would be right to change how I called him at first.
But now that I’m calling him that… It’s a li’l embarrassing somehow…♪
It really is weird when I call him that, isn’t it!? Ahh, you’re not used to me calling him by his first name, so you just wanted to be sure if you were hearing right. Yeah, it still feels a li’l off for me, too.
…Yeah, somehow.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ahaha, just somehow…? But I’m happy for the compliment! Even if you’re just flattering me, I’m still thankful!
S-Somehow…!? But to be honest, I don’t think anything has changed about me. I just wanted to stop being so spoiled from now on.

entry.title: Climax – Tetora Produce Course: Fruits Of One’s Efforts
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Climax
1/3
I went too far the other day… I need to reflect on myself… Woah!? Why’d you suddenly pat my head!? Ah, you thought I was depressed? Don’t worry ‘bout me.
I felt like patting you.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I-I’m not a kid…! Getting pat on the head doesn’t make me happy, y’know? …But you’re worried for me, aren’tcha? I’m happy you feel that way…
You thought I was crying? It’s true that I’m a li’l worried, but… Don’t worry, I’m not that frail.
I can’t help but worry.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I’m fine, really! Please don’t worry about me! I’m sorry for making you worry. You really are such a kind person, Anzu-anego…♪
I ended up making so many people worry this time… I’m real sorry for all the trouble… I’m gonna go apologize to my seniors later today, too.
2/3
We’re gonna get to perform in the auditorium for Repayment Festival! This is all thanks to our efforts in Chocolat Fes, and our fans! I’d love you to come see us if you don’t mind, Anzu-anego!
I’m busy with work…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Y-You don’t gotta apologize! ‘Course you’re gonna be busy with produce work, it only makes sense. Let’s both do our best for our own jobs!
Mm? You might not be able to come cheer us on? Ahh, you’ve been busy with managing the event and preparing stuff, huh? That’s a shame. But if you ever get the time, please come watch us, even if for only a li’l while.
I’ll definitely come!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Really!? You’re awesome, Anego! Now I gotta be sure to put an effort in the performance! ‘Cuz your cheers give us strength! ☆
Ah, you don’t have to stress yourself out over it! I’m sure we’ll be able to get through the whole event as long as we don’t make any major mistake. So you’re free to come watch us in the second half, even if only a li’l bit~♪
3/3
I’m super indebted to Shinkai-senpai and Taichou! I may not be able to become like Taichou, but… I’m gonna do my best in my own way, alongside Midori-kun and Shinobu-kun…!
Ryusei Red!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Y-You’re gonna make me blush, y’know… But I’m gonna inherit Red after Taichou graduates. The leading role still suits Morisawa-senpai for now…!
Whaaa!? You surprised me with that name! But I’ve gotten a real taste of how much work it is to be “Taichou” this time around… I’m gonna work as hard as I can as the next commander in line.
Ryusei Black!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Hm? Do I dislike bein’ called that? I’ve been calling myself that for a whole year, so…
“Ryusei Black” feels more right for me right now, to be honest.
Ah, there’s no need to make that “Ah, I messed up!” look, y’know?
I’m fine being Ryusei Black for now. I’m gonna do my very best ‘til I can proudly call myself “Ryusei Red”!

entry.title: Comet Show – Midori Mini Talk: Worrisome Days
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Comet Show
1/3
(Sigh… I’ve had to deliver so many veggies today…) (This is way too much for one person to carry… Actually, haven’t they been asking for more than usual lately? No wonder it’s been so rough…)
…Alright, I didn’t forget to deliver anything here. Thank you for purchasing~… Wait, there isn’t even anyone here…
I’m here!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Woah!? Anzu-san…!? Umm, could you please greet me first…? You scared the life out of me…
Ah, you don’t have to apologize. I’m also pretty silly for assuming nobody would be here… Let’s just call it even…
Woah, if you were here all along, then please say so… Don’t tell me you heard me talking to myself… So embarrassing…
I was just finishing up my veggie deliveries from my family’s greengrocer. What about you, Anzu-san? Are you working right now? Huh, so you’ve got a meeting to prepare for. That sounds rough to deal with early in the morning…
Good morning.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Good morni—Oh, it’s you, Anzu-san. It’s too early to eat here, y’know…? I doubt there’s anything prepared right now. But I guess you could at least have a coffee here or something, yeah. The tables are big enough for sorting through documents, too.
Oh, that voice sounds familiar… Ahh, so it really was you, Anzu-san. Good morning.
As you can probably tell, I’ve been going around ES delivering veggies. It takes so long to get through because of how huge the load is… "You’re doing a great job"…? I could say the same thing to you, though…? It’s incredible that you’re here so early in the morning…
2/3
Huh…? You’re wondering why I keep sighing over and over again…?
Uuu… I’m sorry, it must’ve been so annoying… But I feel like I can’t get through the day without sighing a little… You probably already know this, but Ryuseitai hasn’t been doing well lately…
It’s making you depressed, isn’t it?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Yeah, exactly. I keep finding myself complaining about how depressing it is… That side of me just frustrates me even more… But I can’t hold in the urge to complain whenever I get fed up with something… So I’ve been at least trying to avoid making any depressing comments whenever I’m around strangers…
The three of us in Ryuseitai are on hiatus right now… and now that I’ve got nothing to do, I end up overthinking stuff and getting even more depressed… I’ve been trying to at least do some kinda physical activity to avoid that, so that’s why I’ve been putting way more effort into my family’s greengrocer than I used to. Ah, wait a sec—Maybe another reason I’ve been sighing so much is because I’ve been carrying a lot of veggies…?
I’ve heard about it.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I knew it. Well, of course you would, since you’re the producer… We were just about to suck it up and do the whole restructuring of the unit when our seniors suddenly decided they’d leave the unit… So things got even more complicated… They’re always so random with their decisions. I wish they’d understand that you need to explain yourself first before deciding on something.
Mmm… Personally, I don’t feel that affected by the whole restructuring thing the agency suggested… Meanwhile, both Tetora-kun and Shinobu-kun were doing their best to accept the reality of the situation, but… our seniors made everything worse, you could say… Thanks to that, Tetora-kun seems on edge, and our seniors haven’t explained themselves yet either, as always. Sigh, this is so depressing…
3/3
Thanks for lending an ear, Anzu-san… Talking to you made me realize that maybe I really did want someone to hear me out all along…
I didn’t think I needed it at first, because I don’t want too many people knowing what’s been going on with us, and I barely have anyone I can talk to when it comes to unit problems…
You can always count on me.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ummm, no, it’s okay… I feel too awkward to do that… I’d feel awful if I put more work on somebody who’s already so busy… Aren’t you the one who could use a lending hand? I could help you out with stuff if it requires manual labor, so please feel free to ask me anytime.
Isn’t that attitude of yours why you’re working so early…?
Here, please take some vegetables as repayment for hearing me out. It’s my way of showing support, so… Please take care with your work. Don’t worry, these aren’t for delivery. Hmm, mini tomatoes should be a nice snack when you’re on the clock…
Somebody to vent to, huh…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
"How about talking to a friend"…? F-Friend…? The first people that came to mind are Tetora-kun and Shinobu-kun, but that’d just be a discussion between Ryuseitai members… I guess Hinata-kun could be another option…? But I might end up bothering him if I suddenly came to him with a problem…
Ehh…? Talk to my roommates?
There’s no way I could talk about my worries to the people who literally act as the vice-president of their agencies… Ah, but dorming with my roommates is pretty normal for the most part… They gift me souvenirs whenever they travel around the country, and check over my school work, and stuff…

entry.title: Comet Show – Midori Mini Talk: Topics About That Guy
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Comet Show
1/3
(Let’s search for… “Morisawa, Chiaki”…) (Huh, there really are a lot of people talking about his casting role in the new tokusatsu show… Where the heck did they get this info from, anyway…?) …Huh, Anzu-san? Good afternoon…
What were you looking at on your phone?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Eh, nothing much… I was just thinking about how I can’t seem to keep up with things lately… I was looking through social media just now, and people are already talking about upcoming shows for winter and spring… When it’s not even October yet… I get so depressed whenever I come across stuff like that… But I guess it’s my own fault for looking up stuff on social media in the first place…
Huh? Nothing much… I was just searching up topics related to Morisawa-senpai on social media…
I’d hate to find out that he’s been talking behind our backs, so I regularly search his name as a check-up.
…Why’re you asking me if I’m okay…? Isn’t it normal to look up stuff about your senior online…?
You had a scary look on your face while you were on your phone.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Oh, you should blame Morisawa-senpai for that. I was just searching up his name on social media…
I tend to search his name every once in a while, but I’ve been doing it way more often lately because I’m frustrated that he’s barely concerned about us nowadays…
Thanks to that, I have all his talk shows memorized in my head… Ugh, this sucks, I’m not even a fan of him or anything…
Huh? Did I…? Tetora-kun’s told me before that I look scary when I’m serious, but I can’t exactly tell on my own… That’s why I’m glad you pointed it out to me right now, Anzu-san. After all, I shouldn’t have a scary look on my face when I’m supposed to be a hero, right?
2/3
What am I doing? …Not much. I’ve got nothing to do right now…
Ryuseitai’s on a hiatus, so I was planning to laze around at home after classes were over, but my parents kicked me out… I’d only stand out if I stuck around the shopping district, though, so… That’s how I ended up here.
What about your practice sessions?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I don’t have any. I feel too awkward practicing all alone in an ES practice room… Also, there’d be no point to it, anyway. I wouldn’t be able to tell how well I’m doing with my choreography on my own… Our formation and how we present ourselves together is really important, y’know… I wouldn’t be able to tell if I’m doing that properly or not at all…
I don’t really have any. The only thing I could do now is solo practice, I think…? I don’t have any personal training like Tetora-kun and Shinobu-kun, either. Wait, woops—Almost forgot about Basketball Club… Isara-senpai’s been telling me to show up whenever I can, so maybe I’ll consider going tomorrow…
What about your solo work?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I do get jobs related to my greengrocer background… But I can’t have people think of me as the greengrocer boy over being an idol or hero, so I only do it every once in a while…
My parents are super happy about it, though, so lately I’ve been trying to think of it as a way to repay them for everything.
Well, I guess I do have some, yeah… But I don’t do my gravure modeling as often as I used to…1 I don’t have any photoshoots to deal with for the weekend anymore, so I’ve just been casually enjoying my weekends lately…
And Ryuseitai’s on hiatus too, so I guess I also get to chill on weekdays…
3/3
…Ah, please check this out. This soft drink ad just showed up on my social media feed.
It’s showing Morisawa-senpai in full… Oh, he’s gotten a lot of comments from his fans, too. Let’s see… "I’m wishing you the best, Chiaki-kun"… "I love you, Chiaki-kun!"… Man, he sure is popular…
That’s the point of the advertisement!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ohhh, you’re the one who suggested this to him?
I mean, I guess it does suit his image and all, but… since I know what he’s actually like, I can’t help but feel like everyone’s being tricked…
We’re talking about the guy who literally yells "Okaa-saaaaaaaan!!!" to the ocean, y’know…?
Point? …Ah, does that mean you’re the one who suggested this ad to him? Huh, it does kinda suit his image. I guess he does look like a pleasant person when he smiles—as long as he keeps his mouth shut, that is.
If only he always looked this calm in real life, and maybe then I’d finally be able to live my life peacefully…
Is something bothering you?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
No, not really… It’s just… He feels so far away…
He was always pestering me day in and out last year… So why is it so hard just to meet up with him now…? It makes no sense to me… I should give him an earful or two the next time we meet, don’t you think? Yeah, that sounds like a good idea…
I know there’s no point in me getting angry at an ad, but I’m kinda upset, like… "What the hell are you smiling over when your unit’s suffering right now"…
He’s supposed to be the number one person who wants to be a hero, but instead he asks to leave the unit? Does he ever bother to think about how we feel? If you’re such an ally of justice and all, then how about you consider protecting your own comrades’ feelings, huh…
format_size
Translation Notes ↑ Obligatory note, since googling “gravure” often results in risque modeling—The type of gravure modeling this refers to is more akin to the fanservice of looking cool or suave in photoshoots to appeal to the viewers.

entry.title: Naked – Chiaki Mini Talk: Cooking Made With Love!
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Naked
1/3
Lately, everyone in Ryuseitai has been busy with their personal work, right? I’m sure exhaustion is starting to build up inside them. That’s why I’d like to cook them something that could energize their spirits!1
Mm~ I’m not sure what to make them exactly…
That sounds great.
Ooh, you think so!? To be frank, I was actually worried everyone would tell me that they don’t need that…
But if you approve of my idea, then I should be able to push through with confidence~♪
You’re busy too, aren’t you, Senpai?
Yeah, I am. But that doesn’t act as an excuse not to cheer them up. We’re a unit, after all. It’s important that we join arms for each other’s sake no matter the time and place, right?
I’d love to make something that bursts them with energy with just one fill…!
2/3
Now that I’ve decided to make them food, the question is what to make… Should I go with grilled fish or rolled omelette?2 Or maybe…
Anzu, what kind of food do you think they’d find simple to eat while having a busy life?
How about onigiri?
Ohh, I see! That might be a really good idea. With onigiri, you can nourish yourself with healthy food with just one hand, even when you’re busy with work.
They won’t get bored of the taste if I make a variety of them with different ingredients, and there’s the excitement of choosing whichever you like. Alright, I’ll go with that!
How about miso soup?
Miso soup, huh… I didn’t think of that; it does sound good. And it’d be abundant with protein if I add in regular or fried tofu, so it’d be good for their nutrition.
The best part is, it should be able to soothe their exhausted bodies. Alright, miso soup it is!
3/3
That all being said, if I’m making enough food for everyone in Ryuseitai, it’s going to be a lot… Even shopping for ingredients will be demanding on me.
Anzu, if it’s alright with you, could you help me out with cooking…?
Of course.
And there it is, with her immediate reply! Thank you, Anzu~♪
Alright then, let’s start by shopping first. Are you ready to head on out? With you around, I should be able to decide on which ingredients to buy in a snap! ☆
I was just about to offer.
You were actually just about to offer helping me…?
Ahh, you truly are so kind, Anzu. I’m a little worried you might exhaust yourself from helping us so much, honestly. But this time around, you’ll be saving me from so much trouble. I’d really appreciate your help with this!

entry.title: Naked – Chiaki Mini Talk: Input Is Important
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Naked
1/3
Parkour has been getting featured on TV lately, and it’s been really fascinating to watch.
Yeah, I was actually thinking about how much parkour and stuntwork have in common. Maybe I should give parkour a shot sometime?
Safety first, of course.
Yeah, you’re absolutely right on that.
As Ryusei Red, I swear to you that I won’t partake in anything dangerous that could worry all the kids out there. I’m well versed in the techniques for keeping your body safe from injury.1 So please be rest assured! ☆
It needs a bit of courage, doesn’t it?
Yeah, and those who call themselves a hero should never forget to show courage!
But also, all sports come with the risk of injury. If I ever give it a try, I promise you that I’ll be extra careful…☆
2/3
Sports and other physical activities can be enjoyed in various ways, not just through watching. For example, listening to the radio commentating a sports match or reading a novel based on a sport are fun in their own right too.
It gets your imagination moving until you feel like you’re right there with them, experiencing it for yourself!
That’s an interesting discovery.
Yeah, right? Sometimes, things resonate a lot deeper inside when it doesn’t come with visuals! I’m always amazed by the overwhelming expressive power that writers have.
Anzu, I’d love you to try reading a novel like that before you sleep sometime. I’m sure you’ll end up having a wonderful dream…☆
I’ll give it a shot.
Yeah, please do. The moment you get absorbed into it, you’ll be having vivid images of the players moving about in your head. Because you’re so focused on reading the words, you might find yourself immersed in its world, far more than if you were to watch it.
Words are as vast as the universe, after all!
3/3
In order to expand the amount of things I can do, I have to actively put in the effort to absorb various things.
The moment I loosen up, I find myself watching adorable videos of animals one after the other.2 There’s nothing wrong with those types of videos, but watching only those is a little too much…
I know how you feel.
Ah, you also end up in that endless loop of watching animal videos, Anzu? This might be similar to how Kanata feels when he gazes at marine animals.
But in Kanata’s case, that comes in handy for managing his aquarium, so it’s probably necessary for him to spend time doing that.3
Try putting a timer.
I see. You’re right, I have to at least force myself to stop with something like that. It isn’t good to use up my time just watching with no end. It’s possible that everyone else in Ryuseitai is struggling with a similar problem, too.
Alright, I’ll have a digital detox day with everyone soon! ☆
format_size
Translation Notes ↑ This is typically known as “breakfall”. For example, when doing a stunt or parkour, the way to fall safely is to roll or tumble down.↑ Chiaki started watching animal videos at around the start of ES2 July; he first mentions this in Mega Stream – Follow Closely! mini talk (Part Two, 3/3).↑ Kanata manages Aoumi Aquarium.

entry.title: Naked – Shinobu Mini Talk: Time Spent With Kids
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Naked
1/3
Anzu-dono, are you going to meet with Morisawa-dono soon?
Ahh, so you have a briefing with him. That’s right, I recall seeing that written in his schedule…1
Mm? If there’s a message I’d like to pass on to Morisawa-dono, you’ll do it for me?
If there’s some business you have with him…
Mmh~ I do not believe I have any urgent matter… I suppose if I had to mention something, I’m looking forward to the live stream we’ll be doing together tonight.
But that is nothing important that I’d need you to pass it on to him, Anzu-dono.
Maybe a supportive message…
Ooh, I see! Alright, then I shall send Morisawa-dono my cheers since you kindly offered~♪
Please do your best in the briefing! It’s you we’re talking about, Morisawa-dono! I just know it’ll go well!
Although, the meeting doesn’t appear to be something that I’d need to cheer on… But still, I hope it energizes Morisawa-dono to hear! ♪
2/3
Yesterday, I was walking around town with Morisawa-dono, when we spotted some kids playing superheroes. As we passed by them, the kids saw Morisawa-dono as a suitable villain role for some reason, and asked him to play the part.
He joined in without ever refusing their casting, and I got to join them playing as well~♪
It must’ve been a peaceful playtime, huh?
Ehehe. Yes, we got to spend a peaceful time with the children~♪ I think we ended up playing with them for around an hour.
The children looked super satisfied, and Morisawa-dono’s face was also beaming with a smile~♪
I wonder why they wanted him to be the villain?
Morisawa-dono doesn’t give off any sort of villain vibes, no matter how you look at it… But children tend to prefer playing as the hero, so perhaps it’s simply natural to them to have the adult as the villain.2
Either way, Morisawa-dono wasn’t one bit reluctant to take on the role. He looked like he was having fun, and played the part perfectly!
3/3
Since we got to see each other today, you’d like to buy me some juice before you head to the briefing?
No, I feel awkward making you treat me for no particular reason, Anzu-dono…!
I’d much rather you allow me to treat you to something, since I’m always indebted to you!
The thought is enough for me.
Mmh~ It doesn’t appear that you’ll accept my offer, does it…
Then… I shall gift you that!
This is candy I bought a while ago. I heard it’s good for the throat, so please do eat it~♪
I already have the drinks with me.
Ah, then how about sweets in return?
Uuu, you also have a lot of sweets with you? You’re always so well-prepared, Anzu-dono…
Then allow me to treat you to food next time. It’s a promise between you and I~♪
format_size
Translation Notes ↑ As a fun note, Shinobu tends to manage Ryuseitai’s schedules as of ES Year 2; this is mentioned in Stella Maris, hidden island 4.↑ This is my personal interpretation as it’s never fully confirmed in the mini talk, but it might possibly be a reference to the Idol Story Always Hold a Heroic Heart, where Chiaki plays as the villain when he sees kids playing superheroes. Even if it isn’t a reference, this cute anecdote reminded me of that idol story!

entry.title: Naked – Shinobu Mini Talk: Performance Worth Seeing
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Naked
1/3
Ooh, there appears to be some performances happening over there! Over there is a magic show, and over on that side is a singing perfomance~♪
Anzu-dono, I’d love to check one of them out if you have the time; which would you like to see?
The magic show sounds nice.
Nihihi, I thought so as well~♪
Ooh, a rabbit jumped out of the hat! And we’re even allowed to pet it?
It’s so fluffy and soft, and just so adorable…♪
The song performance sounds nice.
Understood, nin-nin! It will also act as good reference for my idol work~♪
…Ohh, the song’s tune is intense, but their singing is so delicate and gentle! That stirred me a little. I’d love to be able to sing songs this well, too.
2/3
As I work more as an idol, I get reminded just how important it is to take a look at various things. Even if I don’t end up directly applying any of the techniques, I feel as though I get a much more abundant sense of my work.
I’d love to check out more and more things I’ve never experienced before~♪
That’s a great mindset.
Your praise makes me happy, Anzu-dono…♪ Nevertheless, it’s also true that I mostly have the motivation to do it, but have not actually been doing anything of the sort.
I’d like to put in the effort and go to a theater as well, however small it may be!
You can keep growing, after all.
Ooh, you may be right on that. The more input I take in, the more I might be able to grow as an idol…
Looking at it that way makes it sound a lot more fun; it may even make the effort of going to those places feel lighter, too~♪
3/3
Mm? The singer over in that mini live is singing with their guests.
Ooh, it’s an impromptu duet with the guest!
Huh? I feel like they’re looking over our side this time…
They’re calling for you.
Eh? Me? It does look fun, but is it really alright for me to go up there…?
There aren’t that many people watching, so it should be fine if it’s for a little while?
Fufu, then I shall go and have a bit of fun. Please do watch me from here~♪
Maybe I should go…?
Are you thinking of going there to have a duet with them, Anzu-dono? While I’d love to hear you sing… I don’t think you need to overdo it, you know?
Ah, it looks like they called over a different guest. …Fufu, you look relieved, Anzu-dono. I’m glad for you~♪

entry.title: Ninja Clan – Chiaki Mini Talk: An Invasion from a Formidable Enemy
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Ninja Clan
1/3
Producer! I’m so glad I found you, I was looking for you!
T-The truth is… there was a box in front of my dorm room yesterday… On it said “to Morisawa-senpai”, and… the name of that…
That?
Um, you know, the… Guhh! Find the courage within you, Morisawa Chiaki…!
Eggplants! I was gifted my most detested thing in the world: eggplaaaants~!
Could it be…
Y-Yeah… Exactly, I received eggplants…
I can only think of one person who’d do this, but I didn’t expect him to actually send me a box…
You look pale…?
Ahhh… I’m sorry for worrying you… I feel a chill down my spine all of a sudden, even though it’s so hot outside…
2/3
Somebody could trip if I left the box in the hallway, so I shoved it inside my dorm for the time being, but… I can’t get the courage to open it.
I’d honestly rather avoid seeing or touching it altogether, but… It’ll just rot if I leave it as it is…
How about giving it to someone?
Good idea… There’s a couple of people who cook in the dorm’s kitchen often, so maybe I could hand it to them, instead.
But that means carrying the box… Uuu, so I can’t avoid touching that, can I…
That would be rude to the farmers, after all…
Yeah, you’re right… I shouldn’t waste all the farmers’ effort in growing these. I need to think up a way to get rid of them before they rot, or I’ll feel bad…
Do you hate eggplants that much?
Of course I do…! I don’t even want to hear its name! Don’t you have something you hate that much, too!?
You don’t? U-Umm… Okay then…
3/3
Well, either way, thank you for hearing me out.
I’ll do something about the box by today. I just have to see it this way: This is actually my lucky day! Heroes grow stronger the more powerful the adversary! I’ll make sure to overcome this obstacle, no matter what it takes!
Someone else said the exact same thing…
Ohh!? That’s so cool! They must be a fan of tokusatsu! Who exactly was it? I’d love to talk to them all about tokusatsu…♪1
Shall I take a few from you?
Y-Yeah, please… I’ll use wrapping paper and paper bags to avoid looking at them, and bring them over to you tomorrow.
Please hang in there!
Yeah, thank you! I’d love to hear your cheers! They’ll give me strength! I’ll use them to power up and win against the eggplants…!

entry.title: Ninja Clan – Chiaki Mini Talk: Sightseeing the Historical Village
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Ninja Clan
1/3
Ooh, this village really brings back a lot of memories for me. The last time I was here was for the Scroll of the Elements performance.1 We still have time before the live show, so how about we go around the place for now?
Oh! There’s a samurai walking about! It’s like we’ve been taken back to the era itself~♪
It’d suit you.
Ohh, I’m so happy to hear that~♪ I think I’d have fun acting as a samurai sheathing a katana, punishing the wicked and protecting the weak!
I’m feeling nostalgic, too.
I had a lot of fun going around the place during Scroll of the elements! Oh, and I remember how flashy Kanata’s ninjutsu was. The most exciting performance was when Sengoku jumped through a ring of fire. I remember the cheers like it was yesterday!
I hope the audience enjoys the performance.
Yeah, me too. You prepared a lot for us today, after all!
We had to practice for this performance alongside the one for MDM, but we all worked hard for it, so I’m sure it’ll go well!
2/3
Mm! Does the outfit look okay like this, Producer!?
It’s light and durable, and it even glows! It’s fun to wear~♪
This surely must’ve costed a lot of time and money to make… Did it?
That’s confidential information.
Oh, were you told not to reveal the costs?
Hmm, that makes me a little worried, but I understand. I won’t pry any further.
I put a lot of effort into the katana prop’s design, too.
Oh yeah, I was wondering about that! Could I unsheathe it to try it out?
Ohhh! It has the same texture as one, too! This is so incredibly detailed—you wouldn’t be able to tell on first glance! ♪
It’ll be alright.
Mm~, your “alright” doesn’t always equate to that, though…
Don’t overwork yourself, okay? Everyone, including me, would worry sick if you crashed down.
3/3
Alright, the performance is starting soon. But before that, I’d like to express my gratitude, Producer.
Thank you so much for doing everything in your power for Sengoku’s sake. Sengoku tends to repress his emotions subconsciously, likely because there was a time when nobody accepted him for his interests, but… I can tell he’s enjoying himself a lot right now. I’m so glad you were here for him.
It’s all because everyone was here for him.
Fufu, I’m happy to hear you say that. Takamine, Nagumo, and Kanata all did their very best to make through the harsh practice—all for Sengoku’s sake. I’m so glad everyone in Ryuseitai was here for him. I really, really am.
I simply did my duty.
Haha, your straightforward personality is your strength.
You were only a young girl when we first met, yet you’ve already grown so much since then.
It’s all for the sake of the Ninja Association.
Yeah, this performance is for the sake of the Ninja Association’s survival!
Alright, I’m off! I’ll run and bounce all about on stage!

1/3
huff... i wanted to bathe in water, but chiaki stopped me. but i was hoping to dip myself in it, because it is just so hot~... water-bathing is a matter of [life or death] to me...
i cannot believe chiaki would stop me from doing it, how [heartless]...
Instead, how about...
mm? what is it? you will fan me with a [folding fan] instead?
ufufu, it feels good~♪ thank you very much.
Here’s water.
thank you very much. i will have this, then.
gulp, gulp, whewww~ fufufu, i feel alive again~♪
The waterway...
there are [creatures] in there different from the [pond] i usually bathe in, so it is impossible to get tired of looking at it~♪
ufufu, it is alright. i will not go in it, not for now~♪
2/3
huh? what is this shop...?
ahh, a [souvenir shop], is it? there are so many things sold here~
maybe i will buy something for everyone in the [dorm]. what do you think would be good, anzu-san?
The replica katana.
the [replica katana]~? it is surprisingly well-made, isn’t it? i might give this to [chief-san]. it might [suit] him more than expected.
The manjuu.
this sounds lovely~ i can share it among all of them, so it is quite convenient. maybe i will buy two boxes so i can give them to everyone in [oceans]~♪
The hand-towels.
hm, hm, there are hand-towels with [original patterns] here, too.
oh, so this little one is called [hanzou-mon]? fufu, midori might like this~♪1

alright then, it is about time. let’s head on to the [venue]~
ufufu, i bought plenty of [souvenirs] as well, so i am very satisfied.
but before that, i want to [puka, puka] at least one~ (sways left and right)
P-Please wait!
fufu, i am just joking~ i would only get drenched wet if i dip in right now.
after the live show is over, i will [puka puka] as celebration of our efforts~♪
Please keep it for after the live show.
that is true. there is not much time left either, so how about we go now? i will leave the souvenirs i bought in the green room.
Shall I hold the souvenirs for you?
not to worry. i have quite the strength in me~
but since you seem to have nothing to do for now, could i ask you to at least hold this paper bag for me?

1/3
yes, thank you very much~♪
ah, anzu-san. hello there~ i went and changed my outfit.
fufu, there were a few [staff members] that i [recognize]. so i was greeting them.
This is an ES plan, after all.
ahh, so that is why there are a few [es] people here, yes?
this appears to be an experiment for a [new project], is that right? chiaki said that it is an [honor] for ryuseitai to be chosen for it.

that is true~ i also manage an [aquarium], so i know how important [communication] is.
fufun, didn’t i sound a little mature there? i am also growing lots, you know~♪

they are all changing their outfit, too. when i saw them, one of them was eating the [manjuu] we got as refreshments.
i had one too, and it was so sweet and tasty~♪

fufufu, we have a [full house] with the audience too, don’t we~♪
thanks to anzu-san attracting customers, we will be having a lot of people watching us now. the new [ar performance] we added should turn out amazing, too.

ahh, there will be [enemies] to fight this time, right? such cute [ninja-sans]~ i would love to perform a [live show] where fishies are swimming someday~♪

fufu, seeing anzu-san having so much fun makes me happy, too~♪

it seems shinobu has loosened up his [nerves].
instead of having our bodies be so [stiff], we should be [soft and limp] like jellyfishies~ (sways left and right) if we trust in the flow pulling us to and fro, everything will surely go well~♪
“Peace”
yes, [peace]. let’s join our [hands] together~♪
fufu, we made a four-sided [starfishie]. how very cute.
I will be watching over all of you.
yes, please watch over us. simply having you around will be enough to come in shinobu’s aid, as well as the others. we are counting on you.
Please do your best!
fufu, of course. the [ninja association]’s survival all depends on us.
for shinobu’s sake, let’s deliver our song to everyone here~♪

entry.title: Ninja Clan – Midori Mini Talk: Relaxing Gameplay
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Ninja Clan
1/3
Um… Let’s get close slowly, and fling my net on the bug at the right moment… slooowly…
Crap, it ran away… I think I did it a bit too early…
Ah, good afternoon. I have my meeting with you today, right?
Were you playing a game?
Ah, yeah, I was. You get to decorate an island and craft stuff in this game. It’s pretty fun. Me and Harukawa-kun were going to play together today, so I brought my console to school.
Maybe I arrived too early…
Hmm, have you…? Ermm, let’s see, we have our meeting at the half hour mark, which is ten minutes from now.
Morisawa-senpai always says stuff like, “It’s only natural to be ten minutes early to a job as a working adult!”, so I think you’re right on time.
I’m only going to pass on the documents.
Oh, that’s already a lifesaver. I’m not going to have enough time for another meeting because of my solo work, so…
Um, so it’s a gravure photoshoot again, huh? I feel like I’ve been getting those a lot lately…1
2/3
How about you also try playing this game, Anzu-san? There are other students playing it, too. You can take your time progressing in the game, and you get to fish or dig around for stuff, and even make your own designs for stuff.
And what’s more, all the characters are droopy-looking and soothing to the eyes.
Do yuru-chara appear?
Yeah, or well, they’re called villagers in the game. I get to have a nickname from them whenever I become good friends with one of them, which makes me kind of happy.
Is there anything else you can do in it?
Um, you can also grow your own flowers, or travel to other places.
You can even buy souvenirs on your travels, so I feel like I get to enjoy life itself through the game…♪
Fishing is fun!
It is, right? I tend to lose track of time whenever I fish.
Sigh… I just remembered the big catch I failed to get yesterday… Man, I could’ve caught me a good one…
3/3
Oh yeah, there was a game Tetora-kun recommended me to play with him… Um, I think it’s this one? Lemme download it…
Eep—! What’s with this giant on the screen…? There’s a few characters carrying a weapon in their hands, too… T-This is terrifying!
This game’s fun.
Hm? Do you play this game, Anzu-san?
Huh, if you recommend playing it too, then I guess I’ll give it a shot…
Are you okay?
I’m sorry for surprising you… I’m alright now.
Um, I think the tutorial started or something? I guess I’ll just get through this first…
It’s a popular game, isn’t it?
Oh yeah, you reminded me that my stylist mentioned playing this game… They said their favorite character is the one who takes photos, but I’m not sure which character that is.

entry.title: Ninja Clan – Midori Mini Talk: Eeeggy-eggy-eggyplant
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Ninja Clan
1/3
I’m so sorry for making you help me with packing up the eggplants.
I’m going to send this box of eggplants to Morisawa-senpai. I sent him this urgent message the other day, but he arrived late to our meeting anyway, so this is going to be his punishment.
“Eeeggy-eggy-eggplant…?”
Yeah, it’s as it says: eeeggy-eggy-eggyplant. It’s Eggplant Baron, after all.
Oh, yeah—Could you draw me a picture of Eggplant Baron, Anzu-san? It’d help boost my spirits.
Would this really count as a punishment?
Well, it’d definitely work as one for Morisawa-senpai.
But I heard heroes grow stronger the more powerful the adversary, so maybe he’ll actually cry tears of joy over the opportunity.
These are pretty good eggplants.
Fufu, aren’t they? I chose the absolute best we had in our greengrocer. You can tell how fresh it is from the smooth and silky feel, and the green calyx is clearly in good shape~ I can guarantee its tastiness~♪
2/3
Whew… I packed a lot inside, so it’s heavier than expected… I’m sorry to ask this of you, but could you please press the button on the elevator for me? My hands are tied carrying this box. I’m going to carry this over to Seisoukan Dorm, so I’d like to go down to the lobby.
Should I carry it for you, instead?
No, please don’t worry about it. I deliver this many vegetables all the time, so I’m used to it.
Plus, I’d get scolded if I make you of all people carry this for me…
What if you placed it down for now?
Hmm… But we’ll reach the lobby pretty quickly, won’t we…?
It’s harder to carry it back up, so I’d rather hold onto it all the way.
I’ll join you.
Huh? Do you have something to do at the dorms?
Ohhh, you’d like to pick up Trickstar for their remote photoshoot? They must be really busy lately, too…
3/3
Alright, we’ll have to part ways here. Thank you for your hard work, Anzu-san.
I’m going to place this box in front of Morisawa-senpai’s room. I’m excited to see how he’ll react…♪
Oh, and this eggplant is for you. It’s my thanks for helping me out, so please take it.
Thank you.
Don’t worry about it~♪ I can guarantee its quality, so please eat it while it’s still fresh. You’d definitely enjoy them fried or in a vegetable stew. Oh, I also recommend mapo eggplant.
Will this make him happy?
Hmm~… I wrote “Eggplants” really big on the box, so… He’ll likely jump the moment he sees the box, for starters.
He may not even try opening it… But, well, I’ll see what I’ll do when that happens.
You’re very close, huh?
Huh? Do you mean me and Morisawa-senpai are close?
Whaaat, no way… What made you think we’re on close terms…?1

entry.title: Ninja Clan – Shinobu Mini Talk: Go Go Ninja Training
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Ninja Clan
1/3
Aaalright, it is time I commence my ninja training for today~!
But first, I must do my warm-ups! One, two, three~☆ Ohh! Anzu-dono! Hello there~♪ (waves)
Oh right…
Hmhm, you’d like to send some documents to the Student Council? I plan to go to the office after this, so you may leave it in my hands.
I was looking for you.
Mm? Do you have business with me?
Ooh, I see. You have a question about accounting. You can count on me for that!1
What were you doing?
Why, ninja training, of course! Would you like to join me, Anzu-dono? You are wholly welcome to! ♪
2/3
The way of the ninja also starts from the first step. It is important to train on a daily basis, bit by bit.
I’ve compiled training regimens on a ninja scroll; which one are you interested in, Anzu-dono? For example, there’s ninja training in which you plant down hemp, and then jump over it every day.
Shuriken training.
Mhm, mhm. Shurikens are absolutely essential to a ninja! I bought me new shuriken just the other day~ They’re made of rubber so they do not stab into anything, but they can fly far~♪
Wall climbing.
In order to become a ninja, a nimble body is indispensable!
Ahh, but I haven’t been climbing the school walls ever since I joined the Student Council. I would only bring trouble to Isara-dono if I caused an incident.
Kuji.
Rin-hyou-tou-sha-kai-jin-retsu-zai-zen!, correct? It is used when composing oneself, or when enhancing one’s mind state, so I often recite it before Ibegin training.
3/3
Well then, it is time to resume my training!
…Mm? My phone is ringing. Erm, it’s from Isara-dono? Ermmm, it seems he has something to speak to me about… I wonder what it could be…?
Maybe it’s Student Council work?
But I believe I shouldn’t have any accounting work for the time being…?
Well, thinking about it won’t get me anywhere, so I shall head on to the Student Council Office straight away.
Maybe about work?
That might be likely, indeed. Isara-dono is always so busy, so I hope to exert my full efforts for his sake, as well!
Maybe about Ryuseitai?
Hmm, that would likely be about Ryuseitai-N, then…2 However, that would mean he’d contact Tetora-kun instead. Perhaps it’s a topic he can’t speak to Tetora-kun about so easily?

entry.title: Ninja Clan – Shinobu Mini Talk: The Ninja’s Tears
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Ninja Clan
1/3
…………
Ahh, Anzu-dono. Hello there…
Uu, sniff… Seeing Anzu-dono made the tears come back…
Are you alright!?
I’m alright! I’m brimming with energy, as you can see!
…I can’t lie at all~ I’m so sorry, I tried to put up a smile to brighten myself up~!
What’s wrong…?
Sniff… I think I felt relieved seeing you, Anzu-dono… I apologize for causing you concern. I will stop crying in due time…
Calm down.
M-Mhm… I apologize for causing you trouble…
It’s alright for me to drink water? Thank you very much…
2/3
The truth is, the reason Isara-dono called for me was to talk about the Ninja Association. He said that if no new members join the Ninja Association, it will be closed…
I have worked so hard in it for so long, this is just too much…
So that’s what happened…
It’s true that no new members joined, but I’ve done plenty of activities on my own, as well! Yet to mercilessly disband it… How could this world be so heartless~!?
Why will it be closed?
It is likely because of budget problems. The budget used for club activities is fixed, after all. There are now more clubs after the new school year began, and as the treasurer, I am well-aware of those circumstances…
Don’t cry.
I-I am alright. I’ve cried all my tears out. Ahaha, my eyes sting after crying so much. Maybe I should cool myself down by washing my face…
3/3
I apologize for being so shaken up in tears earlier. I’m fine now. Before we met just now, I spoke to Tetora-kun and Midori-kun about what happened, and they will be helping me out in the matter.
Though the path is steep, hope is not all lost. This is where I must do my absolute best!
Do your best, okay?
Mhm, thanks to your cheers, I feel a lot better now. I will not be able to do anything if I just stay depressed. The way of the ninja also starts from the first step, and so… I shall take that step forward.
Is there anything I can help with?
Hmm… We are still thinking up a strategy for now…
If we think of something we want you to do for us, I will come speak to you about it. I shall be counting on you then.
Cheer up.
Mhm! I’m alright now. Look, aren’t I smiling so bright? I feel a weight off my back after crying, so perhaps it was a good thing I did.

entry.title: Ninja Clan – Tetora Mini Talk: Thrilling Gameplay
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Ninja Clan
1/3
‘Suuup, Anego~! This seat’s free!
I’m sorry for callin’ out for you outta nowhere. You looked like you were trynna find a seat, sooo… Would you like to sit here for lunch?
Are you okay with that?
‘Course! You’re free to sit here. I was gonna eat lunch on my own today, so if anything, I feel super lucky that I get to eat with you!
Thank you.
Don’t worry about it. Did you bring your own lunch box today, Anego?
I’m having the kalbi meal! I’m gonna gobble this all up and work hard on the rest of my classes~♪
Where are the other two?
Ahh, Midori-kun’s got work, and Shinobu-kun has Student Council duties. We sometimes eat in class whenever we can, but I’m on my own today, so I came to the Garden Terrace to eat instead.
2/3
Oh yeah, Midori-kun told me you play this game, too.
Ohh, you’re super into it? Isn’t it so fun~♪ I get so into the game that I almost lose sleep over it.
Sleep on time, okay?
‘Course! I make sure I sleep before it’s midnight. Narukami-senpai’s always warning me that lack of sleep is bad for my skin, so I always stop playing by the time I gotta sleep.
Would you like to play together?
That’d be great~ Let’s play together after we eat! We’ll have to friend each other in-game. Couldja give me your player ID, please?
Which character do you like?
Hmm~… It ain’t my style to run away all the time, so I like playin’ characters that can fight.
What ‘bout you, Anego? Ohhh~ It’s just like you to use that type of character~♪
3/3
Ah, the bell’s gonna ring soon.
Ehehe, I never thought I’d get to play with you, Anego! We’ll have to end it here for today, but I’d love to play with you again sometime, if that’s alright!
Let’s play it with everyone.
You bet! I’d love to play it with you, Shinobu-kun, and Midori-kun. How ‘bout we play on our next lunch break? Aight, I’ll ask ‘em if they’re free. I’ll let ya know if it’s a yes!
Okay, next time then.
Ohhh!? You’re up for another round, I see~♪ I wanna see if I can invite other people to play with us, then.
Hmm… I think Sora-kun might be playing it too, so maybe I’ll try asking him?
That was a lot of fun.
You betcha, I really got into it~♪
Woah—! The bell rang. I gotta head to class quick! I’ll see ya later, Anego!

entry.title: Ninja Clan – Tetora Mini Talk: I Don’t Get It
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Ninja Clan
1/3
Uu~myu… How the heck did our seniors understand what they needed to do through “eggy-eggplant” alone? Maybe I’m the weirdo here… I do need to keep my common sense in check at all times, to be fair…
No, no! It can’t be me who’s weird here~!
What’s wrong?
Ah! Anego, great to see ya! I hope you’re doing well.
Um, you saw me rackin’ my brains? Ahaha, it’s no big deal, please don’t worry ‘bout it.
Um…
Woah—! Please don’t scare me like that, Anego…!
I can barely tell you’re there when you stand behind me without making a sound… I’m so sorry for yelling.
By eggy-eggplant, do you mean…
Huh? You know ‘bout it, Anego?
Midori-kun sent a fishy message to Morisawa-senpai, but he managed to understand it just fine, and I just don’t get how~…
2/3
Eh? You helped Midori-kun out with packing up eggplants in a box?
Ahaha, he seriously sent Morisawa-senpai eggplants? I thought that was a joke…
Us in Ryuseitai were able to meet up as the five of us together after so long, and we had a li’l discussion ‘bout eggplants.
I wonder if he accepted those eggplants?
I dunno… I haven’t heard anything ‘bout it. Ahh, wait, I do kinda remember hearing a scream yesterday… It vaguely sounded like Morisawa-senpai’s voice…
I received eggplants, too.
Ohh, you made it into mapo eggplant? I bet spicy mapo would be great to have in this weather~♪ You won’t feel the heat if you just gobble down some spicy food!
What did you talk about?
The main reason we gathered was to talk ‘bout Shinobu-kun’s worries.
Huh, you already know ‘bout how the Ninja Association might disband? Ohh… So Shinobu-kun told you himself.
3/3
But maaan, the Student Council must seriously be driven to a corner if they’re actually plannin’ to disband the Ninja Association~… And Shinobu-kun worked so hard for his club all this time, too…
I know exactly how much heart and soul he poured into it, so I wanna do whatever I can for him.
This is reminding me of Scroll of the Elements.
You’re right! We performed with Akatsuki back then.1 I remember when Kanzaki-senpai brought his horse, Saigoudon. That was a real surprise!
Like when he got super excited about a ninja scroll…
Oh yeaaah, somethin’ like that happened, right? Midori-kun told me ‘bout it. Shinobu-kun got super excited by the thought of finally finding a real ninja scroll, yeah?
I remember he’d climb the walls often.
Oh yeah, that was part of his training. He used to practice the Cloning Jutsu and the Invisibility Jutsu, too.
I think he used to do a Channeling Jutsu, too, but I don’t really remember what he was tryin’ to channel, exactly…? Do you remember, Anego?

entry.content:

Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Orihime and Hikoboshi
1/3
Ah— Anzu-san… Are you here to look for Isara-senpai? Morisawa-senpai took him somewhere, because he didn’t want to talk about something where I could hear it… Sigh… I’m being left out of the group…
I wonder what he wanted to talk about?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Mm~… If you’re curious, how about going to the coffee shop? That’s where they all said they’d talk…
Even if he can’t talk to me about it, I’m sure he’ll talk to you about it, Anzu-san…
Who knows… He said it’s something between adults only, and that it isn’t for kids to hear… I’m only one or two years apart from my seniors, so being treated as a kid is kind of just… Mm~… It just doesn’t feel good, y’know…?
That’s not true.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Um, they all left to a coffee shop without me, though…? Well, whatever… Hanging out outside of club activities with my seniors, Morisawa-senpai included, would just be a pain…
Please don’t try to console me… Uuu, it hurts even further…
Mm? What is it…? Is that a new yuru-chara design…?
Uwaaah, it’s soooo cuuute! Do you have more? Please show me more…☆
2/3
Uu~… This is why I didn’t want to do a joint practice… Ahh, Anzu-san… I’m really depressed right now, so it’s best if you don’t talk to me…
Huh? Morisawa-senpai? What about him?
It’s lonely without him, isn’t it?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ahh… Sengoku-kun’s feeling pretty lonely, it seems…
But he said he’s happy to practice together with Trickstar— or rather, Isara-senpai… He keeps telling me all sorts of stuff about how amazing Isara-senpai is…
No, I don’t really feel lonely or anything, though…? If anything, it’s nice how quiet it is without him…
But, well, since he’s not around because he’s sick, I am a little worried… So I do want him to recover…
I heard that they didn’t find any serious illness.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
It’s way less noisy without him around though, so it’s fine like this, isn’t it… I heard from Isara-senpai that he went to the hospital… It’d be nice if he could get that suffocating energy of his cured as well, while he’s at it…
Ah, yeah… Morisawa-senpai got a check-up at the hospital, didn’t he… Huh, they didn’t find anything, but he could still easily catch a cold with his current state, so he’s being told to rest…?
Ugh… I can’t imagine that guy staying still and resting…
3/3
(mutter mutter)… (mutter mutter mutter)… Fweh!?
Wah, so cute! Where can I buy this!? These yuru-chara are going to be sold at the Tanabata Festival? Please tell me that you’re the one behind them, Anzu-san!
I hope this made you feel a bit better.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
(mutter, mutter)… I didn’t have to be told all of that… So annoying… (mutter, mutter)… …Ahh, sorry… I just got reminded why I was so irritated…
Yes! I feel much better now! Fufu, I was hugging my knees in the corner, so that must’ve worried you, huh… I don’t feel fully recovered, but… I’ll gaze at this yuru-chara and do my best…♪
You’re really eager.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ah— I’m sorry… A lot of upsetting things happened, so… Seeing something as perfect as this made me feel super excited…
Um, could I pre-order one right now…? I’d love to pre-order at least ten of them…
Of course I’d feel this excited after seeing a design this perfect…! Anzu-san, I’ll be absolutely sure to buy this once it’s out!
Huh? You’ll give me a sample? Uwaah uwaah, thank you so much! I’ll treasure it for life…♪

entry.title: Orihime and Hikoboshi – Midori Produce Course: Tanabata Shooting Star
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Orihime and Hikoboshi
1/3
Haaaaah… I’m already so tired from practicing, why do I have to also be at a festival… I’m so tired… I want to go home…
…Eep! I-I suddenly felt a chill down my spine…!?
Sorry for surprising you.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ahaha… You got surprised too, and dropped the juice can…? Mm? Ahh, this is for me…? Ah no, it’s not like the taste got ruined, and I wouldn’t be bothered by a little dent…♪
Ahh, Anzu-san, so you poked a juice can on me… Ahh, um, it did surprise me, but… I know you didn’t mean any harm with it… I’m also sorry for getting so surprised…
Great work today.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Fweh? …Ahh, Anzu-san, thank you for your hard work… The reason I felt a chill is because of the juice can you poked on me, huh… Fufu, this is wonderful timing, I was just feeling thirsty…♪
Ah, yes, thank you for your hard work as well… Um, I’m happy that you’re giving me juice, but… I’d rather you don’t poke a juice can on me out of nowhere… But well, I guess it did kind of refresh me a little…?
2/3
Woah— I-I’m so sorry for bumping into you… Why did you even suddenly stop in your tracks…? Did you forget something…? Fweh? You saw a shooting star, so you were making a wish…?
I wished for clear skies on the day of Tanabata Festival.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ahh… Yeah, since we may be able to see the Milky Way if the weather is as good as today… It’s Tanabata soon after all, it’d be such a shame if it was cloudy that day…
I’m also hoping that we’ll have clear skies that day…♪
It’d be a shame if it was rainy that day, after all… If it does rain, I can’t deny that I’d feel relieved if it means Tanabata Festival will have to be cancelled… But it’d feel way worse if all our practice went to waste, so I guess I’d rather there be clear skies…?
I wished for Tanabata Festival to be a success.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ahhh… Tanabata Festival… Hahh…… There’s only a little bit left until Tanabata Festival, huh…
Ah no, I do know that… It’s just that, every time I remember it’s soon, I get super depressed…
Fufu. …Ahh, I’m sorry for laughing…
It’s just… That’s so like you to wish for, Anzu-san… Huh? Me?
Mm~… For me, I’d wish to live a peaceful life, or to be surrounded by yuru-chara… something like that…♪
3/3 Note: The 3/3 part is on the day of Tanabata Festival, unlike the 1/3 and 2/3 parts.
Ughh… Did that guy really get sick…? He’s as energetic as ever… He’s been going around eating food from every stall, and playing that target shooting game…
He even found a super sentai mask and got super excited over it… It’s like he’s a little kid…
Festivals are fun for everyone, after all.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
…But Anzu-san, you don’t seem to be having fun, are you…? Ahh… Since you’re the one behind this event, you can’t really afford to enjoy yourself right now…? Um… I know I’m not one to say this, but please do your best, okay…?
Um… I think it’s a little misleading to say "everyone"… I’m the type to only see festivals as a pain… It’s hot, it’s loud, and I’d rather be in my room with the AC on instead of going to a festival…
You seem happy.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I don’t mean to be rude to a senior, but… Are you sure you don’t have bad eyes, Anzu-san…? I’m practically plummeting into depression right now… Sigh, I’m so depressed, I wanna die… But if I start sighing, Morisawa-senpai would probably tell me to cheer up…
Ahh… That’s probably because I got the plushie Morisawa-senpai won from the target shooting game… Fufu, its face is so odd, you can’t even tell whether it’s a bear or a dog… It’s suuuper cute…♪ Morisawa-senpai does some nice things sometimes, huh…♪

entry.title: OVERFLOW! – Chiaki Mini Talk: The Joy Of Reading
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
OVERFLOW!
1/3
…Phew. Sorry I kept you waiting, Anzu. Because you gave me time to read, I could read the whole novel until the end.
The novel is a murder-mystery, and a character I never predicted to be the culprit turned out to be the one behind it all… It was so shocking that I think it’ll take me a while to shake it off.
I’d love to try reading it.
Ah, really? Then I’ll lend you my copy! No need to hold back. I’d love you to find out how interesting this novel is.
If it’s alright, I want to hear your thoughts after you’ve finished reading it! It’d make me happy! ☆
Will this affect your next job…?
Don’t worry, I can switch gears once it’s time!
Besides, my next work is a radio broadcast. I’ll be able to express these feelings to all my listeners, so if anything, this is great timing!
2/3
It’s been a while since I got to take my time reading a novel, and it truly is a wonderful experience! The fun of novels is that undying urge to flip to the next page as soon as possible, while going through a rollercoaster of emotions as you read each line, and I got to remember that joy all over again!
It took me some time to read until the end, but I enjoyed every bit of it!
I’m glad.
Yeah. I’m fortunate to have a lot of busy work, but it meant I couldn’t really get the time to read. Because of that, I had moments when I wasn’t sure if this is the right time to pick up a new novel, but when something’s interesting, you just can’t put the book down.
No matter the situation, it’s always important to take that first step forward!
I understand.
Ohh, you get me, Anzu? That’s a sensation you can only experience through novels, right? ♪
This is the perfect opportunity to start picking up the habit to read!1 If I ever read another interesting story, I’ll tell you all about it, Anzu! ☆
3/3
Oh, whoops. I just kept talking about myself. You came to see me for something, right?
I know I took a while, but please let me hear you out!
I’m here to give you something you dropped.
That key chain is definitely mine…! I had it attached to my pencil case, but it must’ve fell out at some point…
Thank you for picking it up! I really appreciate it, Anzu! ☆
There’s something I’d like you to confirm.
The TV program I’m appearing in next week had its script adjusted?
Hm, hm… I’ll double check more properly later, but from what I can see, it doesn’t seem to be a huge alteration, so I don’t have any problems with this.
You could have just told my agency, but you still came all the way to let me know directly. I appreciate it! ☆

entry.title: OVERFLOW! – Chiaki Mini Talk: Energy From Fans
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
OVERFLOW!
1/3
I’m so thankful you were around the area, Anzu.
I shook hands with a little kiddo who greeted me, but before I knew it, it turned into a huge crowd. I honestly wasn’t sure what I was going to do at that moment!
That was a lot of people, wasn’t it?
Yeah, even though this isn’t a place with a lot of kids with their parents or anything… I wonder if there’s an event happening nearby…?
Ahh, so there’s a small festival happening.
That makes more sense, but I still never could’ve expected a massive crowd forming…
It surprised me.
Yeah, I’m sure. Your face as you rushed over to me said it all.
But even then, as soon as you understood what’s going on, you immediately organized the crowd into a queue, just like a true professional! I really mean it when I say thank you, Anzu! ☆
2/3
The kid who greeted me first was singing and dancing to a Ryuseitai song. The choreography is pretty tricky, but they were incredible at it! ☆
I could tell that they practiced it several times! It made me so happy to feel just how much they love us.
That’s something to appreciate, right?
Yeah, the kid expressed their feelings with everything they had. Honestly, I could feel the tears welling in my eyes a little.
I’m even more determined to respond to those cheers sent to us, now and forever!
It must’ve given you energy, right?
I’m always working hard to cheer up all our fans, but today, I’m the one who got a lot of energy from them! It made me even more aware that our fans truly are our driving force.
Just as we give them energy, they give us energy back… That’s why I’m going to continue working hard to expand this circle of give-and-take, further and further!
3/3
I’m glad I got to interact with our fans, but I ended up dragging you into it, Anzu.
So if you have time after this, could you let me treat you to something? The fancy cafe Hakaze told me about is right around the corner here! ☆
Thank you very much.
Mm. I’m also a little hungry, so I think I’ll order lunch if they offer any.
You don’t have to hold back at all, alright? Just order whatever you like! It’s been a while since we got to eat together, so let’s take our time to eat while having a chat or two! ☆
I have to go back now…
Ah, I see. Then please let me repay you another day!
Is ES the place you need to go back to?
In that case, I have business to take care of in my agency, so let’s go together! We can talk on our way there, too!

entry.title: OVERFLOW! – Midori Mini Talk: Feelings I Want To Convey
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
OVERFLOW!
1/3
I was thinking about this during the briefing too, but the letters for the radio are increasing these days, right?
…I thought so. It’s only a little, but I felt like I’m taking longer to decide between which letter to read during the segment.
Ah— It’s not a bad thing at all, really! If anything, I feel grateful for it in a way…
They’re all enjoying the radio, aren’t they?
Yeah. There’s also a lot of people who write “I’m always looking forward to the next radio” in their letters, too. I don’t know how people feel about me without these letters, so it really brings me a lot of relief.
I have to keep doing my best more and more, to make sure they continue enjoying themselves…!
It’s proof that you have more fans now.
Yes. There’s a lot of fans who sent in a letter for the first time, too.
Also, Morisawa-senpai mentioned just the other day that there are a lot more fan letters coming in the agency now. Seeing physical proof that there’s more and more people supporting Ryuseitai now makes me happy in a way.
2/3
I absolutely read everything addressed to me, whether it’s letters to a radio or fan letters. I always easily get anxious, but… When I read their letters, I start to feel more confident about myself.
It gives me motivation, like, “So many people are cheering for me, so it’ll be okay, I’ll keep doing my best”.
I’m sure you feel grateful for that.
Yes. I hope I can somehow repay all these fans supporting me in some way… But for now, the most reliable and fastest way to do that is saying my thanks in the radio.
I can’t reply to each and every letter, but I want to grow to be able to convey my feelings in my own words.
I’m also cheering for you.
Fufu, thank you so much.
I always can tell that you’re supporting us through your words and the sort of project proposals you make for us. Sometimes I feel the pressure, but… I’ll always do my best not to betray your expectations, Anzu-san.
3/3
I’ve realized just how much energy I get from my fans’ words, so there’s something that’s been on my mind lately. Which is, “maybe it’s alright for me to also be more proactive toward my oshis…!”1
So I’m planning to try and write a letter to my oshi yuru-chara soon.
Which character is it for?
I’m a little indecisive, but I feel like I’m going to go with “Tropical Troppeys” after all. They’ve already sent me a letter when we had our collaboration with them, and I just have to tell them how I feel about their recent activities…!2
…Alright. I’m definitely going to try and write that letter tonight!
I’m sure it’ll make them happy.
Thank you so much. That helped me make up my mind once and for all. I’m going to buy a letter-writing set on my way back home today.
I don’t think there’ll be enough paper with one set alone, so maybe I should buy five packs of them…?

entry.title: OVERFLOW! – Midori Mini Talk: Curious About A Cafe
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
OVERFLOW!
1/3
(Ohh, there’s so many options in the menu… I’m really excited now.)
…Huh? Since when were you here, Anzu-san?
You came a moment ago? I’m sorry, you greeted me and I didn’t even notice…
Sorry for disturbing you.
No, it’s alright. Since you approached me, does that mean you have something to speak to me about? You don’t? You just spotted me so you thought to greet me…?
Ah, to be clear, you can still talk to me even if you don’t have any business with me…!
What were you looking at?
I was looking at the site for a cafe that just recently opened near the train station.
That’s not really something I should be so focused on that I wouldn’t even notice somene talking to me, though, right… Uu, I’m so embarrassed… I’ll be more attentive next time.
2/3
So the cafe I was looking at, right… I found out through their site that they have a dessert made with vegetables. The cafe’s selling point is using only ingredients that are gentle on the body, so they don’t really use sugar, for example…
I talked to Shino-kun about it, and we decided to go together on our next day off.
I’m interested, too.
Then, would you like to join us, Anzu-san? It’s actually a pretty fancy cafe, so I’d need a bit of courage to step in there.
If you come along, it’d give me a lot of reassurance…!
A dessert made with vegetables…
Carrot cake and pumpkin pudding are standards and I know what they taste like, but stuff outside of those two are hard for me to imagine what they’re like. It also works as a way for me to learn how to expand my use of vegetables, so I’m looking forward to it.
If you’re interested, would you like to come, too?
3/3
I just sent you the dates of my days off on HoldHands, but do you have any days off, Anzu-san?
You might have a few days off? That’s good to know, then. I can do any of the days I mentioned, so let’s go to the cafe on a day that’s good for you.
I’ll contact you again.
Yes, I’ll be waiting…♪ That all being said, it’s been a while since I went out with you, Anzu-san.
Eh? You’ll treat me…? No, no, that’s too much, please don’t worry about it.
I’m looking forward to it.
Yes, I’m happy to have more people to share my thoughts with. Ever since I started getting more solo work, it also meant that I’m eating alone more often, too…
But in the end, it’s always more fun eating with someone else, and it makes the food taste all the better.
