entry.title: OVERFLOW! – Shinobu Mini Talk: Delightful Fan Letter
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
OVERFLOW!
1/3
Anzu-dono, I know this is sudden, but may I boast about something?
You see, I received a fan letter from an elementary school boy, who is a fan of I. In the letter, he wrote that he grew to admire ninjas due to my influence, and will soon be performing a period drama for his school play.
That’s incredible influential power.
Ehehe…♪ What is actually amazing is the charm of ninjas and not myself, but it still made me so happy. Performing a period drama for his school play is quite the remarkable taste!
I’m so curious to see what it entails; I wish I could see a glimpse of it, at least!
Will he be the ninja role?
It appears so. And what’s more, the ninja plays an active role in the play.
I wonder if he will wear ninja garbs while performing action scenes? I’m so curious.
Either way, I hope that he enjoys playing the ninja part in his own way!
2/3
I could not even believe it at first when I realized a little kid grew to love ninjas because of me. I’m certain if I told my past self before he entered Yumenosaki, he would be shocked to his core.
I hope that my interests continue to spread out to even more people through my idol activities, it would truly make me so happy~♪
I’m sure it will.
Hearing you say it so confidently makes me feel as though it truly will happen! I’m sure it’s as you say; if I keep working hard as part of Ryuseitai, that day will surely come soon enough.
Slowly but surely, I will make sure to spread the beauty of ninjas to not only Japan, but even the whole wide world!
I wish I could see your surprised face then.
The surprised face of my past self?
Ahaha, me too. And I would’ve loved to share the joy and celebrate with him right after! ♪ Time travelling is impossible, but… There’s nothing wrong with imagining scenarios~♪
3/3
I apologize for turning this all about my boasting.
I don’t know if this can work as repayment, but I would love you to tell me anything you’d like to boast about, Anzu-dono~♪ Or does “boast” as a topic make it a little harder for you to speak about? I don’t mind hearing out something wonderful that happened to you recently.
I was given some delicious sweets.
So the sweets you received from a staff member at your work were delicious?
…Eh? It was a pound cake that would take three hours of waiting in queue to buy, even on week days? Doesn’t that mean it was an exceptionally delicious one…?
Progress on my schedule is going great.
I see! The schedule you were in charge of for a job is moving smoothly. That’s absolutely incredible! This is the proof of your hard work, Anzu-dono~♪
I would love you to teach me tips and tricks to managing schedules as well, as reference point for the future.1

entry.title: OVERFLOW! – Shinobu Mini Talk: Flawless Preparations
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
OVERFLOW!
1/3
Whew, I wasn’t sure what I was going to do for a moment there. Not only did I drop my shopping bag due to how heavy it was, but everything spilled out of it as well…
Once again, thank you so much for helping me pick them back up!
You’re welcome.
You truly are very kind, Anzu-dono. After all, you picked up the items even without the knowledge that they belonged to me at first, correct?
That part of you is very much like a hero in a way~♪
That surprised me.
Ahaha, it would be surprising to suddenly see shampoo and soap rolling on the pavement, yes. I caused you trouble due to my carelessness, and I feel bad for it.
This is another reminder to myself that I shouldn’t buy too much at once. I’ll carve that note inside of me!
2/3
You’re curious to know what I stocked up so much of?
I was thoroughly preparing myself for the tour we will have for the Fan ThanX Festival. Since it is a special occasion, I thought to tackle this with a flawless set-up.
Now I only need to prepare for my physical health… What must I be attentive of to keep myself fully energized on the day of the tour?
Proper nutrition is important.
That makes sense, since food is directly connected to our health. It might be a good idea to think up a food plan for the coming days until the tour, to keep myself properly nourished.
It would greatly help me to hear your thoughts on what would make for good meals, Anzu-dono.
Resting properly is important.
You’re right, I doubt recklessly working hard would be good for my health. I haven’t been able to take the time for myself due to practice lessons and preparations…
But I shall find the spare time to take breaks, just as you advise, Anzu-dono.
3/3
I am absolutely grateful for you lending me an ear, Anzu-dono.
Ah, I know! Please let me give you a present of some sort. Here, this is a shuriken-shaped bath bomb! I heard that if you’re lucky, a tiny figurine may appear from inside~♪
What kind of figurine?
Apparently, it would be a ninja-themed figurine, such as a shuriken or katana model. Among them is the rarest of them all; the golden shuriken~♪
Although, such a color would make it the opposite of hidden. But still, it’s human nature to want something that is called rare.
If it appeared…
If a figurine appeared, you would give it to me?
I appreciate the thought, but I gave that bath bomb to you, Anzu-dono. If you struck gold, I would be much happier if you kept it for yourself~♪

entry.title: OVERFLOW! – Tetora Mini Talk: Favorite Drama
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
OVERFLOW!
1/3
Ah, Anego! You’re here at the perfect time. I was just in the mood to talk to someone!
There’s a drama with a karateka as the main character, and I binge-watched the whole series the other day. It was super good! I still feel so blown away even after I’ve finished it, and all the best scenes keep loopin’ in my head!
I’m a little curious now.
The main character was so manly, so upright and earnest, and he never lost heart even after his harsh past… He was just so cool!
Huh, come to think of it, he was kinda similar to Taishou in a way…?
Actually, he totally was! Taishou really is the man among men of all time!
I’d like to watch it.
I’m sure you’d get hooked too, Anego! It’s such a classic type’a emotional story~♪ I really felt for the main character by the end, that I couldn’t help tearin’ up a li’l…
I’m gonna grow and become a great, big man one day, just like the main character of that drama~!
2/3
The theme song for the drama was amazin’, too~ Every time there was an emotional scene, it’d come on at just the right timin’. It’s a real catchy song, so I keep hummin’ it… Everyone in Ryuseitai even asked me what song I was hummin’.
I gotta improve myself even more so that I can sing songs like that! Songs that make you really feel the story!
That’s a great feeling to have.
Heheh! I’m so happy to hear that from ya, Anego~♪
I feel so motivated now! I’d love to have a practice lesson straight away, even! But I have a job soon, so I’ll hold it in for now, and make sure to keep this determination in mind ‘til the next lesson.
You’re already so wonderful.
Thank you for saying that, Anego! It really motivates me~♪
But I wanna keep aimin’ higher and higher. That’s just another reason why I’mma fire myself up for all my practice lessons! Ossu!
3/3
Just the other day, Narukami-senpai told me that watching different kinds of series is another great way to train. I didn’t really get it when she first told me…
But this drama that I watched on a whim ended up inspirin’ me a lot, so I finally get it now.
You really like dramas, huh?
Ahaha, I totally do.1 I always check what TV drama is on right now, and whenever I find a good one, I get so absorbed into it.
But I’m not skippin’ out on training by watching dramas all the time! Sometimes I watch ‘em while working out! I get to have new input and do some training, so it’s the perfect two birds with one stone~♪
What will you watch next?
I was just thinkin’ about that, actually. So now that you mentioned it, I’d love to hear your recommendations if you have any, Anego!
…Hm, hm. I’ll watch ‘em in order, so I’ll let you know my thoughts once I’m done~♪

entry.title: OVERFLOW! – Tetora Mini Talk: Choosing A Present
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
OVERFLOW!
1/3
Ohh, so this is a new one too, huh~ It looks like it’s made with a good balance of ingredients~ And as for this one…
Ah! Anego! Hello, thank you for your hard work! This protein catalogue? Taishou gave me refreshments the other day, so I’m pickin’ out somethin’ to give him back.
That’s so admirable of you.
Heheh, feels embarrassing bein’ told that.
But Taishou is way more admirable and kind, y’know! Even after he graduated, he’s still always concerned ‘bout me… I can never thank him enough.
I thought it was for yourself.
Yeah, I also stock up for myself! You gotta have these if you work out every day, after all. But this one’s gonna be for Taishou. Lookin’ at all the options makes me wanna get some for myself, but I’ll hold it in for now.
Since this is gonna be a special gift, I wanna choose a flavor of drink Taishou hasn’t tried before, but I can’t decide at all…
2/3
By the way, how does kinako yoghurt flavor sound…? Accordin’ to the reviews, it’s not that sweet, so it’s easy to drink, but I haven’t actually tried it myself.
Maybe it’s too risky goin’ with this flavor for protein shake…?
I think it sounds nice.
Hearin’ that from you gives me relief, Anego! Plus, I feel like Taishou wouldn’t hate a flavor like this.
…Aight, I’ll note it as one option I might take! Thanks for the advice!
Maybe a more standard flavor is better.
You’re right, you can’t go wrong with typical flavors like chocolate. But I wanna surprise him with a flavor he hasn’t tried before, too…
Y’know what, I’ll buy both the standard flavor and risky flavor, and have him try both!
3/3
Thanks to you, Anego, I feel like I got to choose the right present~♪
By the way, how do you usually go ‘bout choosing repayment gifts for refreshments you receive? Although, since it’s you, I feel like you easily manage to choose somethin’ for people…
I think over it a lot.
I guess everyone struggles to choose presents for people, huh?
Plus, knowing that all the time I spend pondering is also the same amount of time I’m ponderin’ over the person I’m choosing a gift for… makes even the thinking process a lotta fun for me! It’d make me so happy if Taishou enjoys the repayment gift I got him, even if only a li’l~♪
You’re right, I don’t think it takes me long to decide.
“When I’m not sure what to get, I ask the person directly first,” huh… That makes sense, that way you can’t go wrong, yeah? But when you want to have it as a surprise, you double-check the person’s tastes or wants beforehand, huh?
I’m learnin’ so much! I’ll also try to keep everyone’s tastes in mind in my daily life more often, not just Taishou’s!

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Chiaki Produce Course: Ryuseitai Summer
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Pirate Festival
1/3
Summer! Sea! Ryuseitai…☆
Mm! The sea in the summer really is superb! And that’s why I couldn’t help myself from yelling for no particular reason…!
Isn’t it hot…?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
It’s because you keep thinking it’s hot that you feel that way. The saying goes, “Sickness and health start with the mind,” right?
Blow away the heat with your state of mind! Fuhahahaha…! ☆
Yeah, it’s hot…☆ But I am not one to kick the bucket through the heat alone…!
Even if it were the scorching hot hell, I will make sure to blaze a bright red! ♪
(Yell as well)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ooh, I can’t fall behind you, Anzu! ☆ YAH-HOOOOO!! THE SEAAAAA…!!
Yep, I feel refreshed now! We’re counting on you for this live show, Anzu!
Hold on, Anzu! You’ll hurt your throat if you yell like that, y’know? You shouldn’t just be yelling, you have to bring out your voice from your gut.
Alright, let me show you how to do it…☆
2/3
Thank you, Anzu…! You planned this Pirate Festival for Ryuseitai’s sake, right?
That makes me so happy, I could hug you right now! ☆
(Take a step back)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Woah, you don’t need to be cautious!
I never do anything that upsets the other person. So you can rest easy and jump into my arms if you like! ☆
Woah, why are you taking a step back? I want to hug you to show my gratitude—… Ahh, right, you’re a girl, though.
Mm, I shouldn’t just casually hug you. Sorry about that!
(Stretch arms wide)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You want me to leap into your arms? That’s what you meant, right…☆ Alright then!
I’ll hug you all I like…☆
Why are you suddenly stretching your arms out?
…Oh, you’re doing warm-ups, huh! Alright, let me join you…☆
3/3
Kanata can be hard to deal with sometimes, but he’s an irreplaceable comrade of mine. Takamine, Sengoku, and Nagumo as well… I can’t have Ryuseitai without them.
After all, the five of us together are Ryuseitai…☆
Over there is…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Mm? Is that Sengoku?
He dove into the sea to play around, huh! He’s still a kid in the end! ☆
Alright, let’s go join him…!
Mm? What’s wrong? That’s… Kanata, isn’t it? He’s floating in the water while in his clothes again.
Good grief, Kanata’s such a handful~♪
That’s true.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Yeah! If even a single person was missing, Ryuseitai’s radiance would be lost. They all follow behind someone like me as a leader…
I have to really express my gratitude for that…☆
Mm, you think so too!? Well, it’s hard to manage Kanata’s free and unrestricted behavior, but…
I have to accept that as another part of Ryuseitai’s unique charms! ☆

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Chiaki Produce Course: Rushing Through the Sandy Beach
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Pirate Festival
1/3
Fuhaha! Anzu, come on over here! Follow me…☆
Mm? Why do you look confused?
We’re on a sandy beach in the summer! There’s no way we wouldn’t go for a run here, right?
Yes!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Mm, that’s a great response…! But first, we need to hydrate ourselves before we run.
It won’t be a laughing matter if we end up collapsing as we run! ☆
Wait, Anzu. Are you planning to run in those shoes…? The sandy beach could make you trip unlike the ground, y’know?
You should change your shoes to something else so that you don’t trip and fall! ☆
Umm…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I think you’d have a hard time running in those shoes…
Alright, I’ll carry you on my shoulders! ☆ There’s no need to look so anxious. Carrying you would be a piece of cake!
What’s wrong, what’s wrong!? You have to help out selling things…? Alright, nothing we can do there then.
Alright, I’ll go for a run on my own at least. I’m aiming for that sun…!
2/3
The beach means shaved ice…☆ Oh, I think I see the beach house over there…?
Alright! Since you’re working so hard, I’ll treat you to shaved ice, Anzu!
But…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
There’s no need to hold back…! We’re indebted to you with this Pirate Festival in many ways.
Repaying you with this is nothing compared to what you’ve done for us!
You’re younger than me, Anzu. The younger ones are supposed to rely on the older.
So just sit back and let me treat you! ☆
Thank you very much.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You know how to express your gratitude, don’t you! ☆ As long as you hold such a kind heart, everyone is bound to follow behind you.
That includes me, of course!
Theeere, there, you’re a good kid…☆ Now I want to treat you to yakisoba and takoyaki while I’m at it too.
Your smile has an amazing power to it…!
3/3
Gazing at the mother sea relaxes me…☆
Alright, let me go for a swim…! Will you come too, Anzu?
I won’t.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I see… That’s too bad, but it’s alright! Anzu, I’d like you to watch me as I swim.
I’ll make sure to swim even better than a professional swimmer! Fuhahahaha…! ☆
You feel worn out from the summer’s heat? That’s where swimming would help prevent that! ☆
If you swim, it’ll blow away all that heat! That’s what I believe in, at least!
I will.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I don’t mind us swimming together, but what about your swimsuit? It’s already enough having Kanata be the type to swim in his clothes.
If we have the police called on us, we won’t be able to hold Pirate Festival anymore, y’know?
Mhm, mhm, you’re very enthusiastic! ☆ You’re a hard worker, a good kid, and cute as well…
It’s honestly such a shame that you aren’t an exclusive producer to Ryuseitai!

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Midori Produce Course: Yuru-chara Summer
entry.content:

Point of View
Anzu
Translation

Story
Pirate Festival
1/3
Anzu-senpai? Anzu-senpai…!
Ahh, whew. There you are. Anzu-senpai in the mascot costume is the cutest in the whole universe for sure…♪
You really like yuru-chara, huh?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
There’s nobody out there in this world who hates yuru-chara…!

Yuru-chara costumes suit you, Anzu-senpai…☆ I feel like the costume looks good because it’s you in it…
You seriously are the best, Anzu-senpai…!
Would you like to try wearing it?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
M-Me…!? Uwaah, uwaah, what do I do… I’m happy you asked, but I don’t think it’d suit me as much as it suits you…
I’m happy enough just gazing~♪
I-It wouldn’t suit me at all… That yuru-chara is for you to wear, anyway…
So please wear it for the rest of your life! Please!
Thank you…?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Please tilt your head like that again…! Ahh, it really is so adorable…!! U-Um, could I take a photo with my phone? I’ll make it my very own treasure for life, so please…!!
No, I’m the one who should be saying thanks here! I got to encounter the most incredible yuru-chara ever…
This is the first time I’ve ever wanted to thank Morisawa-senpai…♪

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Shinobu Produce Course: Graduating From The Shade
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Pirate Festival
1/3
Uu… The sunlight is intense… I am an indoors type of ninja…
Thus, I do not feel as though I can handle this level of hot temperature.
(Tell a ghost story)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Uu, it’s scary, it’s scaryyy~… Please spare me from this ghost story, Anzu-dono!
I will not be able to go to the toilet at night at this rate~
Uu, a chill ran down my spine…
You are good at narrating a ghost story~ This has made the heat get blown out of me! ♪
(Give a cold drink)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
So cold—!?
Y-You will startle me if you suddenly poke a cold drink on my cheek~ I almost felt my lifespan shorten…
Fwaah, it is so cold, it feels good~♪ I might be able to get through the heat with this~
Anzu-dono, you have my undying gratitude!
2/3
Sleeping overnight with everyone in Ryuseitai gets me so excited~♪ I usually just shut myself in my room in the summer break, so…
Having fun with a big group is a first-time experience for me~♪
Same.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You too, Anzu-dono…? You are adored by everyone, so…
I had initially thought you were used to these sorts of things~
Ooh, Anzu-dono as well…!?
Anzu-dono! Let us enjoy this summer a whole ton~♪ I will plan all sorts of things so that you may enjoy yourself!
You look happy.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I simply cannot hide anything from you, Anzu-dono~ I’m so, so happy, I feel myself on cloud nine!
I have to express my gratitude to you, Anzu-dono, for preparing this DreamFes!
I am the sole member of Ninja Association, and so— I always wondered how it felt to have fun with a large group of people. I had always longed for it, so perhaps that’s what makes me even happier right now~?
3/3
The outfits you make are easy to wear, Anzu-dono~ And they feel quite cool when wearing them, as well. I feel as though I can sing and dance in this outfit until the end! ☆
Do your best!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Thank you for your cheers~♪ Anzu-dono prepared this job for our sake.
I will ensure I accomplish it until the very end!
Uu, I cannot handle pressure… I appreciate your cheers, but…
I-I’m so nervous, I could collapse any second~!!
The material is rayon, after all.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Rayon…?
Hm, hm, the material is comfortable and recommended for summer outfits, huh~ True, the feeling of the fabric is almost addicting~♪
What sort of material is rayon…? I’ve heard of linen and cotton before, but…
It is the first time I hear of rayon~?

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Shinobu Produce Course: Dangerous Training
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Pirate Festival
1/3
Coughs, coughs, coughcough… Uu, I accidentally swallowed sea water~…
M-My throat hurts~ The saltiness hurts~…
(Rub his back)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Uu, you have my gratitude…
Hahh… Anzu-dono’s hand is so warm and nice. I feel myself drifting to sleep~♪
Ehh!? I would feel awful if you rubbed my back for me~!! I-I can manage through on my own for something this trivial. So don’t worry about it! Please, I’m begging you~!
(Give him water)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Gulps, gulps… Coughs, coughcough…!
Eh? I’m meant to gargle this, not drink…? Uu, please tell me that sooner~…
I should gargle on this? Right, time to do so! (Gargles and spits) Whew… I feel a little better now.
Anzu-dono is truly kind just like a goddess~♪
2/3
Yo—Ha—To—… A-Anzu-dono, look, look! I am attempting the Water Spider-no-juts—…1
W-Wah, I-I’m losing my bala—WAAAHH!!
(Watch him)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
H-Huhhh!? This is where you’re supposed to save me! …Ha—! You’re testing my capability. That’s what it is, right!?
Then I shall magnificently fix my posture in a swipe~♪
Anzu-dono? At this rate, I will fall into the sea—…
T-This cannot be! I trusted that you would save me, Anzu-dono! This is an awful betrayal~!
(Stretch out a hand)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
P-Phew… That was a close call… If you hadn’t stretched out your hand, I would have dropped into the sea with a splash~!
I owe you my life, Anzu-dono!
I-I can’t reach… I am one step away from reaching~! At this rate, it is inevitable that I will drop into the sea… If I drown, please save me~!
3/3
I decided to dedicate my time forging my ninjutsu now that I am here at the beach… But I could not succeed at any of them, I am truly a hopeless ninja…
But I will not give up! Ninjas weren’t built in a day, nin-nin~!
(Look away)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Anzu-dono, it is rude to not look at someone and respond, you know~?
…Ha—! Could it be that you cannot see me due to the Smokescreen-no-jutsu…?
Anzu-dono, the jutsu has cleared now, so you can be at ease and look at me~♪
H-Huhhh!? Why are you looking away~!? You are so cold to me sometimes, Anzu-dono!
Uu, I’m so hurt…
…Good luck.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
In order to become a fully-fledged ninja, practice makes perfect! I would like you to continue supporting me as I go down this path.
I shall become Japan’s best ninja and protect you, Anzu-dono~♪
It does not make me happy to be told that with a strained face~… Uu, Anzu-dono’s responses hurt me inside…
But I shall not lose here~♪

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Tetora Produce Course: Indebted Person
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Pirate Festival
1/3
I’d like to be spared from dealin’ with Taichou when it’s this hot… He’s runnin’ around while yelling to the sun even now.
It’s a mystery how he manages not to get heatstroke.
What is he saying?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Erm, “Kanataaaaa! Midoriiiii! Shinobuuuuu!”
Uh, why’s he yellin’ our names while running!? I-I’m gonna go stop Taichou!!
Errr, one second. …Hm, hm. He’s yelling, “It’s the seaaaaaaa!! OKAASAAAAAN!”
Huh, I kinda don’t want anyone to think we know each other.
Must be tough.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ahaha, it’s nowhere near the level you go through. We can just deal with Taichou ourselves, but you have your own job to do, Anzu-san.
Really, thanks for all the hard work~♪
Ahaha, I’m already used to it. Well, sometimes it’s a pain and makes me wanna put the job on someone else…
But he’s our leader in the end, so I can’t leave him on his own.
2/3
The exclusive outfit for Pirate Festival looks so cool~♪ I’ve always dreamed of wearing somethin’ like this.
So I’m super happy right now~!
You look cool.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Heheh, you think so? That’s sorta embarrassin’ to hear~♪ It’s the first time someone says I’m cool, y’know. I wanna quickly become a cool, strong man like Taishou already!
I-I look cool? Really, like really really?
I-I’m so happy! I’m super duper happy~♪ And I got told that by none other than Anzu-san, so it makes me happy enough to shed tears!
Why’s that?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
The reason I wanted to wear a military uniform?
‘Cuz military uniforms makes you think of a man’s epic tale! I think other people would say the same, not just me.
‘Cuz military uniforms are a man’s epic tale! You can’t help but dream of wearing an outfit like this at least once. I don’t think it’s weird to long for it, y’know~?
3/3
Anzu-san, you’re really amazing, aren’tcha? You made the outfits for Pirate Festival, motivated Midori-kun for the job…
I’m sure that’d be impossible to do even for Taichou! That’s Anego for ya!
I’ll keep doing my best.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ossu! I’ll also do my best so I don’t fall behind ya! ☆ And then one day, I’ll make sure to shine just like the sun…!
That’s my dream~♪
You’re always a hard worker, but I feel like you’re working too hard, y’know…? I feel restless watchin’ ya, in a different way from how restless it feels watchin’ Taichou.
You should take proper breaks, okay~?
(Blush)
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Anzu-san, are you blushin’…? No, um! I was just thinkin’ how unusual it is to see you blush, so…
It just felt new for me to see!
Anzu-san, your face is bright red…? The sunlight is intense here, so it must be pretty hot, huh.
You should rest under the umbrella~

entry.title: Pirate Festival – Tetora Produce Course: Overworking?
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Pirate Festival
1/3
One, two, one, two ☆
Ah, Anzu-san! ‘Suuup~! There aren’t enough helpin’ hands, so I’m helpin’ out at the beach house~♪
The beach house…?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
The beach house over there~
There’s a lotta people here who came for the live show, so… They said that there’s more customers than usual~
Anzu-san, do you have time after this? I’m gonna take a lunch break soon. If you’re alright with it, please come on over to hang out. You’re always welcome~♪
I’ll also help.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
You sure? Uwaah, that’d be a huge help!! It’s lunchtime, so there’s a buncha customers comin’ in.
But thanks to you joinin’, we should be able to overcome it~
I accepted this job on my own, y’know? I can’t let you get involved just like that, Anzu-san.
Taishou’s gonna scold me if I can’t do this much on my own.
2/3
Here… And here too.. There’s surprisingly a lotta litter here~
Ahh, I’m pickin’ up litter. We can’t have people hurtin’ their feet from empty cans and bottle caps, after all.
At your feet…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
This is… a bottle cap, isn’t it? I would’ve stepped on this if you didn’t tell me, Anzu-san.
I gotta be careful about where I’m steppin’!
Woah, Shinkai-senpai…!? Why’s he sleeping here!? He could get stepped on by someone!
Please wake up, come on~!!
How admirable of you.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
This isn’t admirable at all, I’m just doin’ what’s natural to do~ It’s such a pretty beach, I’d feel awful to let it get littered!
We always gotta carry our litter with us ‘til we get home, right!
Mm~ I’m just doin’ what’s natural to do. You pick up litter when you see it, don’tcha?
It’s the same as that.
3/3
Mm~… I brought my swimsuit, but there’s no opportunity to wear it…
You did, too? Oh yeah, you said you’d buy one, right?
Anzu-san in a swimsuit… I wanna see it, but I don’t have the courage to!
What do you mean?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Anzu-san in a swimsuit… I w-…w-…w-…
I can’t do it! I don’t care if it’s unmanly of me, I can’t do it~! I’ll do anythin’, even kneel in dogeza, so please spare me…!
T-That’s… Uuu, it’s hard to explain…
Actually, it’s just too embarrasin’ to even say! Please get a clue on what I mean~!!
I see…
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Uwaah, I don’t mean that in a bad way, okay!? It’s you, Anzu-san, so I’m sure a swimsuit would look good on ya…
But there’s no way I can look directly at you in it~!!
Ermm, err…?
Uu, I dunno what I’m meant to say in times like these… Ladies really are difficult…

entry.title: Rainbow – Chiaki Produce Course: Snoring
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Rainbow
1/3
Ooh, Transfer Student! What’s up, what’s wrong? Do you have business with Sagami-sensei? He just left his seat to go buy some alcohol.
Personally, I’d rather he doesn’t drink so much… But he told me it’s to relieve stress…
How do you relieve stress, Morisawa-senpai?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Why, by watching tokusatsu shows, of course…! Huh? But I watch that even if I’m not feeling stressed…? Yep! That’s why stress doesn’t affect me! Fuhahahaha…! ☆
Fuhahahaha! You must really want to learn about me if you’re asking such a question, huh!? ♪ That makes me happy, Transfer Student! Feel free to ask me anything…!
Huh? "Never mind, actually"? Why is that, Transfer Student!?
It isn’t good to drink too much alcohol, right?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Mhm, mhm! You think so too, right!? Honestly, I feel like it isn’t a good idea to drink this early in the day in the first place. …Mhm! I’m going to stop him after all! I’m leaving the infirmary in your care, Transfer Student!
Yeah. Not just overdrinking, but drinking in of itself is a pretty bad idea! Huh? Once you become a working adult, it’s common to make connections through drinking…? That’s true, I suppose. Mm… Adults have it so rough.
2/3
Transfer Student? We’re coming across each other a lot in the infirmary lately.
Did you injury yourself in some predicament? If so, just call for me as loud as you can! Just shout "Please save me, Hero!", and I’ll come rushing for you no matter where you are!
I brought over the documents.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Hm, so Kunugi-sensei asked you to do this? I can’t be the one to take these, so I’ll call over Sagami-sensei. Ahh, he told me to watch over the place while he goes to the nearby convenience store. I’ll be back soon enough, so I’ll leave the place to you for now, Transfer Student!
Hm, then I’ll call over Sagami-sensei—… Huh? They’re for me? Ohh, you didn’t see me in my classroom, but a classmate told you I’d be here when you asked about my whereabouts?
I see, I see! Sorry for taking up your time, Transfer Student!
Not "Morisawa-senpai"?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ah, no, I’d still rush to your need if you shouted, “save me, Morisawa-senpai!” But “hero” is just so much cooler, and it makes me happy to be called that! You can call me “hero” anytime you like~♪
Mm? Ahh, yeah, I’d rush over even if you called my name.
But if someone were attacked by a villain in a hero show, they wouldn’t say, “Please save me, Morisawa-senpai!”, would they? I think it’s natural to hope someone asks for help by calling for the “hero” in those cases, y’know?
3/3
(Snores)…♪
Mm? Why is the transfer student in my home…?
Huh!? Wait, this isn’t my home, it’s the infirmary!? Sorry, I think I was still half-asleep!
Are you feeling unwell?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Mm~… I had a little fever, so I took cold medicine.
As you know, medicine is extremely effective on me. I simply felt sleepy as a side-effect, that’s all! You don’t need to worry about me!
No, not at all.
Ah~… The truth is, I tried to get through all the tokusatsu shows I recorded yesterday, and before I knew it, it became the next morning. So I basically had an all-nighter, that’s all. M-Mm, don’t worry, I’ll sleep early tonight!
Your snoring resembles Sagami-sensei’s.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Oh, really? So my snoring is like Sagami-sensei’s…♪ —Wait! You’ve heard him snore before?
Guhh, I’ve never heard it before, though…! That’s a little frustrating!
Huh, really!? I’m so happy~! I could jump with joy~♪ Mhm, I’m a big fan of Sagami-sensei! I have all the shows he’s appeared in back at my home! Let’s watch them all together sometime, Transfer Student!

entry.title: Rainbow – Chiaki Produce Course: Injury and Infirmary
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Rainbow
1/3
Heeey, Transfer Student! Mm? Ahh, no, I didn’t have anything to speak to you about! I happened to see you while walking, so I felt like calling out to you.
Ah— Sorry! Do you have an urgent matter by any chance!?
Do you have Ryuseitai practice now?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Yeah! I can’t help but feel so fired up the moment I don my exclusive uniform~♪
Woah— What’s wrong? Why are you crouching down all of a sudden…? Do you feel unwell? There’s a small part that’s come loose…? Ooh, you’re right! I’ll let Kiryu know so he can stitch it back up!
Ah, no. I had planned for one, but nobody was available for that time-slot in the end. There’s nothing I can do about that, so I was just heading back to my classroom.
Ahaha. Oh well, there are days like this, too. Right then, see you, Transfer Student!
It’s lunch time now.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Oh yeah, the hot and sour soup noodles are on the school’s menu today, right? Hm, so that’s on Wednesday? I see, I see. You remember the menu well, huh?
Huh? Today is Mapo—No, don’t say the rest! Eggplants are the one thing I can’t staaand~!
Lunch time, huh… Ahh, it’s nothing, I just haven’t eaten yet either. Mm? Would I like to eat with you? Thank you for the invitation! I’d love to do so! ☆
2/3
Oh! Perfect timing! Transfer Student, look! Mm? Why am I happily showing you my injured arm?
Heh! Why would I hide my injury, when it’s Sagami-sensei who treated it!?
Doesn’t it hurt?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Woah— Don’t poke my injured arm! Ah, no, it’s just a scratch… so it wouldn’t hurt if you poked it, but…
Ah! The bandage was loose, so you were fixing it for me? Sorry, I got the wrong idea! Thank you…☆
Well, I got injured, so of course it hurts.
Mm? Ahh, yeah, I work as a stuntman! I’ll get scratches even if I take caution.
You’re a big fan of Sagami-sensei, after all.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Huh!? How come you know that!? Ahh, I got it. You’re the producer, so you know all about our interests, right?
Hm? He told you about it even though you didn’t ask…? What did he mention…? Transfer Student, please tell me more!
Yeah, I keep mentioning it here and there, so it seems like I’m the first person that comes to mind when someone thinks of Sagami-sensei’s big fan. You see, Sagami-sensei was Ryusei Rainbow back in his day…
Mm? This sounds like it’ll take a while, so you’d like me to keep it for another time? Alright! Let me know when you have time to listen~♪
3/3
(Humming) Hmhmhm~♪ — Woah, Transfer Student!?
A-Are you alright!? I didn’t expect someone to be crouched down here, so I accidentally tripped over you! Let me take you to the infirmary to have you treated! Hop on my back!
It’s my fault too, so please don’t worry about it.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
No, no! It’s my fault as well for not looking around me! We’ll just repeat this cycle, so… are you alright? …Hm, no injury?
Ah, but your uniform got dirty… Please let me pay for the dry cleaning!
There’s no denying that I bumped into you, so it’s impossible for me not to worry about it! Mm~… I’m glad you feel that way, but… I won’t find peace of mind with that!
Please! Let me help you until I feel satisfied!
That’s embarrassing, so I’d rather not.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Hey now, this isn’t the time to be embarrassed! C’mon now, hop on me quick! …Alright, hold on me tight!
We’ve got an emergency! Please move out of the wayyy…!!
Mm~… Transfer Student, can you stand?
Good, good. It seems you can stand just fine. You don’t have to worry, I won’t make you get on my back. But well, let’s at least go to the infirmary just in case, okay?

entry.title: Sailing Ceremony – Chiaki Mini Talk: Happy News
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Sailing Ceremony
1/3
Ohh, Anzu! Fancy meeting you here! I’m happy to see you looking energetic today, too! Energy is number one when it comes to us people…☆ Oh yeah, there’s something I’d like you to see.
A pin badge?
Yep! This is a limited edition badge of one of my beloved heroes. And would you believe it!? I found it in Mega Sphere’s general store!
It’s hard to find this sold in stores, so I had to show it off to someone. Fufu, it looks so cool no matter how many times I look at it~♪
That’s an action figure, right?
I went to the convenience store earlier, and pulled a raffle ticket of my beloved heroes! I never expected Mega Sphere’s convenience stores to have one of these hero raffles, so I couldn’t help myself from pulling a few times! And in doing so, I got to win the very last action figure you can only get once. Fufu, I’m on a roll today…♪
2/3
Mm? Is that why you’re in such a good mood?
Fufu, of course I’d be in this much of a good mood, y’know! ♪ I came across something I love in a place I never expected to find it in! Come on, be happy together with me, Anzu…♪
I’m glad for you.
Yeah! I’ll display it in my own space of our room! ☆1
But honestly, I’d much rather display it somewhere more noticeable than my space in the room. Actually, maybe I could line up all of Ryuseitai’s favorite things and display them together…♪
You did it!
Thank you, Anzu. I’m so happy to share my happiness with someone!
From what I’ve heard, Mega Sphere has basically everything, so the things you’d want should appear in the stores in no time, hopefully. I assume you’re busy right now, but I recommend you check the Passage Arcade in-between your work.2
3/3
Huh, I see Kanata and Nagumo over on that side. I think they’re gesturing at us…
—Wait, that’s right! The five of us in Ryuseitai were going to have lunch together while planning our next live stream! I got so excited over the merchandise that I completely forgot…! I have to go immediately!
Please enjoy yourself.
Mm! If we find a nice restaurant, I’ll let you know about it, Anzu! You too, Anzu. You should take breaks without pushing yourself, okay? Make sure to stop after finishing a good chunk of your work. Promise me that! I had fun talking! Right, farewell now…☆ (waves)
I’m looking forward to your live stream.
Yeah! Please do look forward to it! ☆ I heard Sengoku and Nagumo have been desperately trying to motivate Takamine for the live stream, so…
I’m sure you’ll get to see an absolutely flawless Ryuseitai on stream!

entry.title: Sailing Ceremony – Chiaki Mini Talk: Looking for Takamine
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Sailing Ceremony
1/3
Heeey, Anzu! Have you seen Takamine anywhere!? He couldn’t accept the fact that we’ve been locked up in Mega Sphere, and ran off.
I only had my eyes off of him for a second… Where could he have gone?
How about we search for him together?
Are you sure? I feel bad for taking up your time, but it would truly be helpful to me! All of us in Ryuseitai are searching for him, but there can never be too many helpers around.
Alright, let’s go then. There’s still plenty of places I haven’t checked yet.
I haven’t seen him.
I see. Thank you for letting me know.
Mm? You’ll look for him with me? But Anzu, I heard you’re busy with the Mega Stream. You don’t have to push yourself, y’know?
You have the time right now? ……Alright, then let’s go look for Takamine together. I’m counting on you, Anzu! ☆
2/3
Mm~ He isn’t here, either… That being said, I didn’t expect the inside of Mega Sphere to be this spacious.
All the buildings are plenty big on their own, so just searching around the area takes a while. It’s likely going to be difficult to search for Takamine.
How about we take a small break?
Yeah, there’s no point to rushing. There’s thankfully a bench nearby, so let’s rest there. Mm? Anzu, are you sweating? If you’d like, you can use my towel.
Y-You don’t have to worry, I haven’t used it yet, so it should be fine! My sweat isn’t anywhere on it!
I’ll go buy us something to drink.
No, I can’t have you go and do that, Anzu. Leave it to me! What sort of drink would you like? It’s a little hot right now, so I think something refreshing would be nice.
You’ll go with my recommendation? Got it! I’ll go buy us a favorite drink of mine, I’ve been having it a lot lately!
3/3
He isn’t here, either… Are we looking in all the wrong places?
—Ah! This is Takamine we’re talking about, so hasn’t he actually gone back to the Star House?1 Why didn’t I think of that…! If I just considered Takamine’s nature, I would’ve realized that immediately!
I’m so sorry…
It’s about time you go, Anzu?
No, I’m so sorry I made you help me this whole time! Thank you for searching with me. If I find Takamine, I’ll let you know, too. Good luck with work!
I’m glad to know you’ll find him.
I’m sorry for making you go all over the place, Anzu.
The Star House in the Passage Arcade is a little far from this area, so we can split our ways here. Let me do something for you as an apology next time. I’ll contact you soon enough!

entry.title: Shooting Star Festival – Chiaki Produce Course: A Joint Live!
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Shooting Star Festival
1/3
Oh, Anzu! You came to school, even during the summer holidays! Great work…☆
Hm, me? I’m heading to the Handicraft Club. He isn’t here with me, but Kanata’s going there too.
The lights were on until late at night.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I see… I’ll have to thank Itsuki and Kagehira-kun.
Hm? Ahh, Ryuseitai will be participating in the Shooting Star Festival, you see. I’ve asked Itsuki and Kagehira-kun to make the outfits for us. That’s probably why they’ve been working until really late.
Wait, that means you were here late at night, too.
Nope, you won’t get me with a simple “teehee♪” I understand that you’re busy, but you have to also rest!
Why the Handicraft Club?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I’m about to go ask Valkyrie if they want to join us in Shooting Star Festival. Hm? Ahh, yeah, it’s a local summer festival. The keyword of this year’s festival is “Shooting Star”, so it was like a calling to us.1
Hmm… Where do I begin… I’ll start from when we decided to participate in Shooting Star Festival.
The story might be long, so let me know if you’re in a hurry.
2/3 I’m so happy! Valkyrie will be joining us in the Shooting Star Festival! ☆
Woah—Anzu!? You really have no presence, huh? …What? “Then it’s my turn to shine”?
I’ll help with making the outfits.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Outfits? Ahh, the ones for the Shooting Star Festival, right? It is true that we’ll need outfits made for both Valkyrie and Ryuseitai.
I’m sure Itsuki wouldn’t mind if you asked him if there’s anything you can help with.
I assume you mean the Shooting Star Festival outfits. But you’re already working on the Quarrel Festival outfits, aren’t you?
I don’t find it admirable to be doing work all over the place, y’know?
I’m happy to have more work.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
It’d be a waste to work throughout all of your precious summer holiday, y’know? Hm? To you, working is a valuable way to spend your time during summer?
Mmm~… You really surprise me with how much of a hard worker you are, Anzu.
I see, I see. You really like to work, huh…☆ Mhm, it’s good to have things you like!
As for me, I love heroes! ♪
3/3 Ooh! This croissant’s absolutely delicious! Hmm? It isn’t good to eat while walking, you say? That’s true. It’s exactly as you say!
It smells tasty.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Are you drooling, Anzu…?
Ahaha, I guess you’re so hungry that you don’t even care how you look right now, huh? I got a lot of them as a gift, so you should eat, too! ☆
Ahaha, you don’t have to get so close to it. Here, this is for you. It’s alright, go ahead and eat it. Eating with someone else makes it all the tastier~♪
Are you hungry?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Ah, no, I’m—…Hm? Did you just hear a growling sound?
It sounded like the sound a stomach makes, but it isn’t me… Mm~, that’s weird…
Ah, I’m not really that hungry, but… I smelled some croissants, and immediately felt like eating some.
Would you like to eat one, too?
format_size
Translation Notes ↑ The ryusei in Ryuseitai lit. means shooting star/meteor. The unit name means “shooting star/meteor squad”.

entry.title: Shooting Star Festival – Chiaki Produce Course: The Festival’s Hero
entry.content:
Mini Talk
Point of View
Anzu
Translation
310mc
Story
Shooting Star Festival
1/3
Mhm, mhm. I’m glad we were able to safely find the little girl’s mother. It’s all thanks to you and Nagumo. Thank you.
Now you too can become a splendid hero alongside us! ♪
I’ll be the one to protect the world’s peace!
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Oh, that sounded really good! You’re getting really into it after being told you’re a hero, you little~♪
Alright, let’s both say it together! I’ll be the one to protect the world’s peace…☆
Mm~, I didn’t expect a rival to appear all of a sudden!
Well, then again, both you and I have the same goal. So let’s go hand-in-hand and protect the world’s peace together…☆
You’re the hero, Senpai.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Thank you, Anzu.
I’m happy to hear you say that about me. …Oh? I spotted young boy who looks lost! We’ll have to part ways now, farewell!
You don’t have to be so modest. I decided you’re a hero. So hold your head high.
…Haha, well, I may say that, but even I still have long ways to go as a hero! ♪
2/3 Looks like we have some time until the Shooting Star Festival starts.
Alright, let’s have a light snack until then. What do you want to eat, Anzu? You’ll find the street food over there, and sweet food on the other side.
Street food.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
I know how you feel, I also just have to eat street food when I’m at festivals! Every stall that’s selling it looks really good, and I can’t help but overeat.
But this time we have a live show, so I’ll keep it small!
Then you want something like okonomiyaki or takoyaki, right? It’s pretty heavy stuff, so I suppose I’ll stick to only one of them.
Besides, whatever you can’t eat, I could just eat it for you~♪
Sweet food.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Alright, then we’ve got crêpe, cotton candy, chocolate bananas, apple candy… Hm, the list just goes on, huh?
For now, let’s go around the stalls and eat whatever we feel like eating~♪
Sweet food, huh? Oh, there’s a crêpe stall over there! I’ll take the classic chocolate banana flavor.
You’ll take the tuna flavor? That’s more like a savory dish than something sweet…?
3/3
Ta~maya~! You say it with me too, Anzu! Ta~maya~!
Mhm, mhm. This is what you just have to do when you’re watching fireworks! ☆
Let’s watch the fireworks quietly.
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Sorry! I couldn’t hear you from how loud the fireworks are. Say that again please! Quietly watch…? Ah, so be quiet, basically.
True. I’ll enjoy the fireworks quietly…☆
It’s fireworks, so doing this would ruin the mood? I don’t really get it, but that’s how it could be seen, huh?
I’m bad at staying quiet, but… Well, I’ll do what I can!
Other people here are doing it now too, aren’t they?
Possibility 1 Possibility 2
Alright then, we have to raise our voices so we don’t lose to them! Ta~maya~! Yes, just like that!
Let’s liven up the fireworks alongside the Shooting Star Festival~♪
Oh, you’re right.
Wait, isn’t that Nagumo over there with the others? Sengoku and Takamine are there too! Let’s go call out to them!

Translation Notes ↑ In Japanese, this is ren-ai shuukan, lit. “love week”. It’s common in schools or workplaces in Japan to hold a “theme” for a week, called “[name of theme] week”, that everyone works hard towards. This is likely a reference to that, since the song is set in school.↑ In Japanese, “gloomy” is yuu-utsu, lit. “melancholy/depression”. This is written in katakana in the lyrics, likely because the kanjis are overly-complex with many strokes. “Yuu-utsu” is the same word in Midori’s character title, "Eagerly Sprouting Melancholic Green", and similar to his habitual phrase, “I’m depressed” (utsu da).↑ The yowacchau (weak-hearted) can also refer to being bashful and blushing, hence the movement Aira, Shinobu and Hinata do in the MV at 2:05.

Story: crossing past the [vast ocean] Solo Song: Tabisuru Ulysses
Translation Notes
(1.) This song is associated with Kanata’s Bright Me Up!! Scout: crossing past the [vast ocean]. It is extremely recommended to read the story as well as Kanata’s card & outfit details! (2.) For Kanata’s previous solo songs, marine blue rendezvous and happy drops, the official lyrics are written in hiragana only. Hiragana-only text is an extremely unique trait of how Kanata speaks, and doesn’t reflect how the Japanese language is typically used. On the other hand, Tabisuru Ulysses is the first time Kanata’s solo song lyrics are written as they typically would be in Japanese: with the use of kanji, katakana, hiragana, and English mixed together. (3.) To add to the above, Kanata has sung lyrics that were written as they typically would be (with kanji and hiragana mixed in), including in his center/leader song, Bokura no Stella. There are also some songs where his lines are in hiragana only, such as Tenka Muteki ☆ Meteoranger! and Ryusei Hanabi. (4.) See here for an article detailing information about the Ulysses butterfly. In Japanese articles, it is typically regarded as “the butterfly of happiness”, and is said that encountering three of them in the same day could bring about happiness to the person. More information in Japanese can be found here. (5.) This is completely my own speculations, but I wanted to point out some interesting things I noticed. Please note this is purely my own intepretations of the song. Hover/Tap the text to see!
The lyrics “good bye/good morning, blue wings” implies that there is only one butterfly with those wings, i.e. the Ulysses is a one-of-a-kind in that area.
The guidepost could be many different things, but since it’s fading from view at around the same time the sun is setting, and the lyrics say “I truly hope we can meet again tomorrow” (implying something that isn’t 100% consistent), plus the Ulysses “journeys with the light”; one possible interpretation is that sunlight/sunrays (and maybe even the clear skies to see the light from the sun) are the Ulysses’ guidepost.
I get the impression that the song’s Ulysses butterfly is inspired by both migratory butterflies (as mentioned in Kanata’s story) and the Ulysses butterfly itself (for its vivid blue color).
↑ Kanata says chiheisen for “horizon”, and it specifically refers to the horizon between the land and sky. This is unlike the “horizon” found in his first solo, marine blue rendezvous. In that solo, it’s suiheisen, which refers to the horizon between the sea and sky.↑ For the Ulysses butterfly, please check the translation notes for more information! I also recommend the story for Kanata’s thoughts on the butterfly imagery.

Translation Notes Comment from the lyricist, Matsui Youhei:
One of the Ultimate 9 Songs presented by Ensemble Stars!!. A love song sung by five people: Hokuto, Midori, Rei, Kaoru, and Souma; “Venus in my eyes ~Tonight, I won’t let go~” is now available on streaming services! The lyrics are by Matsui, and the composition and arrangement are by Fujisue Miki-san!
While writing the lyrics, I was especially particular about the straightforward depiction of eyes that seem to gaze straight at you, the lyrics distribution, and the dialogue parts that I don’t usually get to write in unit songs, and I thought over passion, possessiveness, allure, protection, heaviness… Just all sorts of things while writing!
(1.) In their dialogue parts (the ones between quotation marks), Rei, Hokuto, and Souma use omae for “you”. It’s not unusual for Hokuto to use omae, but it is for Souma, who typically speaks in formal Japanese, as well as Rei, who speaks like an “old man”. Ore-rei (Pre-3rd year Rei) used to use omae, though. (2.) On the other hand, Midori and Kaoru have no omae in their dialogue; the “you” is implied without being stated. ↑ Here, the lyrics use omae for “you”. Omae gives a masculine and rough feel, fitting of the mature and passionate love the singers have. See the translation notes for more information.↑ Rouge refers to the cosmetic red blusher or lipstick.↑ This is likely referring to the planet Venus. Venus is the brightest planet in the Solar System, and can usually be seen by the naked eye within the few hours after sunset or before sunrise.

tell me, etched within your memories is the sight of those blues
even if you have forgotten it after every awakening
vast, vast sea rendezvous
let’s freely row through the water, and go on a far journey
lalala, lalala, the song drifts on until the end
through the round star it swims, as it lights up our path7
washed ashore past the blue, let’s search for treasure
and then, let’s swim through our dreams again
blue, blue sea rendezvous
reflecting on the water’s surface, the sky and sun melt away
swaying, swaying, with you until the very end
to the horizon beyond, let’s head toward that arch of light5
puka, puka…♪ won’t you join me?1

Translation Notes ↑ Puka puka means “floating” (Sometimes translated as “bubble, bubble”). Usually when Kanata says this, it’s to do with his favorite hobby, water-bathing, where he “floats” in a body of water.↑ As a fun note, Kanata tends to sing “let us hear” in songs, like in his center/leader song, Bokura no Stella (Let us hear the voice of that wishing star) and OVERFLOW LIGHT UP!!!!!, (Let us hear the signal that something wonderful happened to you!). In the latter song, he came up with those lyrics himself!↑ “mysterious” is shinpi-teki, similar to the word found in Ryusei Blue’s catchphrase; “The blue flame is the mark of mystery (shinpi)”. The kanjis in the word are god-mystery-like, and its literal meaning is “extraordinary and unfathomable to ordinary logic.”↑ Kanata says kusu kusu for “giggle”. He sometimes laughs with this sound (though usually translated as “ehe, hehe” in my translations), and it indicates a small chuckle/giggle.↑ “horizon beyond” is suiheisen no kanata in Japanese. kanata, meaning “beyond the other side/distance”, is homophonous with Kanata’s name.↑ As a fun note, Kanata’s last name, shinkai, means “deep sea”. Another fun note is that Earth can be referred to as “water planet”. Kanata has said a line using this word before, in Aquarium, Epilogue: “this is the gentle [planet earth] (water planet)! we are all [family], born on this planet!”.↑ “round star” refers to the Earth; in Japanese, hoshi refers to any stellar objects, including planets.

※ Translator’s Note: Meteor Scramble☆Ryuseitai! is not part of the Ryuseitai Album, but I’ve added it in here as it is part of the Yumenosaki Era Ryuseitai Discography. Album Release Countdown Ryuseitai’s comments during the Ryuseitai Album countdown. Day 1
Ossu! I’m Ryuseitai’s Ryusei Black, Nagumo Tetora!
Our album’s finally gonna be on sale! It has all our unit songs in it, including our solo songs.
I feel a li’l tingly about my solo, personally… It’s my first time makin’ one, so…
But havin’ my own song feels real special. It brings me courage! We sung every song with all our feelings, so please listen to them!
Also, starting today, each Ryuseitai member’ll have somethin’ to say. Please look forward to seeing whose comment is next! (waves)
Day 2
I’m Ryuseitai’s Ryusei Green, Takamine Midori… Umm, we’re going to release an album, so… It’d make me happy if you could give it a listen…
I didn’t really notice it until now, but we really have sung a lot of songs, huh…
And this time around, I got to sing a solo for the first time… I hope there’s something in it you could relate to… There’s also a new unit song in the album, so please look forward to listening to it.
This was Takamine Midori speaking. Please look forward to seeing who’s next…
Day 3
This is Ryuseitai’s Ryusei Yellow, Sengoku Shinobu! The long-awaited album for Ryuseitai will be on sale in two days~♪
The album also contains my very own solo! It’s a song filled with everything related to ninjas, so I would be very happy to know if I was able to convey the beauty of ninjas to you!
Also, each of our solos are filled with our individuality. The album has all our songs up until now, as well as a new unit song, so I do hope you find a song you love!
This has been Sengoku Shinobu! Do look forward to tomorrow…☆ (waves)
Day 4
fufufu, i am ryuseitai’s [ryusei blue], shinkai kanata…♪ there is only [one day] left until our [album] is released, yes…? ♪
i really cannot wait any longer, either. i may not be able to [sleep] tonight. the [album] has all the [songs] we have sung together.
and i also got to sing about my [love] for the [sea] in my [solo]~…♪ if you were to listen to this [song] while gazing at the ocean… then you too will be able to [feel] the same way i do…♪ it is a [song] that can [relax] you a whooole lot, so please listen to it, okay…? ♪
this was shinkai kanata speaking…♪
tomorrow is the [last] day. have you already figured out who it will be~? ufufu, please look forward to it~♪ (sways left and right)
Day 5
Ossu! I’m Ryuseitai’s Ryusei Red, Morisawa Chiaki!
It’s finally the long-awaited album release day! I’ve also been waiting forever for it to be released! Have you checked when the store opens? And you’ve got your wallet with you too, right?
Then let’s go to the CD store together right away!1 ☆
Oh, wait! I have to talk about my thoughts on the album first!
This album is a compilation of all our songs. I’d love it if you could take your time to listen to each song one by one!
When we listened to it again, we talked all about how it reminded us of all kinds of things. Of how we spent our days performing live shows, seeing so many people smile, and gaining energy from their smiles.
You give us so much energy just by cheering for us — Nothing could make us happier! It’s the very moment that makes us feel extremely glad to be idols! Thank you!
So we wanted to try and express our feelings of gratitude somehow, and—
Hold it right there! Stop!! Taichou, wait a sec…! You don’t plan on saying everythin’ all by yourself, right!?
Ooh, Black! I know you all have something you wanted to say too, but I got a bit ahead of myself…!
I get how you feel, but we won’t have anythin’ to say at this point~…
Well, I wouldn’t have to talk then, so that’d be a lifesaver…
This is the last day, you know? That is why we planned to surprise the fans with each of us saying something, no? But in the end, it just ended up as it always does… It is never the way we first thought it through.
now, now. we do not need to be formal about this, anyway. it is much more like us to simply do it the usual way…♪ (sways left and right)
now then, chiaki. please continue what you were saying, as our [taichou].
Yep! Thanks, Kanata.
Ahem.
Anyway! We were thinking of how we should express our feelings of gratitude to you, and decided to show it by contributing to the final design of the album. It should be very clear what we did to it, so please do get the real thing and find out what it is…☆
As for us, we’ll continue holding more and more live shows that’ll cheer you right up! I hope our voices reach you! And if they do, then please cheer for us as loud as you can! It’ll make us happy! That’s all from us! These were our thoughts on the album’s release day! Please keep supporting Ryuseitai~☆ (waves)
A video archive of the Ryuseitai countdown can be found here. CD Comments
It’s packed with passionate songs ☆
thank you for all your cheers…♪
I’m so happy we got to put out our own album!
Maybe you’ll find a song you like…?
Please listen to it on repeat! ☆ (shuriken)
Photo Booklet 001: Scout! Dogfight
Ohh, Taichou-dono during club activities holds such a serious expression, it’s so unusual! So cool…☆
Heh, right, right! After all, I’m everyone’s ever-most reliable captain! I wouldn’t mind if you wanted to join the Basketball Club, Sengoku; how about it? You’d get to see my valiant figure all you like! Ha ha ha! ☆
I-I have my own activities over at the Ninja Association, so I must decline the offer~!
002: Lots of Monsters☆Sweet Halloween
This is a photo from Halloween Party! Looking back on it now, even the nights we had during our training camp are wonderful memories…☆
Morisawa-senpai was entertaining during this event… From now on, any time he does something I don’t like, I’ll just shove a ghost yuru-chara at him…♪
T-Takamine? Is it just me, or do you enjoy seeing me get spooked by ghosts?
midori, do not be so [mean] to him, okay? still, [being close] is a good thing…♪
003: Radiant☆Hot Holiday Party
…Mm? What’s Taichou so surprised over in this photo?
Ah—No! This is, erm, um… when I came across a conversation for adults, and, well… It was sort of unbearable to witness… But it turned out that I just had the wrong idea…
Taichou? What’re you mumblin’ about? Your face is bright red…?
004: Drop＊The Far Sea and the Aquarium
S-Shinkai-senpai…!? Why’re you inside the water tank!?
fufufu. i was [making conversation] with the fishies in the [aquarium]~ i felt envious of the fishies, because they could swim so [freely].
Uu~myu… From how I see it, you’re also pretty much a free spirit, though…?
005: Falling Blossoms＊Wisteria Purple of May
Ahh, this is from when Tetora-kun and I couldn’t participate because we had extracurricular lessons. I think the theme was the Genpei War…?
yes. i took on the [role] of [shizukagozen]. one [drawback] was that the [outfit] was hard to move in.
No, it looked really good on you. I expect nothing less from Mikejima-san’s casting choices…☆
please do not mention that rogue’s [name]… i feel like he will appear if we [speak] of him.
006: Shine! A Sparkling Starry Night Festival!
I have heard Shinkai-dono sing countless times during our Ryuseitai activities, but… Your voice was particularly beautiful on that day. And with the outfit, you looked like a true angel~♪
fufufu, thank you very much. that is the [best] compliment…♪ it was fun being in a [temporary unit], so i [put] my [all] that day~
007: Launch! The Night Sky of the Shooting Star Festival
Ohh! This is from Shooting Star Festival! Us first years thought up a part of the performance here, right~ We’d always just leave it up to you seniors, so… when it was our turn to brainstorm, we struggled lots with settling on somethin’.
Mhm, mhm! You were ever so reliable that day! I’m so happy you grew up so wonderfully…☆
You’re exaggeratin’ things, Taichou… But I practiced the drums a ton when Taisho taught me!
008: Snowflake❄Street Performance Of The Shooting Stars
Tetora-kun, you always do zazen meditation before a live show, right…?
Yup! I started doin’ it after Taisho suggested it, and it’s now the best way to calm my nerves before a performance.
I see…! Aaalright, I’ll learn from Tetora-kun and challenge myself with zazen meditation!
Awawa! Don’t understimate zazen, dude! Then again, Sengoku-kun’s pretty nimble, so maybe you’d manage it without any problems…♪
009: Scorching Heat☆A Seaside Beach Match
this is during that time [when] we all [helped out] at the [beach house], yes?
Ossu! I lost the match, so I felt bad that I couldn’t get us the rights to a performance…
it was a [beach flags] match, wasn’t it? tetora was so fast and [cool], actually~
Thank you very much! But, this Nagumo Tetora… refuses to stop here! I’ll get a rematch next year…☆
010: Burning Up! Yumenosaki Academy Sports Festival
this is a [photo] from [sports festival], isn’t it? midori [took part] in the [obstacle race], is that right?
Yeah. I couldn’t win against the Track & Field Club, but I managed to run the whole course.
ufufu. please do get [top] place [next year], okay? i am sure midori can do it…♪
The thought of doing this next year depresses me… But if Transfer Student-san cheers me on with the sports festival mascot again, I might be able to put my all…♪
011: Scout! Colorful Autumn
Mm? Takamine looks unusually happy here…?
Ahaha… When I drew an advertisement poster for the shopping district, he started complimenting my drawin’ for some reason~
Tetora-kun’s drawing is still etched into my mind, it was seriously the best…☆ Draw something next year too, okay…♪
Ooh, so that’s what it was! Call for me next time then; I’ll help out with making posters, too…☆
012: Snowflake❄Street Performance Of The Shooting Stars
If memory serves me right, this was when Midori-kun and I went out to search for the two members of 2wink… But in the end, we got lost~
Yeah. I seriously wanted to die back then…
But, but! The christmas party we went to after the Eve’s Eve Live was fun! ♪
True, I got to talk a lot with Master Artist Fushimi, too. So maybe it was pretty good by the end…♪
013: Special Training! Mismatched Pair Lessons
Huh? Isn’t this 2wink’s uniform…?
Indeed it is! We exchanged uniforms when Yuuta-kun and I held a pair lesson together! ☆ But to be honest, it felt extremely out of place to wear a uniform from a different unit.
i also [exchanged uniforms] with souma, but… in the end, the uniform of our own unit is [number one], isn’t it…♪
014: Secret Acts! The Moonlight Scroll of the Elements
I never thought you’d have “jumping through rings of fire” as a speciality, Sengoku. Honestly, I felt anxious just watching you! But most of all, you’re usually so shy, so I was very happy when you told me all by yourself that you wanted to participate in this project…♪
Ninjas were the main theme here, so I wanted to participate no matter what! If there ever comes another ninja-related job, I would love to participate with everyone again~♪
015: Bursting Into Existence☆Shining in Five Colors Supernova
Ah! This is a photo from when we had our very first hero show at an amusement park!
I arrived to the park early, so I rode on the merry-go-round with Transfer Student-dono! Heh~♪ I may be riding on a cute horse, but still, quite samurai-like, no?
Ahaha… I can’t help but see it as a kid havin’ a blast at an attraction, really…

Translation Notes (1.) Unlimited☆Power!!!!! is the song associated with Ryuseitai’s Repayment Festival story, Climax. Repayment Festival is based on White Day, the day to show your gratitude to others. Some aspects of the song also fit the events of the story, particularly Midori and Tetora’s lines! (2.) The song title contains five exclamations points, one for each member. The exclamation point (!) is also meant to represent a shooting star. The use of ☆ and !!!!! in Ryuseitai songs is common; a song that uses both is The Five-Colored Shooting☆Star!!!!!. (3.) This song is the lead track of the first Ryuseitai Album, released in March 2018. The album card quotes reference several lines in the lyrics, such as Midori’s bloomed card line, “I won’t run away from anything anymore!”, referencing his line in the song, “That’s why we refuse to run away”. Please check out the rest of the card quotes in the “Associated Cards” tab! (4.) The last few seconds of the MV reference the album cover. You can also see this cover in the video for the full version! (5.) Fun Fact! 7 years later, Ryuseitai’s Fan ThanX Festival song was released, called OVERFLOW LIGHT UP!!!!!. Since both songs are based on expressing gratitude to fans, they were both used as BGM in Ryuseitai’s Fan ThanX Festival live stream event! ↑ Here, each time they sing out a line together, one of them responds with their own one-liner.↑ The official lyrics have exactly five exclamations points here, one for each member. The exclamation point (!) is also meant to represent a shooting star. Please check the translation notes for more information!↑ A vow is typically done based on your own conviction, while a promise is agreed upon between at least two people (i.e. mutually done).

Translation Notes (1.) NEW DAYBREAK has no first-person pronouns in the lyrics, so they don’t mention any “I” or “we”. Because of this, the “I” and “we” used in the translation are interchangeable depending on the person’s interpretation. I’ve chosen to mix between the two as Ryuseitai’s development is a lot about five individuals with different backgrounds uniting as one. (2.) The “you” in “With you I’ll sing,” “The feelings you gave me,” and “The meteor that intersects with you” is clearly mentioned in the song with kimi (a second-person pronoun). (3.) This song is sung under the all-leaders Ryuseitai formation. In this case, there is no designated sole leader for NEW DAYBREAK. For other leader turns, see here. ↑ Tetora’s album card references this line, check the Associated Cards for more details.↑ Midori’s album card references this line, check the Associated Cards for more details.↑ Shinobu’s album card references this line, check the Associated Cards for more details.↑ Here, the word for “worked so desperately hard” is gamushara, which is to focus on one objective with such extreme enthusiasm that you practically ignore everything else to reach it. Another way to put it is “reckless” or “frantic”. It’s a word that commonly appears in Ryuseitai songs, and most especially fits Tetora, who sang a line with the same word in GROWING STARRY DAYS.↑ Here, feelings can be both “desires” and “feelings”.↑ This is a very befitting line for Chiaki, as cheers and encouragement are very important to him, shown in Meteor Impact, when he would always have to cheer himself on with “Hang in there, don’t lose now”, until he finally had someone yelling out those cheers for him.↑ This is a very befitting line for Kanata, as he is someone who constantly wants to repay kindness with kindness, and love with love. This is explored in the story of his leader turn, Stella Maris.↑ Kanata’s album card references this line, check the Associated Cards for more details.↑ Originally, they sing kotaetai (want to respond) without any specification what they wish to respond to/with, so another interpretation could also be “respond to (your) feelings”.↑ This is in relation to the cheers of encouragement that Ryuseitai receives from their fans as well as each other.↑ Chiaki’s album card references this line, check the Associated Cards for more details.

Translation Notes Heart Heat Beat is a song about the actual heart inside our body. Ryuseitai takes on the “heart” persona, singing to the listener. This is why the singular pronoun of “I” is used instead of the plural “we”. Comment from the lyricist, Matsui Youhei:
Ryuseitai’s Heart Heat Beat MV released! The composition and arrangement are by Yamamoto Reiji-san!
Their charm lies in each of them having their own unique individualities, and in this song, there’s Chiaki’s passionate zeal, Kanata’s gentle kindness, Tetora’s striving efforts, Shinobu’s bold courage, and Midori’s healing comfort… We depicted an encouraging song sung by the heart flowing through one’s whole body; as a hybrid that mixes each of their growths. Ryuseitai will always be in our “heart”, and I’m super happy that the choreography of a song I love is also a hybrid of cute and cool!
↑ The first-person pronoun in quotations is boku. It’s the only line in the song that has a first-person pronoun in the Japanese lyrics. As Kanata is the one in Ryuseitai who refers to himself with boku, it suits him to sing this line.

Thank you for today, too
If you feel tired, then take a moment of pause, even if you’re taking a shortcut or sideway
Look, the specks of stars illuminating you have been watching over you
Now, take all of this strength
Tightly close within our hearts, love is formed
No matter how simplistic it is
Tightly close within our hearts, love is formed
Only for you, Smile again
A kind, gentle energy
Within my heart, I’m always thinking of you

Translation Notes (1.) Kokoro de pittari ai ni naru is a figurative song title, translated as “Tightly close within our hearts, love is formed” in my translation. It can also be rearranged to say “Form love tightly close within our hearts”. I’d like to break down what each part literally means:
kokoro de: lit. with heart. There is no given possessive pronoun, so it could be “our hearts”, “your heart”, or “my heart”. de could be “with”, “within”, or even “by”.
pittari: lit. precisely fits (into something), perfectly suits (something), or comes into contact with something very tightly, without any gaps or spaces. This is usually used as an adjective or adverb (along with a verb, such as “fit into”). In this case, no verb like that is used in the song’s title.
ai ni naru: lit. to become love, to be made up of love, to transform into love, etc… There are many ways “naru” can be translated, and it all depends on its usage in a sentence. ai is lit. love, and does not necessarily refer to romantic love.
With all of this combined including the full lyrics, I decided to lean towards the image of “Coming into contact within/inside the (listener’s) heart very tightly. In doing so, love is formed”. I wanted to focus on how Chiaki wishes to be by the listener’s side on an emotional level, i.e. emotionally nestling close to someone who feels tired after a long day, and being by their side via the heart rather than through physical contact. (2.) Japanese fans are also not 100% sure what exactly the song title means, and mainly explain their image of it through “vibes”. Hopefully, we can eventually get an explanation of the title’s meaning. 2024/4/28 EDIT: The lyricist talked about the song’s title in a music stream, saying that listening to it would make you feel, “Ah~ Kokoro de pittaru ai ni naru~” without much explanation beyond that. Nonetheless, please feel free to interpret it however you deem fitting for the song’s message! (3.) Chiaki also briefly talks about his solo in the Album Commemoration Live, MC 5. ↑ I recommend reading the translation notes for a complete explanation of what these lines mean.↑ “Simplistic” here is sasayaka (lit. modest, meagre), which also refers to something that doesn’t have much to it except for its form. It’s a word that can be used to humble oneself like “It’s a simple present,” etc.
